tei:div.tei:p: bya::ba 'gu/ //shā chi/hā :muḥ//9 'a cu05 000ji 'ang 5055ji cu 7 bci kho migaX 507 khor
cho ri ri ༅ ༅ nga/ nge tre gci / sna —༷

ཿ/chi la ji 7 — tsho hwa tsho rme 9 4 0 5 1 yo ma kyi 5 ༄tsho/ /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(deb gsum pa/ )sa skya'i dpe ning bsdu sgrig lhan nas bo/rge/sa/r+sha krung go'i bod rig pa dpe sgrun khang /

sngon 'gro'i gtam/de yang spyir 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi blo gros kyi rtsal las byung ba'i shes rig gi rnam grangs la zad mtha' mi mngon pa zhig yod mod kyang / 'dir skabs bab kyi brjod bya rang cag gangs can pa'i mes po gong ma rnams kyis shul bzhag /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas lnga zhes rlud ltar grags pa las/ rig gnas chung ba lnga ni che ba lnga'i khongs su 'du zhing / de yang 'phral yun gyi phan bde sgrub pa'i thabs lam gnyis su nges pa ste/ bzo dang gso ba rig pa gnyis ni phyi dngos po'i 'byung 'phrod kyi nus pa bsdu len byas te skabs 'phral gyi bde ba tsam sgrub pa'i thabs dang / sgra dang tshad ma gnyis ni brjod bya dang rjod byed la rmongs pa'i ling tog bsal nas/ blang dor gyi mig 'byed de 'phral yun gnyis ga'i bde skyid sgrub thabs dang / nang rig pa ni 'khor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad/ lung dang rigs pas gtan la phabs te gnas lugs la nges shes rnyed par bya ba ste/ de ni 'phral bde tsam ma yin par nam zhig gtan gyi bde skyid 'tshol ba'i thabs lam ma nor ba zhig yin/de lta bu'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs chen po de dag la deng sang 'dzam gling shar 1

brtse chen 'od snang la /4skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/nub kun gyis bod rig pa zhes ming nas 'bod cing / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi lam bur bskyod pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs gtso bor gyur pa'i/ skye bo rnam dpyod can mang po zhig gis nang sems kyi bde skyid sgrub pa'i thabs lam ma nor ba zhig tu shes te/ yid dbang med du 'phrogs nas bkres pa zas dang / sgom pa chu'i dpe ltar sbyang brtson byed bzhin pa ni mthong chos su gyur pa lags/ des na yun ring gi bde skyid 'tshol ba'i gang zag zhig yin phyin chad/ spyir bsam blo'i slob gso dang / nyams myong gi mthong rgya/ khyad par du bod kyi rig gzhud nas bshad pa'i sems bzang dang / spyod bzang la bslab tshul 'di dag bde skyid sgrub pa'i lam phyogs zhig tu rtsa 'dzin byed pa ni/ gtan bde 'tshol ba'i kha phyogs ma nor ba zhig yin pa mngon thub kyi yod/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na rang re'i mes po gong mas dka' ba brgya dang ngal ba stong gis bsgrubs pa'i rin bral gyi shes rig 'di dag /dus rabs kyi 'gyur ba dang bstun te bya thabs gsar gtod kyis/ nyam pa slar gso/ mi nyam gong 'phel gyi sgo nas/ sbyong spyod spel gsum byas te rang gi shes 'jon gyi nus pa mtho ru gtang ba tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam gling gi skye 'gro kun la ya rabs spyod bzang gi legasaskyes 'bul thub pa bya rgyu ni/ rang re'i phrag thog tu bab pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin/ de lta bu'i bod kyi rig gzhung chen mo de la brgyud srol tha dad pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta che/ po bco brgyad ces grags pa las da

sngon 'gro'i gtam/lam 'dir sgrub rgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi ya rgyal du gyur pa che ba bcu gcig ldan pa'i lam 'bras dang / bshad rgyud 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu'i nang gses dpal sa skya pa chen po'i bshad srol te/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub gnyis ldan gyi bka' srol bla na med pa zhig /da sngon bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir gnas pa'i skye 'gro'i bsod nams kyi bgo skal du gyur pa la/ gnas gzhi'i ming chos brgyud la chags te dpal ldan sa skya pa zhes mtshan thogs pa de la/mkhas grub kyi skyes chen gser ri'i phreng ba ltar bar ma chad par byon pa rnams kyi gsung / rim bzhin myur skyobs kyis legs sgrig dang dpe sdur sogs kyisapar skrun byas dang byed bzhin pa 'di ni/ thog mar 7sa skya khri 'dzin rin po che dang / mkhan rin po che yon tan bzang po/ mkhan rin po che rgya mtsho sogs kyis slob ston gyi bdag rkyen las byung ba zhig yin zhing / da sngon dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis rgyab skyor 'og /sa skya gong ma rnam lnga'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grel spel zhus te/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba dang chabs cig /da dung mu mthud de chos brgyud 'dir gtogs kyi dpe rnying dpe dkon rnams gtso bor gyur pa myur skyobs bya ched/ dpal sa skya'i dpe rnying nyams gso khang zhes pa'i las khang zhig ched gnyer byas pa'i spyi khyab gtso 'dzin pa/ lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba'i mkhan po rta mgrin rdo rje dang / dpe sgrig zhu chen pa/ shes rig dang nyams myong 3

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/gi lang tsho rdzogs pa'i dgen thub bstan smon lam/ las da'i 'gan 'dzin pa/sku zhabs ngag dbang bzang po sogs kyis gnang ba brgyud/ rgyun par las mi lnga drug tsam gyis ri bad brtson byed bzhin yod pa las/da lam 'dir bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas zhib 'jug pa rnams kyi dgos mkho skong ched/ lo rgyus chos 'byung skor gtso bor byas pa'i deb drug dang / grwa sa khag gi slob gnyer gsar bu ba rnams kyi dgos mkho skong ched bsdus blo rtags gsum phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa rnams/ da lam par bskrun zhus te rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba'o/ /'byung char/ rang re'i mes po'i shul bzhag chos rig kun la kha zhe gnyis mtshungs kyi lhag bsam dkar ba'i mkhyen ldan rnams kyis/ phan tshun gzhog 'degs kyi sgo nas las gzhi 'di'i rigs la mthun sbyor gang mang gnang rgyu'i re smon dang bcas/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'dug khang nas 2008lo'i zla84sa la ga me bde legs kyis/4

bsdu sgrig pa'i gtam// cho rigs rin chen lha yi 'phrul las byung / /byung 'di rin chen mi lus mdzes pa'i rgyan / /rgyan mchog rin chen bsgrun pas dben pa'i brgyu da/ /brgyud pa rin chen shākya'i gdung de rgyal/ /de yang deng dus go la khyon du sna tshogs pa'i shes rig gi tsha rlabs dang 'gran rtsod kyi rno ngar brtas pa'i dus 'dir bzang phyogs nas go chod pa'i dngos rigs sna tshogs thon pa dang / ngan phyogs nas rkyen chung ngus kyang rang gzhan dmigs med kyi gnas su 'phen par byed pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bzo sgrun byed pa 'i dus skabs 'dir phan tshun brtse sems dang bsam zhig gis 'byor phyug ldan pa'i zhi bde'i 'dzam gling zhig bskrun par/ skye bo mi re ngo re'i lhag bsam dang 'bad rtsol la bsten dgos/ de'ang nga tshos sngar 'das zin pa'i gnas tshul la phyi mig zhig bltas nas da lta skyon yon la blang dor bya dgos pas/ re zhig lo rgyus yig tshang du 'khod pa/ 'dzam gling spyi'i chags 'jigs 'phel 'grib kyi gnas tshul dang yang sgos mi'i rigs kyi byung rim dang 'phel rim/ de'i nang gi rgyal rabs dang / rig gnas/ chos lugs dar tshul sogs la rtogs zhib mdzad de snang tshul dang gnas tshul/ drang bden dang brdzun pa / ya rabs dang ma rabs/ mthun sgriX dang ngo lkog rang don dang lhag bsam/

ba chen 'od snang/sa skya'i chos 'grang gces bsdus/gzur gnas dang phyogs res/ dgos dbang dang rang 'dod/ yar rgyas dang rjes lus/ shes ldan dang rmongs pa/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug sogs la phan bde zhes pa ngo ma gang dang gang gis 'ong gi yod med kyi blang dor ma nor ba zhig byed par nges par du spyi dang bye brag gi lo rgyus la blta rtog mdzad de snyigs 'dor bcud len bya rgyu ni shin tu nas gal po che yin/ des na cung zad shes yon ldan pa rnams kyis kyang rang kho na yongs grags bya rgyu'i slob rtsom rnams dor nas sngar gyi lo rgyus yig tshang sogs la 'chad spel rgyun bsrings mdzad rgyu dang dpal 'byor dang go thob cung zad ldan pa rnams kyis kyang rgyan po 'gyes pa dang / phan med kyi 'gran rtsod dang / 'chal rgyug bya ba/ shul bzhag gi rig dngos la nyo tshong byed pa sogs dor nas rang re'i ma 'ongs pa'i blo gsar rnams kyis 'dzam gling 'di'i thog nga tsho shar phyogs pa'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang srol rgyun thun min rnams 'dzin skyong dang 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs su bskyod thub pa'i rmang gzhi zhig 'jog par 'bung 'tshal zhes kho bos gsol ba 'debs pa lags sku //des na rang ljongs 'dir yang ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs dang / chos 'byung / lo rgyus/ 'bel gtam gyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis pa kun gyi rang rang so so'i khyad chos rtsal 'don la bsams te bltas na rin thang bral ba kho na yin kyang / 'dir nged sa skya'i dpe rnying bsdu sgrig khang 'di'i shes dpal zung gi nus pas ma lcogs pas gnas skabs grub mtha' bye brag pa zhig gi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan 2

bsdu grig pa 'i gtam/bcos 'ga' zhig rnam dpyod bkra ba'i rig 'dzin pa rnams kyi spyan sngar phyogs brdzas byas te khyon deb drug bsgrigs pa las/ deb dang po'i nang rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan 61474121na gyis mdzad pa'i rgya bod rgyal rabs dang /rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo/ chos rje sa paṇa 61827251)gyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo/ 'gro mgon chos 'phags 6234728na kyis mdzad pa'i bod kyi rgyal rabs/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan63127399)gyis mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long bcas tshan pa lnga dang / deb gnyis pa'i nang bu ston rin po che rin chen grub 62907364)kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung / deb gsum pa'i nang stag tshang rdzong pa dpal 'byor rgya mtshos ('khyungs 'das gsal po med kyang rnamathar cung zad stag tshang lo tsā ba'i rang rnam du yod pa sa der gzigs 'tshal/)mdzad pa'i rgya bod yig chang chen mo/ deb bzhi pa'i nang mkhas pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub 64971557ngor sa wa chos ldan gyi gdan rabs bcu pa/)kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung la mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun 31gas 66491705ngor mgon pa'i gdan rabs nyer drug pa/dkyis kha skong mdzad pa de dang / deb lnga pa'i nang rtag nag mkhan chen chos rnam rgyal 6ga nag thub bstan rnam rgyal dgon gyi gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa/)gyibs mdzad pa'i chos 'byung dang / mang thos paṇ+ḍi ta klu sgrub rgya mtshos shā523 mnyan yod bya rgod tshin pas kyi gdan rabs lnga pa/)mdzad pa'i bstan rtsis kun btus gnyis/ deb drug pa'i nang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos 1(nga gsar lnga rig slob gling gi mkhan thog dang po/)mdzad pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs dang / lo rgyus dang rnam thar shin tu mang po ngo mtshar lha/ pad tshal/ dbus gtsang gi gnas

ba chen 'od da skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ yig gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams la sgrings yig yang gangs ri'i khrod kyi spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams la springs yig /paṇa chen shāka mchog 64287507thub bstan gser mdog can gyi gdan sa gnyis pa/) gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i chos 'byung dang dbu ma'i chos 'byung /de geg lo chen pos gangs can du bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs pa'i tshul mdor tsam du byas pa dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags 65727641dgung lo so dgu la thub bstan yangs pa can gyi mkhan po mdzad/ slar dgung lo re dgu la 'dar grang mo tsho gdan sa mdzad/) kyis mdzad pa'i pod chen drug gi 'bel gtam bcas spyan bstar zhus pa 'dis mkhas dbang skya ser kun gyis skabs 'di'i 'brel yod yig cha kun 'byor dka' ba'i ngal ba sel phyir yig rnying lo rgyus sngar bskrun zin pa dang ma zin pa'i phyogs mtshungs rnams legs bsgrigs byas pa'i dpe tshogs 'di bla ldan skyes bu'i phongs sel dam par 'gyur ba'i 'dun pa'ang bcangs bzhin yod la thugs 'dun legs par bskong ba'i grogs su'ang 'gyur nges lags so/ /'dir mdzad pa po'i rnam thar ni yongs grags yin pas ngal ba ma byas te mkhyen 'dod rnams kyis 'brel yod yig cha rnams las rtogs par 'tshal lo//skabs 'di'i legs sgrig gi brgyud rim nang rnam dkar kho nas rogs ram mdzad pa nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi rgan dme bde legs lags sogs las rogs lhan rgyas la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin la/ slad mar phyogs gang spyi'i thad nas rogs ram zhus par thugs rje mi chung bar zhu zhes gsol ba'ang 'debs pa lagasaso/ / zhes sa skya'i dpe rnying bsdu sgrig khang na thub bstan smon lam gyis/4

dkar chagamachod brjod/ (1)'dzam bu gling pa'i yul thams cad dang mi'i rigs rus kyi rnam dbye/ (3)bod kyi yul lung chags tshul/ (6)rgya gar gye rgyal rabs/ (12)sangs rgyas shākya mu zhe'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ (17)bstan pa'i gtad rabs dang sde ba'i gyes tshul/ (42)bka' bsdu ba rim pa gsum/ (52)bal po'i rgyal rabs/ (60)rgya nag gi rgyal rabs/ (70)mi nyag gi rgyal rabs/ (83)bod kyi rgyal rabs/ (86)bod du ja dang dkar yol byung ba'i lo rgyus/ (122)rgyal po khri lde gtsug bstan dang khri srong lde'u btsan gyi lo rgyus/ (125)bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i lo rgyus/ (136)khri lde sgong btsan nas glang dar mas chos bsgrubs pa'i bar (146)bstan pa phyi dar gyi byung tshul/ (150)bod kyi blon po mdzangs pa mi bdun gyi lo rgyus/ (163)1

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byu— gces bsdus/ (nabod du gri byung tshul gyi lo rgyus/ (165)bod du ja byung tshul gyi lo rgyus/ (171)dkar yol legs nyes brtag pa'i bstan bcos/ (174)chen po hor gyi rgyal rabs cha lag dang bcas pa (182)dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs mdor bsdus/ (219)chos rje'i bu chen shar nub gung gsum la sogs byon tshul bzhugs/ (253)sa skya'i dpon chen dang nang blon rim byung gi lo rgyus/ (256)dbus gtsang khri skor gyi gtso bo zha lu pa'i dpon rabs byon tshul bdog go (262)lha dbang sprul pa 69rtse chos rgyal gyi brgyud sku dpal ldan shar kha ba'i byon tshul bzhugs/ (268)ma sangs sprul pa stag sna rdzong pa'i lo rgyus/ (291)gnod sbyin sprul pa rnam rgyal gling pa'i lo rgyus/ (305)rgya bod du gsang sngags bla med kyi chos lugs dar tshul/ (309)bod du bstan pa phyi dar la mkhas grub dang dgon sde byung tshul/ (330)'dul ba smad 'dul gyi bshad rgyun byung tshul/ (341)bod du bka' gdams pa'i brgyud pa byung tshul/ (343)rngog khu dbon gyis thog drangs bshad grwa dar tshul/ (350)bod du dus 'bor gyi rgyud 'grel dar tshul/ (358)paṇa chen shākya shrī'i mkhan brgyud byung tshul/ (369)bla chen mkhan brgyud dang sbu tsho mkhan brgyud ༷ṇa chen

dkar chag mkhan brgyud rnams bzhugs/ (375)dwags po bka' brgyud kyi byung tshul/ (378)zhe byed kyi brgyud pa byung tshul/ (390)phag gru bka' brgyud byung tshul/ (391)phag gru khri skor gyi dpon rabs byung tshul/ (397)lha pa'i chos brgyud byung tshul/ (403)shangs pa bka' brgyud byung tshul/ (405)'jig rten rnam gzhag mdo nas btus pa 'ga'/ (422)chos rgyal 'phags pa'i shes bya rab gsal nas snod bcud chags tshul mdor bsdus/ (429)yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed chen mo'i mdzad byang / (444)

༄༅/ /rgya bod kyi yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed chen mo 'dzam gling gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄za/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig dkar phyogs lha dang skyes mchog dam pa 'ga' zhig gi /dkar ba'i thugs kyis bskul phyir 'dzam gling rgyal rabs dang / /dka' brgyud bla ma'i rnam thar mchog gsum byon tshul sogs/ /dkar chag mthong ba don gsal 'di dbang kun la spel/ /thog mar rgya bod kyi yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed chen mo'i mchod brjod dang / gleng gzhi bstan pa//spri/ zu ri /spyi//bye/ ////ma tsho /// tsho ga'adzam bu nga ga rgyal rabs ngas stang thun/ 'dzam bu nga pa' yul khams dang / mi'i rigs brgyud kyi rnam dbye/ rgyal rabs kun gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs/ bdag sna mkha par gyur pa mi shes kyang / /'di sna mthong ba don na lta bur 2ga /chas pa sel ba'i glog dang char 'gro ni/ /gang la mos pa'i min mkha par 'gyur/ /bstan pa'i snam dbye byed na 'di la stos/ /de'i nang nas bskal pa chagasatshul zur tsam dang / sngar 'das kyi sangs rgyas rnams byon tshul dang / thub pasabaskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te lam lnga sa bcu bgrod nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan pa/ bstan pa'i gtad rabs/ bka' brgyud rim pa las sde pa bco brgyad du gyes tshul/ 'bum ṭīka las zur tsam bstan pa'i lo rtsis/ chos rgyal mya ngan med man gyi rgyal rabs byon tshul/ byams mgon gyi

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus (//bstan pa lo grangs 'di tsam nas 'char ba'i nges tshig rnams yod/ 'phag ba/ yul dang / bal po'i chags lugs dang rgyal rabs/ rgya nag gi rgyal rabs/dpa' bo mi nyag gi rgyal rabs/ chos rgyal bod kyi rgyal rabs/ 'di'i nang na dzo shāka zhal gnyis dang / wa ti mched gsum gyi byon tshul/ bod du bstan pa snga dar dang / phyi dar gyi rnam dbye/ rtsis dkar nag dang / sman dpyad/ ja shing /dkar yol/ lan tshwa/ ral gri rnams dar lugs/ blon chen po rtsal po che mi bdun byon tshul rnams yod/ / chen po hor gyi rgyal rabs na/ bod dud/ hor dud/ khri skor/ 'ja' mo bstsal tshul/ chol kha gsum gyi sa mtshams/ rgyal po'i mnga' zhabs/ zhing gi rnam grangs dang / khrims ra'i rnam dbye/ ba yan ching dang saṃ gha ching sang gi gtam brgyud/ dbus gtsang gi khri skor rnams kyi dud grangs/ 'ja' mo 'dzin lugs rnams yod/ sto dpal ldan sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rabs/ sa skya pa'i bu chen/ shar/ nub/ gung gsum khang gsar chen mo dang bcas pa'i byon tshul/ dbus gtsang dpon chen dang / sa skya nang chen gyi byon rim/ khri skor mchog gyur zha lu sku zhang byon tshul dang / nyang yul cags lugs/lha dbang sprul pa dpal ldan shar kha ba'i byon tshul/ ma sangs sprul pa stag sna ba'i byon tshul/ gnod sbyin sprul pa rnam rgyal gling pa'i byon tshul/ rgya bod du bstan pa'i snying po theg pa'i yang rtse gsang sngags bla med kyi chos dar lugs/ ༈bod du bstan pa phyi dar la mkhas grub gling pa rnams byon nas sde dgon btab lugs/ / smad 'dul gyi bshad brgyud/ / jo bo rje'i slob brgyud/ bka' gdams pa'i brgyud rim/ / rngog lo khu dbon gyis thog drangs bshad grwa dar 2

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/lugs/ / rgya bod du dus 'khor rgyud 'grel dar tshul/ / paṇa chen shākya shrī'i slob brgyud/ tshogs pa sde bzhir gyes tshul dang / tha dad kyi mkhan rabs/ ༈bod du bla chen mkhan brgyud/ bu tsho mkhan brgyud/ paṇa chen mkhan brgyud gsum byon pa'i mkhan rabs mdor bsdus/ /dwags po bka' brgyud byon tshul/dpal phag mo gru pa'i bla rabs dang chos brgyud byon tshul/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i dbon rabs byon tshul/ lha pa'i chos lugs dang bla rabs/ ko shangs pa bka' brgyud rin chen bdun ma byon tshul/ 'jig rten rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa/ chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i shes bya rab gsal nas snod bcud 'chags tshul dang / bskal pa che chung gi rnam dbye mdor bsdus pa/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed chen mo'i mdzad byang dang smon lam rnams bzhugs so/ /sngon med ma yin sngon chad grags pa yi/ /yig tshang mchog gyur yig tshang sgrig legs 'dis/ /rang gzhan dge bskul rang gzhan phan bde yi/ /dpal 'byor dpal la spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed chen mo'i mchod brjod rdzogs so/ // yo su sti si / bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi rgyal po skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i sku/ /chos kyi dbang phyug khams gsum 'dren pa'i mchog /chos kyi 'byor pas stong gsum dbul ba sel/ /chos rje bla ma dus gsum mkhyen la 'dud/ /bskal bzang 'di la srid pa gsum gyi mgon/ /mtshan bzang dpe byad brgyad cu'i gzi 'od 'bar/ /rigasabazang zas gtsang sras po lha yi lha/ /blo bzang kun mkhyen rgyal po'i zhabs la 3

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/(/sdi'adud/ /'jam pa'i thugs kyis log pa'i lta ba 'joms/ /dbyangs snyan gsung gis 'gro la chos char 'bebs/ /smra ba'i phyogs la mi 'jigs seng ge yi/ /spobs pa mchog stsol rgyal sras sku la 'dud//bstan pa yun ring gnas phyir ston pa yi/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i mthun rkyen sgrub pa dang / /bstan la gnod byed bdud dpung tshar gcod pa'i/ /bstan srung lha chen dpal 'bar khur mgon/)rgyal gyur cig/de ltar mchod par brjod nas dam pa rnams//dgyes pa'i phal gtam mkhas rmongs 'byed pa'i gzhi/ /rgya gar rgya nag ge sar stag gzig dang / /bal bod hor sog mi lhag rgyal rabs dang / khyad par bod yul gangs can khrod 'di ru / / bstan pa'i gsal byed sa paṇa khu dbon sogs//mkhas grub du mas dka' ba brgya phrag gis/ /dge 'dun sde gtsugs bshad sgrub bskyangs tshul dang / /de'i sbyin bdag sde dpon byams ldan rnams/ /rim par byon nas bstan pa'i bya ba dang / /rang gzhan phan bde'i dpal la legs bkod pa'i/ /yig tshang ngo mtshar phreng ba mtha' yas rnams/ /bdag rmongs blo yi srad bur rgyus ma nus/ /'on kyang bstan la gus shing mkhas pa yi/ /che srol mthong la blo gros che ba dang / /gong ma'i rnam thar dam pas gleng 'os rnams/ /brjed du phangs pas sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dir/ /byon pa'i tshul dang bka' chems bka' khol dang / /rgyal rabs rkyang khug blon po'i zhal gdams dang / /rba bzhed yar lung jo bo tshal pa dang //bu ston gyis mdzad chos 'byung chen mo sogs//yig tshang sna tshogs legs btus brjed byang dang / /blo gsal mdzes pa'i rgyan la phan phyir du/ /mdor bsdus don gsal 'di nyid bdag gis bris/ /mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis bzod 4

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/par mdzad du gsol/ /yig tshang mkhas pa dga' bar byed pa'i mchod brjod dang / gleng gzhi bstan pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig 'dzam bu gling gi rgyal rabs spyi byings kyi stong thun zur tsam gda'o/ // yo su sti/ sngon bsags bsod nams du mas rgyu byas shing / /rigs rus cho 'brang ldan pas rkyen byas te/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'dzoms pas gling bzhi la/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal rnams la'ang bstod par bgyi/ /spyir du lha mi'i rjer gyur rgyal rigs la/ /rgyas par dbye na sum brgya drug cu yod/ /de las bsdus na rnam pa gnyis bshad de/ /dag pa sangs rgyas rje dang ma dag sems can rje/ /sangs rgyas rje ni sku gsum 'gro don mdzad/ /sems can rje la rnam pa lngar phye nas/ /stong gsum dbang byed spyi phud rgyal po dang / /sa 'dzin rgyal po phyogs skyong rgyal po dang / /rigs drug rgyal po 'dzam gling rgyal dang lnga/ /de yang 'dzam gling sog kha'i rgyal po la/ /bskos dang gdung brgyud slo bur rgyal por bshad/ /rgyal po de gsum 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rkyen/ /de la spyi phud rgyal po tshangs pa dang / /sa 'dzin brgya byin phyogs skyong rgyal chen bzhi/ /rigs drug rgyal po gshin rje chos rgyal dang / /'dzam gling gdung brgyud rgyal po mang bkur brgyud/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal spyi bo skyes la sogs/ /gser dngul zangs lcags dbang bskur rgyal po yin/ /bod kyi rgyal po slo bur rgyal por grags/ /bskos pa'i rgyal po phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po yin/ /rgya gar chos kyi rgyal por bskos pa yin//byin rlabs bum pa glang chen snas bzung nas/ /de'i su la dbang bskur de la bskos/ /rgya nag gtsug lag rgyal por bskos pa ni/ /rgya yi khang pa shin tu 5

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/(//mtho ba la/ ta shel gyi skas btsugs su thar de la bskos/ /ge sar dmag gi rgyal por bskos pa ni/ /dpa' chen bzhi yis mda' bzhi phyogs bzhir 'phangs/ /mda' (bzhi dus)gcig sus zin de la bskos/ /stag gzig nor gyi rgyal por bskos pa ni/ /rin chen gling nas nor bu sus lon pa'i/ /nor gyi bdag po de la bskos pa yin/ /bskos pa'i rgyal po bzhi yi ston pa ni/ /rgya gar rgyal po sngon sbyangs las 'phro can/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi snod du rung bsan/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pas ston pa mdzad//rgya nag gtsug lag dpyad kyis 'dul gzigs nas//mkhyen rab bdag po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis/ /gab rtse sum brgya drug cu ston par mdzad/ /ge sar dmag gis 'dul bar gzigs nas ni/ /lha mo pañtsa ka yi bu lnga brgya/ /de 'dra dmag tu sprul nas ston par mdzad/ /stag gzig nor gyi 'dul bar gzigs nas ni/ /'phags pa nor 'dzin skur sprul ston par mdzad/ /rgya gar chos rgyal ma rig mun pa sel/ /rgya nag rgyal pos legs nyesame long bstan/ /ge sar rgyal pos dmag gi dgra dpung 'dul/ /stag gzig rgyal pos dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /ces bshad pa rnams rgyal rabs spyi sgos kyi stong thung zur tsam bstan pa'o/ /'dzam bu gling pa'i yul thams cad dang /mi'i rigs rus kyi rnam dbye dag go // tshe su sti/ srid pa'i gter kha bang mdzod 'dzoms pa'i mthus/ /mi srid bya ba gang yang med pa'i phyir/ khams gsum gling bzhi khyad par rgya bod na//yul grangs mi rigs rnam 'gyur 'di ltar snang / /de'ang lho 'dzam bu gling pa la/ yul grangs che chung dang mtha' dbus kyi ngos 'dzin/ mi rigs dang skad rigs kyi 6

rgya bod mig tshang chen slo/rnam dbye mang du bshad cing / khyad par dam pa'i chos kyi 'byung khungs yin pas/yul gyi dbus/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan la ngos 'dzin pa mang la/ mdo rgyud nas kyang bshad pa ni/ chos dar sa yin pa la dgongs pa'o/ /'dzam bu gling gi sa tshad dang yul khams kyis dbye nas bkod pa lugs gcig la/ 'dzam bu gling sog kha 'di/ dbyibs shing rta lta bu/ sog pa'i yu ba lcags ri ngos la bstan pa la / dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi/ gzhan phyogs gsum po la dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis gnyis so/ /de la shar gyi gling g.yog rnga yab na ljon pa rta mgo can gyi rgyal khams yod cing / nub kyi rnga yab gzhan na yak+ṣa srin po'i rgyal khams yod/gling g.yog gnyis pa'i dbyibs gong dang 'dra zhing / rgyar ni gling che ba'i phyed ma'i tshad do/ /'dzam bu gling 'di la/ yul gru chen po dgu yod par 'dod de/bcom ldan ral gris mdzad pa'i sdom pa rgyan gyi me tog las/yul dbus dang /mtha' 'khob kyi gamatshams ni/shar du li kha ra shing 'phel dang /lhor dum bu'i chu rlung dang /nub tu bram ze'i grong ka ba dang /byang du shi ra'i ri mun pa can gyi bcad pa rnams so/ shar na rgya nag dang khri brtan/ lho na rgya gar dang kha che gnyis/ nub na stag sde dang gzig 'phan gnyis/ byang na khrom dang ge sar gnyis/ dbus na bod yul gangs kyi ra ba dang dgu zer te/ 'dzam bu gling gi sa tshad kyi lte ba/ bod gangs can 'di yin par 'dod pa ni/ sa mtho/ri mang / gangs chags chu bo thams cad 'di nas phyi'i mtha' rnams la 'bab pa'i phyir 'di nyid la sa'i dbus lte ba yin par 'dod do/ /'dzam bu gling na spyir rgyal khams che chung bcu gsum yod pa'i/ ming nges can gyis 'dzin pa lnga ni/rgya gar chos kyi rgyal khams/ rgya nag rtsis kyi rgyal khams/ stag gzig nor gyi 7

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa ci'i chos 'gu pa gces bsdus/()rgyal khams/ khrom ge sar dmag gi rgyal khams/ bod yul kha ba can gyi rgyal khams dang lnga'o/ /mi ma yin pas 'dzin pa'i rgyal khams brgyad ni/ lkog la brang 'byar gyi rgyal khams/ the rangs mig gcig pa'i rgyal khams/ ske lnga rme sha can gyi rgyal khams/ sog po spre'u lag can gyi rgyal khams/ rgya mo khyi khyo can gyi rgyal khams/ rna bo che bong bu'i rgyal khams/ tshe tshe ra mgo can gyi rgyal khams/tsu ta rkang gcig pa'i rgyal khams dang brgyad do/ /zhib par phye na/ 'dzam bu gling pa la/ mi rigs mi 'dra ba sum brgya dang drug cu/ skad rigs mi gcig pa bdun brgya dang nyi shu/ lus kyi rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba bcu bdun/ rus pa lces 'gyur tshad gcig ming kha nas thon tshad gcig yod par bshad na'ang / rus kyi phyi mo bcu gnyis tsam la bsdu'o/ /de la rgyal rigs rnams che ba/ rje rigs rnams btsun pa/ bram ze'i rigs rnams gtsang ba/ dmangs rigs rnams mang ba dang bzhi la phyi'i rigs bzhi zer te/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rigs thams cad 'di khog tu 'dus so/ /bar gyi rigs bzhi ni/ rgya gar ba lha las chad pas khyu ta lha'i skad du smra/ rgya nag pa klu las chad pas nā ga tri ta klu'i skad du smra/ hor lha ma yin las chad pas a pu tri ta lha ma yin gyi skad du smra/ bod spre'u dang brag srin mo las chad pas a wa ṭ+wāṃ tri ta 'dre'i skad du smra ba dang bzhi'o/ /nang gi rigs bzhi ni/ stong dang / sdong dang / se dang / rmu rnams te/ 'di bzhi po las bod mi phal che ba gyes par bshad pas/ 'di rnams la rus kyi phyi mo bcu gnyisazhes pa'o/ /yang lugs(ga ga la/ phyi'i mi'u rigs bzhi ni/ spang phug gi 'phyi ba dang / ko rkyang gi sbal pa dang / spra dang / spre'u bzhi'o/ /nang gi mi'u rigs 8

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/bzhi ni/ gi shang rgya dang / gyim zhad hor/ kha le mon dang / spu rgyal bod bzhi'o/ /de'i nang nas/ rgya la grol cha gnyis su gyes pa ni/ dmu rus dang / ke la'o/ /hor la yang gnyis su gyes pa ni/ srin tsha dang / lha tsha'o/ /mon pa rigs gsum byung ba ni/ mon rang rgyud pa dang /rgya bod mtshams kyi mi nyag rgod po dang gsum mo / / bod la mi'u brgyud drug tu grol te/de'ang sngon dang po/ yul me kha shu g.yag zhur gyi gong khar srid pa'i rgyal bu thing ge zhes pa la bu gsum byung ba rgya bod hor gsum du gyes pa'i/ bod mi khri do chen po bya ba de la/ bu drug byung ba ni/ dbra 'bru sdong gsum sga dang bzhi/ /nu bo dbas brda gnyis dang drug /bod kyi mi'u brgyud drug des/ /dma' kha shu ras 'debs stag pa der/ /bod mi gsum du sa bgos byas/ /sdong gis pa ma le pang thob/ /dbra yis dbra mo rab bkra thob/ /'bru yis 'bru mo phrom phrom thob/ /lha yis lhar ma le po thob/ /dbas brdas rgya bod sa mtshams su/ /mtshams kyi mda' dar gong ma bzung / /de la che brgyud gong nas ma shor ba/ /pho bo ldong gi bu brgyud yin/ /mthu che dam tshig ma nyams pa / / se khyung dbra yi bu brgyud yin/ /dpa' rgya stag mche sder ma nyams pa/ /a lcags 'bru'i bu brgyud yin/ /phyugs g.yang mo'i mkhal tshil ma zhu ba/ /rmu tsha lha yi bu brgyud yin//pho bo sdong la mche drug yod//stod na pa tshab 'bri yas gnyis//bar na ro 'dze rag shi gnyis/ /smad na mi nyag gyi than gnyis/ /che drug 'chan gyi btsun drug de/ /bi ri'i mdo dang gling pa gnyis/ /ro mdze la phu pa dang mda' pa gnyis/ /gyi than la rgyas bsdus che chung gnyis/ /de che btsun spel ma bcu gnyis yin/ /se khyung dbra la 'chad drug yod/ /stod na shad zhung khyung po gnyis/ /bar 9

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(//na mar pa spu rangs gnyis/ /smad na re khe nyag le gnyis/ /che drug mtshan gyi btsun drug de/ /kri la rme sha dang rme tshan gnyis/ /brag ru la gu gu dang rdor nye gnyis/ /nyag le la kho po dang kho dbra gnyis/ /de che btsun spel ma bcu gnyis yin/ khri zam 'bru'i che drug de/ shar na zhing dang rong po gnyis/ /lho na bhe dang ri tho gnyis//smad na 'brom dang ngo kro gnyis//che drug 'chan gyi btsun drag de/ /sbas dang spos dang tsha phrom gsum//bzhugs pa stod nye nyer gre gsum/rā/ btsun spel ma bcu gnyis yin//rmu tsha lha'i che drug de//thod rus ltag rus stod na yod//bya can khrab can stod na yod/ /bya rje spen thog stod na yod/ /che drug 'chan gyi gtsug drug de/ /lha la byes pa sdo/la pa gnyis/ /ltag nas sdo/la stag 'a11ga stag gnyis/ /dbas la che skor chung skor gnyis/ /che btsun spel ma bcu gnyis yin/zhes dang / bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams dang / phyogs bzhi'i rgyal khams kyi samatshams na/ srid pas bkod pa'i rdo ring chen po bzhi yod de/ shar phyogs rgya nag po dang bod kyi sa mtshams na sha phud gangs dkar lha'i yul du 'gron bu dung gi rdo ring gtsug pa yan chad/ lho phyogs rgya dkar po dang bod kyi so mtshams snyug ma bu khur srin gyi yul du mthing zhun g.yu'i rdo ring gtsug pa tshun chad/ nub phyogs stag gzig dang bod kyi so mtshams rkang mang rkang gcig klu'i yul du sha tshe dngul gyi rdo ring gtsug pa man chad/ byang phyogs khrom ge sar dang bod kyi so mtshams ma mo'i lu rgyud sman gyi yul du ra gan gser gyi rdo ring gtsug pa tshun chad/ de rnams bod gangs can gyi rgyal khams su gtogs pa'i sa tshad yin cing / rdo ring gi spang la gzhu 'dom brgyad cu re dang zheng phyogs re 0

rgya bod yig tshang mo/la gzhu 'dom nyi shu re/steng na rgya phibs dang bcas pa yod do zer ro/ /bod la yul gru chen po gsum yod pa ni/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum gangs dang g.ya'i ra ba rdzing dang 'dra ba la yul gru chen po gcig smad lha ri chu drug la nags dang ne'u ljongs zhing dang 'dra ba la yul gru chen po gcig bar du dbus gtsang ru bzhi brag dang chu 'thab sa yur ba dang 'dra ba la yul gru chen po gcig ste gsum mo / / dang por bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams zer zhing / bar skabs su lha srin gyis 'dzin pa'i dus na gdong dmar can gyi yul zer ba'ang byung / rting du spur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams zer ba 'di bod rgyal gri gum btsan po'i sras bar pa bya khris spu bo'i brag thog tu byon nas skru bo'i rje mdzad/ rting la bod yul mthil du gdan drangs nas sbu de gung rgyal du mtshan gsol te bod kyi rgyal por bskos/de'i mnga' zhabs su gyur phyin nas spur rgyal bod kyi yul zer ba 'di byung bar gda'o/ /rgya dkar po'i yul de dar dkar yol ba 'dra/ rgya nag po'i yul mkhris pa dpyang la bskyur ba 'dra/ bal po'i yul gzhong pa'i dkyil 'dra/ zhad zhung gi yul bshang kha'i sbubs 'dra/ lho bal na ba'i kha skor 'dra/ kong po'i yul bre 'dra/bod zal mo'i snang 'dra/ de'i nang nas stod mnga' ris skor gsum rdzing 'dra/bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba 'dra/ smad mdo khams sgang gsum gshongs zhing /rdo /shā // ge/ rgyal rabs khugs pa thugs rje chen po'i yang tig las 1/

'tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/( )rgyal rabs kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa rgya dkar po'i rgyal rabs bzhugs so//na ma sarba brnya bo dhi satwa sgye/ kun mkhyen kun la mkhas pa zas gtsang sras/ /lha yi lhar gyur srid pa gsum gyi mgon/ khams gsum mun pa'i smag rum sel mdzad pa'i / /bu ram shing pa'i gdung 'dzin zhabs la 'dud/ /'dren mchog de yis mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir/ /gzigs pa lnga yis 'gro ba'i don la byon/ /rgyal ba'i zhing mchog rgya gar rgyal rabs 'di/ /rgyal rabs kun gyi gtso bor bri bar bya/ /thog mar 'dzam gling 'di na mchog gyur pa/ /zas bzhi ming drug tha dad rnam gsum gyi/ /kun nas 'byor pa sngon med mi yi bdag /mang pos bkur ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'di'ang sngon rabs dang /da ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus/ kha dog sna tshogs pa las/ dang por/ rgyal po mang pos bkur ba'i gdung rabs 'di/ 'dzam bu gling du/ thog mar byung ba dang mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po/ stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams 'di chags pa na/'dzam bu'i gling 'di'ang chu'i rgya mtsho chen po'i steng du/ rlung gis bsrubs pa'i spris ma/ mar gsar lta bu/ sa chen po 'di chags shing / 'od gsal gyi lha 'ga' zhig tshe 'phos nas/der mi ru skyes te/rang 'od kyis gsal zhing / mkha' la 'gro ba/ dga' bde'i zas kyis 'tsho zhing / tshe lo dpag tu med pa thub pa byung ngo / / de'i tshe na/ nyi zla dang / gza' skar/ dus tshags/ pho mo'i dbye ba yang med do / / der mi gcig gis sa'i bcud ro bzang po dang ldan pa rnyed de myangs pas/rim gyis kha zas za zhing /des lus lci/ rang 'od kyang nub nas/ spyi mthun gyi las dang bsod nams las grub pa'i nyi zla dang gza' skar dus tshigs dang nyi 2

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/nub la sogs pa byung ngo / /sa'i bcud de nub nas/ rim gyis dman te bdud rtsi sa'i zhag dang myu gu'i tshal ma rmos pa'i lo thog byung ba de rnams rim pas zos pa la brten nas/ pho mo'i dbang po dang / 'khrig pa spyod pa byung / de'i ngo tsha skyob pa la khang pa byung ngo / /de'i rting lo thog la 'ga' res/ bsog 'jog byas/ ma byin pa blangs pas kun bgros nas/ gzugs dang spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i mi gcig rgyal por bskos/ de la zhing pa kun gyis ston thog gi drug cha re btab pas rgyal por sa'i drug cha dbang bya ba de nas byung zhing / mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po zhes grags so/ /lho 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi'i rgyal po thog ma yin no/ /rgyal rabs mkhan po 'ga' zhig yar 'ded kyi lha bdun zer ba ni/ mang pos bskur ba'i rgyal po'i yab lha chen po/ de'i yab lha rgyal ba/ de'i yab lha gzi ldan bkra shis/ de'i yab dbang po lag pa/ de'i yab 'khor ba dung skyong / de'i yab dri med dung mdzes/ de'i yab gshed can rnam gshed ste bdun no/ /zer ba 'di la khungs gsal rang zhig mi 'dug na'ang / 'di ni bsam gtan bzhi pa'i lha'i gnas nas chad pa yin zer ro/ / / mang pos bkur ba'i bu brgyud rim pa bzhin/ 'od mdzes/ dge ba/ dge mchog gso sbyong 'phags ) bo skyes mad dam snyam sgoms sngon gyi rgyal po lnga'o/ /de rnams kyi ring la mi'i ming la rim pa bzhin sems can/ tshur shog rme ba can/ sprin mgrin/ rme sha can/ rta la'i rkang ngo /gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bo'i lha ba rdol ba las skyes pa rgyal po nga las nu ni gling bzhi dang / rgyal chen rigs bzhi/ sum cu rtsa gsum man la gser gyi 'khor los dbang bsgyur ro/ /de nas mi'i ming la/ mi zhes bya ba 'di byung ngo / /nga las 13

ba chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/(shenu'i brla g.yas pa las/ skyes pa mdzes pa/ de'i brla g.yon pa las skyes pa nyer mdzes/ de'i brla las mdzes ldan/ de'i brla las mdzes dga' rnams 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po lnga ste/ rim pa bzhin du/ gling bzhi/ gsum/gnyis/gcig la/gser/dngul/ zangs/ lcags kyi 'khor los dbang bsgyur ba'o/ /de'i dus su bskal pa rdzogs ldan/ skye rgu'i tshe lo brgyad khri pa/ bzhi khri pa'ang zer/bram ze'i rigs la sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig 'jig rten du byung ngo / /de'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos lo brgyad khri'i bar la gnas par bshad do/ /mdzes dga'i bu bzang po nas bu brgyud rim pa bzhin rgyal rabs sum cu'i mthar/kun nas 'od zer zhes bya ba'i brgyud rgyal rabs brgya tham pa yul gru 'dzin du byung /de nas rim par brgyud de/ yul dmag gis mi tshugs pa la sogs yul chen po bcu drug tu sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi bstan pa'i ring la/ rgyal rabs drug 'bum chig khri drug stong nyis brgya dang gsum byung ngo / /de nas bskal pa gsum ldan/ tshe lo sum khri pa'i dus/ bram ze'i rigs la sangs rgyas gser thub byon/ de'i dam pa'i chos lo lnga stong gnas par bshad do/ /de nas yang /yul dmag gis mi tshugasang pa la sogs yul chen bzhi na/ sangs rgyas gser thub kyi bstan pa 'i ring la/ rgyal rabs nyis 'bum drug khri chig stong brgya dang lnga bcu byung ba'i tha ma rgyal po kri kri yin te/ de'i dus su/ bskal pa gnyis ldan/ tshe lo nyi khri pa/ rgyal rigs la sangs rgyas 'od srungs byon/ de'i dam pa'i chos tshe lo brgyad khrir gnas par bshad do/ /kri kri'i bu brgyud brgya tham pa yul gru 'dzin du byung ba'i tha ma rgyal po rna ba can yin no/ /de la bu go ta ma 4

rgya bod mig tshang cha smo/dang / bha ra dha dza gnyis/ nu bos rgyal srid bzung / go ta mas nags la bsam gtan bsgoms/ de'i dus su g.yon can pad+ma'i rtsa lag gis smad tshong ma 'gro ba bzang mo bsad pa'i nyes pa/ go ta ma la dkris pas/ bha ra dha dzas rang gi phu bo yen pa dang nyes pa med par ma shes pas/ go'u ta ma khrims las bsgral/ de 'chi khar rang gi mkhan po drang srong mdog nag dang 'phrad/ bden pa brjod pas/ mkhan po gser gyi mdog tu 'gyur/ de'i tshig bzhin chags pa yid la byas pas sa bon zags pa las/ sgo nga'i nang nas khye'u gnyis byung ba mkhan pos/ bu ram shing gi tshal du/ nyi ma la bskyangs pas/ ming nyi ma'i gnyen dang / bu ram shing par btags so/ /phyis bha ra dha dza bu med par shi go'u ta ma btsal bas ma rnyed kyang sngar gyi lo rgyus rnyed pas/ thams cad mya ngan du gyur/khye'u gnyis po blangs nas/ rim pas rgyal sar bskos so/ /'di la bu ram shing pa'i steng zer ro/ /de'i bu'ang mya ngan du gyur/ de'i bu brgyud brgya tham pa yul gru da 'dzin du byung ba'i tha ma/ 'phags skyes po/ de la bu gsum byung ba'i/ ma de shi nas/ rgyal rigs dbang chen gzhan zhig gi bu mo khab tu blangs/ de la bu byung nas/ rgyal sar 'don pa'i chas byas pas/ bu gcig byung ba la/ rgyal srid dgar ming btags rgyal sar bskos/ phu bo gsum po rang rang gi sring mo dang bcas te sprugs nas/ chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram du/ ri dwags gsod cing gnas pas nam zhig lang tsho rgyas pa dang / drang srong gi gnang ba byin nas/ming sring 'grogs pas/ brgyud mang du 'phel te/ ser skya dang / lhas bstan du grong khyer chen po byung ngo / /yab kyi de'i rgyu mtshan tshor nas/ de bzhin phod pa 15

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/rtoṭaphod pa byas pas/ shākya shākya zhes grags so/ /'di la shākya'i rigs kyi ya tshan zer te/ rigs phal pa ma 'dres pa'i phyir ro/ /phyis rgyal srid dga' yang bu med par shi ku bo rnams rim pas rgyal sar bskos pas/ che brgyud la shākya chen po'i brgyud/ 'bring brgyud la shākya ri brag pa'i brgyud/ chung brgyud la shākya li tsa phyi'i brgyud ces par grags shing / rgyal po dka' thub can gyi brgyud lnga khri lnga stong ser skyar byung ba'i tha ma/ shing rta bcu pa'o/ /de rnams kyi brgyud pa bcu gcig gi tha ma/ gzhu brtan la/ sras seng ge 'gram dang / seng ge sgra'o/ /phu bo'i sras zas gtsang / zas dkar/ bre'o zas/ tshad med zas so/ /zas gtsang gi sras rgyal bu don grub dang / gcung dga' bo/ zas dkar la rgyal ba dang / bzang ldan/ bre'o zas la/ ming chen dang / ma 'gags pa'o/ /tshad med zas la/ kun dga' bo dang / lhas sbyin no/ /rgyal bu don grub kyi sras/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po yin te/ 'di yan gyi shākya chen po'i brgyud chad dam zer ro / / rgyal po zas gtsang yan/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa'i ring la/rgyal rabs lnga khri lnga stong nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig byung ngo / /de'i steng du/ rgyal bu don grub dang /sras sgra gcan yan nas/ mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po man la/kun dril bas/ rgyal rabs dgu 'bum gsum khri nyis stong bdun brgya dang /bcu gsum byung bar bzhed do/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ni/ dang po rgyal bu don grub/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byon pa ste/ nyan thos blo chung ba rnams na re/ 'dis skye ba dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol 16

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo nas/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i skyes bu rang rgyud pa gcig rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras su zhakhyungs pa yin zer/ byang sems pa rnams ni/ 'di so so skye bo'i bu yang ma yin/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang ma yin/ sa bcu'i byang sems yin zer/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i yang snying / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ba rnams ni/ 'di sngon bskal pa me long 'byung gnas zhes bya ba la/ lam lnga sa bcu sngon du song nas/ sangs rgyas tshar/ de'i sprul pa yin zer/ gang ltar yang /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis bsags/ sgrib gnyis sbyangs pa'i mthar/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par thams cad mthun pas/ de'ang thugs bskyed lugs/ mdo snying rje pad dkar ltar na/ 'di dang po/bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul du gyur pa'i tshe/thugs bskyed/ zhes pa dang / bskal bzang las/ sman par gyur tshe thugs bskyed/ drin lan gsab pa las/ dmyal ba'i lcags sregs kyi thang la shing rta 'dren pa'i rgyad du gyur tshe thugs bskyed/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo las/ tshong dpon gyi bu mngon dgar gyur tshe'am/ yang na rdza mkhan gyi bu khye'u snang byed bya bar gyur tshe sangs rgyas thub pa chen po'i drung du/ 'khar ba'i bum pa gcig dang / gar sha pa ṇi rdog po lnga/ mchil lham zung gcig rnams phul nas/ bde bar gshegasapa khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang / khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba//de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog/ces pa'i smon lam btab nas/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed par bshad/de rting bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i ngos 'dzin ni/ nyan 17

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/(nethos pa rnams kyi lugs la/ mdzod las/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor yan chad kyis grangs med dang po rdzogs/ de nas mar me mdzad yan chad kyis grangs med gnyis pa rdzogs/ rnam gzigs yan chad kyis gsum pa rdzogs par bshad do / / rnam gzigs mar me rin chen gtsug /grangs med gsum gyi tha mar byung //dang po shākya thub pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar 'dod do//theg chen pa'i lugs la/gong ltar/ khye'u snang byed kyis thugs bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ sa dang po thob kyi bar la / bskal pa grangs med dang po'o/ /de'i dus su/ so so skye bo'i lus grangs med par blangs te/ tshogs kyi lam du zhugs nas/ dge ba spel ba dang / sbyor lam las 'bras la nges shes skyes te/ de'i bar la sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i tha ma/sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can yin no/ /de ltar sa dang po rab tu dga' ba thob nas/ mthong lam chos nyid bden pa rtogs te/ sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa nas sgom lam la zhugs/ sa gsum pa 'od snang byed pa/ bzhi pa 'od rab tu 'phro ba/ lnga pa shin tu sbyangs dka' ba/ drug pa sngon du gyur pa/ bdun pa ring du song ba'i sa thob pa man la/ grangs med gnyis pa'o/ /de'i bar la/ sangs rgyas bdun khri drug stong la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i tha ma/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad yin no/ /de rting sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin thob pa'i dus su/ byang chub sems dpa' dam pa tog dkar por gyur cing / de man gyis grangs med gsum rdzogs te / de'i ring la/ sangs rgyas bdun khri bdun stong la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i tha ma sangs rgyas rnam gzigs yin no/ /de ltar bskal pa grangs med gsum du 8

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/tshogs bsags nas/ sa bcu non cing / ba gnyis pa nas/ bcu pa'i bar la/sgom lam la goms pa 'phel te/ sa bcu gcig pa kun tu 'od dang /bcu gnyis pa ma chags pad+ma can/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang brnyes pa'i tshul 'og nas bshad pa ltar ro/ /thub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi dang po ni/ 'jig rten gyi mdzad pa lnga las/ lhums su zhugs pa dang / sku bltams pa/ gzhen nu'i rol rtsed mdzad pa/ btsun mo khab tu bzhes pa/ rgyal srid bzung ba rnams so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i mdzad pa lnga ni/ rab tu byung ba dang / dka' ba spyad pa dang / chos 'khor bskor ba/ cho 'phrul bstan cing bdud btul ba/ sangs rgyas pa rnams so/ khyad par can gyi mdzad pa gnyis la/rtag tu re ba rnams sun 'byin pa'i phyir/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa dang / phyi rabs pa spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ sku gdung ring bsrel cha brgyad du bgos pas/ byin rlabs 'byung ba'i mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar bcu gnyis kyi dang po/dam pa tog dkar por gyur te/ dga' ldan na bzhugs pa'i dus/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams na/ snyigs ma lnga bdo ba ni/ sems can gyi snyigs ma dang /tshe'i/ nyon mongs pa'i/ lta ba'i/ dus kyi snyigs ma la dgongs/ gdul bya dus la babs par mkhyen te/ rtsod ldan gyi dus/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams tshe lo brgya thub pa'i skabs su/ dga' ldan du rgyal tshab la byams pa dbang bskur nas/ 'dzam bu gling du gzigs pa lnga'i sgo nas 'byon par chas pa ni/ gnas dang / rigs dang / brgyud dang / yum dang / dus dang lnga la gzigs nas/ nga ni 'dzam bu'i gling du chos ston pa la 'gro'o gsungs pas/ lha thams cad ma dga' 19

ba chen 'od snang las/skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/rtogaste / thabs sna tshogs pas ba ye la btab kyang / ma thebs sa pa dang / lha'i bu gzi brjed dam pas/ de ltar na/ glang po che'i gzugs su sprul nas byon na don che'o zer ba ltar/ glang po che thal dkar mche ba drug ldan gcig tu sprul nas byon/grong khyer ser skya'i pho brang nas/ yab rgyal po zas gtsang dang / yum lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma chen mo rgyal srid skyong gin bzhugs pa'i dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes bco brgyad/ bco lnga/ zla ba nya gang ba/ yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i spyi bo nas/glang chen thim par rmis te lhums su zhugs nas/ yum la dga' bde'i ting nge 'dzin mang po 'brungs par gyur to/ /de'ang /jo bo rje'i bzhed pas/ sangs rgyas shing pho byi ba'i dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya la lhums su zhugs/ glang lo dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes brgyad dbyid tha chung zer ba'ang 'dug la sku bltams/ sa mo phag dang byi ba'i mtshams la sangs rgyas/shing pho spre'u'i lo la mya ngan las 'das par mdzad cing / chos rje sa skya pa ni/ ston pa me slo yos la lhums su zhugs/ sa pho 'brug lo'i dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes brgyad dbyid tha ma zer ba'ang 'dug la sku bltams/ sa pho stag la sangs rgyas/ me mo phag gi dpyid tha'i nya'am/ ston tha'i tshes brgyad la mya ngan las 'das par bzhed de/ tshes brgyad rgyal phur 'dzoms pa la sku bltams par mkhas pa mang po zhal mthun no/ /rgyal bu lhums su zhugs pa'i mdzad pa ste dang po'o/ /de ltar yum gyi lhums su zla dgu ngo bcu bzhugs nas/ yab kyi bka' bzhin/mes rgyal po legs par rab gsal gyis bkra shis lu zhi'i tshal du gtsang sbra dang byi dor byas nas/yum gdan dra/sdu pa'i dus sras ni yar 'byon pa drogs

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/cing mar mi gtsang bar dgongs te/ yum gyi phyag g.yas pa shing n+ya dro ta'i yal ga la 'jus pa'i mod la/ rtsibs lo g.yas pa nas/ yar ngo'i tshes brgyad kyi snga dror sku bltams/ brgya byin dang tshangs pas brten cing / lha klu la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba thams cad kyis sku khrus gsol/ mchod pa dang rol mo phul/ sa g.yos/ sgra bsgrags/ me tog gi char phab/ sku las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ bltams 'phral la phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun bdun por ba'i zhabs rjes gang yin la pad+ma re re byung zhing / zhal nas dge mtshan che ba'i tshigs bcad re re yang gsungs so/ /de'i dus su yab kyis/ gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyed bltams tshe/ /sa chen 'di na gom pa bdun bzhud de/ /nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs//de tshe mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes pa'i bstod pa 'di ni thub pa'i bstod pa'i thog ma'o/ /rgyal bu 'di dang dus mnyam du/ yul dbus su rgyal po tshangs byin dang / pad ma chen po/ dmag rgyal rtsibs kyi mu khyud/ mtha' yas dang bzhi po la bu re re btsas pa ni/ gsal rgyal/gzugs can snying po/ shar pa/ gtum po rab snang dang bzhi'o/ /byang sems de nyid sku bltams nas zhag bdun na yum 'das te/ sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes/sru mo skye rgu'i bdag mos mgo byas/ ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ zhabs tog byas pas/'phel skyed shin tu che'o/ /rgyal bu sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa ste gnyis pa'o/ /de'i dus na/ri bo gru 'dzin na drang srong nyon mongs med ces bya ba/ 'jig rten chags 'jig la lta ba mkhas pa zhi/ yod pa des/'od zer gyi snang ba mthong

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(//nas sangs rgyas sku bltams par shes shing / gzhan yang mtshan ltas brtag mkhan rnams na re/ 'dis ni rgyal srid bskyangs na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur zhing / rab tu byung na 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon por nges par 'gyur ro zer ba sogs mtshan bltas shin tu bzang bar stangs bcad do/ /mtshan yang rgyal bu don grub tu gsol lo/ /yang drang srong na re/ da lta rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i dus 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po mi 'byung / 'di ni/ da ste lo sum cu rtsa lnga la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar the tshom ma za zhig bdag ni lang tsho yol bas de'i chos ma thob par 'chi'o/ /zer nas mya ngan byed do/ /drang srong des tsha bo mes byin la/ rgyal bu 'di sangs rgyas pa'i dus su khyod kyang rab tu byung zhig zer ba ltar byas pas/ mes byin gyis dgra bcom pa thob pa'i mtshan ni 'phags pa ka bya na zhes pa'o/ shākya'i rigs rnams kyi mchod pa'i lha gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyi drung du rgyal bu byon pas/ lhas tshur la phyag byas byung bas/ bcom ldan lha'i lha'o zhes pa dang de'i lam na shākya'i rigs gdug pa can/ 'gro ba thams cad la 'tshe ba zhig yod pa des kyang btud pas/shākya thub pa zhes par grags so/ /de nas gzhon nu de nyid nas/ yig dpon srin bu'i go cha la klog yig bslab pa dang / shākya srid sgrub la rtsis dang / slob dpon lhar bcas la 'phong dang / byang sems bzang po len la glang po che'i gnya' bar bzhon pa sogs sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs rgyal po'i bya ba rnams slob pa'i tshul bstan na'ang / sngon sbyangs kyi shugs drag pos slob dpon rnams skyeng par mdzad do/ /lha sbyin la sogs rgyal phran rnams dang / aṅga ma ga dhar sgyu rtsal 22

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/'gran dus zhabs kyi mthe bong gis glang po che'i ro dpag tshad gcig gi bar la skyur bas sa gzhong nge song ba ser skya'i grong khyer gyi phyi rol na glang po gzhong bya ba yod/ mda'i rtsal 'gran pas/ shing ta la bdun lcags kyi phag bdun dang bcas pa phug nas/ mda' zug pa'i rjes la mda' chu khron pa skyes zer ba'i yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu yod do/ /gzhan yang / rkyal dang / shing sdong po gcod pa la sogs rtsal sna gang la'ang sus kyang 'gran par ma bzod pas na/ grags pas khyab par gyur ro/ /gzhon nu rol rtsed kyi mdzad pa ste gsum pa'o//de nas rgyal bus dgung lo bcu bsnyen bzhes pa'i dus/ mtshan mkhan gyi ngag bzhin rgyal po zas gtsang gis sras rab tu 'byung stabs med pas/btsun mor 'os pa rnams khab tu longs gsungs nas/ thog mar shākya lag na be con gyi bu mo grags 'dzan ma 'khor nyi khri dang bcas pa khab tu blangs/ yang dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i dus su shākya dung legs kyi bu mo sa mtsho ma 'khor nyi khri dang bcas pa khab tu blangs/ yang dgung lo nyer dgu pa'i dus su shākya dril bu sgra'i bu mo shākya bza' ri dwags skyes ma 'khor nyi khri dang bcas pa khab tu blangs so/ /de ltar btsun mo cha gsum 'khor drug khri dang bcas pa ni/ khab tu btsun mo bzhes pa'i mdzad pa ste bzhi pa'o// //de ltar lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar la ni rgyal srid tshul dang mthun par bskyangs shing / yab kyis rgyal bu 'jig rten gyi chos la yongs su 'jug par dgongs te zhing pa'i mtha' la rtog tu 'jug pas bran rgan rnams ci bde bar btang nas/rgyal bu nyid rang snga dro shing gi grib ma la bsam gtan bzhi sgom gyin bzhugs 23

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/rtonapas/ phyis dro yang grib ma de ngos la khar 'dug pa yab kyis gzigs nas/gang tshe thub chen zhing pa'i grong bzhud tshe/ /'dzam bu'i grib mas bzhugs sa ma btang zhing / /lha bu gzhen nu drug gis bsad gyur pa/ /de tshe mchod 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /de nas rgyal bus chibs lnga ldan nam shing rta la chibs/ mos pas sna khrid de nyi ma dang po la grong khyer gyi shar sgo la byon/gnyis pa la lho phyogs la byon/ gsum pa la nub phyogs la byon pas/ na ba dang / rgas pa dang / 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa rnams gzigs/ re re bzhin ji ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ mos pas/ sems can kun la 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas nges 'byung drag po skyes/ rang gzhan gyi don du thar pa kho na sgrub pa'i bskul ma byas/ nyi ma bzhi pa la byang phyogs la byon pas/ 'od gsal gyi lha'i rtog pa la byang sems 'di rgyu'i stobs dang ldan par 'dug na'ang / rkyen gyi stobs la rag las pas bdag gis rkyen sgrub bo snyam nas/ nyan thos rab tu byung pa'i cha byad du sprul nas 'ong ba dang mjal/ mos pa la dris pas 'di ni rab tu byung ba bya ba/ thog mtha' bar gsum du dge legs su spyod cing / skye rga na 'chi bzhi las thar bar bya ba'i thabs so zhus pas/ rgyal bus zhen pa las babs nas/ phyag byas rab du byung ba legs so legs so/ /bdag kyang 'di ltar rab tu 'byung ngo gsungs/pho brang du log rab tu byung lugs ji ltar legs bsam pa kho na sems kyin bzhugs pas/ yab dang 'khor 'bangs byin pos blo brid dang g.yengs thabs kyi rnam 'gyur rnam pa sna tshogs pa byed na'ang / de dag thams cad 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs su spyad nas/ gang 24

rgya bod mig tsā 'a mo/la'ang chags sems mi mnga'o/ /de nas mtshan mkhan gyis/ da ste dgung zhag bdun na rgyal bu rab tu ma byung na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zer bas/ yab kyis sras 'di rab tu ma byung na/ nye du 'khor 'bangs thams cad kyis khong gi zhor la/ gling bzhi ri rab kyi rtse la sogs pa mthong bas zhag bdun bar la rab tu byung ba bsrung bar rigs so zer ba'i skad bsgrags shing /phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar/ yab/ khu bo rnams/shākya ming chen dang bcas pas thog drangs kyis/ phyogs bgos/ phag can gyi srung ma nyin mtshan khor yug gnyid med du bzhag de rnams zhag re song rim bzhin/ da ste/ zhag grangs 'di las med 'di song ba dang 'bor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po thob par 'dod pa'i gtam kho na brjod par byed do/ /der zhug drug song ba'i nub mo rgyal bu'i dgongs pa la bdag gis btsun mo drug khri blangs pa la/ gcig dang yang ma 'grogs na/ zas gtsang gi sras kyis bud med bsten ma nus par dbang med kyis rab tu byung ba yin no/ /zhes pa'i ya kha yong bsam pas de spangs pa'i phyir/de nub btsun mo dam pa grags 'dzin ma dang mnyam du gzims so/ /de dus btsun mo la bkra shis kyi mal khri zhig pa la sogs rmi lam ngan pa brgya rmis pas/rgyal bu la zhus pas/ rgyal bus btsun mo'i spro bsrings/dbugs phyung ngo //rgyal bu rang gi mnal lam du/ sa chen po gdan du btings/ ri rab sngas su bcug pa la sogs/ mnal ltas bzang po lnga byung bas/ sangs rgyas pa'i ltas su mkhyen nas/ grags 'dzin ma nga 'gro gsungs pas/ lha gang du bzhud kyang bdag khrid mdzod cig zer/ thams cad mkhyen pas/ btsun mo'ang sangs 25

ba tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(//rgyas kyi sar 'dren pa la dgongs nas/ de ltar bya'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de'i tshe sras sgra gcan 'dzin btsun mo'i lhums su zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal bu 'khor ba'i chos spangs rab tu byung bar bzhed nas/ zhag bdun pa'i srod la/ brgya byin rgyal bu'i drung du 'ongs nas bskul cing /yab/ khu bo/ btsun mo / blon 'bangs/ bsrung ma'i tshogs thams cad gnyid kyis myos su bcug gnod sbyin lnga rtsen la gnod sbyin gyi skas ring long shog gsungs/ blangs nas pho brang la skas ring btsug pa las babs te zhol khang du/ mos pa la/ rta ngang pa gser ldan khyer shog gsungs nas/ rta bzungs pas/ cang shes kyi rig nas bros te ma zin pa dang / rgyal bu rang gi phyag brkyang nas/ lnga ldan tha ma'i khur long la dka' thub kyi nags su skyol cig gsungs pas/ chibs ngang pa gser ldan/ mchi ma phral te mdun du byung / der yab dang ma mjal bar phyin na mi yong snyam nas/ yab shar sgo bsrung ba'i drung du byon/ mnal song 'dug pa la phyag 'tshal/ bskor ba byas/ rta la chibs te nga su yis 'degs gsungs pas/ri rab la sogs chen po rnams kyang 'degs nus pa'i lha'i bu stobs che ba ba'i sa bdag gis 'degs zer nas/ rta rmig re re nas bteg mos pas kyang /myur du myur du rta'i 'phong la zhen te/ dka' thub kyi nags la gtad de nam maX' la myur bar byon no/ /rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs pa'i mdzad pa ste lnga pa'/ /der rgyal bu nam mkha' la byon pa la brgya byin/ tshangs pa/ 'dod khams/ gzugs khams kyi lha rnams dang bcas pas bar snang la bsu ba byas/26

rgya bong yig tshang chen mo/spo ba bskyed nas byon pas/ nam thun gcig la/ dka' thub kyi nags su mchod rten rnam dag gi drang du rtol lo/ /ser skya'i rgyal blon 'bangs rnams ni/ mya ngan gyis gdung par cer to/ /de nas mos pa la/ rta dang rgyan cha thams cad bskur nas/ ser skyar slog btang ngo / /smre ngag 'don zhing phyin pas zhag bdun la slebs tsam byung zhing / grong khyer mthong tsam nas mos pas 'gro ma nus par rta rang kha gtad btang bas/ rtas skad 'tsher ba dang / mi dmangs kyi bsam pa la/rgyal bu phebs byung snyam ste ltar phyin pas/ rta gong na dbu rgyan dang na bza' la sogs pa 'dug pas/ thams cad kyis rta la 'a rtsa sa shing ngus pa dang / lnga ldan de nyid du shi nas/ grong khyer sgra gcan du bram ze las drug la mkhas pa zhig gi bur skyes so/ /der yab rgyal pos dril bsgrags pa'i don gyis rgyal bu rab tu byung ba'i mkhan slob la sogs ni/ sus kyang byed ma nus/ don dang mthun pa shes mi'ang med pas/ dgung lo sum cur phebs pa'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad dus lor ba shing mo phag lor bar do//kyi nyin/ mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du/ rgyal bu rang gi ral gris dbu skra bzhar ro/ /dbu skra rnams brgya byin gyis khyer nas/sum cu rtsa gsum na rin po che las grub pa'i dbu skra'i mchod rten bya ba bzhengs yod do/ /des na bza' ngur smig ma rnyed pa la grong khyer dpe med kyi khyim bdag gi bus rgyal bu don grub rab tu byung dus phul cig ces shing gi lha la bcol bzhag 'dug pa de/ brgya byin gyis blangs nas phul/ ka shi ga'i na bza' khyer nas sum cu rtsa gsum na rin po che las grub pa'i na bza'i mchod rten bya ba bzhengs yod do/ /na bza' ngur smig gsol nas rang byung du bsnyen par rdzogs27

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/( )par gyur to/ /de nas/ yab dang / mes rgyal po legs par rab gsal gyis/rgyal bu gcig pu nags na 'dug zer ba thos nas/ 'khor lnga brgya btang bas/lnga gor ge gzhan rnams phyir slog btang ngo / /rab tu byung ba'i mdzad pa ste drug pa'/de /nas 'khor lnga po de yang khrid de chu bo ni rañdza na'i 'gram gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa der byon lo drug gi bar la til 'bru gcig rgya shug 'bru gcig 'bras 'bru gcig la brten nas dka' thub mdzad bsam gtan bzhi bsgom pa la lus gshed ldan pa dgos pas zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes ma gnyis kyis ba stong gi 'o ma skol ba'i nying khu la lha'i bu mo gnyis kyis gzi brdzid bskyed pa'i sman btab nas drangs pas gsol ba dang / skad cig la sku lus gser gyi mdog lta bur gyur to/ /de'i tshe ga bor lnga po na re/ 'o skol rnams kyis/ lo drug gi bar bsod snyoms blang gin drangs dus mi gsol bar bud med kyis drangs pa gsol ba 'di 'chal 'dug pas da rang re rnams 'gro zhabs tog mi sgrub phyis 'phrad na'ang phyag dang bsu ba la sogs kyang mi byed do zer nas wā rā ṇa phyir song ngo / /dka' ba spyad pa'i mdzad pa ste bdun pa'o/ /de nas byang sems kyis sangs rgya bar bzhed de ri bya rkang la byon pa dang /ri de'i rtse mo nas nyil byung bas bdag gi tshul khrims la sogs nyams par gyur pa ni med/ 'di ltar skal ba dman pa cis nyes snyam pa dang / 'od gsal kyi lha na re/khyed la gang yang nyams pa'i skyon gyis ma gos kyis/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sangs rgya sa rdo rje gdan gyi sbo yin pas/ der gshegs zer 28

rgya bod yig tshang 'a mo/nas byon pa'i lam du/tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang pos glang bu grags pa dang /bkra shis bya ba la khal bkal nas tshong la 'gro ba dang mjal te/ byang sems la 'bras chan drangs pa gsol ba'i zhal phor med pa la lha'i bus/ lhung bzed gsum phul ba/ gcig gis chog par mkhyen nas/ gsum po gcig tu byin gyis rlabs nas der gsol lo/ /tshong dpon gyi lam gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir/lnga 'i bkra shis don grub bya ba thub pa'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i chos kyi thog ma yin spo / /de nas yang gshegs pa'i lam du/ brgya byin gyis rtswa tshong gi khye'ur sprul nas/ rtswa bkra shis zhes bya ba 'jam zhing dri zhi kha pa khur gcig phul ba de/rdo rje gdan gyi spo la byang chub kyi shing drung du rtswa'i gdan bting nas zhal shar du gzigs skyil krung bcas te/ ji srid zag med ma thob bar/ /de srid skyil krung gshig mi bya/ /zhes gsungs nas/ lha'i bu'i bdud bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis byams pas btul nas/ nam gung rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad/tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so gsungs zhing / gsang sngags bla med pa rnams ni/ byang sems kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang de nyid la/ de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ye shes kyi lus kyi 'og min du byon nas/ de na de bzhin gshegasapa til gyi gang bu tsam bzhugs 'dug pa la phyag byas nas/ seng ge'i khri la 'dug ste/ stong pa'i ngang la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag kyang gsang sngags kyi gdams pa med pas/ sangs rgya bar ma nus nas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byang sems de'i mdun du byon te/ ting nge 'dzin de las slang nas/ 'di skad du/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis gsang sngags kyi don mi 29

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(//shes par ji ltar sangs rgya bar bya snyam/ zhes gsungs pa dang / byang sems kyis de rnams la phyag byas te/ thal mo sbyar nas/ gsang sngags kyi don bya ba ji ltar lags zhus pa dang / mngon par byang chub lnga'i gdams ngag gsungs pa de ma thag tu de ltar bsgoms pa dang / sa bcu gcig bcu gnyis/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob ste/ dgung lo so drug zhes pa'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas skad/ 'di rdo rje gdan du tho rangs sangs rgyas zer ba dang yang mi 'gal lo/ /nges par 'og min du sangs rgyas pa ni / stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'og min du/ /sangs rgya bar ni ma gyur na/ /'dod khams gzugs med khams su ni/ /sangs rgya bar ni mi mdzad do/ /zhes bshad pas mngon no/ /mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa ste brgyad pa'o/ /de ltar mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas ma thag tu sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste / / dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs la/ rtsod ldan gyi dus/ gdul bya dman par gyur pa rnams la zab mo'i chos bstan kyang go bar dka' bas rang nyid nags 'dab brten la nyams su len par bya'o gsungs te/ sangs rgyas nas/ zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar la/ gzhan la chos ma gsungs so/ /de'i bar la lha tshangs pas/gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas/'gro ba'i don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol zhes/ rim par zhus pas/mthar chos gsung bar gnang ste/ 'khor rnams bsdu ba'i phyir/ ghaṇ+ḍi brdungs 30

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/pa'i sgra las/ sangs rgyas slob mar gyur pa gang su dag /deng 'dir ston pas chos kyi char 'bebs kyis/ /gang dag nyan par 'dod pa 'dir byon la/ /zab mo rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon cig yang / /zhes pa'i skad gsal bar byung zhing /thog mar wā rā ṇa srir byon/ lnga sde bzang po la sogs pa 'khor lnga pos khrims bcas 'dus pa'ang ston pa'i zil ma thub par btud cing / chu stod zla ba'i tshesabazhi nas/ 'khor lnga sde bzang pos mgo byas/ theg dman gyi gang zag rnams la bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor ro/ /gsum pa ni/dang po sgrub ba'i 'khor lo/ bar pa chad pas bcad pa'i 'khor lo/ tha ma rung mthun gyi 'khor lo'o/ /der 'khor lnga po ye shes khong chud kyi bsnyen par rdzogs par gyur cing / kun shes koṇ+ḍi rgyas dgra bcom pa thob/ gzhan bzhi po yang mtshan ldan pa rta thul dang / rlang pa ming chen bzang ldan yang / zag pa las sems grol lo/ /'khor lnga pos/ chos gos zlum gon ma byas pa la 'od gsal gyi lhas brda bstan no/ /chos 'khor gnyis pa/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la/ rab 'byor dang / sha ri'i bu la sogs pa 'khor dgra bcom byang sems mang po la/theg pa thun mong ma yin pa/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro/ /chos 'khor gsum pa/ ri ma la ya dang / yangs pa can la sogs par don dam yang dag 'phags la sogs 'khor rnam bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa la/ theg pa thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa/ don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rnams bskor ro/ /de'i skabs zhig tu/ yab rgyal po zas gtsang yang / dge ba la bskul ba'i dus la bab par khyen te/31

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(//bcom ldan 'das/ 'khor lnga sde/ grags byin dang / 'char ka la sogs/ dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang bcas te/ ser skya'i gnas dang nye ba shing n+ya gro ta'i kun dga' ra bar gshegs nas/ thabs gcig tu bzhugs shing / lha mi mang po la chos ston par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe dge slong rnams kyi nang nas/ rgyal po zas gtsang dge ba la bskul bar nus pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka gcig po 'dug par dgongs nas/ 'char ka btang bas/yab rgyal po ni ser skya'i pho brang na shākya'i rigs thams cad bsags/ nga'i bus rgyal srid skyong du ma 'dod pa yin pas/ khyed sus kyang bkur sti ma byed cig zer ba'i dril bsgrag bca' ba byed kyin 'dug par sleb pa dang shākya gzhen nu bzhin rab gsal la sogs/ shākya'i bu mang po ni/ rang shugs kyis dad pa skyes nas/ 'char rka'i gdong bsu/ bsnyun 'dri bar byed do/ /der 'char nas/ta la bdun cam gyi bar snang la/ skyil mo krung bcas nas/ rgyal po zas gtsang gi mdun du phyin pas/ rgyal po yang dad de/ dri ba gleng mo mang du mdzad/ 'char ka la bsgos drangs/ ston pa la'ang bgos bskur/ nga yang bu dang mjal ba la mgyogs par yong zer/ 'char ka sngon la brdzangs/ rgyal pos blon 'bangs mang po bsags nas/ bzhen pa dang rgyan cha sna tshogs pa dang bcas te byon pas/ston pas/ yab kyi nga rgyal bcag pa'i phyir du/ 'dod khams/ gzugs khams kyi lha'i bu mang pos mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa khyer nas/ ston pa bar snang la sku 'chag cing bzhugs pas/ yab shin tu dad ste/ rgyang ma nas phyag 'tshal/ gus pas bstod pa ni/ nga yang 'di dang khyod la lan gsum du/ /thub pa 32

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ khyod kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje che mnga' lha mis mchod pa'i gtso/khyod 'dra 'jig rten ma mchis lhag ci smyos/ /mtshan ni don grub legs shes sngon brjod pas/ /pha dang ma yis bsam ste btags pa legs/ khyod kyi bsam rdzogs bdud rtsi rnyed pa na//don grub legs par da gdod bdag gis 'tshal//zhes pas bstod pa'i rjes la/ ston pas seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te/ yab srasamajal ba'i dga' spro mdzad cing / dge slong 'char mas/ yab rgyal po dge ba la bskul ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po de la/ gal te gzugs yod na 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du mi shong ste/ bsod nams rgya che'o gsungs so/ /der kyang 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro//de'ang / thog mar/ chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du grags pa bskor ba'i ring la/ lo bdun du zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgus ma tshang ba song bar byed cing /ston pa khong sangs rgyas nas lo bdun lon pa'i dus su/ sum cu rtsa gsum du/yum la chos gsung ba la byon/ zhag dgu cu'i bar la bzhugs pas/ rgya gar du 'khor rnam bzhi la sogs sus kyang ma go ba'i dus na/ rgyal po u tra ya nas/ rtse gcig tu gsol ba btabs pas/ rmi lam du zhal mjal/ gsung byon pa dang /rgyal po de yid rab tu skyo nas/ mo'u gal gyi bu la bskur te/ can dan go shi ṣa la ston pa'i sku tshad ji lta ba gcig lha yul du bzhengs/ sangs rgyas nyid rang gi rab gnas mdzad nas/ rgya gar la gdan drangs so/ /phyis rgya nag tu spyan drangs nas/ tsan+dan jo bor grags pa yod 'dug yum gyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang / sum cu rtsa gsum nas smin drug zla ba'i tshes bzhi la ston pa mi yul du 33

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gu pa gce bsdus/(nephebs pa ni/ dpal ldan lha las babs pa'i dus che khog bya'o/ /de ltar theg pa chung ngu'i chos rnams na/ gang la gang 'tsham par bstan zin gyi/ theg chen gyi chos rnams/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams la/ gsal bar ston pa'i dus skabs la ma sleb pa la dgongs nas/ sprul pas gsungs pa ni/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal du sprul nas dur khrod bsil ba tshal du byon nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la bya ba'i rgyud gsungs/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed du byon nas spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs/'og min du byon nas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs/ rgya gar lho phyogs kri dharma pha la chos kyi 'byung gnas su byon rdo gru gsum bsnol ba'i steng du bzhugs nas rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs so/ /de rnams sna chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdzad pa ste dgu pa'o/ /de dag gi skabs su/ ston pa la mtho 'tshams shing / bar du gcod par 'dod pa'i bdud dang / mu stegs rnams rlags par mdzad pa ni/ thog mar 'khor mo 'jig gi yul du/ bdud 'dul ba'i dus na gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas na/ bdud rje dga' rab dbang phyug bya ba 'dod khams na mthu stobs che ba zhig lha'i bu dgu khris bskor nas yod pa bdud kyi dpung rnams pham par go nas/ mthar kho rang ston pa'i drung du 'ong nas/ go ta ma khyod kyi bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags zer ba'i rdzun ston par 'dug pa/ de'i dpang por su yod zer ba la/ ston pa nyid ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te phyag g.yas pa'i mthil sa la bsnun nas/ sa 'di 'gro ba kun gyi rten yin te/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu mnyam shing nye ring med/ /de ring khyod kyis gzu dang dpang byos shig /34

rgya bod yig tshang 'a mo/ gsungs pas sa g.yos/ lha mo brtan ma gser mdog lus kyi stod/ sa'i steng du don/ phyag g.yon na bum pa dang / g.yas pas bshags 'debs pa'i tshul gyis/ de ni nges par bden pa'i dpang po ngas thub bo zer ba dang / bdud rje skyengs te/ dpa' bkong bar byas shing bdud kyi sde rnams pham par gyur to/ /de rting / mnyan yod kyi grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu/ mu stegs kyi ston pa chen po rdzogs byed dang / gnag lhas kyi bu ka ti dang / rnam par smra ba'i bu kun nas rgyal ba dang / mi pham skra'i lha ba can dang / ka ta ya na nog can dang / gnyer gyi bu gcer bu dang drug po 'khor dang bcas pa mtho 'tshams par byung dus/ rgya gar gling drag gi rgyal po/ rgyal phran/ dge 'dun/ skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa/'bum phrag mang po tshogs pa'i dbus su/ rta zla'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar la ston pas nyin re bzhin cho 'phrul du ma bstan nas/ bdud dang mu stegs thams cad tshar bcad de nang pa'i sgor bcug pa ni/ bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa'i mdzad pa ste bcu pa'o/ /ston pa sangs rgyas nyid kyis rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du byas sheng / bdud bzhi bcom/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la dbang thob pas/ bskal pa'i bar du bzhugs na'ang dbang yod pa la/ bdud kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/mya ngan las 'da' bar zhal gyis bzhes tshar ba dang shing mkhan gyi bu btsun pas/ lo ma'i gdug tshod phul bas/ sems can rtag 'dzin can rnams/ mi rtag pa bskul ba'i phyir du mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed de/ grong khyer rnamachog tu byon dus/ 'jam dpal gyis/ phyin chad ji ltar bgyid zhus pas/ bdud dang 33

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/(shemu stegs 'dul ba'i phyir du/ nga'i sku tshab bzhengs shig gsungs te/ zhal nasa'od zer gsum 'phros pas/ tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / brgya byin la phogs/ khong gsum pos sangs rgyas kyi sku tshab bzhengs pa'i yon bdag byed par khas blangs/ bi shwa dmes lha bzo dang / byams pas dkon gnyer/ phyag rdor gyi sku bsrung / dpal mgon bdud cu rtsa lngas bsrung ma byed par dam bcas/ de nas tshangs pas/ la'i rin po che las/ chos sku'i rten bum pa zlum po ring bsrel gyis bkang ba bzhengs pa/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros spyan drangs nas/o rgyan gyi yul/ he ru da'i rgyal khams na bar snang la bzhugs te/ reg pa med pa du ba lta bu'i mchod rten zer/ mi ma yin thams cad kyis mchod pa'i rten byed cing mchog gi dngos grub ster ro/ khyab 'jug ra hu las/ klu'i rin po che las longs sku'i rten/ rnam snang gangs chen mtsho dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa gcig bzhengs pa phyi'i rgya mtsho na bzhugs te/ klu dang / gza' rnams kyi mchod pa'i rten byed cing / de'i dbu gtsug na rin po che chu shel yod pas zla ba nya res kyi 'od zer phog pas/ de las chu byung nas/ sku khrus gsol ba yod cing / de dusachu 'thung tshad/ tshe 'di'i nad gdon sdig sgrib dag phyi ma byang chub thob/ sku de la gsol ba btab pas/ 'bras kyi char pa nyin mtshan bcu gnyis 'babs so /brgya byin gyis/ lha dang mi'i rin po che las sangs rgyas dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad gcig pang du 'tsho ba'i ma ma la dris nas bzhengs/ bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad rgyan 'dogs pa'i ma ma la dris nas bzhengs/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i sku tshad/ da ltar sangs rgyas nyid rang dang mnyam zer nas sku gsum po de sprul sku'i rten du 36

rgya bod yigazung chen mo/bzhengs te rten de thams cad la sangs rgyas nyid rang gis rab gnas mdzad cing / sku che ba de sum cu rtsa gsum du khyer nas brgya byin gyi yi dam mdzad/ chung ba gnyis po rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi yi dam mdzad cing / bar skabs su rgya nag por 'byon pa dang / mthar bod yul du 'byon par lung bstan to/ /sprul sku gsum po bzhengs pa'i lugs phud la/mkha' spyod ma'i sku chung bkaṇi ga yang rang byung bstodalung ra lo jo mor grags pa de yin par byed do/ /du byon zer ro/ /de nas grong khyer rtswa mchog tu/ chu klung ha ri zhes bya ba'i 'gram shing sa la yod par byang chub kyi shing la sku brten nas mo'u gal gyi bu la/ 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /da ste zla ba gsum na mya ngan las 'da' bas/ khyod kyis/ ri rab kyi rtser song la/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bos/ chos kyi phyi ma nyan pa dang sgro 'dogs dpyod pa la shog gyis shig gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas/ sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ 'gro ba thams cad mya ngan du gyur bzhin par 'dus nas gsol ba btab kyang bzhugs par ma gnang / myang 'das kyi mdo gsungs 'phags pa shā ri'i bu la sogs/ skye shi la dbang thob pa rnams ni/ ston pa'i sngon la mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas ston pas/ kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar nges so/ /chos thams cad rtag pa dang / bde ba dang /dngos po dang /bdag dang bcas par gyis shig thub par ston cig gsungs so//gsol ba bcom ldan 'das/ sngon chos thams cad mi rtag pa/ sdug bsngal ba/stong pa/ bdag med pa 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa yin gsungs na / da 'di ltar gsungs pa ci la dgongs pa lags zhus pas/ bka' stsal pa/37

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(ṭangs sngon gyi dus na/ theg pa chung ngu / mtshan nyid kyi theg pa la dgongs nas/ de bzhin du bstan/ da gang ci 'dul ba la de bzhin du ston cig theg pa chen po'i mtha'/ dge 'dun pa smras so zhes gsungs so/ /de'i dus su 'khor 'dus pa de nyid kyi nang nas/ rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po ku ma dza ra de nyid stan las langs te/phyag byas/ ston pa'i mdun du seng ge'i lta stangs kyis/ mig mi 'dzum par lta zhing / 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas so gsungs mod kyang / bstan pa'i snying po zab mo'i lam/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i theg pa dag 'dzam gling 'dir ma gsungs so / / zhes gsol ba dang / de'i lan du/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ /lha gnas gsum du grags pa yi/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /'dzam gling shar gyi phyogs mtshams su/ /mi las skal ldan gra ma che / / rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /sngon du ltas rnams snang gyur te/ /drag shul can zhes bya ba'i rtser/ /grogs kyi sems la dman pa'i lus/ /lang da'i bdag po la sogs la/ /phyag na rdo rjes ston par 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /'di bzhin mdo sde gdams ngag 'bog pa'i rgyal po nas kyang gsungs shing / de mthun/ gsang ba lung bstan pa dang / sngon byung gi rgyud phyi ma nas kyang gsungs so / / der 'khor thams cad mya ngan byed cing / smre ngag 'don pa la/ yang bka' stsal pa/ nga ni nges par mya ngan las 'da' bas/ lus gser mdog 'di la yang dang yang du stos shig nyis mya ngan ma byed cig 'dus byas thams cad 'di dang 'dra ba yin gsungs shing / sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' zhing / /chos kyang nub 38

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/par mi 'gyur te/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul bstan tsam/ /gsungs pa la/ nyan thos rnams na re/ de ltar na cis kyang bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas/ sa steng 'jig rten ga na yang / /skyes nas 'chi bar ma gyur pa/ /gang zhig khyod kyis mthong ngam ci/ /'on te thos nas the tshom za/ /nga yi mya ngan khyod byed na/ khyod kyi mya ngan su yis byed/ /de la 'brasabu gang yang med/ /gsungs so/ /de ni chos gsungs pa'i phyi ma'o/ /der dbu nub tu bstan/ zhal lhor gzigs/ zhabs shar la brkyangs/ phyag g.yas 'og tu bcug g.yon brla'i steng du brkyang nas/ dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa sag zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nam gung zla mdor myang 'das na gag zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nam gyi gung tso la gi degs par gsungs/ba ri rtse'i rtser nub pa'i dus su/ chos kyi dbyings su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa ste mdzad pa bcu gcig pa'o/ /der sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ me tog gi char bab mkha' la rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dang dri bzang pos khyab par gyur cing lha rnams kyis bsus te/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing mchog dam par gshegs so/ /sku gdung ni bka' bzhin/ dri bzang pos byugs/ ras yug stong dang / 'bru mar gyis dril zhag bdun nas zhugs la 'bul snyam pa la/ ston pa rang gi thugs dpal be'u nas me rang 'bar du 'bar nas bzhu'o/ /gdung rus dang / ring bsrel la/ ma gha da'i bre bo che bcu gnyis byung ba'i bgos ra la 'khor rnams ma 'cham par rtsod cing / yangs pa can gyi rgyad rnams kyis dpung bcas nas bsrungs so/ /der bram ze bre'o dang mnyam pas gsol ba btab cing thams cad 39

ba chen 'od snang la /gsu'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(//la spro srings nas bgos mkhan byas te/ cha gcig grong khyer rtswa mchog gi spyad rnams la byin/ de bzhin du yul sdig pa can gyi rgyad rnams dang / yul rtog pa can gyi rgyal rigs bu lu ka dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal rigs kro ta ya dang / khyab 'jug gi bram ze dang / yul ser skya'i rgyal rigs nag rgya rnams dang / yangs pa can gyi rgyal rigs li tsa byi rnams dang / yul ma gha da'i sna chen po la gtogs pa'i bram ze dbyer byed rnams te/ cha brgyad du bgos nas byin no / / de rting sku gdung bcug pa'i rin po che'i bum pa de thams cad kyis bram ze bre'o dang mnyam pa rang la byin no/ /bram ze'i khye'u legs mdzes spun gyis/ sku gdung ma thob par/ gdung thal sol ba rnams byin no/ /de rnams rang rang gi yul du khyer mchod rten re bzhengs pas/ sku gdung gi mchod rten brgyad dang /bum pa'i mchod rten/ sol ba'i mchod rten bya ba dang bcu tham pa 'dzam bu gling du byung ngo / /grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi mchod rten der ni klu'i rgyal pos mchod par byed do/ /ston pa'i tshems mche ba bzhi'i gcig ni brgya byin gyis sum cu rtsa gsum du khyer/ gcig tshig 'dzin grong khyer yid 'ong na bzhugs/ gcig ka ling da'i rgyal po'i yul na yod/ gcig grong khyer sgra sgrogs na klu'i rgyal pos mchod pa 'bul lo/ /ston pas byin gyis brlab pas bi shwa rkarmas bzo slob ma dgos par ston pa'i sku tshad bzhengs/ de'i thugs dar nyid rang gi thugs dpal be'u dang sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po sogs kyis byur bur bkang ste/byang chub kyi snying po ma gha da rdo rje'i gdan na bzhugs so/ /ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyis lo'i dbyar der 'phags pa drug sdes 'dod khams pa'i lha'i 40

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/gnang ba dang bstun nas sangs rgyas kyi sku tshab khru bcu drug pa mya ngan 'das chung bya ba dang / gzugs khams pa dang bstun nas khru sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ mya ngan 'das chen bya ba'i sku bzhengs so/ /de nas lo nyis brgya tsam na rgyal po shrī sing has rten de gnyis la byang chub shing gi ra bas bskor nas mchod pa byas so/ /de nas lo nyi shu tsam la/ bram ze ma hā pā la bya ba'i khyim bdag chen po gcig la bu ma hā saṃ be/ tsakra saṃ be/ bi ma saṃ be bya ba spun gsum yod pa'i che ba gnyis phyi pa dang / chung ba nang pa'i chos lugs byed zer ma 'cham pa la/ mas lung bstan pa bzhin/ gangs ri ti si'i rtser ma hā khru wa yab yum la dris pas de na'ang tshe 'di la phyi pa rdzu 'phrul che na'ang phyi mar nang pa phan zer nas nang pa'i nyan thos la bsnyen bkur byed kyin 'dug pas/ nang pa'i chos lugs byed par kha 'cham ste/pha ma'i lung bstan bzhin bu che bas ri bo gangs can gyi rgyud yul wā rā ṇa sī drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags/ bden bzhi'i 'bor lo bskor sar rdo rin po ches rgyu byas nas sangs rgyas kyi sku tshab dharma tsakra zer ba gcig bzhengs so/ /'bring pos rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal ka dam dha ka skad 'don pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor bskor sar gnas chen brgyad kyi byang chub snying po'i sa'i lo ma la rgyu byas nas sku tshab gcig bzhengs pa de la bhe mu wan zhes grags so/ /bu chung bas ma'i ngag bzhin/ dbus gyur rdo rje gdan gyi steng / byang chub shing gi shar/ ston pas sku rgyab brten nas sangs rgyas pa der/ phyi mchod rten dang nang lha khang du yod pa'i gha smyo la'i dkyil du chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram ston pas sku khrus mdzad pa'i rdzing bu na tsan+dan go shi dzi'i sdong po 'gyel ba brdar ba'i lde gu la rgyu 41

brtse chen 'od snang la /ga skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/(shobyas nas bi shwa dmes bzos te sangs rgyas dgung lo sum cu pa'i sku tshad gcig bzhengs pa ni rdo rje gdan na da ltar bzhugs pa'i mahā bho dhi'i sku 'di yin no/ /spyan 'bras gnyis ni tshong dpon gyi bu la klu'i rgyal pos byin pa'i rin po che margad cung yod pa khru gang la phas dum bu gnyis byas nas phul ba de bcug yod pa'o/ /sku de bzheng bas pa'i zhag grangs ma thim pa la bram ze mas ltas pa las rkyen nas sku yi zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe'u chung ma tshang ba yod ces grags so/ /phyi rabs spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir du sku gdung ring bsrel rnams byin rlabs kyi rten du bzhag pa'i mdzad pa ste bcu gnyis pa'o/ /ston pa shākya thub pas mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir dgung lo brgyad cu'i bar la gnas chen gang dang gang du bzhugs/ mya ngan las 'da' khar bstan pa su la gtad bstan pa ni/ bye brag bshad mtsho chen mo las/ chosa'akhor gnas dang yangs pa can/ /sa dkar can dang lha'i gnas/ /'brog gnas mchod rten ri dang ni/ /byis pa gsod dang ko sham bi/ /'od ma'i tshal dang sgra bcas dang / /ser skya yi ni grong khyer te/ /'di rnams su ni thub pa yi/ /skyes mchog lo re lo re bzhugs/ /'bar ba'i gnas kyi phug tu gnyis/ /sman gyi nags su lo bzhi ste/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong du lnga/ /nyi shu rtsa gsum mnyan yod du/ /dka' ba spyad pa lo drug ste/ /nyi shu rtsa dgu khab na gnas/ /de ltar rgyal ba brgyad cu la/ /thub mchog dam pa mya ngan 'das/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs pa yi/ /bsod nams gnas ni 'di dag lags/ /rtag tu lus dang ngag dang yid/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /bcom ldan 42
