rgya bod mig tshang za mo/thugs la gdon gsol ba'i gsung sna tshogs byung ba la zhu ba phul kyang ma nyan par/ nyang rong rtsibs kyi thang la tshal du rje 'bangs 'thab pas/ lo dzom rten 'brel la mkhas pas rgyal po rang gi ral gri'i rab dgu zi glang po sna bya ba de klod la bskor gyin rta rgyugs pas/ lha'i dmu thag chad lha nyams pas 'bangs kyis dkrongs/ spur de zangs kyi ga'ur bcug nas lci mda' zam kha nas nyang chu skya mo la bskur btang bas/ rgyang mkhar mtsho khug tu dgung zhag bdun chags kyang 'dzin mkhan med tshong dus mgur mo'i thad du dgung zhag bcu gsum chags kyang 'dzin mkhan med/ kong chu rlag thub khyer ba chu srin rdo rje ri mo'i bran mo / klu srin bye ma lag ring gis chu la nya shor phyin pas ga'u rnyed pa rje mo la phul bas bang mdzod du sbas so/ /de la stod kyi steng zer ro/ /yab dkrongs pa dang / sras gsum pos yab mes kyi bang mdzod na lha glang ru dkar bya ba'i glang 'phur shed gcig yod pa de la zhen nas/ kong yul la bros so/ /de rnams kyi ma la lo ngam kyi rta g.yog bcol/ lha cig yod pa la chung mar byas/ pho brang gsham du rtse dgus mgo byas rgyal srid thams cad lo ngam rta rdzis bzung ngo / /ma des rta 'tsho ru phyin pa'i nyin gcig gnyid song ba'i rmi lam na/ mi dkar po gcig dang bsna sa pa rmi/ gnyid sad pa dang sngas kha nas g.yag dkar po gcig langs song / zla ba brgyad na khrag gi gong bu lag mgo tsam gcig skyes/ de bor ni ma phod gso ba la ni kha mig med/ bsgul gyin 'dug pas 'brong rwa gcig tu bcug kong rnams kyisang nga pa'i drod la bcos pas/ci zhig tsam na bu khye'u gcig byung /de'i ming 'jang gi bu ru las skyes kyi ngar bsos po bya bar btags/ de lo bcu 93

ba chen 'od snang la /sa lha'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/(//lon pa dang pha dang phu bo la sogs gang na yod dris ba la/ mas sngar gyi rgyu mtshan bshad pas spur dang spun zla 'tshol du 'gro zer phyin pas spur rnyed kyang slongs pas ni ma ster rkus pas ni ma thob nyo bas rin ci dgos byas pas/ mi'i bu mo bya lo ma bya mig yod pa/lo bcu drug lon pa gcig 'dod zer nas btsal btsal bas/ g.ye'i gangs bar spur gong nas/ pha tshar la re then/ ma skyid la rung zhus gyi bu mo dge'u yu me bya ba/ de 'dra gcig 'dug nas nyo bar byasapas/ pha nas gser mo rang tsam zhig 'dod zer/ ma na re spur de la 'tshal gyi thig brgyad cu rgyag chug zer ba khas blangs/ bu mo khyer/ spur blus so kong yul sen mo phug tu bang so sngon ma gcig rtsigs na'ang / der ma bzhugs bang sortsigs pa'i thog ma ni de yin no/ /de nas gcin gsum gdan 'dren phyin pas gcen sha khri ni kong yul gre sna na bzhugs/ kong rje dkar por mtshan gsol nas kong po'i rje mdzad/ gcung nya khri ni/ nya btsun rgyal por mtshan gsol nas dwags po'i rje mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ khong gnyis gdan ma drongs bar pa bya khri sbo bo brag thog na spo de gung rgyal du mtshan gsol ba spo bo'i rje mdzad kyin 'dug pas gdan drangs nas/rgyal sar bskos/ de phyin chad nasaspur rgyal bod kyi yul bya ba 'di'ang grags so/ /de nas spur de yar lung du gdan drangs nas/ bon po spa ra'i bu/ kye rgyal smra'o tshes gris btub nas ltasapas/ lo bcu gsum song ba'i sbur zangs de kha che bas/ skad ngar ra ra zer bas yul de'i ming yang nga ra thang du btags/ de nas sbur de/ 'chong rgyas grang mo grang chung gi sgom la sbas nas gnam nas gser gyi thig gu gcig byung nas/94

rgya bod yig tsha cha cho /de la thims pas gnam la gser thig tu mtshan chags so/ /de nas ru la skyes kyis nyang ro bsham po mkhar gyi ri rtse la/ bya rgod kyi gsob tu zhugs nas/ lo ngam pho mo phru gu thams cad bsad gsham po mkhar gyi rtse phab nas/ sku mkhar 'phying ba stag rtse rtsig pa'i ming rdo la bcug she'u yul thams cad snangs su bcad/ der rje spo de gung rgyal mnyes nas ru ma skyes la/ khu khu lha bu smon bzang bya ba'i ming btags/ yab gri gum btsan po'i ring la/ zhang zhung dang / bru zhwa'i bon pos gshin gyi 'dur bon byung ngo / /sras spu de gung rgyal gyi ring la/ sgrung dang ldebs byung zhing / gnam bon gshen po che bya ba byung / blon ru la skyes dang de'i bu lha'u mgo dkar gyis blon po byas pa'i ring la/ 'brong thur du sdebs/ chu yur bar bcug spang zhing du smos/ sol bas rdo bzhus/ gser/ dngul/ zangs/lcags bton/ chu la zam pa gtsugs so/ /rgyal po'i spur g.ya' la skyal steng gnyis bang so rdza dang g.ya' la btab ces so/ /spu de gung rgyal gyi sras/ i sho legs te de nas bu brgyud rim pa bzhin no/ /de sho legs/ the sho legs/ go tu legs/ 'brom zhen legs/ a 31 legs rnams la/ sa'i legs drug zer ro / / legs drug bang so g.ya' spang mtshams su btab/ a sho legs spyod sras za nam zi lde/ de nas bu brgyud rim pa bzhin/ lde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ snol nam lde/ snol po lde/ sde snol nam/ lde se snol po/ lde rgyal po/ lde sprin btsan rnams la bar gyi lde brgyad do/ /lde brgyad bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab/lde sprin btsan gyi sras/ rgyal to re long btsan/ 'di'i ring la thon mi 'bring po rgyal dang/ snubs smon do re/ 'dar gyi bu stong dar rje rnams kyis blon po byas95

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(//so / / 'di yan chod kyi rgyal po rnams kyis lha klu'i bu mo dang bzhos te/ btsun mo brten dgongs pa la ma 'tshal zer nas sa la ro ma byung skad do/ /de rting nas 'bangs dang gnyen sdebs pa ste/ rgyal po to re long btsan nas bu brgyud rim pa bzhin/ rje khri btsan nas/ blon po snubs gnya' to re rtsug lo dang /stabs khri bzung mon kheng gis byas so/ /rje khri sgra spungs btsan/ blon mgar khri sgra ji thung dang / thon mi klu mangs dras pos byas/ rje khri thog rje thog btsan/blon mgar gnya' ldom bu dang / snubs skyes thog rje lo btsan gyis byas so/ /de yan mi rje lhas mdzad nas/ gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi bar la chab srid dang sgrung dang / ldebs dang / bon gsum gyis bskyangs zer ro/ khri thog rje thog btsan dang / btsun mo ru yong gza' stong rgya mtsho'i sras/ lha tho tho ri'i gnyan btsan te/ bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan po byon nas lo dgu brgya drug cu rtsa drug song ba'i me mo yos la gzungs so/ /de rnams la btsan lnga zer ro/ /rje de'i blon po khri thog rje btsan dang / sbrang khri gzung lan pas byas so/ /rgyal po de'i sku ring la/pho brang yum bu bla mkhar gyi rtser nam mkha' nas zangs kyi ga'u nang du spang stong phyag brgya pa dang / gser gyi mchod rten khru gang pa/ mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa/ tsin+ta ma ṇi'i gzungs/ mu tro'i phyag rgya rnams byon te/ da ste gdung rabs lnga nas 'di'i don shes par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i sgra grags so/ /lo de la shing po spre'u lo yin par byed/de chos yin par ma shes nas ngo mtshar can zhig go snyam nas/ pho brang gi rtser bzhugs/ gser skyems dang g.yu sngon la sogs pas mchod pas rgyal po dgung lo brgyad cu pa la so skyes/ sgra dkar nag por gyur/96

rgya bod yig tshang cher cho /gnyer ma med cing sku gzhen sha can du gyur te lo brgya dang nyi shu thub/ rten di la gnyan po gsang ba zhes par mtshan gsol/ nga'i brgyud 'dzin rnams kyis 'di la mchod pa phul nas gsol ba thob cig 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ 'di'i ring la bod du dam pa'i chos kyi dbu rnyed pa yin zhing / rgyal po 'di ni 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa'o/ /btsan lnga man chad bang so yul du btab/ yul gyi ming ni 'phying lung so ra thang / /btsan lnga'i chad pa sa phung sbra 'drar yod/ /phul med chad pa gru bzhi'i mi shesaskad/ /rje de'i sras khri gnyan gzung btsan/ blon po sbas snang bzhir zla btsan dang / mgar khri 'bring gi byas/ khri gnya'i chad pa don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/de yang yul med sa phung brdal ba 'dra/ rje de'i sras 'byo gnyan lde sa blon po gnyan thang spang yang rje dang / sgrubs khri dar re thong pos byas/ rje'i sras stag ri gnyan gzigs dang / yab sras de gnyis la bar steng zer/ de'i lo rgyus/'bro gnyan lde ru'i khab tu mchims bza' klu rgyang ngam bu zhes pa mo'i zas la rnam rtog langs pa'i skyon gyis/ rgyal po la klu nad tsi tsi dzo la byung nas/ yab yum gnyis blon po gnyag thang spangs sam rje dang gsum ka gson dur la bzhugs dgos pa byung / sras gcig yod pa ni dmus long du gyur/ zhal chems bsam pa bzang po gser dang 'dra ba ste/ /bzang po'i gros ni bdud rtsi yin pas nyon/ /ngan pa rnams ni me dang 'dra bas spongs/ /mi chos rtog pa yin gyis rnam par rtog pa skyung / khyod kyis gnyen po gsang ba mchod/ 'a zha'i sman pa bod la mig phye/ mig ma byung na sum pa'i yul na bon po gcig gi chung ma rgya mo 97

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(//rgya lcam bya ba dang / nga nub gcig 'grogs pa la bu sum ri ring po bya ba yod pas/ de bos la rgyal sar chug gsungs so/ /'bro gnyan lde ru'i bang so shad mdar brtsigs/ de nas dmu long dkon pa bkras/ gnyan po gsang ba rgyasapar mchod/ 'a zha'i sman pa bos nas pho brang yum bu'i rtser mig phye bas skyid shod stag mo'i ri la gnyan rtswa za ba mthong / de nas mtshan yang stag ri gnyan gzigs su gsol nas rgyal sar bcug go/de'i sgron po ni mon khri do re snang btsan dang / sna nam mang gnya' sbrang khri gzungs min pa rnams kyis byas/ yab sras de nyid kyi bar du zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bzhugs skad do/ /mnyan gzigasabang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ /gral ni khri gnyan gong dngos g.yon na yod/ /de yang yul med sa phung brdal ba 'dra/ rje de'i sras gnam ri srong btsan/ blon po sbas snang bsher dang tshe spong na ga nag ser dang / nyang rtseng dgu snon ban sngags gsum rnams kyis byas/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la/ rgya nag nas nag rtsis drug cu skor tsam dang / sman dpyad/ zas sgom gyi phan gnod bshad pa tsam byung / rgya gar nas rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang / nyi ma drug skor tsam byung ba 'di rnams bod du sman rtsis byung ba'i snga mar byed na'ang / bod la yi ge dang sgra skad bsgyur shes pa med pas/ mkhan slob brda ston tsam ma gtogs/dar rgyas che ba ma byung 'dug bod rgyal des rgya dang / gru gu btul/ nyang sbal snon dang gsum pa mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ gru gu'i g.yu rnying drel rgyab bco brgyad/bod du sleb pa'ang de dus yin zer bar 'dug sku mkhar khris brtsigs 'bum gdugs bya ba/ ba dmar mo'i 'o ma rkyang pas 'jim pa sbrus nas brtsigs so/ /98

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/ rgyal pos dmus te long ba khrid nas brag gsum ding ma mtsho'i 'gram nas rnyed pa'i rta cang shes la chibs/ sbrang dga' bo dang / dmu spun rgyang ring po bya ba'i rgyad mi gnyis khrid/ phung g.yag thal kha ru ring bya ba'i 'brong na le bong zan bsad/ byang du thod pa'i khar brtsigs/ phyir lan 'brong sha dang rta lan tshwa rnyed do / / de gong bod na btab tshwa re tsam ma gtogs/ lan tshwa'i ming med/ de phyin chad byang tshwa re tsam chugs pa la bod du nas kyi drug cu sde 'jal ba byung ngo / /'di yi chad ni don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ de nas phul skyes brtsigs pas sog mkhar yod/ gral ni khri gnyan bzung btsan g.yon na yod/ rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan dang / yum tshe spong bza' 'bri ma thod dkar kyi sras srong btsan ni mes tho tho ri'i snyan btsan 'byungs rting lo brgya dang dgu bcu go gcig song ba'i me mo glang lo la pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling du sku 'byungs nas/ lo bcu gsum na yab 'das lo de nyid la rgyal por mnga' gsol/ rgyal srid lo drug cu ri rtsa dgur bzung / 'di ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos su kha ba can du byon nas/ gdul bya smin par bya ba'i phyir dam pa'i chos kyi sgol gtad pa'i tshul gyis/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa bzung bar lha mo dri ma med pa lung bstan pa'i mdo dang / dam pa dang po'i rgyud las lung bstan pa bzhin du yin la/ bod kyi rgyal po lo bcu bzhi pa gcig gis/ rgyal srid chos bzhin du skyong gin 'dug ces pa'i snyan grags kyis 'dzam bu gling khyab ste/ phyogs bzhi'i rgyal pos nor rdzas khyad par can gyi skyes dang / yi ge bskur byung ba bod rgyal po la skyes lan bskur rgyu'i nor yod kyang / kha 'phrin ma gtoges yi ge med pas/ bod la yi ge 99

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i cho 'gung gces bsdus/(//gcig ci nas kyang dgos pa 'dug dgongs nas/ thon mi a nu'i bu sam bho ṭami chung bya ba de blo gsal bas/ gser bskur nas rgya gar du yi ge dang chosaslob pa la btang bas/ mkhas pa li byin dang mjal te ngas yi ge'i lugs mi 'dra ba drug cu rtsa bzhi shes pas/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram la rdo ring la bris yod zer bstan nas slob ma khyod kyi 'di pa gang 'dod zer ba la/ bod kyi yi ge lugs 'di slabs lo tsā yang mkhas par shes/ mdo dkon mchog sprin dang /tog gzungs dang / snying rje pad dkar la sogs spyan drangs yong pas/ rgyal po thugs rab tu dgyes so/ /bod kyi lo tsā dang yig mkhan la mkhas pa snga ba 'di yin no/ /rgya gar na yi ge thams cad dbyangs yig bcu drug dang /thon mi phyin du rgya gar rgyal po go pi la dge mjal/khong gis mthun sbyor mdzad de/rgya gar nas yig mkhan mkhasapa li byin dang / pa ṇ+ḍita a nan+da zhes bya ba'ang gdan drangs yong nas tog gzungs la sogs bsgyur zer ba'ang /khyung po g.yu bris mdzad pa 'i bod yig gi stong thun chen mo na byas la dug go/gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi la mi tshud pa gang yang med na'ang / bod sgra brjod ngan pas de bzhin ma go rgya gar ba gcig la/ e ka zer 'jig rten la lo ma chos la ṅgā mi/zhus la kri ta zer la/ smras pa zer dgos pa rnams bod skad du/ ma khug par/thon mi thugs mug nas gzim khang gi sgo bsdams/ cung gzims pas gnyid song ba sad nas ltas pas/ gam na rgan mo sgur ba lta bu gcig 'dug rgan mo gang nas 'ong ngas sgo bsdams yod pa/ ji ltar byas/ gar 'gro/ ci byed byasapas/ chos nyid don la 'gro 'ong med/ /yang dag don la ci cha med/ /nam mkha' dag la lam byas pas/ /sgo cha dam kyang ga la thub/ /gsungs/ der the 100

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/tshom skyes/ yang bskyar nas dris pas/ nga za hor nas 'ong / 'a zha'i yul du 'gro gsungs/ thag ring thung yod byas pas/ ci cha zer/ brgyags gang yod byas pas/ ja yod zer te/rgan mo mi snang bar song ngo //de ni rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa'o/ /de rting bsam pas/ ca cha ja gsum/ zha za 'a dang / yi ge phyed ngo drug po de/ stod smad du bcug pa'i ka mad sum cu la gug 'greng la sogs rig pas sbyar nas bsdus te brtsams pas/ bod kyi sgra skad dang mthun pa'i yig 'byu sdebs tu btub pa byung ste/ rgyal po'i zhal nas da sngon rang la nga'i yab mes kyi gnyen po gsang ba 'di na ci 'dug klog dang gsungs/ ltas pas mdo za ma togaspang skong phyag brgya pa/ dge ba bcu'i mdo tsin+da ma ṇi'i gzungs rnams bzhugs 'dug pas/ shin tu mos nas rgyal pos kyang lo bzhir mtshams bcad/ yi ge dang chos bslabs so/ /mdo dkon mchog sprin la sogs thon mis rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i chos rnams kyang / bod skad du bsgyur/ chos bsgyur ba'i thog ma de rnams yin zhing / chab 'og thams cad la chos dang yi ge rgyas par spel zhing /bod yig gi thog mar rgyal por/ jo bo thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i bstod pa 'di brtsams nas phud la phul lo/ /lha skyon gyi ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan can/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje dang ni shes rab gnyis/ /mnyam par sbyor ba'i thugs mnga' zhid / /phyag gnyis thugs skar thal mo sbyar/ /dpal ldan mnyam sbyor la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po'i gtso/ /gsang sngags rgyal po'i bgrang phreng ni/ /mu tig ltar dkar g.yas 10

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/(shen 'dzin/ /rigs sngags 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pas/ /pad+ma shel gyi 'od bsags la/ /pad+ma dkar po g.yon na 'dzin/ /phyag na pad+mo phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings rnam dag dri ma med/ /zla ba'i 'od ltar rgyas pa'i yum/ /gzugs kyi lha mo yid 'ong ma/ /yi ge drug ma phyag 'tshalalo / / mtha' yas 'od ldan gser mdog can//yid bzhin nor bu chen po ltar//sems can re ba bskong mdzad pa'i/ /nor bu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /'di ni lha sa zla ba'i brag la bris te bkod nas yod do/ /de dus rgyal pos/ lo bzhir sgor ma byon pa des/ blon po rnams na re rgyal pos ci yang mi shes/ bod khams bde ba 'di/ nged rnams kyis byas pa yin zer ba rgyal posagasan nas/ nga glan par rtsi na bod mi thul bar dgongs nas/ rgyal po'i rigasade sa gcig tu gnas na/ kun bde ba yin te sngon yang khrims med pas shes pa can gyi mi bcu gnyis mthar 'khyams 'dug da ngas chos khrims dge ba bcu la dpe blangs pa'i khrims bca'o gsungs nas/ bsad pa la stong srang nyis khri tshig stong / nus pa la brgyad cu 'jal/ byur byas pa la sna gcod pa/ rdzun phra ma smra ba'i lce 'breg yang mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gis khrims kyi gzhi bzung bar byas te/ dkon mchog la dad pa skyo ngal med pa dang gcig don dam par sangs rgyas kyi chos btsal zhing bsgrub par bya ba dang gnyis/ gtsug lag dang chos la blo sbyangs pa dang gsum/ pha ma la drin lan dran pa dang bzhi/ yon tan can dang rigs kyi rgan pa la bkur sti bya ba dang lnga/ sha nye dang mdza' bshes la gzhung drang por bsrang zhing dang du blangs pa dang drug ma brtag cing ma bcol 102

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ba'i las la rtog 'dod med pa dang bdun/ yul mi khyim mtshes la phan btags pa dang brgyad/ gzhi drang por bsrang zhing khengs sems chung ba dang dgu/bya las dang byed spyod thams cad ya rabs kyi rjes rnyog cing phyir mig ring du blta ba dang bcu/ drin chen gyi mi yi lan mi bcag bzang lan brlan pa dang bcu gcig bu lon dus su 'jal cing bre srang la g.yo mi bya ba dang bcu gnyis/thams cad la snyoms par bya zhing 'gran sems mi bya ba dang bcu gsum/grogs kyi nang du bud med kyi kha la mi nyan cing rang tshod zin par bya ba dang bcu bzhi/ bya ba thams cad khong mdzangs shing ngag 'jam pa'i khog nas bsgrub pa dang bco lnga/ sems can gang la'ang sdang ba'i sems mi 'chang zhing byams snying rjes skyong ba dang bcu drug go /bod kyi khrims dang bod kyi chos dang khrims rnams skyid shod sho ma ra nar gtan la phab bo/ /der blon 'bangs rnams dga' nas/rgyal po 'di shin tu sgam po cig 'dug go zer nas/ khri srong btsan sgam por mtshan gsol lo/ /gzhan yang skye bo tha mal pa rnams chos la blo kha drang ba'i phyir thog mar/ sgrung dang / ldebs dang / bon rnams bstan/ rgyal pos mdzad pa'i sgrung rgyud dang / ldebs kyi bkod pa/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi slo 'bur na bris yod do/ /de dus blon po nyang mang po rje shad snang la sogs pa/ mdzangs pa mi drug gis tshig drug drug sum cu rtsa drug la sogs pas gtan tshigs gtan la phab/ bod ru bzhi stong sder phye/ sku bsrung phyogs bzhir bzhag mi la yig tshang skur/ mdo ba'i rta la cho ris bris/ phu chu rdzing du skyil/ gzhung chu yur du drangs/ri khyim klungs su phab/ thang la zhing du slogs/ zhing lhur bcad/ chu la gru gtsug103

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/(//bre srang gtan la phab/ mtha'i rgyal phran rnams dang lho mon/ rtswa mi shing mi lasogs thams cad mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ chab srid byin po bde zhing skyid la/chos lugs la phal cher zhugs so/ /der rgyal po'i dgongs pa la/ nga'i khrimasarnams kyang btsan par byung / da chos kyis gdul du btub par 'dug pas chosabya'o/ /chos byed pa la yi dam gyi lha dgos te ci la bya'am snyam pa la/ tshes brgyad kyi srod la sprin gseb nas/ lha'i bu mo na re/ rgya gar lho phyogs mthar thug pa sing ga'i gling / rgya mtsho'i 'gram bye ma'i gling / kha sar pa ṇi'i sku rgyab glang po che nyal ba'i 'og nas/ tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i khog na zhal bcu gcig pa'i sku rang byon gcig yod pa de spyan drangs na/ kha ba can du 'gro don rgyasapar gyur ro/ /zer nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de la rgyal po thugs rab tu dgyes te/ rang gi smin mtshams nas 'od zer bkye ba'i sna la/ dge slong shī la a ka ra ma ti bya ba sprul nas stod de spyan 'dren pa la btang ngo / /sprul pa'i dge slong des/ rgya gar la byon te/ sing ga la'i gling gi grong khyer ke ru'i rgyal po u ma ra ge sar bya ba stobs dang / 'byor pa ldan pa phyi rol pa'i chos lugs la zhugs pa gcig 'dug pa de la/ sprul pa du ma bstan nas nang pa'i bstan pa la bcug sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang po bzhedas par bskul nas/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram na/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi ring la rtsa ba zug gser thub kyi ring la lo 'dab rgyas/ 'od srung gi dus su me tog shar/ shākya thub pa'i dus la 'bras bu smin/ de rting rtsa ba rul nas 'gyel ba/ bye mas non pa'i tsan+dan sprul gyi snying po'i nang nas dal bus chod cing ces pa'i sgra dang bcas te/ bcu gcig 04

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/zhal sor bcu gnyis pa phyag bcu pa/ me tog ma nu ma'i mdog ltar dmar ba dri ngad kyis dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi bar khyab pa/ lta bas mchog mi shes pa gcig byon pa de dang / tsan+dan gyi tshal pa gcig bye ma'i gling nas 'jag ma re re'i rtse la lha'i bu mo bdun bdun/ 'phags pa la mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshul du 'dug par gzigs pas/ de'i 'jag ma pon cig po ta la'i lam nas me rtag sprug gu'i stong po btsal cig grong khyer ke ru mchod rten pad+ma 'khor lo'i nang nas/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig dang / 'od srungs/ shākya thub pa rnams kyi sku gdung ring bsrel khyor pa re re/ de la bzhugs pa'i byang chub shing gi chos sdong gsum/ gnas chen brgyad kyi bye ba nyag re'i steng na sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu dgu bzhugs pa dang / chu bo sna ra dza na'i 'gram du sangs rgyas kyi lhung bzed nas chu 'pho ba'i shul gyi bye ma nyag re'i steng na/ byang chub sems dpa' 'bum 'bum bzhugs 'dug par gzigs nas/ gnas chen de pa'i bye ma bre re re rin po che sna gnyis dang bcas pa/ dge slong gis bsnams byon te/ mchod gnas /byad par can bcu po de rgyal po la phul bas/ thugs rab tu dgyes shing ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /dge slong de yang rgyal po la bskor ba gsum byas te de'i smin mtshams su nub bo/ /de nas mchod g.yog la/ bu mo mtshan ldan ma bcu drug bkod de/ dus drug tu mchod pa 'bul zhing rgyal po rang yang / lha'i drung las 'ben gang yang mi 'da' bar bzhugs so/ /de rting rgyal po'i dgongs pa la / da dung lho bal gyi sa cha nas/ rten rang byung ngo mtshar can 'di 'dra re tsam gdan 'dren rgyu e yod snyam nas tsan+dan gyi jo bo la gsol ba btab pas/ lha'i /05

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(//thugs ka nas 'od 'phros bal yul gyi bar mtha'i lung par/ tsan+dan gyi nagasagaseb na tsan+dan ha ri'i sdong po gcig la/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku rang byung gsum rtsegs mar 'dug pa la phog pa dang / rgyal pos sngar bzhin sprul pa bkye nas dge slong shī la a ka ra spyan 'dren pa la btang bas/ sa de na lha'i byin rlabs kyis nyin mtshan khyad med kyi rnam par 'dug cing / nyin par tsan+dan gyi sdong po la/ mtshan mo lha'i sku dngos su gsal ba bzhugs pa mthong ba/ de la thig tshad btab nas nyin mo sdong po g.yengs pas/ dal bus chod cig zer ba'i sgra byung ste/ lha gsum byon pa'i stod lha de na re nga rgya gar dang bal po'i mtshamasasu zhog cig sa de na snga dro re re la tshong dpon re spos grir 'chi ba yod la de chad par 'gyur ro gsungs pa ni/ jo bo ja ma li bya ba tsan+dan dkar po'i sku rang byung zhal gsum phyag drug pa byis pa 61 lnga pa tsam dri bsung gis dpag tshad nga57) khongs khyab pa'i ngo mtshar can gcig byon no/ /bar ma de na re/ nga bal yul yam bu ya gal du zhog cig yul khams de na nad rims ngan pas mi mang po rgyun par 'chi'i yod pas de chad par 'gyur ro gsungs pa ni rdzo bo u khang bya ba tsan+dan dkar po'i sku rang byung zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa mtshar ba gcig byon no / / smad ma na re/ nga mang yul gyi grong du zhog cig yul de na grong dpon rnams mdze nad kyis 'chi ba yod pa de chad par 'gyur ro gsungs pa ni jo bo wa ti bya ba sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs mar 'dzin cing g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa'i rang byung gcig byon no / / de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan rgyal po la zhus pas/ lha spyan ma drongs kyang sems106

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/can gyi don chen po byas 'dus gsungs nas/ rab tu dgyes par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po'i thugs la/ yi dam gyi lha dngos dang mjal phyin/ sems can gyi don la tshegs med bod 'bangs sems can gyi don sa phyogs gang nas 'grub brtag dgos snyam nas gzigs pas/ mes po tho tho ri byang sems kyi sprul pa des/ zhabs kyis bcags pa'i skyid shod lha sa dmar po ri'i sa phyogs der/ theg pa chen po'i chos spel du btub par gzigs nas/ mchod gnas rnams shing rta la spyan drangs/ rgyal blon kun byon/ sbra stod tshal du zhag mal mdzad/ sang 'gro btab par rgyal po dang blon po sna chen pos chu khar khrus mdzad/ chab gsol dus/ dbus kyi gye rer yi ge drug ma 'byon par lung bstan no / / de nas dmar po'i ri'i rtser phebs/ yab mes kyi ri shul du/ pho brang btab nas bzhugs so/ /der ngas sems can gyi don byed par khas blangs dam bcas pa yin pas/ de dag 'dul ba'i thabs ci legs khas ma lha la gsol ba btab pas/ lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer skar mda' lta bu gnyis shar nub tu song bas/ rgya nag dang / bal yul du song zhing khro gnyer can dang sgrol ma'i sprul pa khab tu spyan drongs zer ba'i sgra byung nas/ sngon la blon po mgar dang /thon mi chung gis mgo byas/ rta pa brgya la gser gyi dong rtse brgya dang / gser gyi bang ba bdun/ glang po che gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa lha'i rin po ches spras pa gcig gser phye bre phyed/ yi ge bcug pa'i gser/ dngul/ zangs gsum gyi sgrom bu dang bcas pa bskur/ bslab bya byas nas/ ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad skar ma snab so'i nyi ma rtse ra la/ bal po'i lha gcig slong ba la brdzangs so/ /107

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(//der khong rnams kyis nub phyogs bal po'i pho brang yam gal du slebs/ rgyal po 'od zer go cha dang mjal/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhabs kyisabacag pa'i 'phags pa'i yul gyi rgyal po nga dang / bod mtha' 'khob rgyal po gnyis gnyen sdebs pa'i 'os min dgongs nas/ rgyal po khong yun ring du mig mi 'jed par bsam nas/ khyed nga'i gnyen mdar mi 'ong / nga la sangs rgyasa'od srung gi dus nas da lta yan chod du rgyal khrims ma 'chugs par yod/ de dang 'dra ba'i rgyal khrims 'cha' nus na/ bu mo sbyin gyis de ltar mi yong na mi ster bas/ khyed rang kyi rgyal po la dris shog gsungs pa la/ blon po mgar gyis rje lags/ bal bod kyi sa thag ring po 'di la/ bka' 'phrin tshig re la 'gro 'ong byas na/ lha cig spyan drongs dus ga na yong / gsung de'i lan du ngos kyi rgyal pos/ yi ge'i sgrom bu 'di bskur ba lags byas te/ zangs kyi sgrom bu 'bul ba rnams dang bcas pa phyag tu phul bas/ sgrom bu kha phye bas bal po'i yi ger byung ste/ des snga rgyal khrims yod med de bzhin bden na'ang / da phyin rgyal po khyed de la dgyes te lha gcig ster na ngas nyi ma gcig la sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du bkod la/ mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir/chos dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas la bzhag gi de ngo mtshar mi che'am bya ba 'dug pas/ 'di 'dra bden nam mi bden nam/ kha pho ni che/ nga la snyad pa yin nam gal te bden na/ ngas thub par dka' ba gcig yod par 'dug dgongs pa'i the tshom skyes nas/ yang gsungs pa/ nga'i yul na sangs rgyas 'od srung gi sku gdung ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod rten gyi thog drangs/ sku gsung thugs kyi 08

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/rten ngo mtshar can mang po mchod pa'i rgyun ma chad pa dang bcas pa yod do/ /de 'dra yod na gnyen sdebs par 'os pas dris la shog gsungs pa dang / de'i lan du/ snga ma bzhin dngul gyi sgrom bu phul ba/ de'i nang na/ ngas sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ kha ba can 'dir/ nyi ma gcig la gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs nas/ sgo thams cad khyod phyogs la bstan par bya'i de ngo mtshar mi che'am zer ba byung bas/ mtha' 'khob rgyal po de la/ bu mo ma byin na ni 'os dmag khyer nas yul khams thams cad bcom/ lha cig yang rang dbang med par 'phrog pa'i rnam par 'dug pas/ ster dgos pa 'dra dgongs kyang / khas ma blang par/ yang smras pa/ khyed kyi rgyal po de/ kha pho che ba gcig tu yod pa 'dug ste/ nga'i chab 'og tu gtogs pa rnams la/ sangs rgyasa'od srung gi dus nas/ da lta yan chod la thab tu du ba rgyun mi chad pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyad rgyu yod/ de dang 'dra ba'i mnga' thang yod na bu mo ster bas/ khyed rang byings po sdod rta pa 'ga' mthong la rgyal po la dris shog gsungs pa la/ snga ma bzhin du zhus shing gsung de'i lan 'di lags byas nas/gser gyi sgrom bu phul bas/ de'i nang nas/ sngar phan khyed 'byor pa che bar srid/ rgyal po de la dgyes shing / lha cig ster na/ ngas dkon mchog la gsol ba btab/ sprul pa bkye nas/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir/ rin po che du ma'i gter kha phye/ phyogs bzhi nas la sgo mang po'i sgo dbye la/ 'dod yon rnam lnga brgya stong mang por sprul nas/ mthar khyed rgyal khams gzhan thams cad kyi rin po che rnams kyang / kha ba can la rag pas dgos pa bya'i/ de'ang ngo mtshar 09

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gu pa gces bsdus/(goche ba min nam bya ba'i yi ge byung bas/ bal po'i rgyal blon thams cad zhe sgrag cing / ngo mtshar che nas bod rgyal po'i yi ge'i sgrom bu la zad pa'ang mi 'dugamangon par shes pa la thogs pa med pas nges par sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po gcig yod par 'dug snyam nas/ lha cig bal bza' khri btsun/ rin po che sna tshogs la sogs pa'i rdzong bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ yi dam mi bskyod rdo rje/byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ tsan+dan gyi sgron ma'i sku rang byon gcig dang bcasapa gnang ba gdan drangs nas/ pho brang dmar po rir phebs so/ /de nas b.labazas rgyal po thugs mi skyo zhing pha rol gyi dmag gis mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir/rin po che mang po sbyar/gnod sbyin pho mo rnams bran du bkol nas/ dmar po ri khong du bcug pa'i so phag gi lcags ri gyang rim sum cu rtsa gnyis dang mnyam pa/ srin yul laṅka pu ri'i grong khyer dang 'dra ba/ mkhar dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i rtse mo nyag stong du tshang pa/ mkhar re la mdung ba dan dmar po can bzhi re gtsug pa/ phyogs bzhi la/ sgo spe bzhi bsrung mi yod pa/ rtse mkhar la bya ra ba mi lnga rgyun du yod pa/ de'i lho ngos la lcags ri'i nang na pho brang sog po mkhar bya ba dgu thog dang rgyal po'i rtse mkhar mnyam pa/ de gnyis lcags thag gis sbrel nas dngul zam la rgyu ba/ mkhar dang lcags ri rnams la/ mda' yab dang / sgo chung dang / rnga yab dang / pha gu dang / kha bad/ rta babs/ rin po che'i dril bu g.yel kha/ mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed sogs kyis brgyan pa/ pha rol gyi dpung gis mi tshugs pa gcig bzhengs so/ /de rting yang blon po mgar dang thon mi sa sto ṭas mgo byas pa'i rta pa brgya la dngul gyi dong rtse brgya dang /110

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/rin po che'i gos gcig glang po che rin po che'i dra bas g.yogs pas/ gser phye bre phyed dang bcas pa rnams bskur nas/ shar phyogs rgya nag po'i lha cig slong ba la brdzangs so/ khong rnams kyis rgya bkra shis khri sgor sleb thang tha'i dzung rgyal po dang mjal nas/ rgyu mtshan zhus/ phyag rten phul bas/ de'i dus na lha cig slong ba la/ rgya gar/ stag gzig khrom ge sar hor gyi rgyal po dang bcas pasakyang rta pa brgya brgya sleb pa dang 'dzom/ rgya nag rgyal po yab yum/ sras pho mo dang bcas pa thams cad/ bod la ster 'dod pa gcig kyang med na'ang / rgyal khrims la brten dgos pa byung bas/ da khyed blon po rnams rig pa su che ba de la ster ro gsungs nas/ tha dad kyi mi re la sha chang re sprad nas/ nyin gcig la bza' btung dang / lug lhags mnyes tshar ba khang pa ma rdzab pa byed dgos so byas pas/ rgya'i g.yu bzhag 'khyil ba la dar rgyus kha sus thub/ bkra shibs khri sgo'i da nangs kyi yong sa'i sgo sus shes/ rta ma bu brgya dang / bya ma bu brgya ngo sprod sus thub/ mthar lha cig kong jo 'dra 'dra'i bu mo sum brgya'i gseb nas ngos sus zin la ster ro gsungs byung ba la/ blon po mgar rig pa che ba dang /gnas mos bslab bya byas pa la brten nas/ na ma thams cad khong gis sheb(nas lha gcig bod la mi ster ka med byung zhing / snye bo gzhan rnams ni so sor log rgya nag pa rnams ni/ nged kyi lha cig de/ bod la shor ro zer nas/ cho nge 'deb bas pa'ang byung / de ltar na'ang / las 'brel dang / khrims gzhin bzhag nas/ lha cig rgya bza' kong jo/ rin po che la sogs pa'i rdzong bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ yi dam shākya mu rne/ gab rtse drug cu skor/ sman dpyad/ bzo sna bco 11/

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(/sdibargyad/ 'bru sna tshang /ldan du la phug dang yi ma kho na yin/)bran g.yog pho mo mang po dang bcas pa gnang nas/ sngon la brdza ngas/ blon po mgar rig pa che ba'i rigasabargyud spel ba'i phyir du/ lo gcig sdod dgos gsungs/ rting la sdad dgos pa byung ba'i skabs su/ na rdzu btab/ rim 'gro la bsnyad pa'i g.yo thabs sna tshogs byas nas/ rgya mi mang rab dang bcas pa khrid nas yar mgyogs par yong bas/ kong jo dpon g.yog gi phyi rjes khams kyi nags shod du zin/ de nas/bod rgyal po'i drung du/ lha cig skal rdzongs phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te phebs kyin yod pas blon 'bangs rnams kyis bsu ba dang / dga' ston gyi grab bsgom pa mdzod cig zer ba'i zhu ba sngon ma btang ba bzhin/ pho brang dmar po ri'i phyogs bzhi'i srung (bsgoms la/ lam bcos pa dang / bsu mi tha dad du ba6yin pas lha cig gi rjo/la pa skyes nas/ nyin gcig la khye1gas bzhi'i lam nas lha cig 'dra 'dra re dang bcas pa'i/ sprul pa byung nas pho brang gi sgor gcig tu gyur te nang du byon/ lha sa'i mthil/ nag gseb bye ma'i gling chu mig 'gram du lha'i shing rta bying nas/ rgyad lha dga'/ klu dgas kyang ma theg par/ jo bo de rkar bzhugs pa ni/ sa dgra mnon pa la dgongs pa'o/ /sku bsrung la spyad gnyis bzhag gos dar gyi sla yol gyis gcad do/ /der kong jo rgyal po dang mjal yab yum gsum blon 'bangs dang bcas pa dgyes shing dga' mgur spyod do/ /de nas rgyal po'i thugs la/ lha rten gsung rab 'di pa bzhugasapa'i gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs dgos nas/ kong jos por thang khra bo rtings nas/ ju yag gi rtsis byas pas/ yul de na bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad la 2

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/ sogs pa dge mtshan du ma tshang 'dug na'ang / sa'i dgra brgyad dam lnga 'dug pa dang lar bod yul kha ba can 'di/ srin mo gan rkyal du nyal ba dang 'dra'o/ /'o thang gi mtsho 'di srin mo'i snying khrag tu 'dug pa 'di mnon dgos pas/ de la'ang dang por ru bzhir lha khang brtsigs dgos zer nas/ dpung mgo g.yas pa la/ ka tshal/ ga sku snan pa la khra 'iXgrag brla g.yas pa la gtsang 'gram/ ga sku snan pa la grom pa rgyang brtsigs so/ /yang srin mo'i yan lag bzhi mnon pa'i phyir mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi ni/ gru mo g.yas pa la kong po bu chung /g.yon pa la lho brag kho mthing / pus lnga sna g.yas pa la ka brag g.yon pa la pra dum rtse brtsigs so/ /yang srin mo'i nying lag bzhi mnon pa'i phyir/ yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi ni/ lag mthil g.yas pa la byang 'tshal gyi rlung mnon/ g.yon pa la khams su slong thang sgrol ma/ rkang mgo g.yas pa la byams sprin/ g.yon pa la mon bum thang skyer chung rnams bzhengs/ de rting yi po dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyi pa'i dus sa pho khyi la ra sa'i rmang gting / yang zhig nas rtsig tu ma btub pa la/ rgyal pos/ tsan+dan gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas sngon la lho phyogs su pho brang rtsigs la / der mchod pa'i rten ngo mtshar can rnams spyan drongs shig de nas rim gyis 'dod pa 'grub par 'gyur ro gsungs pa byung nas/ bal bza' ma bka' bsgo nas/ lho phyogs su pho brang brtsigs/ mchod pa'i rten rnams gdan drangs/ rgyal po yang phebs nas bal po'i lha bzos gnang ste/ yi dam gyi lha bzhengs pa'i rgyu khyad par can dang lag cha rnams rgyal po'i spyan sngar bsags/ sang nyin nas lha bzhengs rtsis la/ de nub pho brang gi mthong khung na/ mar sangs rgyas byang sems 113

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/(shothams cad 'od zer bkra shar re byon/ lha'i sku la thim song bas/ rgyal po'idagongs pa la/ nga'i yi dam 'di la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sem dpa' thams cad dang byin brlabs mnyam pa zhig yod par 'dug pas/ shinatu legs/ de'ang bod kha ba can pa'i lha skal thugs rje chen po'i rigs lnga bsartsa gcig gi nang nas gang bzhengs na drag dgongs pa la/ sang nam langs tsa na/dbu'i sngas kha na rgyal po rang dang / sku bongs mnyam pa'i lha bcu gcig zhala'adi rang byon du byon 'dus pas/ shin tu legs na'ang tsan+dan gyi sku rang byunga'adi dang mchod rten 'di gsum lha sku'i khong snying du bzhugs pa zhig byed dgosabasam pa yin te gsungs pa dang / lha sku de'i phyag gnyis kyis lha rang gi shamathabs pus gong du brdzes te/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil nas 'od zer 'phros/tsan+dan gyi lha sku dang mchod rten gsum po spyan drangs/ thugs kar bzhugs pas/sku shin tu sbram/ a mi : wa yang g.yon gyi phyogs su song / zhabs sngar shul du byon kyang / sham thabs pus gong du lus te chags pas/ rgyal po shin tu ngo mtshar zhing mnyes par gyur to/ /der rting rgyal pos yi dam la gsol ba btab pas/ zhal dbus ma nas 'od zer byung / lho nub la wa ba tshal du/ dug gi sdong po la phog de thor bas 'dre srin gyi 'dus dpung bshig 'od zer brag la phog pa las/ kha sar pa ṇi dang / rta mgrin/ a mi dhe wa rnams kyi sku dod 'dug pa bzhin 'bur du brkos yod cing / brag lha can gdong zhes par grags so/ /'od zer des/ nub phyogs brag lha klu phug gi ma mo'i nyal sa 'phrogs/ rgyal pos sprul pa bkye nas thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong gi bzo mdzad/ bal 114

rgya bod mig tshang chen smo/po'i lha bzos/ lo gi shwa ri dang / kha sar pa ṇi/ dbyangs can ma/ 'od zer can/khro gnyer can/ rta mgrin/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba rnams bzhengs te gtso bo dgu bzhugs so/ /de nas jo mo ru yong za rgyal mo btsun gyis/ ma mo'i nyal sar bcom ldan 'das rnam snang kun tu zhal brag la 'bur du dod pa bzhengs/pho brang gi lho nub btsan gyi rgyu srang yod sar mchod rten ke ru brtsigs/ klu'i da ltar mo che'i sa 'dir yin/ pho brang gi steng na/ gser gyi lha shākya mu zhes mnan zin rgyal pos phyogs bzhi dang sa'i dgra brgyad po mnan/ bkra shis pa'i rtagasabargyad po gsal bar byas pa ni/ gnam la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ sal pad ma 'dab brgyad kyi bar na 'phan kur stag mo'i ri la gdugs yod/ ra ku'i brag la nya yod/ rdzong btsan gyi brag la bum pa yod/ grib se sgrom na dung yod/yugs ma'i zur na rin po che'i dpal be'u yod/ bshun gyi ri la rgyal mtshan yod/ der rting yon tan thams cad 'thon pas ra sa'i lha khang rtsig tu btub par mkhyen nas/ bod kha ba can du legs so cog 'byung zhing nyes so cog sgrib pa'i phyir du/ rgyal pos sprul pa lnga stong bkye nas lha khang bzhengs/ btsun mo dam pa bal bza' khri btsun gyis ra sa 'phrul snang dang / rgya bza' kong jos rgya stag ra mo che/ zhang zhung bza' li tig man gyis khram bu lkog ma/ ru yong bza' rgyal mo btsun gyis brag lha klu phug mon bza' khri lcam gyis yer pa'i lha khang rnams bzhengs so/ /ra sa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas lo gsum lon tsa na/bod 'bangs byin pos nam zla dus bzhi'i rtsis ma shes shan ma phye pa la/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dgongs pa la/ ngas chos 'jig rten gyi khrims 'chos/1/5

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(//bod 'bangs dge la bskul thub pa byung na'ang / 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog gi grab sel thabs/ rgya dkar nag gi rtsis kyang rgyas par spel nas/ rgyal khams 'baphan gdags dgos snyam pa 'khrungs te/ bod mi blo gsal shes rab dang ldan pa / 'bre gnya' brtan dang / lang tsho ldong legs/ bya gag stong kun/ 'dar mistag kha bya ba dang bzhi po la gser gyi spar ru dngul gyi yang khol can brgyad/gser spar ru re re lam chas gser phye bre phyed dang bcas pa bskur nas/ khyed rnams rgya nag yul du song la bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir phan pa'i gtsug lagaslob nas spyon cig sngar bod na kong jos khyer byung ba'i nag rtsis drug cu skor zur tsam dang / rgya gar nas bsgyur ba'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ nyi ma drug skor tsam mo/ /dkar nag gi rtsis ma dar bas gson gshin kyi rtsis dang / nam zla'i dus bzhi'i thob lugs rgya nag po la gtugs dgos par 'dug pas/ mkhasapar slobs la spyon cig bya dga' chen po byed pa yin no gsungs pa'i/ bka' bsgo nas rdzangs btang bas/ khong bzhi po phyin te rgya nag tu sngon la/ mkhas pa mi bzhi la rang sar gtugs/ de pa'i nang na nam zla'i rtsis la mkhas pa/ rgya khri ma hā ya na bya ba la bod mi bzhi nas zhus/ lo gcig dang zla ba bdun bsdad/gzhan gyi rgyud chen la sogs ma bu tshang ba rang ni ma gnang / rgyud snang gsal sgron me dang spang rgya bla ma dang gnam sa rjes gcod dang / phyag shog 'brong bu'i gab rtse tsam gnang bas/ blo gsal de rnams kyis gson gshin gyi rtsis dang /nam zla dus bzhi shan phyed par byas nas/yar la sdebs yongs/ de'i skabs na slabs shes kyi yon tan gang la'ang stangs 'bul dgongs pas na/ rje sa bdag 16

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ rgyal po dbu la bzhugs pa'i khrom tshogs sar nag rtsis gang shes pa thams cad pod skad du bskur bas stangs phul cig gsungs pa la/ 'bre gnya' brtan gyis gang shes bshad/ de la bya gag gis dgag pa btang de rting lang tsho sdong legs kyis bshad/ de la'ang bya gag gis skyon btsal/ de nas rgyal po la rgyab bcol te/ bya gag rang gis bshad pas/ bla sgo gsum ka phye mkhas par grags/ rgyal blon thams cad thugs mnyes so/ /'dar mi stag kha bya ba de ni bya gag gi rjes su 'brang zer bas/ bshad mi dgos/ de'i slob mar gyur/ der 'tshogs pa kun na re/ 'bre gnya' brtan khyed rang spar kha'i mo phran tsam thob pa las gson gshin gyi rtsis gzhan ma byed cig mi phung bar 'gyur ro zer ro lang tsho la khyod rang gson rtsis zas tshol tsam gyis la gshin rtsis dang / gto chen mo ma byed cig zer nas/ gnyis po phud nas/ rgyal pos rgyas btab bo/ / bya gag stong kun de rgya nag gi rtsis gang la'ang mkhas par spyad de/ de'i bu bya gag rgya mtsho bya ba lags so/ /pha tshe bu rabs su rje'i bla rtsis pa byas so/ /bod du nag rtsis dar ba'i sngon ma 'di rnams yin par byed cing / nag rtsis kyi brgyud rim rnying ma ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis lha tshangs pa la gsungs/des srid pa'i lha mo rnam rgyal ma/ lha wang de 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ klu dga' bo/bram ze ser skya/ rgya stag po che/ hang gha/ rgya do re/ rgya khri mahā ya na rnams la rim par bshad cing / des bod kyi mkhas pa mi bzhi po la bslabs pa'i bya gag stong kun gyi rigs brgyud ni ga ring ye shes rgyal po tshang yin par byed la/ de pa spyir nag rtsis la dang sgos su sa gzhung la mchog tu mkhas pa yin no/ /7

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (she/de'ang nag rtsis la rgyud chen por grags pa lnga yod pa ni/ sdong po kun 'dus shing gi rgyud/ snang gsal sgron me me'i rgyud/ gab pa 'phrul 'khor sa'i rgyud/se ru nag po lcags kyi rgyud/ bdud rtsi bum pa chu'i rgyud rnams so//gzhan yang rgyud phran dang /bstan bcos man ngag ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo//de nas kyang bod rgyal po blon chen po bcu drug dang bcas te rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar byon nas rgya'i so kha 'bul ba dang / kong jo len dus kyi khas len chad btsan par bya ba'i phyir/ lha khang mang po bzhengs/ lo bcu gsum gyi ring la rgya bod du lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs tshar ba'i rting ma/ rab sgang du yongs rdzogs lha khang zhes bya ba bzhengs so/ /bka' chems bka' khol ma las/ chos rgyal 'di'i ring la rgya gar nas slob dpon ku mā ra bya ba spyan drangs te/ de'i lo tsā ba thon mi sam bho ṭas byas nas/ mngon pa'i sde snod dang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bsgyur ro/ /bal po'i blon po shī la ma lha'i lo tsā ba lha cig bal bza' khri btsun gyis byas nas mdo sde'i sde snod dang / phal po che dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud rnams bsgyur ro/ /rgya gar gyi bram ze sha ka ra'i lo tsā ba a tsa ra ṅgārma ko dzis byas nas/ 'dul ba'i sde snod dang kā ri kā 'dul ba 'od ldan/ kri ya'am mdo rgyud rnams bsgyur ro/ /rgya nag nas slob dpon ha shang mahā ya na spyan drangs te/ de'i lo tsā ba lha cig rgya mo kong jo dang lha lung rdo rje dpal gyis byas nas nag rtsis dang sman spyad la sogs mang po bsgyur bar byed do/ /zhang zhung gi yul nas bon po'i grub thob/zhang zhung lha ldem bya ba bos nas bo/ ༵ a'o rnams bsags nas bon slob

rgya bod yig tshang mo/tu bcug ste/ nad pa'i rim 'gro la sogs pa bon yang dar bar mdzad do/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po nyid rang gis ma 'ongs pa'i dus su/ bod kyi chos skal dar bar bya ba'i phyir du/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i chos skor ma bu zhal gdams dang bcas pa brgya rtsa brgyad zhal nas gsungs shing / de dag thams cad dpe ru bris nas/ lha sa'i byang chub gling gi rta mgrin zhabs 'og dang g.yo ru khra 'brug rgyal po'i bkor mdzod na sbas yod do/ /dus mtha' la sleb dus skyes bu skal ldan las 'phro can rnams kyis rnyed par lung bstan no / / gzhan yang bod mun pa'i smag rum gyis 'thibs pa bsal ba'i phyir du gang la gang 'tsham pa'i sprul pa bkye ba ni de nas bod rnams lung gi chos la yid ches par bya ba'i phyir/ khrom dkyil du/ nad pa dang / sman pa dang /mo ma dang / bon pos sha ba nam mkha' la 'gro shes pa la sogs sprul nas/nad pa drag de la khrom rnams ngo mtshar skyes pas da ltar gyi nad pa 'di 'dra la las che na ngan song gsum dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal brjod pas yid ma ches/ spre'u'i spyad ha lu man+da'i sgrung bshad nas bod kyi rigs brgyud dang /las kyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i mdo sde dang sbyar bas yid ches/ bslab pa gsum la bkod pa'i phyir bon byas/ nad sos pa las phan che ba'i bslab pa gsum gyi yon tan bstan/ sangs rgyas kyis rgya gar du mdzad pa bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i dod por/ rgyal pos ra sa'i gtsug lag khang du mjad pa bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus yod cing / khro bo smre brtsegs kyi rgyab na mchod rten brgyad po byas yo/ spya/ /de lta bu'i chos rgyal chen po 'di

'tshen na 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (neni 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dngos yin par grags shing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srol legs par gtod nas/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis zhesapa sa pho khyi lo shar ba'i stod la bka' chems chen mo bzhag pa yin/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /nga nas mi rabs lnga nyid nas/ /lde zhes bya ba'i chos rgyal 'byung / /dam chos ma lus rgyas par byed/ /tha ma de yang sangasargyas 'gyur/ /de nas mi rabs gnyis nas ni/ /rgyal po dud 'gro'i ming can 'byung //dam chos ma lus rgyas par byed/ /de nas mi rabs 'ga' zhig na/ /dam chos mi rtag tsam zhig 'byung / /mar me 'chi khar gsal ba bzhin/ /rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus su ni/ /dam chos shin tu gsal bar 'byung / /zhes pa la sogs/ bod 'bangs spyi sgos thams cad la phan pa'i zhal gdams mang po gsungs pa'i rjes la/ rgyal po dang khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa bal mo bza' dang / sgron ma'i sprul pa rgya mo bza' dang yab yum gsum ka 'phrul snang gi btsan khang byang mar rang byon 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal la thims so/ /rgyas par bka' chems bka' khor mar lta'o/ /'ga' res rgyal po/ 'phan yul zal mo sgang du grongs zer ba'ang 'dug ste/ blon po sna chen po dang si'u gung ston la sogs gros la dbang ba rnams kyis/ bod 'bangs byin po spro ba srings pa'i phyir du re zhig zal mo snang du bsnyung pa skad dang / sku gshegs pa'i tshul du byas par byed do/ /rgya bza' kong jo lcag mo grang la rgya nag nas byon/ bod yul du lo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs par byed/srong btsan bang so 'phyong rgyas mda' ru btab/ /che chu 2rdod ni dpag chen mda' rgyang gang / /

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/nang na lha khang lnga yang bzhugs so skad/ /bang so nang rgyan can du grags pa yin/ /bang so gru bzhir brtsigs pa de nas byung / /ming la smug ri smug po legs so skad/ /rje de dang mon bza' khri lcam gyi sras gung srong gung btsan/blon po ni mang po rje zhang snang dang / sgrubs btsan do re byas/ chab srid lo lnga bzung dgung lo bco brgyad pa la 'das nas slar yang / yab kyis rgyal srid bzung pa phyed mar bgrang skad/ gung srong bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ /gral ni gnam ri srong btsan g.yon na yod/ /ming ni gung si gung chen yin no skad/ /rje de dang 'a zha bza' kong rdzo mo rje'i sras mang srong mang btsan lo bcu gsum na mes po 'das nas/ lo bco lnga'i bar la srid bzung / blon po mgar stong btsan yul bzung dang mchims mang gnyer gyis byas/ nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la gtsang gi bar snang du 'das/ shangs kyi pho brang sgang yin zer/ mang srong bang so srong btsan g.yon na yod/ /ming ni sngo bzher hral po bya ba lags/ /rje de dang 'bro bza' khri se khri ma lod kyi sras 'dus srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po ni chu mo bya lo pa ste/ ma 'grungs gong tsam du yab 'das/ 'khrungs 'phral nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar la srid bzung / 'di'i ring la bod du rol mo'i rnam grangs mang po 'byung ba'i snga ltas su rtsal po che mi bdun byung ba ni/ a rgod ldong btsan gyis seng ge dkar mo'i gnya' ba nas bzung byung skad/ mon khri bzang gis stag dar ma gnyis lcags thag gis sgrol nas khrid pa sdo/nga pa ngur sgras khengs pa byas byung skad/ lho don da/ /yang dag 'phags kyis seng ldeng gi

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (negadung chen po bcu gsum gyi steng du lcags dos kyi gong tsha gcig dang byas nas khur byung skad/ lcog ro zangs dkar gyis lha sa'i rdo ring rked pa la btsugs nas yo ga yo zhin byung skad/ rngog rings nag pos bal yul nasaglang po che'i phrug gu gson por khur byung skad/ 'gos shar chung gis shwa ba yu mo'i blud bu nos rgyangs nas klad la bskor gin byung / mon rgyal mtshan rnam grags kyis mig mthong gsum re mda' rgyang gang gis sleb cing gtsang po la phar 'phyong tshur 'phyong byed kyin byung skad do/ /rgyal po 'di'i dus su/ bod na/ sngar med pa'i ja dang dkar yol byung ba'i lo rgyus yod pa rgyas par gzhan du blta zhing / zur tsam bstan pa ni dus nam zhig rgyal po snang drag po zhig gis thebs pa'i dus su/ bod na sman dpyad gzhung bzhin shes pa ni med/ zas dang spyod lam/ rig bzo la brten pa tsam yod pas sku mtshams bzhugs yod pa'i nang nas/ pho brang gi pu shu'i zur na bya yid du 'ong ba sngar ma mthong ba gcig gi kha na shing bu lo 'dab dang ldan pa nyung shas shig khyer nas skad snyan par sgrog gin 'dug pa rgyal pos gzigs na'ang / sngon ma ched gnyer ma mdzad/ sang gi nyi ma shar mtshams su'ang de bzhin du byed kyin 'dug pa dang / rgyal po'ang the tshom skyes te ltas nas shing de rnams zhing ma la bcug pas/ sngar med kyi shing du 'dug cing shing de yi sne mo gcig zhal du bcug nas bro ba myang pas zhal skyem pa sos btung ba'i mchog tu mngon nas/ da khyed blon 'bangasarnams nyon cig nga na ba'i skabs 'a/// gzhan gyi bza' btung ni gang yang

rgya bod yig mong chen mo/mi 'dod/ byas khyer ba'i shing bu 'di ni btung ba'i mchog lus kyi gsos nad kyi sman du 'dug pas/ nga la blo nye ba rnams kyis shing 'di lta bu gar 'dug kyang tshol byon cig bya dga' chen po byed do gsungs pa dang /blon 'bangs byings pos bod yul gyi sa cha stod smad thams cad du btsal kyang ma rnyed/ blon po rgyal po las bsam du med pa'i slo ba nye shos gcig gis/ bod kyi sa mtha' 'khyams 'khyams pas rgya nag 'thub bo/ / sug ling nge ba mthong sa gcig tu sleb ste/ pha gi 'dra ba'i gseb na shing de nges par yod dam snyam nas gtad phyin pas/ nags de'i tshu rol na chu chen po gcig 'dug pas chu la ni 'gro ma nus/ shing de ni nags gseb na yod par rig ste rgyal po yid la sems kyin sdad tsa na dar cig nas nya chen po gcig kho'i thad de nas chu de la zhugs song ba dang / chu kha zheng che ba ma gtogs gting la mi nub par 'dug pas/ sems dga' ste/ de'i rjes la brgal phyin nas/ nags khag seb tu sleb pa dang / nags kham ni phal che ba byasasakhyer ba'i shing de rkyang du 'dug pas/ da ni pha gis rje bo nges par sku brtas par 'gyur ro snyam pa'i dga' spro dang bcas nas/ shing de 'dra ba rgyab gcig brngas yang bsam mno phyi ma la rgyal po bsnyung ba dwangs pa la ni 'dis phan nges/ sa thag ring bar 'dug pas/ da lan 'khur ba'i grogs sam khal ma gcig yod na bsam pa'i 'dod pa skyes pa'i dus der da zhi med pa'i shwa ba mo gcig mi 'dzem par rtsa ru slob byung bas 'di 'dra la'ang khal bkal rung pa'ang srid dam snyam nas grabs byas/rdos/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin byar byung

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//nas/ shing de nas shwa ba'i khal rgyab gcig dang / kho rang gi rgyab gcig khur yong bas/ lam zhag zla ba'i bar la song na'ang shwa bas kyang khur nas/ bod rgyal po'i pho brang mthong sar bskyal lo/ /de nas grogs bkug ste rgyal po'i spyan sngar phul bas shin tu dgyes nas bya dga' chen po'ang byas/ bsnyung sos pa la yang phan po byung skad/ de rting rgyal po'i zhal nas 'di ni btung ba'i mchog tu 'dug pas/ 'di 'thung sa'i sdod sngar yod pa'i gzi/ mchong /gser/ dngul la sogs rin po che'i zhal skyogs 'di rnams kyang ma yin pa'i/ sngar med kyi snod cig tshol dgos par 'dug pa/ de'ang rgya nag po'i rgyal po la/ dkar yol zer ba zhig yod 'dug pa slongs la shog cig gsungs pa byung nas/ gser yig pa btang bas rgya nag rgyal po na re/ rang re rgya bod gnyis 'thab mthun lan mang bod la phan gdags pa'i phyir du nged kyis/ sman rtsis bzo gnas rol mo mkhan rim par btang na'ang /bod kyis bsam du ma 'dod pas dkar yol mi bskur/ bod rang la bzo rgyu yod na bzo mkhan zhig btang yongs gsungs pa byung nas rgya'i dkar yol bzo mkhan khrid yong ste/ bod rgyal po'i mdun du rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/ des na / rang red bzo bar rigs pas/ snga sor rgyu dang chas rkyen ci 'dra dgosapa bsogs shig gsungs pa la/ kho na re rgyu'i rab ni rin po che'i 'ching bu/'bring ni 'dze/ tha ma rdo dkar po la yang rung ngo zer bas gan mdzod nas rgyu gsum po gang dgos pa sprad/ dkar yol la rigs rnam pa mang bas ji ltar bzo zer ba la/ bzo gnas kyi ri/sdu ni sngar rgya nag du'ang ma dar ba zhig

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/bzo dgos pa/ gzugs ni kha g.yel ba/ srab pa/ rkang pa thung ba/ mdog dkar 'jam/ sngo dwangs ldan pa zhig dgos/ ming ni/ bod na sngar med pa dar bas dar/ snod de bsten pas tshe dang dpal 'byor 'phel bar byed pa na dar tshe zhes par thogs shig de dang ri mo'i rnam pa ni/ dang po 'dab chags byas shing khyer byung ba la rkyen pa yin pas rab de'i nang du bya kha na shing khyer ba re bris/ 'bring la mtsho nya dang bcas pa re gyis/ tha ma rnams la spang ri shwa ba dang bcas pa re gyis/ de rnams las zhan pa byung na ri mo dang /rnam grangs gang 'os bzo bos blos bcol la gyis shig gsungs/ der bzo bos/ rgyu bzang ngan dwangs snyigs las ses nas dar rtse la rigs rnam pa drug tu gyes te/ rgyal po'i bka' gnang ba gsum po la/ shab tshe/ lan tshe/shang tshe bya bar ming btags/ phal pa gsum po la/ theg tshe/ nges tshe/ brdo tshe zhes par btags te/ bod dkar dar tshe'i rigs 'di rnams ni/ de gong rgya nag na'ang med par byed cing bod du/ ja dang dkar yol byung ba'i sngon ma 'di yin par 'dod do/ /rgyal po 'dis bod ma yin pa'i 'jang yul la sogs rgyal khams mang po 'og tu bcug mnga' thang che bar byung dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa la 'jang yul du 'das/ spur gnyer cog gru gung khri zhes bya bas byas/ 'phrul rgyal bang so mang srong g.yon na yod/ /ming ni seng ge rtsig pa can no skad/ /bang so 'di la lcags ris bskor nas yod/ /de ni hor gyis mi sdes brtsigs so skad/ /rje de dang mchims bza' btsan la me tog gi sras khri lde gtsug brtan mes a/ /rdoms su grags pa de lcags pho 95grag

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/ (//gi lo la pho brang ldan dkar du 'khrungs/ de'i lo bzhugs la yab 'das nasasrid bzung /blon po sbas skyes bzang stong btsan dang /mchims rgyal gzigasashu lde 'bro chu bzang hor mang gsum gyis byas/ de yang mes srong btsan gyis/lung bstan zhal chems su bzhag pa de nga yin snyam du dgongs nas/ sangasargyas gsang ba dang sangs rgyas zhi ba spyan drangs/ theg chen gyi mdo sngagasadang / de bzhugs nga pa'i brag dmar mgrin bzang / brag dmar ka chu/ lha samakhar brag 'ching phu nam ral/ ma sa gong dang lha khang lnga bzhengs/ rgya nag ger shang nas mdo gser 'od dam pa dang / mdo las rnam 'byed bsgyur/ bi ji btsan pa shi las sman dpyad mang po bsgyur/ de'i ring la 'phying nga stag rtse nas g.yu rdog chen po gcig kyang rnyed do/ /des btsun mo 'jang bza' khri btsun khab tu bzhes pa la/ srab shin tu mtshar ba gcig bltams pa'i ming 'jang tsha lha dbon du grags/ de'i khab tu 'os pa bod na med pas/ rgya nag nas/ rgya rje ling dzung khri bzher gyi sras mo zhim shing kong jo blangs pas kong jo ma slebs pa la gnyag khri bzang 'don gyi bu mo ma blangs pa'i ko long byas nas/ 'jang tsha gnyag kyis bkrongs so/ /'jang tsha lha dbon bang so yab kyi mdun zlum por brtsigs nas yod do skad/ der yab dang kong jo 'dus pa'i sras khri srong lde btsan mes sgong btsan sgam po 'byungs rting lo brgya dang bdun cu don bzhi song ba'i lcags pho rta lo la brag dmar du sku bltams/ yab ni dgung lo drug cu rtsa gsum pa la yar 'brog sbal tshan khar 'das so/ /ag tshom bang so mu ra ༵ ༵ brtsigs/ /gral ni 'phrul gyi rgyal

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/po'i g.yon na yod/ /ming ri lha ri gtsug nam bya ba lags/ khri srong lde btsan dgung lo bcu gsum pa la yab 'das te rgyal srid lo bzhi bcu rtsa gsum bzung / 'di ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul par grags shing /'dis dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul ni bsam gyis mi khyab la khyad par de'i dgung lo 'ga'i bar la sdig blon ma zhang khron pa skyes kyis gros ston nas sngar gyi rgyal brgyud sku tshe thung ba la sogs pa rnams chos khrims byas pas lan pa yin/ da bar chad bzlog thabs la bon gyis chosabazhin sus ma byas pa la chad pa byed do zer nas lha shākya mu rne bye thems su bcug pa dang / mang yul du skyel ba dang / dkon gnyer hwa shang rgan po rgya nag la bsgrod pa dang / 'bangs gum pa la dge rtsa mi gtong ba'i khrims bu chung 'cha' ba la sogs bstan pa la gnod pa'i bya ba mang po byas 'dug pa thams cad rgyal bu rgyal sar ston 'phral nas bkag ma shad khron pa skyes gson por dur du bcug lha shākya mu zhe mang yul nas gdan drangs dam chos dar bar bya ba dang bsam yas kyi lha khang bzhengs par 'dod nas bod 'bangs rnams gshes gcog pa'i phyir khyed rnams kyis has po ri 'di lcags kyi sbugs su 'jug gam/ dge rgyas bye ma gling gser phyes 'gengs sam g.yas ru gtsang po zangs kyi sbugs su 'jug gam/ has po ri'i rtse mor shel gyi mchod rten zhang po rgya'i yul mthong ba zhig brtsig gam/ yang na nga 'dod pa'i lha khang gcig bzhengs sam gsungs pa'i 'dam kha byed du bcug pas/ lha khang 'dams nas rgyaX 7po dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig lon pa'i

ba chen 'od snang la /4skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (she/stag lo la sba ye shes dbang po dang sba snang gsal la sogs rnams za hor gyi yul nas/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa spyan 'dren pa la btang / phebs nas sa chog mdzad de/ rgyal po rang gis gser gyi 'byor thog nas rmangs brus pas/ khru gang tsam nas/ 'bras dang sa zhag don/ stag lo de la bsam yas kyi rmangasabating pas/ bod kyi lha srin rnams phrag dog che bar byung nas mkhan po'i bka' bzhin/ de nas mang po rje dang seng sto lha lung gnyis u rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug nas gdan 'dren pa la btang bas/ dam can gyi bskul nas slob dpon gyis snga thud bcug byon pas mang yul du phebs pa dang mjal/ gser 'bul gnang byas/rgyal pos bsu ba la byon kyang yon mchod phyag sus 'tshal ma 'dum pa'i dus su / slob dpon gyis nga che nga gnyan gyi mgur gsungs/ pho brang du phebasanas/ bod la dbang che ba'i klu'i rgyal po mal gro la/ klu gter bcug lha 'dre zil gnon gyi mgur gsungs/ lha srin thams cad dam la btags nas/ lha khang bzhengs pas nyin mo las mtshan mo mgyogs par brtsigs/zur phud u tshal klu yis bar chad byas nas shing byin pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bod la klu nad dar bar bshad/ der rgya gar o tan ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas/ bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum ri rab kyi tshul du byas/ khor sa phyi nang rim pa bdun du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ yang thog 'dul ba dang bstun nas phug gi rgyud ris/ mdo rgyud bcu bzhu 8thams cad mdo sde dang bstun/ lder

rgya bod mig tsha 'a mo/bzo bdun cu don brgyad thams cad gsang sngags dang bstun/ ka ba stong rtsa gnyis sgo mo che sum cu rtsa drug sgo chung bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ byi'u skad can drugacong chen po brgyad/ mngon pa dang bstun pa'i gling chen po bzhi/ gling phran brgyad/ nyi zla dang bcas pa bzhedas te/ shar gyi lus 'phags po la mkhyen rab 'jam dpal gling / gling g.yog lus dang la rnam dag khrims khang gling /lus 'phags la brda sbyor tshangs pa'i gling gsum po zla gam/ lhor 'dzam bu gling la/ rnga yab la bdud 'dul sngags pa'i gling / rnga yab gzhan la sgra bsgyur rgya gar gling gsum po sog kha/ nub tu ba lang spyod la dga' ldan byams pa'i gling / g.yo ldan la be+e ro tsā na'i gling / lam mchog 'gro la mi g.yo bsam gtan gling gsum po zlum po/ byang du sgra mi snyan la byang chub sems bskyed gling / sgra mi snyan dang la rin chen sna tshogs gling / sgra mi snyan gyi zla bo la dpe dkar dkor mdzod gling gsum po gru bzhi/ yak+ṣa rta 'og gnyis nyi zla'i tshul/ phyi'i lcags ri zur mangs rdo rje'i 'gros/ mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tshul du kha skor re la sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel re re yod pa/phyogs bzhir mgon khang bzhi/ phyi sgo'i gdong na rdo ring bzhi/ de'i steng na zangs kyi khyi mo re re dang bcas pa rnams rgyal pos bka' gnang nas bzhengs/ btsun mo dam pa dkar rgyal mtsho me tog sgron gyis khams gsum bzang khang gling / 'bro bza' byang chub sgron gyis dge rgyas bye ma gling / pho yong bza' rgyal mo btsun gyis sbu tshal gser khang gling / gyim shang kong jos dam pa'i shing khang rtse dgu ba/zlos/ dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi zur

ba chen 'od snang la /ga skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (3)bzhi'i mchod rten chen po bzhi ni/ blon po chen po shud po dpal gyi seṅges/dkar po byang chen mchod rten nyan thos lugs seng ges brgyan pa/ rgya tsha lha snang gis/ dmar po chos 'khor bskor ba'i mchod rten/ byang sems lugs/pad mas brgyan pa/ stag gru klu gong gis nag po sku gdung mchod rten de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung dang mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ mchims rdo rje spre chung gis sngon po lha bab mchod rten de bzhin gshegs pa'i lugs lha khang sgo bcu drug gis brgyan pa rnams bzhengs/ shing pho stag gi lo dbyi zla ra ba'i tshes bdun skar ma rgyal la lha khang rnams kyi 'gram rtings nas/ lo drug la thams cad 'byongs te/ sa mo lug lo la mkhan po bo dhi sa twa dang slob dpon pad+mas rab gnas mnga' gsol mdzad dus byin rlabs dang ngo mtshar che ba'i rnam 'phrul mang du byung ste/ byang gi byang chub sems bskyed gling gi lha gtso bo rnam snang nam mkha' la 'phags pa dang / dbu rtse'i lder bzo rnams sgo'i phyir byon byung ba/ rgyal po'i dgongs pa la ngo mtshar che ste/ da lha rnams nang du mi tshud dgongs pa byung 'phral la thams cad nang du log sngar shul du byon pa dang /rdo ring bzhi po'i steng gi zangs kyi khyi mo rnams phyogs bzhir 'phyongs te / skad thengs gsum gsum ston nas slar yang rdo khar log pa dang/ 'khor ba'i gnyug ring rnams rim gyi ma skyes pa dus gcig la skyes pa dang / khams gsum zangs khang gling gi lha gtso bo'i mgul du me tog pad ma'i stong po skyes pa la sogs pa byung bas rgyal po yon mchod thugs dgyes shing blon 'bangs thams cad ngo mtshar dad /sdu phyur par gyur te/ dpal gyi bsam

rgya bod mig tshang chen slo/yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i mtshan gsol rgyal pos rje'i dga' glu bcu gsum bya ba dang / blon chen po rnams kyi skyid pa'i dpal dgu la sogs mi res bkra shis pa'i glu re blangs/ brag dmar mtsho mo 'gur me tog pad sdong rang 'khrungs su lo bcu gsum gyi bar la skyid kyi gro mo che brdungs dga' ston rgya chen po byas so/ /de ltar bde skyid yo lang gi ring la/ lha khang gi nya ra zhabs tog la cung g.yel bar byung bas/rgyal po'i zhal nas da nga'i bzhed pa grub na'ang / rten lha khang ngo mtshar can 'di rnams chud mi za ba'i nya ra zhags tog byed mkhan khag can 'dra dgos par 'dug pas/ su 'os na gsungs pa la mkhan po na re/ rgya gar na dkon mchog gi zhabs tog la dkon gnyer zer ba'i btsun pa yong ba yin/ bod na sngar btsun pa ni mi 'dug rgyal po rang la bsam zhing dad mos yod pa'i blon 'bangs su 'os la 'tshol dgos gsungs pas/ yang rgyal po'i zhal nas/ de ltar yin na bod mi la'ang btsun pa rung ngam mkhan pos rjes su bzung du gsol zhus pas/ rung mi rung nyams sad du btub gsungs nas/ sba gsal snang dang / dbas khri gsher/ pa gor be+e ro tsā na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba/ me a tsar+ya rin chen mchog gtsang legs grub rnams mkhan po la rab tu byung e thub nyams sad pas/ khyad 'phags yod par dgongs te/ khong rnams la rim pa bzhin du sba sgo rnye rak+ṣi ta ye shes dbang po bsrung ba/ dbas rat+na rak+ṣi ta rin chen bsrung ba / ra mi rnye rak+ṣi ta rin chen dbang ༵ /srung ba/ rlangs khams pa su ga ta

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (//warma rak+ṣi ta bde bar gshegs pa bsrung ba/ pa gor be+e ro tsā na rak+ṣi ta rnam par snang mdzad bsrung ba/ mkhon nā gis rak+ṣi ta klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/gtsang khyo rlun rak+ṣi ta lha'i dbang po bsrung ba bya bar ming btags/ bod kyi btsun pa la snga ba sad mi mi bdun du grags pa byung / de rnams la ka ba shrī ku de rak+ṣi ta dpal brtsegs bsrung ba la sogs lo tsā ba brgya rtsa brgyad slob tu bcug de rnams la cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / zhang ban+de ye shes sdel sogs lo tsā ba stong rtsa brgyad slob tu bcug nas mtshan nyid kyi chos dar bar byas shing / lug lo nas dge 'dun de rnams thams cad mkhan po'i chos lugs bzhin yod par smra ba'i sde btsugs/ rgya gar nas dbu ma'i dge slong bcu gnyis gdan drangs nas/ dbu ma bye brag tu smra ba'i sde btsugs dam chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad nas/ mkhan po rgya gar la 'byon gsungs pa la rgyal pos zhu ba phul nas/ 61 gcig gi bar la 61 tsā ba rnams la zhal brda mdzad nas chos mang po bsgyur/ bod du mu stegs mi 'byung gi sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di la gnyis su gyes nas rtsod par 'gyur te mthar rtsod pa chos phyogs su zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan/ de rting mkhan po bo dhi satwa'i dbu la chibs pa'i 'phra ba 'phog nas mya ngan las 'das/ spur bsam yas has po ri'i rtse la mchod rten byas nas bzhugs so/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis spir bod yul du mi lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi bzhugs te lha klu gdug pa can thams chod dam la btags/ sa gzhi ri brag mang po gnas chen du byin gyis rlabs/ chos gter nor 1 /2 bsam gyis mi khyab pa sbas/ gsang

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/ sngags la'ang lo tsā ba sad mi mi drug bya ba byung ste/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying po dang /'bre rgyal ba'i blo gros/ru gong bir+ya rtsa/gru gu pe sha rlangs dbal gyi seng ge ce ku ku ra tsa la sogs pas lo tsā byas nas/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mang po gsungs pa rnams bsgyur/ gzhan yang gnyags dang / so zur gnubs gsum dang / 'khon rdo rje rin po che la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gtso bo brgyad du grags pa'i slob ma grub pa brnyes pa mang du spel/ gsang sngagasakyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad nas lho nub rnga yab gling la gshegs te/ lha sras mu ne btsan pos thog drangs bod kyi blon 'bangs mang pos/ mang yul gung thang gi la khar skyes ma byas la thog tu bod rgyal blon ban skya spyi mang la phan pa'i zhal gdams zab mo pad+ma bka' chems su grags pa de gsungs nas nyi ma'i zer la chibs te zangs mdog dpal ri'i gzhal yas khang du byon/ da lta srin po'i kha gnon mdzad cing 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'o/ /yang bod kyi dge slong mi lnga tshe 'di la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i chos 'tshol du rgya gar la btang be+e ro tsā nas chos lon/ yang tshe gcig la sangs rgya ba'i chos 'dod gsungs pas mkhan po dang / nyang ting 'dzin bzang po'i lung bstan bzhin/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi'i mchod gnas mkhas pa bi ma la mi tra gdan 'dren pa la ka cog gnyis dang / rma rin chen mchog kha che'i yul du btang slob dpon dang mjal rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ bho ti sa twa brnyar thim/ /zhes pa lan gsum gsungs pa dang / gdan 'dren pa gsum pos 'byon par nges pa'i go ba mi di ༵ re re rnyed/ slob dpon gyis ka pā

'tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ (goli sor bzhi la rgya yig 'bru bdun bris pa gcig bsnams nas/ bsam yasasu phebs rgya bod kyi log lta thul bar 'dug pa dgongs/ lha dang rgyal po su la'ang phyag ma mdzad pas/ phyi pa gcig yin nam snyam pa'i the tshom skyes de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ phyag gi don shes sam gsungs/ mi shes zhus pas ngas lha dang gnyis su med pa'i phyag btsal zin/ brda'i phyag lhas mi thub gsungs nang pa'i slob dpon rang min pa 'dra snyam pa byung bas/ rgyal po thugs ma ches na phyag phyed gsungs/ bi ma las chos gos gsol rdzu 'phrul gyis phyag mdzad de/ rnam par snang mdzad gzugs sku la/ /bi ma ye shesalha'i phyag /kun rdzob ngo gang phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs nas/ phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul byas pas/ lha rnam snang gi dbu'i gtsug nas gdan khri yan chod gas so/ /der mu stegs yin nges snyam rgyal po zhal ngo nag sding song ba dang / slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ mi dgyes mi dgos gsungs yang lha'i spyi bor phyag bzhag ste/ rnam par snang mdzad ye shes lha'i lha/ /bi ma las ni gzugs kyi phung po yis/ /ye shes lnga ldan rtags kyi dbang bskur ro/ /gsungs pas/ sngar las mtshar bar 'grigs/ phyi nang thams cad 'od kyisakhengs so/ /de rting khyed bod kyi rgyal po yin pas/ phyag 'tshal lam gsungasanas grabs tsam byas pas/ rgyal po'i na bza' hrog lhug tshig pas phar la phyag phul/ seng ge'i khri gsum rtsegs la bzhugs su gsol/ rgyal po yab yum blon 'bangs kyis gdams pa mang du zhus so/ /yang rgya gar nas mkhan po'i slob ma ka ma la shī la gdan 1hā/sa/ bsam yas kyi thad du phebs

4 bod mig cha ོ smo/ nas gtsang po'i bar na yod pa la/ brda bstan pas rgya nag hwa shang thul bar 'dug par mkhyen/ rgyal po gtso bor bzhugs nas hwa shang dang rtsod pa byas pas thams cad kyi go bar/ hwa shang gi lta ba'i the tshom bcad hwa shang pham ste/rgya nag la 61ga pa la lam ya gcig lus pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi phyi ma/bod du nga'i lta ba 'dzin pa'ang 'ga' re yod par 'dug zer ba smras/ slob dpon ka ma la shi las/ sgom rim gsum brtsams nas rgyal po la phul te/gang zag las dag pa rnams ni/ ka ma shī la'i lta ba dang chos lugs la bzhugs pa'o/ /yang sing gha la'i slob dpon da na shī la sogs dang paṇ+ḍita mkhas pa mang po gdan drangs te zhabs tog byas shing / de rnams kyis rang rang gi yul skad dang bstun pa'i/ bka' bstan bcos gsungs tshad rnams mkhas pa be+e ro tsā na dang / ka cog zhang gsum la sogs rgya bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis rim par bsgyur/ mdo rgyud man ngag la 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyis bstan pa nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad cing / yang ya rabs kyi skye bo pho mo brgya rtsa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dus gcig la rab tu byung ste/ shar du dga' ldan lha phug lhor stag tshang seng ge phug nub tu brag dmar sbo thon/byang du ar+ya pa lo'i phug dang bzhir sgom grwa chen po yang btsugs/ mkhas grub chen po bzhis rtse gcig sgrub pa mdzad cing skyong ngo / /yang jo mo 'bro bza' byang chub sgron gyi sku tshe'i smad la g.yas ru smad kyi lha khang dang / rgyal po mu tig btsan pos shangs su mtshal gyi lha khang / jo mo dkar rgyal mtsho me tog sgron gyi sku tshe'i smad la dpal /spya bo ri'i lha khang bzhengs/ mtshims

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (5bza' lha mo btsan dang mkhar rje bza' mtsho rgyal gnyis kyis sgrub pa mdzad pas lha khang phyag rjes med do/ /sba ye shes dbang po la sogs/ chos blon rnams kyis kyang lha khang mang du bzhengs so/ /yang chos rgyal 'di'i ring nas gso dpyad sman gyi rig pa yang dar bar byed pa la/ de'ang dang po bod du sman dpyad bsgyur ba'i dus gsum byung ba ni/mes srong btsan snam po'i ring la gso rig gi dbu brnyes par byas na'ang /thor dpyad cung zad tsam zhig dar te de nas ma dar ro/ khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la srol legs par gtod pa ni lo tsā ba be+e ro tsā nas phyogs thams cad kyi sman pa rnams spyan drangs nas/bod skad du bsgyur ba ni/ rgya gar shin+ta gar pas sman lhas gsungs pa'i rgyud thams cad bsgyur/ rgya nag hwa shang ma hā ya nas 'jam dpal gyis gsungs pa'i rgyud rnams dang / bal po da na shī las spyan ras gzigs kyis gsungs pa'i rgyud rnams dang / gru gu seng mchog chen pos phyag na rdo rjes gsungs pa'i rgyud rnams dang / khrom btsan pa shī las byams pas gsungs pa'i rgyud rnams dang / dol po khyim ru rtsesasgron mas gsungs pa'i rgyud thams cad bsgyur nas bod kyi sman pa la snga ba rgyal po'i bla sman du bskos pa dgu dang / dar byed kun tu grags pa'i sman pa bzhi bcu rtsa lnga la sku gas pa sman pa mkhas par grags pa dgu nga55 rtsa gnyis byung rabs la sogs rgyas bshad zur du gsal/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi ring la gso rig dar zhing rgyas par byung ngo / /bye brag gi dbye ba gsum ni/ gong du bsgyur ba rnams: (rnying ma/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ bsgyur ba'i rgyud yan lag brgyad pa rtsa 'grel dang / man ngag dum rgyud skor gsum dang / rgyal po'i bla dpyad la sogs pa rnams la gsar ma/ 'gyur gsar rnying 'dres ma dang gter ma rnams la phyed mar dar ba zer ro /spyir 'dzam bu'i gling du thog mar gso rig dpag tu med pa gcig yod kyang / mdor bsdus na/ rgyud rab sde gsum ni/ nang pa sangs rgyasapa'i rgyud sde dang / phyi pa mu stegs pa'i rgyud sde dang / rig pa sngon byung gi rgyud sde dang gsum mo/ /babs bcu gcig ni/ bde gshegs bka'i babs/ tshangs pa lha'i babs/ drang srong lha'i babs/ rigs gsum thugs rje'i babs/ 'phags pa mkhyen pa'i babs/ mkha' 'gro ma brda'i babs/grub thob lung gi babs/ mu stegs rang gzhud gi babs/ lha dngos grub kyi babs/ 'dre gsang tshig gi babs/ dol po glen tshig gi babs rnams so/ /bshad tshul bzhi ni/ rtsa ba ru tshugs su bshad pa dang / 'grel pa bshad pa dang bcaX nas yongs grags rtog dpyod can du man ngag snyan rgyud can du bshada~Xr/ ga/nyis ni/ rgya gar nas nag por bsgyur pa dang / rgya nag nas dkar por bsgyur pa'o/ /lugs bcu gsum ni/ rgya gar gyi lugs dang / kha che'i lugs/bal po'i lugs/gar log gi lugs/ khrom gyi lugs/ rgya nag lugs/zhad zhud gi lugs/gru gu'i lugs/sog po'i lugs/mon gyi lugs/mi nyag gi lugs/bod kyi lugs/rdo'i lugs rnams so//sman gyi rgyud chen rnam grangs ni/ston pa'i thugs kyi 'od zer 3 7 //rtsa rgyud le'u drug pa bstan//sku'i 'od

ba chen 'od thal /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//las bshad pa'i rgyud/ /le'u sum cu rtsa gcig dang / /yon tan 'od lasaman ngag rgyud/ /le'u dgu bcu go gnyis bstan/ /phrin las 'od kyi phyi ma'i rgyud/ /le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / /gsung gi yongs gtad le'u gnyis/ /rgyud chen bzhi dang mjug don kun/ /dril bas brgya dang lnga bcu drug /bde gshegs rnams kyi sprul pas 'gro don du/ /rgya gar yul du sman gyi sbyor ba gsungs/ /rgya nag yul du me dang rtsa spyongs bstan/ /dol po 'i yul du gtar kha gtso bor bstan/ /bod kyi yul du rtsa chu'i brtag pa bstan/ /lha yi 'khor la gso dpyad 'bum pa gsungs/ /drang srong 'khor la tsa ra ka sde brgyad/ /nang pa'i 'khor la rigs gsum mgon po'i rgyud/ /mu stegs 'khor la dbang phyug chen po'i rgyud/ /gso dpyad rgyud 'dir thams cad 'dus par bstan/ /'dir ma 'dus pa'i gso dpyad gzhan na med/ /de ltar rgyud rnamasadang / bstan bcos phal che ba yan lag brgyad du phye nas bstan dgos te/dang por/ lha tshangs pas byas pa'i gso dbyad 'bum pa dang / bar du drang srong tsa ra gas byas pa'i tsa ra ka 'bum sder grags pa le'u lnga brgya nyi shu yod pa la sogs pa rnams la yan lag brgyad du bsdus nas bstan no/ /de'ang /yan lag brgyad ni/ dang por/ rkos bstan pa'i sde dang / gnyis pa gzhi sgrub pa'i sde/ gsum pa bdud rtsi chen po'i sde/ bzhi pa mi 'jigs mtshon cha'i sde/lnga pa bdud rtsi rnam lnga'i sde/ drug pa srog gi sgrom bu'i sde/ /bdun pa gsobyed rnam lnga'i sde/ brgyad pa gso byed sman gyi sde rnams so/ /de la stod 'grel gser gyi sbar khab/ smad 'a:sbya gser gyi lde mig dang bcas pa yod

rgya bod yig tshang smo/ do / / yang slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i gsodapyad yan lag brgyad po'i bstan bcos mdzad pa na/ lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod/ /mtshon dang 'chi ba rgas ro tsa/ /gso dpyad gang la gnas pa yi/ /yan lag brgyad du ngas bshad do/ /zhes bya ba'ang gsungs 'dug gzhud yan lag brgyad pa'i dgongs pa ni 'di lta ste/ nad skyed pa'i rgyu gnyis las ring ba'i rgyu ni ma rig pa'o/ /nye ba'i rgyu ni 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug gsum mo/ /nad rigs kyang rgyas par dbye na/ bdun brgya sum cu ste/ de'ang / ma zhu gsum dang rims nad brgyad/ /lud lnga dbugs lnga skyi bu lnga/ /rlung nad brgyad cu mkhris nas gsum/ /mngal skyon mngal nad nyi shu lnga/ /sbrum ma'i nad lnga byis pa'i nad/ /bcu gcig pa ni byis pa'i gdon/ /bcu gnyis spyi gdon bco brgyad spyo byed drug /brjed byed bzhi ste mig gi nad/ /dgu bcu rtsa bzhir bshad pa yin/ /sna nad rtsa lnga rna bco brgyad/ /mgul sogs kha nad bcu dgu'o/ /zhes pa la sogs nad bdun brgya sum cu'i rnam grangs nges tshig dang bcas pa yod do/ /man ngag pa phal cher nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir grags pa la / brgya dang rtsa gcig ltar snang 'phral gyi nad/ /ma bcos rang dgar bzhag pas 'tsho ba mang / /brgya dang rtsa gcig kun btags gdon gyi nad/ /gdon ma bcos par sman dpyad len mi 'dod/ /brgya dang rtsa gcig yongs grub tshe yi nad/ /ma bcos 'chi la bcos na 'tsho ba mang / /brgya dang rtsa gcig las dbang sngon gyi nad//bcos pas mi thub 'chi ba'i nad du bshad//srog gcod nad dgu 'dus pa bya ba /sdu/ /de ltar bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir phye na

ba tshe run 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces ba ris/ (goyang / /tsha grang gnyis su ma 'dus gang yang med/ /ngos gzung brtag la stong dang nyis brgya yang / /lta reg dri bar ma 'dus brtag thabs med/ /gso byed gnyen po stong dang rtsa gnyis yang / /sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi ru ma 'dusamed/ /gso dpyad lag len sum brgya drug cu yang / /ngos gzung gso tshul gso thabs gsum du 'dus/ /mda' gzhu 'phang khengs gtad sa med rtse gang / /de bzhin rgyud dang yan lag gnas skabs mdo/ /du mar brjod kyang mdo don rnam pa gnyis/ /nad dang nad med bya bar hril gyis 'dril/ /sman pa dag la dgos pa rnam bzhi ni//ri thang mtshams su spyang ste khra 'dra dgos/ /nad ngo len dus glen te lug 'dra dgos/ /nad gnya' cog dus brdar te wa 'dra dgos/ /dpyad log byed dus dpa' ste stag 'dra dgos/ /rlung mkhris bad dzin gsum gyi spyi khog phub//tshig 'di dpe la ma bzhag nyams su long //don 'di yal bar ma gtong sems la chongs/ /man ngag kha khyer ma byed snying la zhog /sman dpyad shes lo ma byed rtog dpyod gzob/ /sman gyi ro drug ni/mngar ba/skur ba/lan tshwa/ kha ba/ tsha ba/ bska ba dang drug go /zhes gsungs shing de ltar gso dpyad sman gyi rig pa la mkhas pa bod rgyal po'i bla sman la bskos pa dgu ni/ stod na bi rje 'ug pa gsum/ bar na mi nyag dang brang ti g.yu thog gsum/ smad na gnya' dang mtha' bzhi stong dang gsum/ zhes bya ba'i drang srong gi sprul pa mkhas btsun ldan pa rim par byung ste/ rgyal po'i lung gis/ nga ni kun gyi lha yin la/ /'di dag nga yi rje yin pas/ /kun gyis lha rjer mtshan gsol la/ /ma/spya cing bkur ba'i gnas su bsten/ /

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/gsungs pa'i dril bsgrags so/ / rje de'i/ blon po ni/ mgos khri bzang yab lhag dbas rgyal to re/ khri gsum rjes stag ga sna/ gnyer stag btsan sdong gzigs la sogs pas mdzangs kyis las thabs byas/ shad rje rgyal gzigs dang / stag sgra klu gong gis phyi'i dgra brtul/ rgya'i bkra shis khri sgo phab pa la sogs kyi lo rgyus phyi'i rdo ring la bris yod do/ khri srong rje stag snas rgya dang gru gu 'jang gsum gyi mol 'dum byas/ rgya bod mtshams su bod kyi dpa' bo mi dgusamago byas/ skye 'dus kyi dmag dpung so bsrung la bzhag pa la/ bka' ma log gzer ba'i sde chen po chags nas/ mtha' dmag bod du mi 'jug par bya ba la sogs sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'di ni rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas bod la bka' drin shin tu che/ 'di dgung lo lnga bcu drug cu re brgyad pa min nam yang zer rtsa drug bzhed pa/ shing mo glang lo la zur mkhar du sku gshegasaso/ khri srong lde btsan bang so mu ra ri la yod/ /ming ni 'phrul ri gtsug sna bya ba yin/ /bang so phyi rgya can zhes bya bar grags/ / 'di'i rtsa na rdo ring yi ge bris pa gcig kyang yod do/ /rje de dang tshe spong bza' dkar rgyal me tog sgron gyi sras bzhi las/ gcen mu khri btsan po sku gzhen nu la gshegs pas bang so med do/ /de 'og mu ne btsan po chu pho stag la brag dmar du 'khrungs lo gcig zla dgu rgyal sa bzung / yab kyi dus mchod la tshul 'jug gi zla ba la bsam yas kyi mdo sde mchod pa dang /cho 'phrul zla ba la 'dul ba'i mchod ༵ /tsug bod 'bangs byings po'i dbul

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gi ces bsdus/ (nephyug theng gsum snyom kyang rang rang gi sbyin shugs yin par dgongs/ mngon pa'i mchod pa 'dzug rtsis la sogs khrims gnyis dar bar mdzad pa'i dgongs pa yod na'ang / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa la dug gis bkrongs so/ /'phrul chen mu yi btsan po'i bang so ni/ /ag tshom bang so'i g.yas ngosamadun na yod/ /ming ni lha ri ldem bu bya ba yin/ /de 'og mu tig btsan pos zhang rgya tsha'i bu bsad pas/ de pa tshang gis g.yo thabs kyis bkrongs/mu tig btsan po'i bang so don mkhar mda' na yod/ /ming ni skya rengasaldengs pa lags so skad/ /gcung po khri lde srong btsan shing pho 'brug la brag dmar du 'brungs/ lo bzhi pa la gcen 'das nas khong la rgyal srid bskosapa nyams sad pa'i phyir/ khri'i steng du bzhugs dbu la nor bu'i gtsug rgyan gsol nas/ ljid ma theg par mjing pa g.yo tsam byung na'ang / bkra shis pa'i ltas mang du byung bas/ sad na legs mjing yon zhes pa'i mtshan chags/ rgyal srid lo sum cu rtsa gnyis bzung blon po sa mang rje lda ldong dang /sbra rgyal mtshon skong gis byas/ paṇ+ḍita bi ma la mi tra dang / ka ma la shī la/ dzñā na se na/ bal po hūṃ ka ra rnams spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba la sogs pa rnams kyis sngar skad sna tshogs kyis bsgyur ba'i chos thams cad rgya gar ba bstan pa'i 'byung khungs yin pas/ rgya gar gyi skad sha gcig tu bsgyur/ bod skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab snga mo'i yab mes rim pas lha khang mang du bzhengs 'dug nga ni 'dzam bu'i gling du che tshad thub pa'i lha khang gcig bzhengs pa/ 41dod pas/ nyi ma tsam dang / skar chen

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ gyi tshad tsam bzhengs pa'i sa mig 'tshol cig gsungs pa la blon 'bangs byings po'i blor ma 'byud de/ chu dang ri brag gis bkag nas rgya chen de 'dra shongs sa bod yul na med do zer rim par zhus pas/ 'o na/ skar ma chung shos rgyang grags gcig gi khyon yod zer bar 'dug pa/ de tsam gcig cis kyang byed gsungs nas skar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs/ lha sa'i khyams khrab bzos rab byung thams cad kyi 'tsho ba sbyar/ lha sa dang / bsam yas la sogs su bshad grwa bcu gnyis/ mer pa dang / mchims phu la sogs par bsgom grwa bcu gnyis btsugs/ stangs 'bul drug sems phyogs bcu gnyis su byas nas dam chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ me mo bya la sbrags kyi phur 'das so/ /rgyal chen bang so 'phrul rgyal mda' na yod/ /yum gyis chab gang skongs pas nang gis mthong ming ni rgyal chen 'phrul ri lags so skad/ /de'i mdun na che ge yig tshang du ma bris pa'i rdo ring 'a po gcig kyang yod do/ /rje de dang 'bro bza' mang po rje'i sras lnga ste/ gtsang ma dang / dar ma dang / ral pa can/ lhun rje/ lhun grub rnams las gtsang ma chos la dga' ches/ dar ma sdig la dga' ches pas/ rgyal sar ma bskos/lhun rje/ lhun grub gnyis gzhen nu la 'das pas bang so yang med do/ /bar pa ral pa can ni/ khri srong lde btsan gcings nas lo bdun cu don drug song ba'i me pho khyi lo la 'u shang rdor sku 'khrungs/ lo bcu gnyis pa'i thog tu blon po rnams gros byas nas rgyal sar bskos/ srid lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bar la bzung / blon po bran kha dpal yon /byi / 'bro khri bzang ram shags/ 'bre
