brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (shekhri rje stag sna gsum gyis byas/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su len dra bo ti/ pra dzñā : ba/shirnyi gar+bha rnams spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pa mang pos chos kyi dag ther mang po legs par mdzad/ sngar ma bsgyur ba rnams kyang bsgyur/ lcags mo phag lo la 'u shang rdo dpal dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang rgya phibs dgu brtsegs/ khyung nam mkha' la lding pa 'dra ba bzhengs/ yab mes kyis gtsug lag khang bzhed ba/par dam bcas nas ma 'byongs pa rnams gsos/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar lha khang dang sha chu sdong btsan gyi mtsho'i dkyil du lcags kyi sdong po'i steng du sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i lha khang dang / rlangs yul gyi ring po gsum par sle'u 'phrul gyi kre dang 'og tu ka brag dkon mchog 'byung gnas/bod du byams chen lha khang /nyang ro rtsig nar gsar du lha khang khrab sgo can rnams bzhengs/ btsun mo cog ro za dpal gyi ngang tshul gyis btsan thang g.yu'i lha khang / nyang bza' mchog gi lha mos smon 'gro stag tshal gyi lha khang bzhengs/ gcen dar mas 'bri lha khang dang / de'i btsun mo btsan mo 'phan gyis yar lung dpag bsam ljon shing dang / phug po che'i lnga khang / mkhas btsun sngags pa dang / btsun chen rnams kyis brag lha mgon po dang yer pa yang dben/ nyang ting 'dzin gyis zha'i lha khang dang / bran ka dpal yon gyis dbyes tshal dang dmas yul me long thang / ka ba dpal brtsegs kyis ka ba yul sna/ tshe sbong stag bzang ra mdos/ stod lung rnag ma/ tshe spong lha bzang klu dpal gyis bo dong bya rgod gzhongs kyi lha khang rnams 1 4 4 / lar na 'di yan/ bod kyi rgyal

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ blon rnams kyis/ rgya bod du/ gtsug lag khang stong rtsa brgyad bzhengs par 'dod do/ /chos rgyal de ni sngon sangs rgyas kyi lung bstan pa na/ grong khyer rdo 'jog ces bya ba na khyim bdag ral pa can bya bas/ bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin cing phyag na rdo rje'i sprul par grags so/ /phrin las kyi gtso bor/ dam chos la spyod/ dkon mchog mchod/ tshogs gnyis kyi nor bsog rgyal khrims chos bzhin skyongs/rab tu byung ba re re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun phul/ 'tsho ba sbyar bkur sti che ba'i tshad dge 'dun la/ skye bos lab gtong ba dang mdzub mo bsgreng pa byung na/rgyal pos nga'i mchod gnas la de bzhin byed pa ma 'os gsungs nas/mdzub mo bcad pa byung zhing de ltar bstan pa'i gshed dang mnga' thang skyes/sngar yab mes kyi ring la chab 'og tu ma chud pa'i shar phyogs rgya nag po dbang du bsdas/ so mtshams spo lon shan gyi ri rgyud dar dkar kyi yol ba 'dra ba la ga/gas/ nub phyogs stag gzig gi so mtshams/ stag sha dung gi sgo mo can la gtugs/ byang phyogs hor gyi so mtshams bye ma rkang ring nya yi rgyab 'dra ba la gtugs/ lho phyogs su mon ta la wa ti shel gyi dum bu 'dra ba la gtugs shing /'dzam bu gling gi gsum gnyis dbang du bsdus par byas so//de dus rgyal pos bod dmag 'bum phrag 'ga' re khyer nas/ rgya'i sa mang du bcom/ gha thag gi sa na smon ri dol dkar bya ba yod par sgar chen btab/shar smad tsong kha'i mthil thug dmag khyer ba yin gsungs pas rgyal chen rnam sras dung gi khye'u chung lo brgyad rdo 4/cig tu sprul te bod rgyal po khri'u shing

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//gi thog na bzhugs pa'i mdun du pus btsug thal mo sbyar nas/ 'di man la nga'i sgos kyi bran 'khor mi nyag ma gha zung yod pa la dmag gi brda ded mi gsung ba dgos zer ba la/ de bzhin yin na rgya bod la sogs mi gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i rtags mtshan re yod par gyis gsungs pas/ mi nyag gi ral pa 'di bzhag pa yin bya ba dang / rgyal po 'di'i ring la gru gu'i yul nas g.yu rnying dre'u khal rgyab bco brgyad 'bul byung bas bod na gru gu'i g.yu rnying yin nges de las med do bya ba dang / 'u shang rdo'i lha khang brtsig dus mig gcig pa dang / tsu ta rkang gcig pa sogs rgyal khams gzhan mang po'i lam mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan/ phyi sa 'og nas de lta bu'i mgo dang / rus pa mang du thon pa byung zer ba 'dug pas na/ bod rgyal po'i mnga' thang che shos su byung bar gda'o/ /dus de tsa na/ khyim ni bag dro mi ni khong dal/ phyugs ni lo dang zla ba na bsdud/ mi nyal nyi mas slong / 'bri yan sna med/ rta yan sgrog med/ sgo la khyi med/ rje byams/ 'bangs gus/ grogs gzhud bzang / gnyen sha tsha/pho ni dpa'/ mo ni mdzangs la chas bzang / bod 'bangs byin po bde skyid la longs spyod/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ches dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas na sku drin shin tu che'o/ /'di yan chad la skyid pa'i gdung rabs byed dang bcu dang / shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang lnga zer ro/ /phyed ma ni/chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / mes ag tshoms kyi/ sras gzhon nu la 'das nas/ rgyal srid skyar ma re bzung pa la zer ro/ /de rting / nag po'i phyogs ste/ du nye ba dang bod spyi mthun gyi bsod

rgya bod mig tshang chen smo/nams 'grib pas/ rje la btsun mo cog ro bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul mdang /mtshims bza' dkar rgyal/ sna nam bza' mang mo khod legs/ nyang bza' mchog gi lha mo/ tshe spong bza' mdo rgyal ma dang lnga yod kyang srid ma zin/rgyal po'ang ha cang chos la dad ches pas/ sbas stag sna la sogs sdig blon rnams kyis/ ban chen po bkums/ lha sras gtsang ma gro mor spugs/ btsun mo dam pa dang bran ka dpal yon nyes med la skyon phab/ rgyal po nyid kyang /dgung lo so drug pa lcags mo bya lo la cog ro legs sgra lha sdong btsan gyi mal gro shad pa'i lha khang rdo skas la bzhud pa la ral gyis btsabs nas bkrongs so/ khu chen ral pa can gyi bang so ni/ /don mkhar mda'i g.yon gyi phyogs na yod/ /ming ni khri steng ming ri legs so skad/ /de'i tsa na/rdo ring yi ge med pa gcig kyang yod/ de ltar rgyal po la sras med/ lha khang la mnga' gsol med/ bang so la nor med/rdo ring la yi ge med zer/ de yan chad mu ne btsan po the ba'i rgyal sar bzhugs pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis byung ngo //lo grangs stong dang bzhi brgya bzhi bcu zhe bzhi tsam song bar byed do/ /rje 'bangs skyid pa'i nyi ma bde ba'i dus yin no/ /gcen po glang dar ma chu mo lug lo pa yin/ so dgu lon pa'i dus na khri ral dkrongs nas khong gis rgyal srid bzung / lo gnyis rgyal po tshul bzhin byas/ chu mo phag gi lo mjug nas thugs la gdon gsol ba dang / blon po rgyal to re stag sna can la sogs sdig la dga' ba rnams kyis bsgyur nas/ sngar nu bo la rgyal srid bskos pa'i snying nad byas/ bod du /rdo rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs/ lo phyed

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (//dang bzhir sdig rgyal kho na byas/ lo zhe bzhi pa me pho stag lo'i dus/ yer pa'i lha ri snying po na lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yod pa'i sar nam phyed na lha mo nag mo bud med du sprul byung nas/ da bod na grub thob khyod las med/ sdig can rgyal po bsgral ran zer ba byung nas/ lha sa'i rdo ring gi rtsa ru lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal po bkrongs nas bros so/ /de dus rgyal po na re/ nga sgrol ba yang na lo gsum gyis phyis/ yang na lo gsum gyis sngas zer lo/sdig rgyal de'i rkyen gyis chu mo phag nas/ lcags pho rta'i bar lo drug cu rtsabargyad tsam bod du dam chos nub 'dug dar ma'i bang so 'phrul dang rgyal chen bar/ /de'i ming ni bang rim 'khor lo can/ /zer te rtsig pa'i 'phro lalus song skad/ /glang dar ma la smad kyi steng zer ro/ /'di man chad/ bod sil bur chad de/ dar ma dkrongs rting btsun mo che bas/ bu chung gcig btsal nas/ mdang mo rang la skyes pa'i bu yin byas pas mdang skyes kyi bu chung la gre'u mi yong ste yum gyi bka' brtan tu chug byas pas/ yum brtan byung / des dbu ru bzung / chung ba la lto bor gyi sras gcig yod pa/ mar me'i 'od la srungs pas/ 'od srungs byung des g.yo ru bzung / dbu g.yor 'khrug pa byas/ rgyal rig bas gcig la phyogs ris gnyis su phye/ blon po khu thog sbra shang sri dang / rngog yag gsum sgra rje yab dang / rngog rgyal to re gel pa rnams kyis byas/ rgyal blon de rnams bsod nams chung bas/ sa mo glang la khengs log byung / me mo bya la bang so rnams bshigs/ rje 'bangs bye/rgyal khrims zhig / /48phyi'i so kha shor/ bod nang 'khrugs/

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ glang dar mas chu mo phag la/ bstan pa bsnub pa'i mgo tshugs nas lcags pho rta la dbus gtsang gi mi drug gam bcus/ mdo smad du rab tu byung nas/bsam yas su bod rgyal tsha la na yab sras kyis spyan sngar sleb pa yan lo drug cu rtsa brgyad kyi bar la/ spyir bod dang / sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgra mi grags pa byung ste/ sdom pa 'bog len gyi bka' chad/ gtsug lag khang rnams su wa khyi'i tshang bcas/ tsher phung skyes/ bshas ra lud khang byas/ lder bzo la sprang po'i sba zom skal/ mi dge ba'i las thabs sna tshogs byung bas/ glang dar ma yab sras ni bod 'bangs la bka' drin shin tu chung ngo / /yum brtan dgung lo sum cu rtsa drug la 'das te bang so med do/ /'od srungs ni/ shing mo lug lo pa pho brang yum bur btsas pa ste/sum cu rtsa dgu la yar lung 'phan mdar 'das so/ /'od srungs bang so spe gyi /ba na yod/ /༷nga ni skye'u lha rten lags so skad/ /de phyin chad bang dī rnyi/ kā rnyi /dri spya ḍā/ tshu/la ni/ glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i tshe / dpal chu bo ri nas/ 'jad pa gtsang rab gsal dang / bo dong pa g.yo dge 'byung / stod lung pa dmar shākya mu yi gsum gyis/ 'dul ba'i po ti/dre'u khal rgyab gcig bkal nas mnga' ris la bros/ gar log la phyin/ lo tsā ba med pas 'gro don ma byung bar/ hor yul bskor nas/ mdo smad an chung rnam rdzong dan tig shel gyi lha khang du slebs pa dang / de phyogs rnams/sdig rgyal dang thag 'gyang zhing / /shā rus che bas chos kyi brda mtshon tsam

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (sheyang 'dug pa dang / bon po'i rgan po'i dmu zu gsal bzang bya ba'i tsha bo mu gzu gsal 'bar zer ba/ lo bco lnga pa gcig khong rnams la dad nas/gtsang gis mkhan po/ g.yos slob dpon byas te dge tshul la zhugs pa'i ming dge ba gsal du btags so/ /'di'i skabs su/ lha sar/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal po glang dar ma bsgral nas/ rjes gcod pa sngon ma byung ba log song ba dang / khong gis mngon pa kun las btus dang 'dul ba 'od ldan las chog ga me sha tam gsum po khyer nas/ mdo khams la bros pa yang gtsang g.yo dmar gsum dang mjal/ dge ba rab gsal gyis rab tu byung nas lo lnga song ba dang / sngar gyi mkhan slob dang dmar gyis gsang ston byas/lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal po bsad pas kha skong mi rung gsungs nas/rgya'i hwa shang ke wang dang / gyi wan bya ba gnyis btsal nas de lnga la bsnyen rdzogs byas/ ming dgongs pa rab gsal du grags shing / des bstan pa'i me ro smad nas slangs zhes pa'o/ /de rting / dgongs pa rab gsal gyisamakhan po byas nas/ sba gong ye shes bsrung dang / par rin chen gsal/'al pa rdo rje dbang phyug snubs rak+shi ta/ jo bo ye shes seng ge co ro shesarab byang chub dge tshul bsgrub tu gcug na'ang mkhan slob cha ma tshang bas bla chen gyi slob ma la snga ba khams kyi zog po mi drug bya bar grags pa byung / bla chen gyis bka' brtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi bya ba yang de rnams la byas pa byed de / bzhi ni/ zhwa theb kyi mu thum dang / bla gos kyi mtha' tshems/ gtor bu/ka pā la'i nang rnams sngon por byed 5sdu bla chen dang po bon po'i brgyud par

rgya bong yig tshang chen mo/song ba'i thugs zhen gyi brda mtshon yin zer bar 'dug de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan/ bsam yas nas yum brtan gyi rgyal brgyud mnga' bdag tsha na yab sras kyis gsan te/ dbus gtsang gi mi drug mdo smad la chos tshol du rdzangs ba ni/ dbus nas klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ 'bre ye shes yon tan/gtsang nas tshong btsun shes rab seng ge lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang bzhi pos/ bla chen dngos la sdom pa blangs/ sba btsun blo gros dbang phyug dang /rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sum pa ye shes 'byung gnas gsum pos/grum sgrubs gnyis la sdom pa blangs te de rnams la/ sba rag gnyis po gcig tu dril bas mi drug zer ro/ /yang dbus pa gsum dang / gtsang pa gsum/ gtsang min dbus min gcig dang mi bdun zer ba'ang 'dug yang /dbus gtsang gi mi bcu ru byed pa'ang yod pa ni/ klu mes shes rab tshul khrims dang / 'bre ye shes yon tan/ klan shes rab 'bar/ sba blo gros dbang phyug rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas rnam ba'i la dbus pa mi lnga/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug tsong btsun shes rab seng ge yu pa lte dkar/ 'o brgyad spun gnyis rnams la gtsang pa mi lnga zer bar 'dug pa/ rim pa bzhin phyin pas mang du song pa yin nam bsam gang ltar na'ang khong rnams kyis sdom pa blangs/ chos mang du zhus nas yar yong dus bla chen gyi zhal nas lo ston mthu che bas bstan pa srungs shig klu mes sku btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ tshong dge blo rno bas ston pa gyis/ 'bre kha bkod mkhas pas gnas gzhi bzung /thams cad kyis bstan pa dar ba'i sa/ khur cig gsungs nas brdzangs pa

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//bzhin/ 'ong rnams yar phebs rgyal po dang mjal/ bya dga' dang bkur sti chen po byas nas thog mar thams cad 'dzoms nas nyang smad rgyan gong gi lha khang bzhengs/ de rting / dbus gtsang gi sa char rang sa rang sa nas khas len byas pa'i gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs nas dge 'dun gyi sde gtsug dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par byas pas na/ bstan pa phyi dar la a mes bla chen po dgongs pa rab gsal dang / slob ma/ dbus gtsang gi mi rnams/ sbyin bdag mnga' bdag tsha la na yab sras dang bcas pa thog mar sku drin shin tu che ba lags/ rgyal po glang dar ma'i sras gnyis la gdung brgyud ji ltar byung na / gcen yum brtan dang / pa tshab bza' bkra shis mtsho'i sras/ khri lde/mgon gnyen/ de'i sras khri lde rig pa mgon dang / nyi ma mgon/ gcung de'i sras nyi 'od dpal mgon/ de'i brgyud klung shod dang 'phan yul mdo khamasan mang ngo / /gcen po'i sras khri lde so dang / rdo rje 'bar/ lde so'i brgyud/bug pa can dang / thang lha brag pa rnams so/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i sras/ khri dbang phyug btsan/ de'i sras/ tsha la na ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras/mnga' bdag khri pa/ yab sras 'di gnyis kyis dbus gtsang gi mi rnams mdo smad nas chos tshol ba la rim par brdzang pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde dang / lha khang bzhings pa/ bsam yas chos 'khor sgrub pa la sogs bod yul dbus gtsang du bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i bdag rkyen brjid khur che bar mdzad do/ khri pa'i sras/ a tsa ra dang / dge slong / bla ma/ bho dhi ra dza rnams so/ /a tsa ra'i brgyud/ 'a/byi 2so pa/ gtsang rgyab pa/ glags pa lam

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/pa / grib pa/ snye thang pa/ khum sa rtsad po la sogs pa'o/ /bla ma la brgyud pa med/ dge slong gi brgyud/ spe bzhi pa/ bho dhi ra dza'i brgyud/ lha btsun sngon mo / snyug rum pa/lha 'bri snang pa la sogs byung /da lta/ 'on/rdo/ chab thang /bsam yas btsad po rnams so/ /de rnams yum brtan gyi brgyud pa yin no/khri lde 'od srungs dang / cog ro bzari rgyal mo legs kyi sras/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan shing mo bya lo la yar lung 'phang mdar 'byungs/ yab mes kyi mdzad spyod ngan pa bor nas/ nyang smad sgrol bu'i smad lung la sogs/gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs/ blon po spyang rgan a po dang / 'bro gtsug dgra lha ldong gi ba'i byas/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa la/ gnyags stag rtse bas yar lung shor por bkrongs so/ /'di pa dang / yum brtan gyi sras khri lde mgon gnyen dang / tsha bo rig pa mgon gyi ring sa mo glang la khengs log dang / bang so bshig pa/ sku mkhar rtse nas 'bebs pa la sogs byung bar byed do/ /de'i btsun mo/ tshe spong bza' g.yo rur bzhag pa'i sras skyid lde nyi ma mgon/chun ma/ dbal bza' 'phan rgyal u rur bzhag pa'i sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal lo/ /de gnyis kyi srid phal che ba yum brtan tshang gis khyer bas sku mched de gnyis/ rim pas mnga' ris stod phyogs la bros te/nyi ma mgon la sras/ dpal gyi mgon dang / lde gtsug mgon dang / bkra shis nyi ma mgon rnams byung ba la stod kyi mgon gsum zer ro/ /yab skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi sngon la byon nas/ stod yul rnams mnga' 'og tu bsdus pas/ spyi ming la mnga' ris zer zhi /3sras che bas/ mang yul dang / nub

ba tshe chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'gu pa gces bsdus/ (naral la mnga' byas/ bar pas/ zhang zhung / spyi cog gnyis/ snyi gong / ru thogaganyis/pu rangs ya tshe gnyis te drug la mnga' byas/ chung bas/ gar zha dang /zangs dkar la mnga' byed du bcug des na mnga' ris skor gsum du grags so/ /bkra shis nyi ma mgon/ sku mkhar nyi bzang du bzhugs/ gra khor re dang /srong nge gnyis/khor re'i sras/ na ga rā dza dang / khru ba rā po ro/ /yab khor re'i sku tshe'i smad la/ yab mes kyi yig tshang gzigs pas/ thug skyo nas gong ma'i phyag srol bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar bzhed pa la/ rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po med par rten gyi drung du bslab pa nos te/mtshan yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces bya/ de yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud la lung zin te/ byang phyogs gangs ri'i ljongs kyi rgyud/ /mi rigs bzhi'i gnas pa la/ /rigs ni rgyal po'i rigs su ste/ /ye shes 'od ces bya rga'abyung / /de yis bstan pa'i bdag rkyen byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ tho lding gser gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ sras gnyis kyang rab tu byung ste/mtshan zhi ba 'od dang / byang chub 'od do/ /yab sras rnams kyis ya rabs kyi khye'u blo rno ba bdun/ g.yog chung bcu bzhi dang bcas pa rab tu byung glegaser mang po bskur nas/ kha cher chos tshol ba la btang / paṇ+ḍita ṅgārma pha tshwadang / bram ze rin chen rdo rje spyan 'drong na gser la ma rtsi/ gzhan yang bod la phan pa'i paṇ+ḍita rtsad chod/ lo tsā mkhas par slobs shog gsungs nasabardzangs pas/ gzhan bcu dgu tshad pas shi /mdo sde nas lung bstan pa'i g.yas ru gzhung pa lhur zor ri/ san bzang po la dge slong bya'i gdong

rgya bod yig tshang chen rmo/pa can du grags pa des lo chen dang / yar 'brog mtsho'i 'gram pa rirang pa 6 lha stong ra'i yul na yod/〉sgo chung legs pa'i shes rab gnyis lus/ lo tsā slobs nas rgya gar shar nub kun tu btsal bas/ bri ka ma la shī la na di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes bya ba bod la phan thogs pa zhig 'dug zer ba lha bla ma la zhus pas dgyes nas/ de cis kyang spyan drongs pa zhig byed gsungs nas/yul gtsang stag tshal ba'i 61 tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge la gser sing ma srang bcu drug yod pa gcig gi sna drangs pa'i gser srang mang po bskur nas/'khor brgya tsam dang bcas rgya gar la brdzangs pas/ rdzo bo ni spyan ma drongs/'khor phal che ba tshad pas gum/ gser sil ma rnams rgyag ling pa de lha bla ma la phul bas/ da dung de'i mgo nas spyan 'dren dgos gsungs/ rgya brtson seng dang nag tsho gnyis/ jo bo rje bod du ni gdan mi 'drongs par 'dug rgya gar du jo bo la gdams ngag zhu ru 'gro zer nas dpon slob drug byon no/ lha bla mas kyang rgyal srid gos la gtad nas paṇ+ḍi ta gdan 'dren pa'i cha rkyen gyi gser 'tshol ba la rgya gar mtha' 'khob la byon pas/ mtha' 'khob tu mu stegs rgyal pos btson du bzung khyod bod rnams phyi rol pa'i bstan pa la 'jug na blu ma mi len/ mi nyan na khyod rang gi lus dang mnyam pa'i gser dgos zer byung nas/ sras gnyis pa lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis/ bod 'bangs byings po la gser bsdus pas sku lus dang mnyam pa rnyed na'ang / dbu tsam gcig ma 'dzoms pas/ de man la sdod du ni ma 'dod/ lha bla ma'i zhal nas/khyed rnams kyi byed lugs de ka yin 135/ da nga rgas pas/ sems can la phan

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (shemi thogs/ gser de rnams kyis/ jo bo rje dang paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa rnams gdan drongs/ mtho lding du mchod pa chen po shoms/ yab mes kyis bzhengs pa'i/lha sa dang / bsam yas la sogs la zhig gsos gyis/ mdor na bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i thabs tshol gyis shig gsungs pa'i 'phrin bskur byung / de ltar na'ang da dung gser dbu tsam zhig btsal la cis kyang blus zer ba'i skabs su lha bla ma mtha' 'khor tu sku gshegs so/ /de'i skabasasu / gcung srong nge'i sras/ lha ldes/ paṇ+ḍita 'e ti dzñā na dang phra la ring mo spyan drangs nas/ chos bsgyur rtsis la/ lo tsā ba bal por pho log gis shi nas/chos bsgyur mkhan ni med/ sngar shes pa nyams su len mkhan ni yod de lo tsā ba med pas/ paṇ+ḍita gnyis po bod yul la 'khyams so/ /de'i tshe/ bal po rme ru rtse bya ba bod du 'ong rgya skad shes pas/ chos bshad na'ang bod kyis mogo bas phar log de mtshams/ lo mang rab gyi bar la/ lo paṇa gyi 'byon bzhud chad do/ /de rting / lha btsun byang chub 'od kyi thugs la/ da khu bo de'i dgongs pa rdzogs phyir du/ jo bo rje dang paṇ+ḍi ta gdan gang 'drong bya dgosasnyam pa la/ pho nya ba ma rnyed pa'i skabs su rgya brtson seng rgya gar du bsdad/nag tshos lo tsā ba mkhas par slabs nas/tshur yongs/rgyags len pa la yang thog lha khang na yod pas/ lha btsun gyis bos nas/ 'o skol bod la bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib mang du byung bas/ bri ka ma la shī la nas/ jo bo rje lha gcig spyan 'dren khong ye ma byon na/ de 'og nas/ che ba gcig gdan cis kyang 'dren pas 'dul ba 'dzin pa /spya 6tshad pa la yang goms/ lam rgyus kyang

rgya pod yig tshang za mo/che/ lo tsā yang shes pas/ spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya la 'byon pa zhu/ dgos gsung nan skyed nas 'khor g.yog brgya tsam yang bshams byas pas/ nag tsho na re de tsam gyis mang lnga tsam gyis chog gsungs/ der rdzo bo paṇ+ḍita la 'bul rgyu'i gser ling pa srang bcu drug yod pa de dang / lo tsā ba la srang bdun lam rgyags la srang bdun/ sngar 'gro myong ba'i 'phral skad shes pa gcig la srang lnga / an ston/rkan ston/ rgya ston gsum la srang shas re re bskur nas dpon blon lnga brdzangs/ khong rnams kyis/ bri ka ma la shī la'i 'gron khang du slebs dus/ rgya btson seng dang mjal/ gser nyung shas phul nas rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ gzhan paṇ+ḍi ta mang ste bod la phan mi thogs/ da dung jo bo spyan gang 'drong byed do gsungs nas/ bslab bya byas/ jo bo'i drung du gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul/ bod kyi snang tshul rgyas par zhus pas/ jo bos/ yi dam mkha' 'gro la gsol ba btab nas lung bstan thob na 'gro'o gsungs pa'i zhal blangs byung / sgrol ma dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan la bod la phyin na/ lo nyi shu ni thung du 'gro/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar 'gyur ro gsungs pa la/ jo bo'i zhal nas bstan pa la phan na/ tshe thung na'ang thung / bod rnams snying yang rje bar 'dug pas 'gro bar bya'o gsungs nas/ dgung lo re gnyis bzhes pa chu mo lug lo la byon/ bal por phebs dus rgya brtson seng la mu stegs kyi ngan sngags byung nas 'das pa dang / jo bo na re bod spyi mthun la rgya brtson seng mi 'chi ba'i bsod nams kyang mi 'dug da lo tsā ba mkhas pa med pas/ ngas bod la phan mi tho/bye/ phyir log 'gro gsungs pa la nag

brtse chen 'od snang la /4skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (/)tshos zhu nan bskyed pas/gdan 'drongs te/mtho lding lha khang du lha btsun yon mchod zhal mjal/lo chen rin bzang dang /nag tsho la sogs pas lo tsā byasanas chos mang po bsgyur/ 'brom ston dang mnga' ris su mjal/ mnga' risadang dbus gtsang gi sa char lo bcu gcig dang zla ba lnga bzhugs/ rten rab gnas med pa la rab gnas/ yon bsngo ba med pa la bsngo ba/ gshin dge ba med pa la dge rtsa gtong ba la sogs pa dkar phyogs 'phel ba'i srol mang du gtod cing / dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas na/ jo bo rje yon mchod dpon slob de rnams bod la sku drin shin tu che'o/ /de'i dngos kyi slob ma/ khu rngog 'brom gsum la sogs bka' gdams pa'i brgyud 'dzin sde dgon dar rgyas che bar byung ngo / /jo bo rje'i gsung lo chen rin chen bzang po rnams kyis bsgyur ba yan gyi/ sngags mtshan nyid thams cad la snga 'gyur zhes grags so/ /jo bo nyid ni dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gsum pa shing pho rta lo dbyug pa zla ba'i tshes brgyad la snye thang nas dga' ldan du gshegs so//gcung srong nge la sras lha lde dang / gnam la 'od chen/ u pa dang gsum byung ste yab sras de pas/ kha char gyi lha khang bzhengs/ paṇ+ḍita pukhye shrī spyan drangs so/ /lha lde'i sras 'od ldes rgyal srid bskyangs/lha btsun byang chub 'od dang gcung 'od zer go cha gsum mo/ /yab sras 'di pas paṇ+ḍi ta sha ka ra warma/ ṅgārma pā la/pad+ma ka ra/ dharma ka ra rnams spyan drangs so/ /de rnams kyis gsungs pa lo tsā ba gyi rdzo zla ba'i 'od zer/ 'gos khug pa lha btsas la sogs pa rnams kyis bsgyur ba man nas gsang sngags/sdu/ 'gyur zhes pa'i mgo tshugs pa'o/ /

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ gcen 'od ldes dzña na shrī spyan drangs/ 'od lde'i sras mnga' bdag rtse lde'i ring la rgya gar nas mkhan po zhi ba bzang po/ mkhas pa dzñā na shrī/ 'chi med sa ra lha )/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra/ btsun mo can/ paṇ+ḍi ta purkye shrī/ su rla sidhi/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kirti/ paṇ+ḍi ta gzhon nu 'bum pa/ gser gyi go cha/ bal po bha len+d+ra/kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī rnams spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi lo tsā ba/ rngog blo ldan shes rab/ zu dga' ba'i rdo rje/ gzhen nu mchog chos seng / khyung po gragasaseng / gu ru rin chen grags/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po / zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab/ gnyan chung dar ma grags/ cog ro chos mchog mar pa do pa/ lho brag mar pa lo tsā/ pa tshab nyi ma grags/ rma ban chos 'bar/ rwa lo/ dpyal lo/ sa lo kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ khro lo byams pa dpal sogs rgya bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa mang pos rgya bal gyi paṇ+ḍi ta de rnams kyis gsungs pa'i sngags mtshan nyid dpag tu med par bsgyur/bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pas bka' drin shin tu che'o/ khyad par gyis kyang mnga' bdag rtse lde'i sku tshe'i smad la khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta spyan 'dren du btang pas/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sha kya shrī zhes pa de nyid/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum stong nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad song ba'i chu pho stag lo la sku gcings par 'dug cing /dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga bzhes na'ang yi dam gyi lung bstan byung ba dang /gdan 'dren pa mos shugs ches bas me pho stag lo de la gdan 'drongs so/ /bod yul du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs /53 khro dpyal gsum la sogs slob ma

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ rtonamakhas pa mang du spel/ gtsang so ba tshul khrims mdzes dang /rdor byang rnam gnyis la sogs pa slob mar bskos nas bstan pa'i srol btsugs te/ bod kyi spyi mchod/ tshogs pa sde bzhir grags pa'i bstan pa'i rgyun chu bo ltar ring ba 'di bzhin mdzad de/ dgu bcu rtsa bdun pa la rgya gar la bzhud/ go dgu bzhes pa sa mo yos lo la chos kyi dbyings su gshegs par gda'o/ /mnga' bdag rtse lde'i sras/ bha lde/ de nas rim bzhin/ bkra shis lde/ ba lde/ na ga lde ba rnams byon/ 'di yan chad la/ gu ge bu rangs/ mang yul la sogs kyi btsan po rnams chad par 'dod cing / dpal 'khor btsan man chad la sngon rabs kyi yig tshang du mi mthun pa'ang 'ga' re snang ngo / /nā ga de ba'i sras/btsan phyug lde yar rtser byon/ de'i sras bkra shis lde/ de'i sras grags btsan zhes gser bre bcu bdun gyis 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bzhengs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi la mchod rten bzhengs/ dngul dkar lnga brgya la phag mo dang lhan skyes bzhengs/ dngul dkar stong phrag bcu gnyis kyis byams pa bzhengs/gsung rab mang po'ang bzhengs so/ /de'i sras a sogs ldes rdo rje gdan du chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis phul ba'i grong bzhi bcu zhe gnyis sog po lasanyos nas rdo rje gdan du phul/ rin dngul dkar bcu gnyis re lo re bzhin sog po la 'dab par byas so/ /de'i sras/ 'dze dar smal dang / a nan smal la / pho bos/ kye rdor lha dgu/ dngul dkar blugs su bzhengs/ nu bos rdo rje gdan gsos/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/ de'i sras re'u smal gyis/rgya gar nas rgyal khams mang po 6 / dngul dkar bzhi bcu la sman bla

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/ mched brgyad bzhengs/ lha sa jo bo'i dbu thog tu gser tog phul/ de'i sras/ sa smal yin/ 'dzi dar smal gyi sras/ a ji smal gyis gser dkar bcu gcig la sgrol ma'i sku bzhengs/ rgyal sa ma thob gong du sa skyar lha btsun byas/ de'i sras ya rtser skyes pa sri ti smal dang / blon po dpal ldan grags pas sa skya'i chos khri chen mo dang / lha sa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi steng du she tog byas so/ /de rnams gcen skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi brgyud pa yin na / / gcung po khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyi sras/ dpal lde/ 'od lde / skyid lde rnams la smad kyi lde gsum zer te/ yab sras 'di pa mnga' ris gung thang man la chags te/ dpal lde'i brgyud sngon po'i tshon por thug pa ste/khab gung thang pa/ klu rgyal/ ci ba/ lha rtse ba/ sla lung / gtsang skor ba rnams te la stod yan chod pa rnams so/ /gcung skyid lde 'jad rta nag tu phog sras drug byung ba'i lnga byang du gshegs te 'gro'i rtsad po dang g.yas ru ru lag gi btsan po dang / mus pa/ 'jad/ rta nag na yod pa rnams so/ /gcig gi brgyud rtsad po rgyal ba 'od la thug pa'o//gtsang grom pa rgyang / nyang stod rnams na yod do/ /'od lde'i brgyud/ gtsang g.yas ru na yod do/ /skyid mkhar rtsad po la thug cing / shar tsong kha'i rgyal po gcen mnga' 'od chen la sogs pa mdo smad kyi rgyal brgyud rnams kyang yin no/ /mnga' bdag khri chung gi ring la yar lung du byon te/de'i brgyud/dbus kyi rtsad po/ 'od srungs rnams yin la / de'i sras/ 'od skyid 'bar/ /sa'i sras bdun gyi che ba zhang rje khri lde

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//'bar/ gtsang pa tsha drug khri lde 'bar la sras drug gi g.yu thog gi brgyud/ sna mo ba/'phying nga ba/ don mkhar ba/ thang 'khor ba rnams yin no/ /byi chung lha sgom gdung chad/ gung lde 'od 'bar spe skyar gdung chad/ zla ba'i brgyud rta bshags pa dang gra sna ba yin no/ khri thog thag ma ru sper gdung chad/ chung ba bzhengs spyan 'bar gyi brgyud/ mon mkhar ba/ zhang mda' ba/ spun bsnyen thang pa rnams so/ /lha ston dkar mo'i brgyud bye chung ba rnams yin no/ /gtsang pa tshe drug la 'od btsan/lha bcan/ gung btsan gsum gyi brgyud byings po'i btsad po rnams yin no/ /lhun po'i brgyud bya ra na yod do/ /dar ra'i brgyud khra 'brug pa dang / chu mig gog po rnams te de rnams 'od srungs kyi brgyud pa yin no/ /bod kyi rgyal rabs byung tshul 'di rnams yar lung jo bo dang / byang ji ston pa/ tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje la sogs kyis bsgrigs pa'i yig tshang rnams nas legs par btus te sdebs pa yin zhing / yar rtse'i rgyal rabs ni/ gser thog pa rin rdor la zhib par dris nas bris pa yin zer bar 'dug go /dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /mdo rgyud mkhas mang phal che'i bzhed mthun par/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa lnga stong gnas pa la/ /thub dbang sa pho 'brug la 'khrungs pa nas/ /lo grangs chig stong lnga brgya sum cu drug /'das pa'i chu pho khyi la bod rgyal gyis/ /snga ba gnya' khri btsan po rgyal par byon/ /de nas dgu brgya drug cu rtsa gcig pa/ /chu khyi mtho ri gnyan btsan byon pa nas/ /brgya dang go bdun song ba'i me gling lor/ /srong bcan sgam po 'a cings nas chig brgya dang 1/62/don bzhi lcags rta lo la brag dmar

rgya bod yig tshang 'a mo/du / khri srong lde btsan zhakhyungs rting don drug pa'i/ /me pho khyi la mnga' bdag khri ral 'khrungs/ /so drug lcags bya'i bar la rgyal srid bzung / /de yan dam pa chos kyi dbu rnyed tshul//bod la rgyal rabs bzhi bcu zhe gnyis byon/ /de rting chu mo phag nas lcags rta'i bar/ /drug cu rtsa brgyad dar mas bstan pa bsgrubs/ /bod khams dbus gtsang dam chos sgra mi grags/ /de nas bstan pa phyi dar me stag lo/ /paṇa chen shāka shrī byon yan bzhi brgya dang / /dgu bcu go bdun me stag de lo nas/ /deng sang shing stag brgyad dkar dbus gnas yin/ /nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad sngar 'das kun/ /dril bas sum stong lnga brgya gya lnga song / /me bya yan la zhe gnyis myong / ma 'ongs bstan pa'i lhag ma chig stong dang / /bzhi brgya bco lnga yod par rtsis pa la/ /rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya the zhes lo/ /'di don go ba'i skye bo shes ldan kun/ /bstan pa rin chen sgron me gnas dus 'dir/ /rnam grol thar pa'i lam la 'jug par rigs/ /chos rgyal rgyal rabs 'di bris dge ba yis/ /thub bstan bstan pa'i sgor zhugs 'phags tshogs kyis/ /bstan 'dzin 'dzin ma'i ngos kun khyab gyur cig /'gro kun kun mkhyen rgyal po myur thob shog // mdzangs mi mi bdun gyi byon tshul/oṃ su sti/ bod du chos rgyal mes dbon rim pa yis mnga' thang chab srid spyi mthun bsod nams la/6/3/sprul pa'i blon chen bzang la mang po

'tshe tshen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ (//byon/ khyad par bod 'bangs byings la drin che ba'i/ /mdzangs pa mi bdun bya ba 'di ltar ro/ /thog mar gri gum btsan po'i sras gsum gyi/ /bar pa spu de gung rgyal sku ring la/ /gcig tu mdzangs pa chen po mdzangs kyi bu/ /ru lasaskyes kyi ngar gsos bya ba yin/ /de yis thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ /ba glang 'bri gnag ra lug khrims su bstsal/ /rtswa la chun po byas nas dbyar rtsi dgun du bstsal/ /spang thang zhing du slog nas ri'i ngo rnams bzung / /de yi gong na bod na rtsi thog lo thog med/ khri snyan bzung btsan rgyal po'i sku ring la / / gnyis su mdzangs pa blon chen khu yi bu/ /lha bu mgo dkar zhes pa de nyid byung / /de yis thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ /'brog gi don dang zhing gis mthun du sdebs/ /mtsho la gtar kha byas nas yur ba dkyus su bcug /phu chu rdzing du skyil nas mtshan chu nyin mor drangs/ /de yi gong na zhing rnams char mas 'debs/ /stag ri gnyan gzigs rgyal po'i sku ring la/ /gsum du mdzangs shing mkhas pa mong gi bu/ khri do ri yi gnang tshab bya ba byung / /de yi thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ /sol bas rdo bzhus gser dngul zangs lcags brtan/ khreng la bugs phug bzhol dang gnya' shing bcos/ /mdzo glang dor du ldebs nas thang la thams cad btab/ /de'i gong na bod na sgal dang rin chen med/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la/ /bzhi ru mdzangs pa thon mi saṃ bho ṭa/ /'jam dbyangs sprul pa skye rgu'i sgron me des/ /'gro ba'i don du dka' las dpag med kyis/ /ka kha sum cu bod yig gug kyed bcas/ /'dogs dang 'brel lci/ tsheg dang shad kyi bcad/ /tshig gis

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/dbye nas skabs don smra ba brtsams/ /de gong bod na klog dang yi ge med/ khri lde gtsug brtan rgyal po'i sku ring la/ /lnga ru mdzangs pa khri bzang yab don byung / /de yi thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ /bre dang srang gi 'du bgod rtsis su bzung / /yul du khyor gyi za ma zung du 'dzin/ /dga' gnyis tshong byed mthun gnyis las la spyod/ /de gong bod na bre srang nyo tshong med/ /chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan ring //drug tu mdzangs pa khri bzang yab lhag byon/ /de yis thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ /ri khyim thams cad klung gi bde la phab/ /zhing mtha'i snang la so nam khang khyim bcas/ /thang ma zhid slogs chu rnams zhing la bcug /de'i gong na ri la mkhar khyim 'dzin/ khri lde srong btsan 'phrul rgyal sku ring la/ /bdun du mdzangs pa chen po gnyer gyi bu/ /stag tshab ldong gzigs bya ba de nyid byon//de yis thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ /phyogs bzhi'i srung mas sku'i rim 'gro byed/ /sgos kyis stong sdes so kha'i dgra la rgol/ /nang gi 'khod snyoms khrims kyis gsos gtong bcad/ /de'i gong na bod na gsos gtong med/ /'dzangs pa mi bdun byung tshul de ltar lags/༈/su sti/bod kyi rgyal po rim pa'i mnga' thang las//sngon med gri dang ja shing dkar yol sogs//ya mtshan ngo mtshar can rnams gsar 'phel du//rim par byung tshul bstan pa 'di ltar ro/ /thog mar gri gum btsan po'i sku tshe'i smad/ /bod du ral gri dar ba 'di ltar snang //shes rab mtshon gyis log lta'i dgra bo 'dul/ /dran pa'i zhaga~Xs rgod pa'i chom rkun 'ching / /sprul

ba chen 'od snang la /tsho skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ (//pas chos dbyings dag pa'i sgo 'byed pa/ khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngon chad bod yul na ral gri'i dpyad dang rnam dbye yi ger bris pa mi snang / bdag gib(mkhas pa'i snyan tshig rnams(la/ legs(par rtog dpyod byas nas ral gri'i rgyas bshad yi ger bkod pa 'di ltar ro/ /de'ang ral gri'i rigs kyi dbye ba ni/ shad ma/ sog po/ hu phed gsum/ dgu zi / 'ja' ral dag dang lnga/de dag rnams kyi nang tshan ni/ zhang ma dang / zhang rje gnyis su 'byed/ sog po dang / sog rdzi gnyis su 'byed/ 'ja' ral dang / rgya 'ja' gnyis su snye2byed/ hu phed dang hu rogs gnyis su 'byed/ dgu zi dang / dgu dag gnyis su 'byed/ shad ma 'di rgya'i ral grir 'dug tha'i dzung rgyal po'i ring nas dar/ rgyal po'i zhang yul bya ba der/ /zhang bza' khro mo bya bas brdungs/ /gri des ci srid che rgu chod/ /mtshon la bud med mkhasapa de na btags/ /shad po de'i yul du brdungs pas zhang zhes zer/ mgar ba bud med yin pas ma zhes zer/ de dang shad dmar la mo la//rje gcig yod pa des kyang brdungs//de dang de rgyud zhang rjer 'bod//sog po 'di mtha' mi'i gri ru 'dun sog po thung rgyal gyi ring nas dar/ /sog yul bya ba'i mtha' med der/ /mgar ba rgas po gcig gis brdungs/ /gri des gnam lcagasakyi sbal pa chod/ /de phyir lcags la sog po rno/ /mi rigs las bgrang pasasog po ste/ /mgar ba rgan pos brdungs pas sog rgan zer/ /de dang de yi brgyud la sog rgan lo/ /de bor gyis dogs nas rdzi bo bzhag /des kyang nor la shes pa dang / /de dang de /spyad sog rdzir grags/ khu phed 'di hor

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/gyi ral grir 'dug /jing gir rgyal po'i ring nas dar/ /hor yul hu phed bya bas brdungs/ /gri des 'brong rwa drug re chod/ /de phyir hu phed rwa la rno/ /yul dang ming la grags pa yin/ /de dang de rgyud hu phed zer/kho la rogs gcig yod pa des kyang shes/ /de dang de brgyud la hu rogs zer/ /dgu zi 'di bod kyi gri ru 'dug /gri gum btsan pa'i ring nas dar/ /yul zi 'du bya ba'i sa ngan du/ /mig zim bu dpun dgus brdungs pa yin/ /che shos kyis gnam gyi dmu thag chod/ /de 'og brgyad la'ang rno rtags yod//de dgu'i slob ma kha dgur gyes/ bod la ral gri mang ba de ltar red/ /mi spun dgus brdungs pas dgu zhes te/ /mig zin po yod pas zi zhes pa/ /de dang de brgyud la dgu zi zer/ khong dgu la bdag gcig yod pa des kyang shes/ /de dang de brgyud la dgu bdag zer/ /'ja' ni lho mon gyi gri ru 'dug /nam mkha' gri mdzes kyi ring nas dar//'ja' yul lho brag gi nags gseb tu/ /mi tog thal mgo bya bas brdungs/ /gri des ljon shing dgu re chod/ /'ja' ral skya la rno ba de nas grags/ /'ja' zhes yul la grags pa yin/ /de dang de brgyud la 'ja' ral zer/ /rgyal pos kyang mgar ba zhes nas brdungs/ /de rigs rnams ni rgyal 'jal yin//de rnams rags rim dbye ba na/ /shad ma'i rigs la rnam pa gsum/ /'bri rtse go chod zhang phran te/ /de las gyes na gnyis 'gyur yod/ /shad rje'i sa dkar sa dmar gnyis/ /zhad ma'i sde tshan de las med/ /sog po'ang gyes pa rnam gsum ste/ / sog chen sog skya sog phran gsum/ /de rnams gyes pa'ang ga~Xs 'gyur yod/ /sog rdzi lcags rlag

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (re/thag khres can/ /sog po'i sde tshan de las med/ khu phed gyes pa zal dkar dang / /zal dmar zal khra dag dang gsum/ /de rnams gyes pa'ang gnyisa'agyur yod/ khu rogs khas rgan khas sna gnyis/ khu phed sde tshan de lasamed/ /dgu zi gyes pa rnam dgu ni/ /nam mkha' spu chod dgra lha'i gar chod dang / /gong khra dgu chod chu nang nya chod dang / /gal rdo'i rdo chod ngan tho'i skasachod dang / /o tsha'i bsam chod (snyig ho/)/ /gong go'i phag chod bya ba de dang dgu/ /de rnams gyes pa'ang gnyis 'gyur yod/ /dgu bdag gyes pa rnam gsum ni/ shang dkar shang nag za 'ug can dang gsum/ /dgu zi'i sde tshan de las med/ /rigs ni so gnyis shang lang gnyis kar yod/ /'ja' ral dag las gyes pa ni/ shar 'ja' lhor 'ja' gnyis su 'dod/ shar 'ja' gyes pa rnam gsum ni/ /bshal khog dngul khog 'bri khog gsum/ /de rnamasalas gyes gsum 'gyur yod/ /lho 'ja' 'ja' rnying ga'u ma//dgu la zi dang bar pa dang / /gsar brdungs dag dang rnam lnga yod/ /rgya 'ja' shang dmar shang nag dang / /mi sags can dang gsum du gyes/ /'ja' rigs 'di yang 'ad)pa can/ /ma gtogs thams cad shang ma yin/ /'ja' ral sde tshan de las med/ /mtshan nyid brtag pa'i man ngag ni/ /shad ma'i rigs la shad them ste/ /sog po'i rtags ni go chog go khu phed rtags ni hu rdzi ste/ /dgu rdzi'i rtags ni dgu tshig 'dra/ /'ja' ral rtags ni lcags zhag go /rtagasarnams yod pa de kun yin/ /rtags med yin pa'ang 'ga' re yod/ /'o na gang yin shes par gyis/ /gzug 6 8 bshad par bstun dgos te/ /zhang

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo ma phal cher phar phar phra/ /lug tshon zhag gis byug pa 'dra/ /sog po phal cher rtsa rtse mnyam/ /thang shing 'dab ma bzhar ba 'dra/ khu phed phal cher mthong bas lji/ /sprul nag khyung gi ded pa 'dra/ /dgu zi phal cher skya la 'jigs/ /lcang skya'i byug pa rlon pa 'dra/ /'ja' ral phal cher rngams la ngar/ /stag mo thang la rgyug pa 'dra/ /zhang ma mi 'gyur nges pa'i rtags/ /rtse nas sor gsum bcal ba yi/ /ngar yod med mtshams ri mo ni/ /sen mosabakod pa'i rjes 'dra yod/ /mkhas pas mig gis ltas pas shes/ /blun kyang lag pas nyul bas go /sog po mi 'gyur nges pa'i rtags/ /rtse nas sor gsum bcal ba na/ /pho mo lcags kyi go chod yod/ khu phed mi 'gyur ngesapa'i rtags/ /rtse nas phyed 'jal sor lnga'i phyed/ /mthun mtshams stag mo'i ris 'dra yod/ /dgu zi mi 'gyur nges pa'i rtags/ /gzhung la lcags kyi dar 'dog ni/ /dgu tshig skya mo 'dra ba yod/ /'ja' ral mi 'gyur nges pa'i rtags/ /srab la zhang che rtse mo sbom/ /shad ma go chod mtshan nyid ni/ /lcagasamadog dkar la 'jam pa yis/ /zhang ma lang phran mtshan nyid ni/ /lo legs ljang pa 'dra na yin/ /zhang rje rtsa ba'i mtshan nyid sna/ /mthug la lcags mdog nag pa ni//zhang dkar dkar la mthug na yin/ /shad dmar dmar la mthug na yin/ /gyes pa'i mtshan nyid 'dir ma smyos/ /sog po rtsa ba'i mtshan nyid ni / / phyi rtags sog por gcig pa la/ /nang rtags mi 'gyur nges pa ni/ /rtse mo sbal rgan ya thod 'dra/ /sog po che ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /go chod rtse mo li na yin/ /sog po sog skya'i mtshan nyis spya/ /gangs la shwa spu gtor ba 'dra/ /

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//sog po sog phran mtshan nyid ni/ khol bu khol nyag byung na yin/ khu phed rtsa ba'i mchan nyid ni/ khu phed phyi rtags gcig pa la/ /nang rtags hu rdzi kham sne can/ khu phed zel dkar mtshan nyid ni/ khu phed phyi rtags gcig pa la/ /nang rtags hu rdzi kham sne can/ khu phed zel dkar mtshan nyid ni/ khu rdzi phyi ru li na yin/ /zal dkar zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ khu rdzi nang du li na yin/ /zal khra zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /phyi nang gnyis ka li na yin/ khu grogs zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /hu rdzi nyis brtsegs yod na yin/ khu rogs kha rgan mtshan nyid ni/ /btab brdungs gcig la yong ba yin/ khu rogs khas sna'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sgra dang mgo gnyis 'joms na yin/ /dgu zi rtsa ba'i mtshan nyid dbye/ /nam mkha' spu gcod nang rtags ni//thur sgra dogs gsum 'jom na yin/ /dgra lha gar chod mtshan nyid ni/ /thu ris rkyang pa yod na yin/ /gong khra dgu chod mtshan nyid ni/ /skra ris rkyang pa yod na yin/ /chu nang nya chod mtshan nyid ni/ /dogs ris rkyang pa yod na yin/ /gal rge'i jo chod mtshan nyid ni/ /pho lcags gtsang yug gcig la zer/ /bye ne'i dong chod mtshan nyid ni / / mo lcags gtsang yug gcig la zer/ /ngan tho'i skad chod mtshan nyid ni//stabs brdungs ngar khrel can la zer/ /o tsha'i bsam chod mchan nyid ni/ /thur brdungs grang ngar can la zer/ /gong go'i phag chod mtshan nyid ni/ /lcags nag 'dres ma gcig la zer//dgu bdag rtse sbob ltag brdungs yin//shang dkar pho lcags gcig la zer/ tanang nag slo lcags gcig la zer/ /lcags zhags can la za lug zer/ 17//ja' ral ngo bo mtshan nyid ni/ /phyi

rgya bod yig tshang za mo/rtags 'ja' ral yin pa la/ /nang rtags mi 'gyur nges pa ni/ /srab la zhang che rtse sbom yin/ /shar 'ja' zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /shang lang sgro thur gzhung pa can/ /lho 'ja' ljid la so rtsib can/ /rgyal 'ja' shin tu thug la ring / /shang dmar mo lcags dbyig can yin/ gang na mi lhags g.yang gzhi can/ /rtsa ba'i 'ja' rtse g.yag ru kha/ /gyes pa'i rnam grangs 'dir ma smos/ /skyes dang lcags rigs rtags dang gsum/ /bstun la de'i sbyi mtshan dbye/ /pha tshan rigs kyi spyi khyab yin/ /nang tshan nang gi spyi khyab yin/ /rtags tshan rang gi thob skal yin/ /de rnams rags pa'i dbye ba tsam/ /gri rigs gyes pa'i rnam grangs dang / /lcags rigs nus pa ngar tshad kyi/ /rnam dbye rgyas bshad 'dir ma spros//blo ldan mkhas pa'i rjes 'jug dang //g.yul ngor dpa' ba'i skyes bu rnams//'di don rtogs dpyod ma chug par/ /blang dor ma nor mtshon bzung nas/ /bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs kun/ /myur bar chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /maṅga le/ // tshe su sti/ bod rgyal 'dus srong mang po rje/ /rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i dus/ /sngar med lha'i bdud rtsi bzhin/ /ja dang dkar yol byung ba yin/ /gtan tshigs rgyal rabs dag na gsal/ /rnam dbye rgyas bshad 'di ltar gnang / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri glegs bam 'dzin/ /dkyil krung dbyibs legs 'gying ldem brjid pa'i sku/ /rin chen sna tshogs mdzesapa'i rgyan gyis spras//kun mkhyen rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /bde gshegs kun mchod 'phags pa 7 / /ya rabs bshes gnyen gsol

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'gu pa gces bsdus/ (re/zas mchog /'dod yon mchog ldan bdud rtsi yi/ /mtshan nyid 'gro ba'i don du 'bri/ /lha'i yul du bdud rtsi gsol/ /thigs pa mi'i yul du babs//rgyal po'i khab tu ja ru smin/ /skye 'gro rnams kyi dpal du shar/ /de la dbye na bcu drug ste/ /phu mda' gnyis dang char ma chu ba dang / /zhing sar zhing rnying sa cha bshang gci dang / /lud can lud med rtsi ja bar ja dang / /tsha 'dul grang 'dul smin dang ma smin no/ /phu gsum ja ni 'dab chung ja shing sbom/ /mdog skya ngad pa tang kun dri ma bro/ /ro bska bsregs skol bad gan nad sel 'gyur/ /dzña na pu ta zhes bya'i ja ru grags/ /mda' gsum 'dab ma che 'jam ja shing sbom/ /mdog nag dud khu ro ngad shin tu kha/ /gas ba'i 'os yin rlung nad rab tu sel/ /u su nan ta zhes bya'i ja ru grags/ /char ma'i ja ni 'dab che ja shing sbol/ kha dog kham pa ngan dri khu ba nag /ro skad bsregs skol 'os yin mkhris pa sel/ /sab ste kham ser mar khu'i khu ba 'dra/ /ko'u ma ti zhes bya'i ja ru grags/ /a mi bha ra zhes bya'i ja/ /chu ma'i zhing la skyes pa ste/ /'dab ma thung mnyen ja shing phra/ /mdog sngo ci zhur khu ba 'dra/ /ngad pa mngar zhing ro mchog 'jam/ /brdungs pa'i 'os yin sil drod snyoms//ha la dzña zhes bya'i ja/ /zhing sar las skyes kha dog ser//'dab che rtsub cing ja shing la / khu ba khrag 'dra ro mchog kha/ /ngad pa ja men shing gi dri/ /lhab skol 'os yin gti mug sel/ /a / ta ma zhes bya'i ja/ /zhing rnyed las skyes kha dog sgrug /'dab ma thung chung ja shing phra/ /'o ma shing gi khu ba 'dra/ /ngad pa dri zhim ro mchog mngar/ /brdungs par ba/zlo zhing rlung nad sel/ /ha lu pa ta zhes

rgya bod yig zung chen slo/bya'i ja/ /sa bshang ma skyes kha dog ser/ /'dab ma chung srab ja shing phra/ khu ba ljang ser ro mchog mngar/ /ngad pa ta la'i dri dang mtshungs/ /brdungs pa'i 'os yin mkhris pa sel/ /gru gu pha la zhes bya'i ja/ /gci ba'i bar skye bas kha dog nag /'dab ma mang la ja shing lhung /khu ba'i mdog ser ro mchog bska//ngad pa mañdzu sha rka'i dri/ /brdungs par bzang zhing khrag nad sel/ /sa ri bha li zhes pa'i ja/ /lud can las skyes kha dog ser/ /'dab ma ja shing 'jam la snyoms/ khu ba zar ma'i mar khu 'dra/ /de'i ngad pa dri zhim 'jam/ /tshod btung kun 'dud nad rnams sel/ /a li bha gu zhes pa'i ja//lud med las skyes kha dog dmar/ /'dab ma che gyong ja shing sbom/ khu ba dmar nag ro mchog kha/ /ngad pa sna tsha dri ngad can/ /bsregs skol 'os yin rlung mkhris sel//mu pan ti zhes bya ba'i ja/ /rtse ja nyid yin kha dog ser//ja shing 'dab ma chung zhing 'jam/ khu ba dmar ser ngad pa chung / /ro mngar nad rnams ma lus sel/ /yon tan brgyad ldan kun la bsngags/ /has ti 'gu zhes bya ba'i ja/kha dog ser 'jam bar ja yin/ /ja shing 'dab ma 'jam la snyoms//zhu mkhan mdog 'dra sngo zhing mngar/ /ro ngad mngar zhing chu non chung / /rgan po gcong can rnams la sman/ /rgyu na dha lu tsha 'dul ja/ /ja shing 'dab ma gcig tu 'dres/ /ngad pa bkrag mdangs mi ldan yang / /skol tshe ro dang nus pa 'byung / khu ba gur gum 'bri mar mdog /'byung bzhi snyoms shing bkrag mdangs skyes//bha la mi ta grang 'dul ja/ /sengs na rdul phran sngo skya 'byung //nyin dgung 'ja' tshon sngon dmar 'a/nga / /ja shing 'dab ma gzugs ni

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/ rtonagasal/ khu ba ser skya dar ba'i mdog /ro dang ngad pa kha zhing dka'/ /lus bzang gis kha'athung stobs rtsal skyed/ 5tā lu hu ka zhes pa'i ja/ /legs par smin pas gnag cing snum/ /ja shing 'dab ma gnyen lhag 'jam/ /gser gyi zhag 'dra ro drug ldan/ /ngad pa dri zhim chu non che/ /rlung dang dug ro sel bar byed//dzña na dzña tu zhes pa'i ja//ma smin kha dog bkrag dmar skye/ /ja shing sbom la 'dab ma nyung / khu ba sngo nag bri ba'i mdog /ro dang ngad pa rtsug cing gyong /khog pa'i nad slong rlung khams skyed//thog mar dkar yol nang blugs dus//bong bu rnga mo spre'u'i gzugs/ /ma trang mi ro keng rus bris/ /de dbus gsal na ltas ngan gnas/ /gang du babs der mi dge 'byung / /rdzas brgyad drang srong tshe'i gzugs/ /rgyal po nor bu rin chen bdun/ /de bzhin dkar yol nang na gnas/ /gang du babs der dge legs 'byung / /ja nyo ba dang ja tshong dang / /ja 'thung skye bo mang gyur kyang / /ja dpyad ha shang de ba mkhas/ /de la gha mi rgyal pos zhus//gha la mi tra mgon pos zhus//de nas rim bzhin brgyud de zhus/ /yo mar rgya ja bzang ngan brtags pa'i bstan bcos bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /maṅga lo/ // rgya gar skad du/ swā ta blu shā sto/ bod skad du/ dkar yol brtag pa'i bstan bcos/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo rab dkar skyon bral dri ma med pa'i dpal/ /yid 'ong dbyibs legs bzang po'i bcud 'dzin pa/ /kun nas yid 'phrog rnam par mdzes pa'i snod/ /rin chen dkar yol brtag thabs 'di //sbyangs shig rgyu ni rab 'bring rnam pa

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/gsum/ /rab ni rin chen 'ching bu dang / /'bring ni 'dzeng la byas pa ste/ /tha ma rdo thal dkar po'o/ kha dog ser ba rab yin te/ /dkar ba 'bring la tha ma sngo/ /dbyibs dang ri mo'i brtag pa yang / /'bru brgyad rigs ni bcu drug bshad//bha ra tra dang shag ti dang //bha ling ta ka mu lu ti//ka li ka ta ka lang ka / ma ti ku tra gha na pa/ /sing snu dha ra ka ra dang / /bhu ki ta dang bhi lding gi /ba ra ha si prat+pa gi /bha ra ta ni rab tu ser/ /ku mu ta'i me tog bzhin/ khyung gzhog mang shing shing lo rgyas/ /gang na yod der dge legs 'byung / shag ti ka ni dkar zhing ser/ /'bar 'bur mang zhing khyung gshog nyung / /chu risamang zhing bas ga'i/ /me tog dang 'dra longs spyod 'phel/ /bha li ta ka dkar zhing srab/ khyung gzhog chu ris dag dang ldan/ /tsam pa kha'i me tog 'dra/ /ye shes ting 'dzin rab tu 'phel/ /mu mu ti ni kham pa'i mdog /phyi nas gnyisakur ri mo med/ khu du da'i me tog 'dra/ /de 'dzin mi la kha zas mod/ /bhi na du ka ni dkar zhing sngo/ /chu ris khyung gshog dag dang ldan/ /ut+pa la'i me tog 'dra//snying rtser ldan zhing sems mi 'khrugs/ /pa li ti ni sngo zhing srab/ /spos ldan rigs kyi ri mo yod/ /ka ra ti'i me tog 'dra/ /de 'dzin blo gros rigs pa 'go /ka li ka ta kha dog dang / /sprin gyi ri mos rnam par brgyan/ /ma la sha yi me tog 'dra/ /bu dang rigs brgyud rnam par 'phel a lang ka ra sprin gyi mdog mang lo yal kha rab tu 'khrigs/ /tsa na na'i me tog 'dra//snyan sgrags ldan zhing gtam snyan thob//ma ti ku ta dkar zhing dmar/ /'dab ma yangs pa'i ljon zhing ldan/ /da /3 ti'i me tog 'dra/ /rigs brgyud mi

ba tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (ri)'phel longs spyod nyams/ /sgyu na sa ni sgo lnga'i mdog zhung gzhog mi ldan nya ris yod/ /mdangs med sa ta'i me tog 'dra/ /de 'dzin nad dang rdul mang dang //sing ghu dha ra sngo zhing dwangs/ /bya rog gshog gdengs mgrin pa ring / /tsar tsi ma'i me tog 'dra/ /rtag tu kha smad rtsod pa 'byung / /ka ra ka ni sngo zhing dkar/ /ri dwags gzugs kyis nye bar brgyan/ khu lu ga'i me rtag 'dra/ /bdag po mi sdod gnas nas 'pho/ /bhu ki ta ni sngo skya'i mdog /chu ris gru dang gnyan par ldan/ /sab ti ka li'i me tog 'dra/ /bya ba mi 'grub rnam rtog mang / /bhi lding ki ni nam mkha'i mdog/'brug dang sprin gyis nye bar brgyan//ut+pa la'i me tog 'dra/ /rgyal po rnams kyis snod du bzung / /ba ra ha si dkar zhing gtsang / /bya dang shing los rnam par brgyan/ /'dzam bu kri sha'i me rtag 'dra/ /bshes gnyen rnams kyi snod du bzung / /tra tam ki ni sngo zhing 'tsher/ /chu ris chu srin ri mos brgyan/ /ma3 sha na'i me tog 'dra/ /ya rabs rnams kyi sgod du bzung / /'brug rgyab rab kyi yon tan ni/ /bdug dang ja rlangs mig nad sel/ /blo gsal nad zhi gti mug 'jom/ /zas kyi ro skyed nusapar ldan/ /'brug rgyab yon tan dpag med ldan/ /blo ldan rnams kyis 'di bzungs shig /dkar yol dar che'i brtag thabs la/ /rigs ni drag tu shes bya ste/ shab tshe lab tshe shang tshe dang / /theg tshe dob tshe sdong che'i/gang tshe kha g.yel rkang pa thung / kha dog dkar sngo srab la yangs/ /sprin nam shing lo chu ris 'bu/ /'brug rgyab dwangs mnyam yon tan 'byung / /lab tshe sham 'bor dbyibs mi mdzes/ /srab 1 7 sbyangs la dwangs pa 'byung / /be+eḍūrla'i

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ mdog dang mtshungs/ /bya dang ri dwags ri mos brgyan/ /shang tshe dbyibs legs kha dog sngo/ /skad 'tsher mdangs ldan rkang pa ring / /pa tra shing losanye bar brgyan/ /yid 'ong mdzes pa'i gzugs dang ldan/ /theg tshe mdog sngo rkang pa sbom/ lus che gting zab thub cing brdzid/ kha rub skad che gzugs dbyibs sbom/ mang los rab brgyan lji zhing gtsang / /deb tshe rgyud dman kha dog ngan/ /skad dang mi mthun ri mos dben/ /legs nyes skyon yon gnyis dang bral/ /sa tshe zhes byar rab tu grags/ /rdo tshe yid 'ong 'brug rgyab 'dra/kha dog dbyibs legs skad bzang yang / /chu ris khyung gshog ma ldan cing / /nang du khyi rjes 'dra ba nyams/ /gzhan yang mtshan nyid mdor bsdus na/ khri spyo bzang mchog dman skad la brtag /'brug dang sprin du 'brel na rab/ /ja dang shing du 'brel na 'bring / /nya dang chu srin tha mar bshad/ /'brug dang glang chen seng ge stag /'khor lo bum pa pad+ma dang / /ljon shing nags tshal ri mo rnams//'di ldan snod mchog bzang po yin/khyung dang ngang pa ri dwags dang //sprin dang shing lo chu ris dang / /mtsho dang chu srin me tog rnams/ /bde skyid yun thung mthar mi rtag /nya dang bya rog mi ro'i gzugs/ /ri dwags mtshon gyis bsnun pa dang / /gcan gzan sgrogs tu tshud pa rnams/ /gang gis bcangs der sdug bsngal 'byung / /dkar 'jam dbyibs legs srab cing yang //gtsang zhing dwangs la ri mo bzang //bsham yangs srin khung nags tshal med/ /mtshan nyid 'di bcu mkhas pas brtag kha cher sku 'khrungs kun mkhyen rgyal po yi/ /rin chen dkar yol |/ga thabs 'di sbyar bas/ /zab rgyas

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ /ri)chos kyi dbyings su bdag gyur te/ /'gro rnams ye shes yon tan myur thob shog /dkar yol brtag thabs rin chen snod kyi bdud rtsi zhes bya ba/ kha che thams cas mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel bar gyu/ ca1 su/sti/ gang sku rab brjed mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /gang gsung snyan pa'i sgra yis sbyo stegs kun khyab/ /gang thugs dpag yaba'i mkhyen pa rab rgyas pa/ /gang zhig bslu med 'jam dbyangs zhabs la 'dud//sngon chad bod 'dir dkar yol bzang ngan dpyad/ /rnam gzhag yi ger bkod pa mi 'dug pas/ /che chung dbye 'byed rigs khungs byung tshul rnams/ /rjes 'dun mkhas pa'i mdun sar khrid pa'i phyir/ /mkhas mang du mas rjes su bzung ba'i bu/ /mkhas grub rtsod dang bral ba'i lung rigs can/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po blo gros dpal bzang gis/ /rnam gzhag gsal phyir yi ger 'bri bar bya/ /nor bu'i bye brag dkar yol 'brug rgyab 'di/ /dang por snga ba rgya gar yul du srid/ /ded dpon chen pos rgya mtsho'i phar mtha' mā /nor bu blangs phyir rdzing chen bskyod pa'i tshe/ /pho 'dom bce drug yod pa'i dkar yol gnyis/ /ga'u kha spyor bzhin du mtsho nang na/ /bkrag mdangs 'od dang bcas te 'dug par mthong / kha rlangs mchu yis bzung nas steng du thon/ /mchu la brdar ba'i shugs kyi khyung por grags/ /'brug gi rgyab tu ngal gsos kha bye ba'i/ /nang nas yid bzhin nor bu dag kyang don/ /phyi la srog chags bzhi'i rjes kyang byung / /de la 'dod rgu 'a/༵ gyur 'di ltar ro/ khyung po 'bor ma

rgya pod yig tshang 'a rmo/ nor bu'i bye brag yin//dgo ba rnga mo'i sder ma'i rjes la ni//kun gyis bkur zhing gzi brjid chen por 'gyur/ /gnyis 'thung dbang po'i khal ma'i rjes la ni/ /sa la dbang bsgyur mi'i bdag por 'gyur/ /gyi ling rta'i rmig ma'i rjes la ni/ /rkang bzhi la dbang dud 'gro 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gyu sram nya'i gzhog pa'i rjes la ni/ /btung ba dang ldan chu la dbang bsgyur 'gyur/ /dpa' bos mkha' la ral gri g.yug rjes ni/ /pha rol dgra las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur/ /mdzangs mas sa la me long bzhag rjes ni/ /ro brgya'i zas rnyed snang srid gsal bar 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i rtags dang ya mtshan ldan pa yi / / nor bu'i shugs kyis dkar yol gnyis po des/ /chos rgyal mya ngan med ces grags pa'i dus/ /seng ge'i 'o ma bzhes pa'i gsol zhal byas/ /deng sang dus na ser skya'i grong khyer gyi/ /gtsug lag khang gi mchod rdzas chen po byed/ /de'i rjes su zhugs pa'i dkar yol gnyis/ /'grong gnyan ldi gu'i ring la bod du dar/ /rgyal po'i gsol zhal dbang po'i gter du sbas/ /de yi rting la rlung nam 'phrul rgyal dus/ /mkhas pa'i bzo bos sol nag thang po cher/ /'ching bu'i rgyu la rna snyen sku thos dpe byas nas/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis che chung 'bring gsum ston/ /rab dang 'bring dkar tha ma sngo shas che/ /bod yul dbus gcang mthil na nor bu las/ /grub pa'i 'brug rgyab grags pa de bstsal lo/ /'di la yon tan dpag med ldan/ /skal ldan rnams kyis 'di bzungs shig /de la zla bo gsum yod dar tshe dang / /'dol la byang skya gsum du grags pa yin/ /de rnams bod sdo /nga ba'i dkar yol yin/ /dar tshe la

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ rtonani ri mo'i nges pa med/ /bla dar ma dang sngo sgor gnyis su 'dod//'bras shel la ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /rtsa'o che dang dung sbreng gnyis su 'dod/ /bzang ngan rnam gzhag ri mos 'byed pa yin/ man tu dwangs shing ri mo nyis 'byug can/ /pad+ma'i nang na bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / /rgya nag pa tra kha la 'khor ba sogs/ /gzhan yang 'brug chung gnyis gnyis kha sprad dang / /'brug chen re res khyab par bris pa yod/ /dkar la mdangs chags dwangs shing ri mo phyug /de dag bzang zhing phyi rtags mtshan nyid yin/ /dwangs chung ma ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /rtsi ni bca' sngo phal cher sbu gu can/ /bzo ni kha kha ma yin dbyibs gcig yin/ /ming gi rnam grangs ri mos 'byed pa yin/ /gragasa'os ma zhes zer ba'i dkar yol 'di/ /nang la pad brtsegs kha la pha gusabaskor/ /ti shi grags pa 'od zer dus su byung / /rgyal bzang ma zhes bya ba'i dkar yol 'di/ /yu ba dkar gzugs zheng du ring ba la/ /srab cing yangasal dwangs pas gzhan pas 'dren//sngo khra 'brug gis brgyan pa dag kyang yod//dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po dbon shi yis/ /son bying dbon gyis khrims ra bzung dus bzos/ /dbang phyug brtson 'grus yan la rdzogs par 'dod/ khu la hu yi tha dad bcom pa'i dus/khyad par can gyi dkar yol nor bu gcig/bha dang rgyal po'i skad kyis bskur ba dang / /de ni sen mo dag gis brdungasatsam na/ /bza' btung gang 'dod de las 'byung ba yod/ /rgyal po zi ling mkhar du 'das pa dang / /dkar yol de las bza' btung ma byung bas/ /ya mtshan can de de ru bcag zhes tho /80/skud ba 'grong pa'i bug ga ni/ /stong

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ rtsa la yod kyang mi 'jag pa/ /sa skya shar pa'i phyag na yod/ /ka pad zhes byar grags pa'i dkar yol ni/ /ka pā la dang pad+ma'i ri mo can/ /de phyir ka pad zhes byar grags pa yin/ /ka pad yung nga'i mdog 'dra ba/ /lha pa'i phyag na yod ces grags/ /ja dang mnyam du 'byom pa gcig /yar lung jo bo'i phyag na yod/ /sa tshe zhes byar grags pa'i dkar yol ni/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i sader bzos pa yin/ /dkyil du yi ge sa gcig nges par yod//dus phyis gong nas thon pa'i dkar yol gnyis/ /dme mtshan gsol de bzhin gshegs pa dang //'gro kun skyabs gnas theg chen chos rgyal la/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po rta'i ming chen pos phul/ /che chung gnyis yod che ba theg chen yin/ /sngo khra nyin mo bde legs dag kyang yod/ /ri mo drug dang bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs/ /shin tu mtshar ba'i ri mo bzhigs na legs/ /'di gnyis khyad par can yin deng sang dar/ /'di rnams 'brug rgyab thog drangs ngos 'dzin rdzogs/ /dge bas 'gro kun dbul ba sel bar shog // chen po hor gyi rgyal rabs cha lag dang bcas pa/na mo badz+ra pa ni ye/ mthu stobs gnam lcags rdo rjes bdud dpung tshogs/ /gzir byed sdigs mdzub drag pos dgra bgegs kun/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrod mdzad pa'i/ khro rgyal nam mkha'i mdangs ldan zhabs btud nas//de yi sprul pa bya rdogs hor yul du//srid bzung skabs

ba chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ ( )su rgya nag bal bod du'ang / /bstan pa skyong dang rgol ba bzlog pa sogs/ /ci byung lo rgyus don gsal 'di ltar ro/ /chen po hor gyi rgyal rabs la snga ba/dang por gnam gyi bu sbor ta che/ de'i bu bā ta che gan/ de'i bu tham chag de'i bu khyi che mer khan/ de slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sprul pa yin zer/de'i bu brgyud la rim pa bzhin 'ur byang bo ro 'ol/ de'i bu bas ka ni dun/sems za'u je/ kha chu/ de'i bu bun mer khan de 'das pa'i rjes la/ nag mo.a lan kho las nyi ma'i zer las skyes pa'i sbo thon char mung khan/ de'i yang bu brgyud rim pa bzhin/ ga'i chi/ sbi kher/ ma nan tho don/ sba'i shing / khor dog shing / na'i khan/ ga bu khan/ bar dan ba dur/ ye sur ga ba dur 'di yan la hor gyi rgyal rabs bcu dgu hor yul du byung ngo / /ye su ga dur rgyalapo dang btsun mo hu lun gyi sras tha'i dzung jing gir rgyal po shing pho rta lo la sku 'byungs te sku mched bdun lnga'ang snang /)yod/ khong gi dgung lo sum cu so gsum lon pa sa pho stag gi lo la mi lhag rgyal rgod kyi rjes la tho rdzi zhesapa'i rgyal po gcig gis thang gi rgyal po byed kyin yod pa'i lag nas rgyal sa 'phrogs nas/ hor gyis rgya nag thang gi rgyal srid lo nyi shu rtsa gsum bzung nas/ dgung lo drug cu re drug pa me mo phag gi lo ston zla dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis la/ mi nyag 'ga'i bas char gnam du gshegs kha so/ /gnam mam bya tshe ring gis byin pa'i nor bu'i tham kha yang rgyal po de'i ring la byung ba yin zer/de'i bu/ 'jo chi dang / cha ga ta'i/ o ko ta'i/ 'a 'a gyi pha min/)tho lo no yon la sogs dgu yod/ rgyal po rang sdi/ gis sras che ba gnyis pos rgyal sa la

rgya bod yig chos chen mo/ mi rtsod pa'i yi ge bcug nas/ g.yas sa g.yon ru'i rgan pa la bskos/ nu 'ang gi'i bu yin/) bo che ba o go ta yis rgyal sa lo drug mdzad/ 'jo chi la bu brgyad dang /ca ga ta la bu du ba sogs dgu yod/o ko ta'i sras che ba go yug rgyal pos rgyal sa zla ba drug mdzad/ de'i nu bo go dan la sogs pa bdun yod/ go yug ldan 〉pa bu gsum yod/ tho lo no yon gyis sngar yi ge ma byin pa sa rgyal sa la rtsod pa yod cing / de dang btsun mo za yin e kha zo rog ta'i bu che ba/ mong 'bri gung pa dang yon mchod du 'brel gol gan gyis rgyal sa lo dgu mdzad/ sras gnyis pa se chen rje sa paṇa dang 'brel go dan/ gsum pa go pe la sngon ma gung thang pa dang 'brel shi dzung se chen gan shing mo phag lo la 'khrungs rgyal sa lo sum cu so lnga mdzad/ bzhi pa kurma pa dang 'brel a ri bho ga lnga pa hu 'bri khung pa dang 'brel la hu 'di lhag pa'i rgyal po yin zer nas rgyal khams tshol ba la stod du btang bas de nas stod hor du grags pa 'di byung ba yin no/ /se chen dang dpon mo cha bu'i sras bzhi'i che ba/rdo rje/gnyis pa/jing gin/gsum pa/me gha la/ bzhi pa/ no mo gan no/ /btsun mo zhwa gon ma'i sras brgyad kyi khrugaces pa 'ang snang )tshe ba/ hu por che/ gnyis pa/ a rog che/gi sum pa chad/)bzhi pa/go yug thi mur/ lnga pa/ e sen sbo ga drug pa/ tho gan/ bdun pa/ go go chu/brgyad pa/ rdo lo/ thams cad bsdoms pas/ se chen gyi bu bcu gnyis byung /se chen rang gis dgung lo sum cu so bzhi lon pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo nas bzung ste rgyal sa lo sum cu so lnga mdzad brgyad cu tham pa'i shing pho rta lo la gnam du gshegs/ se chen gyi / 8 rdo ba rdo rje la sras med/ rgyal bu jing

ba chen 'od snang la /skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (//gin dang de'i btsun mo go go can gyi sras che ba ka ma la/ gnyis pa dharma pha la skugs pa/ gsum pa phrol ja du thi mur dang gsum yod pa'i ol ja du 'dis dben cing lo gnyis dang / ta'i ti lo bcu gcig ste rgyal sa lo bcu gsum mdzad/ de'i bu ti shu myur du 'das/ dharma pha la dang / bas mo tha tong tha'i hu da gi'i sras che ba ha'i shan gyis ci shun lo gsum/ ta'i ti lo gnyisargyal sa mdzad/ ming gu lug rgyal po yang zer ro/ /gnyis pa a yu par pa ta rgyal sar bton srid lo dgu bzung / bu yan du rgyal po lo gnyis mdzad cesakyang /sngar ro/ /ka ma lu'i sras ye sun the mur gyis ta'i ti lo gcig dang ci shun lo bzhi ste rgyal sa lo lnga mdzad/ bu yan du'i sras si ti pha la g.ying dzung ge gan rgyal pos rgyal sa lo gsum mdzad/ go dan la sras ji big thi mur sogs gsum yod/ ye sun thi mur gyi sras ra khyi phag gis zhag bzhi bcu rgyal sa mdzad/ me gha la'i sras a nan ta/ de'i sras snga kyi rug thi mur bsad/de la bu gnyis yod/ go lug rgyal po'i sras che ba ku sha la gu thug tu lo ngo gcig bzhugs te smyo rgyal sa lo gcig mdzad/༄go thug rgyal ngo 'ang zer ro/ /gnyisapa thog the mur gyis thon le lo gsum dang ci shun lo gnyis te rgyal sa lo lnga mdzad 'ja' yan du rgyal po'ang zer ro/ /ku sha la'i sras gnyis kyi chung ba rin chen dpal rgyal po thog mar rgyal sar bton pas ci shun zla ba gcig mdzad nas gnam du gshegs/ de'i skabs su/ rtsis pa rnams bsagasanganas rtsis byas pas/ de'i gcen po tho gan thi mur bya lo zla ba drug pa shar nas rgyal sar bston na se chen da 8 4 pa gcig yong zer ba byung ba la/

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/ mi dpon rnams na re de tsam rgyal sa stong par 'jog pa rgyal khams kyi khag sus theg zer ba la/ yel thi mur tha shi na re khyed se khyim tha'i sa rnams kyis da dung legs par rtsis/ de ltar bden na gong ma sku tshe ring ba las lhag pa med de'i bar la rgyal khams kyi khag ngas khur zer nas zla ba drug rgyal sa stongs/ khrims kyi bya ba rnams el the mur gyis byas/ de rting chu mo bya lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad la pho brang chen po shang dor/ tho gan the mur rgyal sar bton nas ci shun lo gcig dang / dben thung lo gnyis/ ci dben lo drugaci jing lo nyi shu rtsa bdun te dril bas lo sum cu so drug rgyal sar bzhugs shing khri thog phebs nas lo nyi shu rtsa drug lon pa'i skabs su/ sa mo khyi lo la ti shi kun rgyal ba zhi bar gshegs/ sog po'i mi dpon ngo log nas pho brang shang do mes bsregs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems chen dang / rdo'i lhung bzed nam mkha' la byon ces gleng / de rting lo bcu lon pa'i sa pho spre'u'i lo hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer dgu'i srod la gong ma chen po yab sras/ pho brang rta'i tu nas hor yul la gshegs dgos pa byung zhing / rgyal sa rgya rta'i ming rgyal pos bzung ba yin zer grags so/ /de'ang snga song pho brang shang do sog pos me la bsreg dus sman rtse'i rgyal bus hor rgyal po la gus btud byas pas ma lo bar yul nas phud/ sa skyar yong chos byas pas/ mi 'dusachen po byung 'dug de'i skabs su/ hor rgyal gyi rtsis pa na re/ nub phyogs kyi ban de ngo log nas rgyal sa 'phrog pa 'dug zer ba byung nas/ ltar btang bas sman rtse'i lha btsun 'khor mang po/ bskor ba mthong / de hor rgyal po la

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (//zhus pas gsod zer ba'i lung byung nas/ gsod du phyin pas kho na re nga ngo log byed rtsis min pa la gsod na skye ba phyi ma la hor gyi rgyal sa 'phrog par shog zer ba'i smod pa bor bas rgya rta'i ming rgyal por skyes nas hor gyi rgyal sa 'phrog pa yin zer ro/ /sman rtse lha btsun de bsad dus khrag yang 'o mar byung ces grags so/ /hor tho gan the mur rgyal po'i dus rgya nag rgyal sa chug ba'i nyes lan byung tshul 'chad lugs mi gcig pa 'ga' snang na'ang / de dus dbus gtsang nas phyin pa'i ti shi 'dra gleng dus 'di skad zer ro/ /rgyal sa mi chug pa'i lo bcu skor gyi gong du rgya nag gi rtsis pa na re/ da rgyal sa'adi la 'pho chug byung dogs 'dug pas da lta sras 'di rgyal sar ston na thub bo zer ba la/ yab rgyal pos kyang de bzhin 'thad par bka' gnang / mi dpon thams cad legs par bgros 'cham na'ang sras rgyal bu a yu par pa ta la zhus pas/ sngon nas da'i bar la yab rgyal po gnam la ma gshegasanas rgyal sa bskos pa'i srol lugs mi 'dug pa la/ da lta gong ma sku brtan par bzhugs/ khrims gnyis dar rgyas 'phel ba'i dus 'dir/ rgyal sal bskos bzhag byed pa mi 'os gsungs nas gsan ma 'dod/ de mtshams sman rtse'i rgyal khams 'chos pa'i dmag 'degs dgos byung dus/ dmag dpon la rgyal bu bskos dmag 'bum phrag sum cu tsam btang bas/ sman rtse'i rgyal khams lon pa dang byus chen po thob pa ni byung / de rjes pho brang 'og gi dmag mi bcu dpon thob pa gcig gis kho rang nad kyis thebs/ bu chung dmag tshab la gzhan ma rnyed par/ lab sdo byer ba'i mchod gnas rgya nag rmu rgod/

rgya bod yig cha za rngo / 'byor rdzas kyis dbul ba gcig yod pa de btang / khos kyang yon mchod 'brel che ba la bsam slar rgyags la sogs pa la bltas nas dmag chas su zhugs phyin pa dmag po che sgo bsher ba'i skabs su/ rgyal po'i zhal bltas nas brnye dmag chad sprad pa 'di lta bu/ khrims gnyis ka khyad du gsad/ dpe srol la gnod pa yin pas kho rang khrims la sbyar/ kho'i bcu 'og rnams la dbyug pa brgya dang bdun re rgyab bo zer byung ba la kho dbul bas mi nye'i dbang du song ba la sogs rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ kho rang la dgug pa grangs med brgyab nas shi la thug par byas/ grogs dbyug pa phogs pa rnams kyang lus sems dub pa'i ngang kho la 'khor nas/ dmag byings po'i shul du lus pa / re zhig nas khong rnams lus gsos pa dang / ban+de log po des blo ston nas ngo log rtsom par gros 'cham/ pho brang gi nub phyogs rgya mtsho'i gling chung btsan pa gcig bzung nas/ thag nye ring med pa su 'phrad mthong tshad thams cad bcom 'phrogs gsad bzung byas pas/ de phyogs kyi mi thams cad rim nga sa kho'i 'og tu zhugs dgos pa byung zhing / khong dpon g.yog rnams la dbang cha 'phrogs pa'i gzhi bu mas la sogs kyang byung ngo / /mthar lo gcig gnyis nas spyang su zhing zer ba'i/ zhing gcig hril po tsam kho'i dbang du 'dus par gyur te/ de skabs nas lab de khos hor rgyal po la zhu ba btang nas/ khyed kyi sras pos nga nyes med la khrims phabs pas/ deng sang nga'i 'og tu zhing gcig 'dus yod pas da nga la dbang gi lung kha gser dam dang bcas pa ster dgos byas pas/ rgya 8 7 gsung nas kho rtsa ba rigs brgyud

brtse chen 'od snang la /skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (re/su yin rtsad chod/ hor yin na kho rang zhu ba bzhin ster dgos pa yin yong zer/ der zhib tu dris pas kho rgya dmangs rigs gcig yin par 'dug zhus pas/ 'o na dbang gi ming ster du mi rung gsungs nas/ kho la de bzhin gyi lung bsgyur bas kho khros shing / de dus kho la bu chung smra shes pa tsam zhig yod pa des kyang / smra ba'i thog mar hor rgyal po'i gsung dang / mdzad spyod kyi lad mo kho na byed pa gcig byung bas/ phas rten 'brel shis par go nas yang rgyal po la zhu ba bskyar ma btang ba las/ rgyal po khyod kyis nga 'dod pa bzhin las kha byin na ngas kyang khyod 'dod pa bzhin byed bsam pa yin te/de bzhin mi 'thad na dbang gi las ka rang rang gis bkod pas chog da phyin nas/ nga'i rgyal khams la khyod kyis lung mi 'gro zer ba byung zhing / de nyid nas kho rang la ta'i ming dbang zer ba btags nas/ khyon gyis mi dpon chen po rnams la'ang springs yig gtong ba mnga' thang lo re bzhin yar 'phel du gyur/ de'i grags pa thos pas/ dang por lab de dmag tshab la gtong mkhan gyi gnas po dang bcu 'og gi nye tshan 'dra yang lo'i sar phyin/ phrad dus sngar gyi byas byung lan rtsa 'dod pas blo slad nas/ zla grangs dus tshes 'di tsam la nges kyi phyi nas/ dmag stobs can khyer yong khyed pho brang nang na yod pa rnams kyis nang du thabs shes gang 'grub ltos/ nga'i bu 'di yang chung ngu nas rgyal po'i bya ba byed kyi yod pas/ hor gyi rgyal sa 'phrog thub par nges so zer te/ de bzhin byed par gros 'cham/ dus bsgrigs nas gnasapo skor rnams pho brang du bslebs pa1 8 8 / sngar nyes pa phogs pa'i ching sang

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/gcig yang gsos nas/ lab de'i dmag tshan che ba yong gi yod par 'dug zer ba'i skad ngan ma tshor ba'i skabs der ching sang des/ pho brang nang gi grong pa shas che ba la rgyal po'i lung yin pas/ sang snga mor/ pho brang gi zur du dar skyer kha cig btsugs yod/ de byung phral la khyed rnams kyi steng du'ang / dar skyer kha re tshugs shig de bzhin su ma byas pa la/ nyes pa yod do zer ba'i dril bsgrags/ sang snga dro de bzhin byas te/ pho brang nang gi sum cha lta ba gcig gi khang steng du dar btsugs 'dug pa la/ rgyal po na re 'di ci yin gsungs pa la/ ching sang des lab de'i dmag tshan spyan nye mor gtugs yong gi yod 'dug pas/ pho brang gi ching so rgyal khams byings po khar sang nas kho la ngo ltas tshar zer/ nang gi dar btsugs pa 'di rnams kyang / rang re la ngo log kho'i dar gyi brda' chad 'dug pas/ da ji ltar mdzad/ rgyal po rang yang kho la ngo lta'am/ hor yul la 'bros pa gang 'thad bya ran par 'dug zer/de 'phral la rtsis pa rnams bos nas rtsis byas pas da lan rgyal sa 'chor bar 'dug gong ma hor yul la byon pa legs/ phyis rgyal sa 'di hor gyis lon pa yang yong bar 'dug zer ba byung nas/ de la mngon par gtad de gong ma tho gan the mur rgyal po yab sras/ rtsa ba'i hor gyi mi dpon stod rim rnams dmag 'bum phrag gcig tsam yod zer ba dang bcas pa rnams kyis nor bu'i tham khas 'go byas/ khyad nor drag shos gang theg rta dang / glang po dang /rnga mo la sogs par bkal nas/ pho brang gi byang sgo nas srod la 'thon nas hor rang yul la byon pa yin zer 1 8 9 / de rting zhag gsum gyi bar la phyi

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//nas dmag kyang ma sleb/ nang na ban+de phyogs kyi dpung mi lag kyang med par/gong ma byon pa'i sgo sdems mi yang ma byung pho brang rtse stong par lus pas/ hor zhen che ba 'dras gong ma'i phyi la zhu ba btang na'ang / hor dmag bskur nas yong zer bzlog ma phod/ zhag gsum song ba'i snga dro sngon la/ lab de pha bu drag btus stong tsam gcig pho brang rtser slebs/ de 'phral la byang sgo bsdams/lho sgo la kho pa rnams rim pas bcug ste/ sang snga dro nas nang re bzhin rgya tor che go gsal byas nas/ hor mi grangs brgya brgya nyes pa la sbyar nas tshar bcad par 'dug zer zhing / de nas lab de'i bu la rgyal sa bskos nas rta'i ming rgyal por mtshan gsol/ rgyal khams kyi bdag po byas pa yin zhing / de lta na'ang rgya'i ru mtshon gyi dar thams cad skyer khar byed pa 'di thog mar/pho brang gi nang du dar skye mkhar mgor btsugs pa de'i rten 'brel la brtags pa yin zer ro/ /hor gyi rgyal po'i thog ma tha'i dzung jing gir rgyal pos sa pho stag la rgya nag rgyal sa thob nas rting ma tho gan the mur rgyal pos sa pho sprel lo la rgyal sa shor ba yan la/ lo brgya dang lnga bcu nga gcig song zhing hor gyi rgyal rabs kyang grangs bco lnga byung 'dug chos rje sa paṇa dgung lo drug cu rtsa gsum pa shing pho 'brug lo la/ hor gyi gser yig pa la snga ba rdor tha ches sa skya nas gdan drangs nas byon/ lam bar la lo gsum song / drug cu re drug bzhes pa me mo lug lo la byang ngos sprul pa sder hor rgyal po se chen go dan dang mjal nas/ hor gyi rgyal sa shor ba yan la/ hor dang sa skya pa yon mchod lo brgya dang bcu drug 9 0 'dug go/se chen rgyal po'i btsun

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ mo chung ba'i sras/ a rog che nyi ma nub phyogs la shes su bcug nas/ rgya bod mtshams su bzhugs/ dbus gtsang du'ang byon nas ngo log mang po mnan/ de'i sras the mur bo khas kyang gdan sa chen po'i zhabs tog dang /khrims la phan pa'i bya ba bzang po mang po byas/ de'i sras lab de yab kyi go sar bskos nas dbus gtsang du ma byon/ ma chung ba'i bu chos dpal la ri tsing dbang gi ming byin dbus gtsang du byon/ rgyal gyi rtsi ri'i gzhol du stod hor gyi dmag dpung btul/ 'bri khung sgom pa khrims la bsgral de'i bu brgyud/pad ma ta/ ri cing dbang dang / pra dzñā dbang la sogs pa ga chu na yod pa rnams yin zhing / phyi skor dbus gtsang du phebs pa'i rgyal bu hor tha'i tshe dzong thing chen po yab sras pa'ang yin no/ /hor gyi rgyal rabs mdor bsdus rim pa ni/ dang por gnam nas byon pa'i sbor ta che/ /ye su ga dur yar btab bcu dgu ni/ /hor yul rang du rgyal brgyud rim par byon/ /rgya nag rgyal sa gzung ba thog ma'i mtshan/ /jing gir rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon/ mang pho rta la sku 'khrungs pa/ /so gsum lon pa'i sa stag nas/ /rgyal srid nyer gsum mdzad la 'dud/ /hor gyi rgyal po gnyis pa ni/ /o go ta'i rgyal po ste/ /rgyal sa lo drug mdzad la 'dud/ /hor gyi rgyal po gsum pa ni/ /go yug rgyal po zhes bya ste/ /rgyal sa zla drug mdzad la 'dud/ /tor gyi rgyal po bzhi pa ni/ /mong gor rgyal po zhes bya ste/ /rgyal sa lo dgu mdzad la 'dud/ /sa skyong rgyal po lnga pa ni//se chen rgyal po shing mo phag/so bzhi lon pa'i lcags sprel nas//lo ni sum cu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /mi dab1) /la srid bskyangs la 'dud/ /tor gyi

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i nas 'byung gces bsdus/ ()rgyal po drug pa ni/ /ol ja du'i rgyal pos te/ /lo ni bcu gsum bar dag tu / / rgyal sa mdzad pa de la 'dud/ /hor gyi rgyal po bdun pa ni/ /go lug rgyal po zhes bya ste/ /rgyal sa lo lnga mdzad la 'dud/ /hor gyi rgyal po brgyad pa ni / / bu yan du'i rgyal po ste/ /a mu bar sa rta yang zer/ rgyal sa lo dgu mdzad la 'dud/ /hor gyi rgyal po dgu pa ni/ /zi ti pa la ga si khyung ga yang zer ste/go dan rgyal po zhes bya ste/ /rgyal sa lo gsum mdzad la 'dud/ /hor gyi rgyal po bcu pa ni / / me sun the mur zhes bya ste/ /rgyal srid lo lnga mdzad la 'dud/ /hor gyi rgyal po bcu gcig pa/ /ra khyi phag zhes bya ba ste/ /zhag po bzhi bcu tham pa'i bar/ /rgyal srid mdzad pa de la 'dud/ /hor gyi rgyal po bcu gnyis pa/ /ku sha la zhes bya ba ste/ /rgyal srid lo gcig mdzad la 'dud/ /hor gyi rgyal po bcu gsum pa//'ja' yan du'i rgyal po ste/ /rgyal sa lo lnga mdzad la 'dud//bcu bzhi pa ni rin chen dpal/ /rgyal sa zla gcig mdzad la 'dud/ /hor gyi rgyal po bco lnga pa/ /tho gan the mur rgyal po des/ /chu mo bya nas sa sprel lo'i/ /hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer dgu'i yan/ /rgyal srid sum cu rtsa drug bar/ /chos bzhin bskyangs pa de la 'dud/ /rgyal rabs rkyang bgrang bco lnga yis/ /dang por rgyal srid jing gir gyis/ /sa stag nas bzung tha ma'i bar/ /tho gan the mur sa sprel lo//hor yul byon pa yar bcad la//lo ni brgya dang bcu phrag lnga / / gcig dang bcas par rgyal srid bskyangs//me mo lug la byang ngos su/ /chos rje sa paṇa se chen dang / /mjal nas sa sprel mar bcad la/ /hor dang sa skya yon mchod du/ /'brel ba'i swā sbyangs brgya dang bcu/ /drug gi bar la

rgya bod jig tshang chen mo/bstan pa'i srol/ /gsal bar mdzad pa rnams la 'dud/ /sa pho spre'u yi lo la / / rgya yi rta'i mi rgyal po yis/ /rgya nag rgyal sa blangs pa nas/ /da lo shing pho stag 61 gong dkar gzhi 'dzom ya rkyen nas dbus gtsang khrug chen po lang pa'i dus srog smre brgyad dkar dbus na yod pa 'di yan la lo drug cu re bdun song 'dug go/sngon thang gi rgyal po ye hu ti zer ba'i dus/ rgyal khams kyi ming la thang zer ba 'dug de'i don rgyal khams dga' ba dang skyid pa zer ro/ /de rting g.yung rgyal po'i dus su/ rgyal khams kyi ming lha'i zer/ de'i don rgyal khams slong nus pa'i yon tan zer ro/ /de rting rgyal rabs kha yar la/ rgyal khams la ming zur pa ma btags/hor jing gir rgyal pos rgyal khams kyi ming ta dben zer bar btags/ de'i don ji lta bu yi zer ba yi ge'i nang na yod pas/khen dben zer ba'i yig 'brus yangs pa dang / chen po rgyas pa 'di yin par song na/ bden pa brtan pa'i gdan sa zer ba yin no/ /ta dben thong ji'i deb ther zer ba na'ang rgyal khams chen por khrims kyi bya ba phra rags byed tshul rnams zhib par btab yod pa'i ta dben mthong ji tho ling byus skya'u ste 'di bod skad du bsgyur na/ shākya'i bstan pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams chen po'i slob dpon zer ro/ /ko rnyeng gu shrī chang gu'i gung bod skad du spyi bor byug pa'i rtsa ba'i rdo rje slob dpon zer ro/ /dim zam lu son li pi du dben sha hu'i mi dbon lha khang mang po'i bdag po zer ba yin/ bod dbus gtsang du/thog mar tor jing gir rgyal pos rgya nag rgyal sa lon nas/ rgyal khams byings po gnan/ bu rnams la sa 9 3 byas pa'i dus dang / gzhan yang rgyal

pa tshe run 'od snang las/sa sbya'i chos 'gung ces bsdus/ (gopo na rim gyi bar la lha sde mi sde phye gsal dang / sa tshigs/ dud bgrang lugs ci rigs su byung 'dug na'ang / 'dir hor rgyal po tho gan the kur rgyal sar phebs nas/ tho zhu ta sna nu gan bya ba dang ge chag ta'i phing chang mngags nas dbus gtsang dpon chen gzhon dbang skyar ma'i dus/ mi tshigs/ dud grangs hor dud bcas pa ni 'di ltar snang ngo / khang pa ka ba drug gi khyon gcig dang / zhing hor son khal bcu gnyis kyi sa/ mi bza' mi bu tsha bran khol pho mo dang bcas pa drug phyugs sgal rmos bzhen gsum/ ra lug mgo chen gnyis rnams la mgo se nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa/ de 'dra gcig la hor dud tshang ba gcig zer bar 'dug cing / hor dud lnga bcu la rta mgo gcig de gnyis la brgya skor gcig de bcu la stong skor gcig de bcu la khri skor gcig zer zhing / khri skor lugs can tshang ma la/ lha sde stong 'khor bzhi dang / mi sde stong 'khor drag bgos pa yin 'dug khri skor bcu la klu gcig de bcu la zhing gcig dror ro/ /'di bzhin rtsis pa'i zhing bcu gcig hor se chen rgyal po'i dus mnga' 'og tu bcug pa yin 'dug cing / zhing gi ming ni ta'i tu mkhar nang na cong zhing / spyi so na ho nam zhing / zhing zi zhing /gam zu'i zhing / si chon zhing / yu nam zhing / rgyang si zhing / byang ca'i zhing /gu rum zhing / le'o yang zhing / bod chol kha gsum gyis zhing gcig ma longs na yang bla ma'i bzhugs gnas dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i sa phyogs yin pas zhing gcig tu bgrangs pas bcu gcig yin zer ro/ /las gnas bkod pa'i rim pa ni/ bcu |rdzun/ lnga bcu dpon/ brgya dpon/ stong

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ dpon/ khri dpon/ klu'i dar ra kha che/ klu gsum la dbang na/ klu gun min dben hu zhes pa'i ming dang / shel gyi tham kha ster ba yin par 'dug bod du dpon chen shākya bzang po la gnang 'dug gzhan dpon chen phal che ba la dhing zam lu son li si du dben ba hu zer ba'i ming dang / dngul tham gling drag ma stag mgo dang bcas pa ster bar 'dug dpon chen zhes pa ni/ bla the'i nye gnas la bod kyis che ming btags par 'dug cing / chol kha zhes pa ni hor rgyal pos bla ma la dbang yon du phul ba'i mdo stod smad/ dbus gtsang dang bcas pa la ming btags par 'dug rgya hor gyi yul na/ zhing dang /khri stong la sogs ma gtogs chol kha'i ming gi brjod bya med zer ro/ /zhing du longs nas zhing gi mi dpon chen po zer/ rgyal brgyud/ bu dang mag pa la bskos pa yin 'dug cing / dbang gi ming dang gser gyi tham kha/gser sgor/ dngul sgor ster bar 'dug de'ang bu che chung 'bring gsum la dbes shi'i dbang gi ming rab 'bring dang / las tshan mang nyung rim pa gsum du bskos pa yin gsungs 'dug rgyal khams chen po 'jags dgos pa'i don la / rgyal po yab sras la'ang ngo bsrung med pa'i snyan bskul zhu ba dang / rgyal brgyud mi dpon rnams kyis gsug pa ba thos pa dang / bya ba nor ba byas na 'chos pa dang / skyon 'dzin pa'i khrims ra tha'i sa gsum yod pa'i ku'i tha'i khrims ra ta'i tu na yod/ si tha'i zhim chang hu na yod/ gnam tha'i hang byi'u na yod do/ /tha'i sa gsum gyi 'og na gleg hang si nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod/ sa chen lang / son ha/ bzhin ming / tsa spya sa ho/ de rnams khrims kyi 'gag bzhi
