ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//yin/ de bzhi'i skor la khrims ra drug bzhi nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa'o/ /mi chen hor gyi rgyal rabs 'di bris pa'i/ /dge chen rnam dkar 'bras bu de'i mthus/ /sa chen 'di la gnas pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /bde chen thar pa'i gling du myur bsgrod shog /hor se chen rgyal po'i rang lung gis/ mi chen das sman la bka' bstsal pa/ das sman khyod nyon cig bod 'di mi thu mo yin par 'dugasngon bod rgyal po yod pa'i dus thang tha'i dzung rgyal po'i ring la ri bo rtse lnga bar bod dmag mang po yong / hu ding hu'i sar bka' ma log zer ba'i dmag tshan chen sdod pa byas 'dug da lta bod la rgyal po med/ jing gir rgyal po'i sku bsod las/ rgyal khams chen po dbang du bsdus/ sa skya bla ma'ang rang re'i bla mchod du khug pa 'di yin/ bla ma 'phags pa khu dbon 'di pa yul gzhan gyi rgyal po yin na/ khong shes rab che bas rang res mi thub/ da lta rang re'i 'og na chud pa 'di yin/ das sman khyod spyod pa bzang po yod pas/sa skya par thengs gcig songs shig bod byings po se chen go pe la'i 'og tu chud na mi chen das sman yang sa skya na sleb yod par 'dug zer ba'i gtam snyan po thos pa yin gsungs/ das sman gyis zhus pa/ rgyal po khyod kyi lung bzhin 'gro bar bya/ de ltar na'ang bod bya ba/ mi thu mor 'dug pa dang khong rang gi rgyal khrims kyang zhig rgya hor gyi khrims ji bzhin ma 'jags/ so kha rnams kyang ma tshugs par yod 'dug pas yar phyin gyi mthun rkyen spyor ba dang / bya ba chen po grub pa ji ltar yong min zer/ yang rgyal po'i lung gis/rang la bod byings po 'og tu chug 9 6 par 'dug zer ba'i gtam snyan thob

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/pa des chog chas kha/ cha rkyen gang dgos ma thung ba gan pas bskur/ sa skya man la 'ja' mo che chung du 'os/ sa 'jam rtsub/ mi sde dar rgyad/ rgya 'ja' la dpe byas te tshugs the/ga bla ma 'phags pa yar phebs dus/ byon lam bde dgos pa yin/ yang don gcig la khyod san jing dben du bkod pa la bod kyi gnas lugs rnams zhib par go na/ gan pa'i bya ba chen po byed pa dang / mi mang po la phan pa yin pas song shog gsungs nas/ bla ma'i bka' shog dang rgyal po'i 'ja' sa dgos pa rnams gnang / das sman 'khor mang po dang bcas pa yar phyir gyis chas/ bod kyi ban skya rgan mgo drag rigs spyi sgos la gnang sbyin gyi char rkyen bzang po dang bcas pa/ gan mdzod che chung nas bskur te yar yong / thog mar bod du bstan pa phyi dar gyi chos 'byung sa yin pas/ mdo smad kyi sa dan tig shel gyi lha khang dang / mdo stod gtso mdo bsam grub/ gtsang dpal ldan sa skya rnams su rim par mi mang po bsags la gang 'os kyi gnang sbyin sprad/ bka' lung rnams bsgrags shing rgya bod kyi so mtshams nas sa skya man la/ 'ja' chen kun dril nyi shu rtsa bdun gtsugs/ so sor phye na/ mdo smad pa 'ja' pas/ 'ja' mo bdun/mdo stod la 'ja' mo dgu/ dbus gtsang la 'ja' mo bcu gcig de'i nang nas kyang dbus pas mja' mo 'dzin dgos pa la/sogashag rtsi bar/sha pho/rkang /dgon gsar/ byam gya ba dang bdun/ gtsang pas 'dzin dgos pa la/stag tshong 'dus/ dar lung / grom pa sa skya rang dang bzhi btsugs/ so so'i khri skor rnams kyis 'ja' skyor 'ad sna'i bkod pa byas/ bod byings po

ba chen 'od snang la /ga skya'i chos 'gu pa gces bsdus/ (//la rgyal po yon mchod kyi bka' lung 'phrod/ sa skya 'khor bod spyi sgos kyi gnas lugs thams cad khong du chud nas/ rgyal po'i drung du slebs/ rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas go chod 'dug gsungs/ gsol ras dang gnang sbyin bzang po byin/ san bying dben gyi khrims dar rtsa ba'i dpon chen la bskos/bod kyi 'ja' mo rnams gsar btsug yin pas/ 'jag par byed pa'i mi gcig dgos par yod zhus pas/ mi chen i ji lag zer ba la/ bod 'ja' shes pa'i 'ja' sa dang / thong ji'i las ka byin nas yar la btang / de nasabazung ste hor sa skya pa mchod yon du ji tsam 'brel gyi bar la bod 'ja' nyi shu rtsa bdun po bde mor 'jags pas/ bla ma dpon chen/ hor bod kyi gser yig pa rnams 'byon lam bde zhing / bod 'bangs byings po skyid por byung skad/ 'di ni se chen rgyal pos/ sa skyar gser yig pa mngags pa'i sngon ma yin zhing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / sa skya pa la shin tu dad pa'i mi dpon bzang po gcig byung 'dug pas/ rnam thar zur tsam bris pa yin/ thong ji li ji lags kyis bod 'ja' thog tu ma sleb gong du hor rgyal pos/ 'jang yul la dmag thog byon dus/ mdo smad kyi 'ja' mo gnyis/ rgya 'ja' kyi zhor la mar bsdus pa'i rim shugs rgyab pas mdo stod ga re go pe'i 'ja' mo gnyis dbus gtsang pa la drin che bar byung gda'o/ /hor se chen rgyal po'i dus/ bod khams chen po la mi rtsis dud grangs byung ba'i dus/ mdo smad nas yar rtsis par 'dug pas ga chu rab kha na nang so la gtogs pa'i gzhis dang /rgyang gi rtsa dang /bla ba /sdur dang / de'i 'og na de ma khang gzhis

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ bya ba yod pa/ de rnams bla ma 'phags pa la sa phud dang lung gis phul nas/gan 'ja' la sogs/ rgya bod kyi khral dud gang yang mi 'khri ba gtsang mar yod pa la hor son lnga brgya'i sa yin zer bar 'dug /hor dang sa skya pa yon mchod du 'brel nas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pas rgya nag ta tu'i pho brang du thengs gsum byon/ gong ma se chen rgyal po yab yum sras bcas la sa skya pa'i khyad chos/ rgyud gsum gyi dbang mo che thengs gsum bskur ba'i dbang yon dang po la dbus gtsang gi khri skor bcu gsum phul ba ni / mnga' ris rdzong kha'i 'og gi blo da lo rdzong gsum khri skor gcig la stod lho byang / chu zhal rnams re rer grangs pas khri skor bzhi/ sbra ber khyung gsum khri skor gcig yar 'brog chal pa khri skor gnyis/ rgya 'bri/ g.ya' phag khri skor bzhi/ zur nas bsdus pa'i gcig byung ba/ /bya yul hor dud stong phrag gcig /'brug pa hor dud dgu brgyar byed/ /stong dang dgu brgya phyed khyer du/khri skor gcig gi bya ba bsgrub/ /de rnams dril bas bcu gsum tshang / /dbang yon bar ma la/ chol kha gsum phul ba'i/ bya yul mnga' ris gung thang man/ sog la skya bo yan dam pa chos kyi chol kha/ sog la skya bo man me chu gug pa yan mgo nag mi'i chol kha/ me chu khug pa man nas rgya'i mchod rten dkar po yan dud 'gro rta'i chol kha dang gsum po de/ mi rta chos gsum gyi 'bul ba'i lugs su byas nas phul bar 'dug cing / chol kha re re la dpon chen re re/ rgyal po yon mchod bka' gros su bstun nas bskos pa mdzad 'dug dbang yon rting ma la bla ma'i 9 9 bzhin rgya'i yur ma chen mo phul

'tshe na 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (nanas rgya mi khri phrag mang po srog thar du bcug 'dug de dus bla ma 'phags pas bsngo ba smon lam 'di ltar mdzad do/ /nam mkha'i khams ni khrag gi mdog ltar dmar/ /rkang leb ro yi phyi'i rgya mtsho khengs/ /'di 'dra bcad pa'i dge ba gang de yis/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug thugs dgongs rdzogasaphyir dang / /phan bde'i bstan pa rab tu rgyas phyir dang / /mi dbang sku tshe shin tu brtan phyir bsngo/ /zhes gsungs shing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba sems can gyi don la phan pa rgya chen po mdzad par gda'o/ /gong ma se chen rgyal po dang bla ma 'phags pa yon mchod gnyis thugs bsod 'bel gtam gleng ba'i skabs su/ rgyal pos/ bla ma la/ dang por/ jing gir rgyalapos rgyal khams chen po bsdus pa'i dus dang / nged kyi rgyal khams 'chos pa dang 'jags su 'jug pa'i dus su yang / gshe mong legs par 'dabasapas hor gyi dmag mi rnams la da lta zas nor gyi gshe mong zhan pas/ gshe mong mnon pa'i thabs dang chos phyogs ji ltar byas na 'thad gsungs pas/bla ma'i zhal tas/ khyed rang la yod pa'i mdzod kyi cha rkyen dang / dmag mi dang res pa'i grangs long pas lo 'ga'i bar la gzhi bcas kyi lto gos 'tsho ba'i gnang sbyin byed par 'ong gsungs pa byung nas de bzhin byas pas/dmag mi la/ rtsa ba'i hor dmag khri tsho lnga bcu dang / res pa yang tshan che bar byung pa la gnang sbyin byed pa'i cha rkyen ma 'dang par byung bas/ yang rgyal po'i gsung nas/ da lta/ cha rkyen gyis ma btsogs pas/ hor yul gyi lho phyogs na/ sman tshe zhes bya ba'i rgyal po dang / de'i //sdu 'og mi sde phyug po yod par 'dug de

rgya bod mig tshang chen smo/rang re'i dmag gis blangs na bu rta'i gshe mong bcos na e 'thad gsungs pas/ bla ma'i gsungs nas/ da lta khyed la don 'di bsgrub pa'i mi mi snang bas/ ma rings/ nged kyis brtag pa byed gsungs/ de'i phyi lo/ rgyal po'i gcung po/ e chen hu li dus gong ma la 'dab nor dang lo gsar skyel ba la/khong gi mi dpon ra yan zer bas mgo byas/ 'u lag lnga brgya tsam dang bcas yong ba'i lam du/ u lug non yon bya ba bya ri dwags la yong / nam la byed pa dang 'phrad/ shes rab che ba/ gzugs bzang ba'i mi dpon de nyid/ rta thog tu dri ba gtam lab byas pas/ gcig la gcig mgu ba yin/ rgyal po dang mjal 'phrad byas rting / rgyal brgyud mi dpon rnams kyi rtsar hor yul nas u lug zer ba'i mi dpon bzang po gcig 'dug de rgyal po'i rtsa ru sdod 'os pa gcig 'dug byas lab pa'i gtam gong mas gsan nas u lug 'bod mkhan btang / thugs la btags nas nang blon chen por gyur to/ /'dis kyang ba yan ching sang la phan btags pa'i gtam rting la yong de nas ba yan ta'i tur slebs nas/ rgyal po mjal 'phrad byed pa'i dus su/pho brang du ston mo chen po byed pa la/ bla ma dam pa ring gdan drangs/ ba yan mjal ba'i spyod pa dang 'gro lugs/ zhu ba'i gtam brjod mkhas pa/ yon tan che bar 'dug pas bla mas mkhyen nas/ rgyal po la mi bzang po la mi bzang po 'khor bar 'dug gsungs pas/ rgyal pos dgongs nas/ ba yan gyi tshab tu/ gong ma'i res dpon gcig dang / gser yig pa byings po de la gnang sbyin bzang po byas/ lo la/ /skur nas btang ba yan sdod gsungs

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (shenas bsdad yod pa'i skabs/ khong ba yan dang u lug gnyis gcig lasagacig bzang ba'i blon po gnyis yod pa'i dus der/ yang rgyal pos/ bla ma la da ba yan 'di sman tshe'i phyogs su btang na gsungs pas/ des pher bar 'dug nged kyi don grub pa'i thabs dang / rten 'brel byed gsungs nas/bal po e rner dga' sprul pa'i la bzo lta bu la zhal ta mdzad/ 'ju chur lha khang dang chos skyong ma hā kwa la'i sku 'khor dang bcas pa bzhengs/ rab gnas bla ma rang gis mdzad/ mgon po'i zhal sman che'i phyogs la gzigasapar mdzad/ slob dpon dam pa kun dga' chos stong der sgrub pa mdzad pa la bskos/ ba yan la ching sang gi ming dang tham kha byin nas/ khong gi grogs la rgya'i rigs kyi byang bi thang jung phing chang zer ba'i mkhas pa gcig kyang btang zhing / ching sang gis 'go byas/ hor dmag byings po brdzangs nas/sman tshe'i rgyal khams long la shog gsungs nas lung byung dus/ ba yan ching sang gis nged sman tsher slebs nas/ dmag dpon che'i bya ba 'dra mi 'dra the tshom byung dus zhu ba btong dgos te/ nged kyi gser yig pa gong ma'i drung du 'gro ba dang / de skug pa'i bar du dmag gi 'gro 'dug ji ltar byed zhus pas/khyod bden par 'dug nga'i lung yin gyis la khyod rang gis thag chod bya ba rnams 'grim du chug gsungs pa'i lung thob nas phyin pas/ ching sang dmag legs nas sman tshe rgyal po'i pho brang yang thob/rgyal khams blang nas/thad ka thad gar mi dpon bsko bzhag byas/ sman tshe rgyal po'i mu tig gi gos gcigang dmag rgyal ba'i rtags byed zer /sdu ching sang gis bzung / gzhan cha rkyen

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ byings po rgyal po la 'dab tu btang ba'i dus su/ sman tshe'i sa phyogs rgyus yod pa'i mi 'ga' res mkhar mig gi sa cha mi sde bzang sar las ka zhus 'ja' sa khyer song ba/ ba yan gyis 'grim du ma bcug cha gcig par dang por lung thob yod pa dang / mi dpon bkod tshar ba rnams brtan du ma bcug na/ mi sde khrums zhig gis dogs pa byas nas bya ba 'jags rting /rgyal po'i drung du yong nas mjal ba'i tshe ching sang res dang 'dzoms pas mjal phrad grub ma thag khong rang gi khang par ma yong par res khang du sdad pa'i bar la rgyal pos kho la nga rgyal chen po yod dogs pa gcig byung nas/zu gur che gcig ba yan gyi rtsar btang nas/ khyod ba yan tshan pa'i mi yin pa/gan pa la sras ming dang las ka chen po byin nas btang ba yin/ sman tshe'i rgyal khams lon pa la brtson 'grus bya ba phing chang gis byas/ ming khyod kyis blangs nas/ nga rgyal ma byed gsungs pa gcig bskur nas btang / zu gur che song rting rgyal po la nga'i don la rgyal po'i thugs bde bar mdzod/ 'tsham pa'i mi tshan pa la bzhag na 'tsham par 'gro/ ming dang las ka byin pa 'bebs na rgyal po'i rang dbang yin/ sman tshe'i rgyal khams len pa la brtson 'grus bya ba phing chang gis byas nas ming ba yan gyis blangs gsungs te/de'i rgyu mtshan sman tshe rnams kyis lab te 'ong rgyal po khyed la don grub pas mi chog gam/ zhus nas btang ba dang / gtam 'di rgyal po la zhus pasanga'i gtam de mgyogs drags/ khos 'di zer du byung dogs gsungs so/ /de rting rgyal pos sman rtser 'ja' sa byin ༵spyang ba'i mi ching sang gis 'grim du ma

'tshe run 'od snang la /sa sbya'i chos 'byung gtses bsdus/ (gobacug pa de rnams kyis ba yan gyis sman tshe rgyal po'i char rkyen la rang nor byas/ gan mdzod la ma gdab/ 'ja' sa sa bkod pa'i mi 'grim du ma bcug par/ kho rang gi mi rnams las ka la bkod zer nas rtug bsher byung pa la/ba yan rang la dris gsungs/ ba yan bzung nas phyi rol na bzhag yod pa'i dus su/ u lug no yon phyir song nas/ nang du byung rgyal po'i drung du 'gro ba/ching sang gis mthong nas/ u lug yun ta khyod kyi ma go ba ci yod byas pas/ngas go yod zer nas/ gong ma la ba yan ching sang la mi ngan pas gtug gsher byas/ khong bzung nas gyam bcos 'dug ba yan mi gcig rang res gsod kyang sla/ rtswa gcig gcod pa dang khyad ci yod de sman tshe'i rgyal khams pa rnams kyis rgyal po khyed la 'phya smod mi yong bam zhus pas/ de bden/ kho thongs gsungs nas las ka phab/ rang gi khang par bsdad yod pa'i dus/ re zhig na ba yan gyis dmag po ches hor yul la brdeg par 'dug zer ba'i 'ur chen po byung nas/ blon po rnams skrag ste rgyal po la ci drag zhus pas/khyed rnams gros gyis gsungs pa la/ khong rnams kyis gros bya rgyu ma rnyed pas/rgyal po la bskyar nas zhus pas/ khyed rnams kyis bya thabs ma rnyed na/thabs kyis ba yan la gros dris gsungs nas/ phyin pas ching sang na re/ nga go ma chod par las ka phab nas sdad pa'i mis ci shes/ khyed rang rnams shes mod zer ba byung nas/ de bzhin rgyal po la zhus pas/ gong ma rang gi rtsar ba yan bos nas gros dris pas/ rang re'i hor dmag rnams kyi steng du mi bzang po bskos te/ dmag gisa~X na thub yod mod zhus pas/ ba yan

rgya bod yig tshang ma mo/ ching sang 'gro dgos gsungs/dmag dpon la bskos nas btang /khong 'gro ba'i skyel thung gi sar rgyal pos ba yan ching sang ci zer lta ba'i skad nyan pa btang bas/ ching sang rta bzhon nas 'gro khar/ sdod pa'i blon po skyel thung pa rnams la khyed mi mngags pa'ang 'di 'dra ba'i mi mngags pa ang zer ba/thengs gsum lab nas song zer ba thos nas rgyal po la zhus pas gtam de ma bzang / ba yan la log shog gyis gsungs/ mi btang zim dem 'ja' mor slebs pa phyir bos nas/ sang snga mor slebs pa dang / rgyal pos ba yan khyod kyis kha sang je gon thing nas rta bzhon 'gro khar/ ci lab gsungs pas cang ma smras zer/ rgyal po rang gis/ khyed mi 'di 'dra ba mngags pa 'dug ang / zer ba lab 'dug pa/ khyod kyis smras pa min nam gsungs pas/ de bden zer/ ci'i don la byas pas/ ching sang gis zhus pa ngas sman tshe'i rgyal khams blangs nas rgyal po khyed la gtad pa de/ nyi ma shar nas nub kyi bar rgyal khams pa rnams kyis shes pa yin/ de'i rting nga la nyes pa med pa dmangs su phab nas bzhag pa de'ang nyi ma shar nas nub kyi bar du thos yod/'di lta bu'i skyon gyi mi btong ba/ byang phyogs hor gyi yul na rgyal po khyed kyi brgyud pa/ mi che la mang ba rnams yod/ nga skyon phog pa'i mi khong tsho'i steng du bskos nas btang tsa na khong rnams kyang rgyal po la yid chad byed/ dmag po che'i bya ba ci 'dra yong ngam bsam nas lab pa yin zhus pas/ rgyal po na re/khyod bden ba yan las bden pa med/ da lta rang 'ja' sa bris ba yan gyis sman tshe'i rgyal khams blangs pa dang 2/0/she mong 'dabs pa rnams 'ja' sa'i

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (ri)stod du bris/ mi ngan pas rdzun zhus byas pa bar der bris/ ba yan bden pa yin pas ming dang shed mong mnan pa rnams gting la bris la/ rgyal brgyud bu mo/ mag pa/ dmag dpon/ dmag mi/ mi dpon/ mi sde rnams kyis ba yan ching sang 'grim chug gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas ba yan gyis dmag dpung thul/ hor yul rgyal khams bde bar byas nas tshur 'khor ba dang /rgyal pos kyang / ba yan la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i thugs 'dogs bzang po mdzad/ rgyal brgyud blon po'i tshogs rnams kyis kyang legs par bkur ba'i blon po rin po che yin par 'dug gal ching la snga ba'i 'ja' sa 'di yin zer ro/ /bla ma 'phags pa la/ rgyal pos chos zhu ba lta ci smos 'jig rten gyi bya ba chen po rnams kyang bka' gros byed pa'i gtan tshigs gcig 'di yin cing / bla mas kyang / chos dang mthun par 'jig rten gyi bya ba legs pa rnams kyang rgyal po la ston pa yin zer/ sman tshe'i rgyal pos mgo byas ngo lta ba rnams yong pa'i dus su/ ju chu'i mgon khang bstan pas rang re'i yul du dmag sna la byung ba'i mi nag po 'khor dang bcas pa de tsho'ang 'di na 'dug pa zer lo//yon mchod gnyis kyi bka' bgros kyis ba yan ching sang sman tsher btang nas rgyal khams blangs pa'i don la 'gro mgon 'phags pas/ rgyal po la/khyed rang lus ma skyong bar/ sman tshe'i rgyal rabs mang po'i bar du khong rang la 'jags zin gyi rgyal khams rang res lon pas 'dzam gling gcig tu 'dres 'drar gyur/ khyed rang 'khor los sgyur rgyal dag dang mtshungs/ ces pa'i bstod pa mdzad pa'ang 'dug mdo/ sdu/ 'gro mgon chos kyi rgyal pos/ go

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ pe la chos kyi rgyal por byin gyis brlabs nas hor dang / rgya nag po'i 'byor pa chen pos sa skyas mgo byas bod yul 'dir bstan pa'i mthil yong ba yon mchod 'di gnyis kyi bka' drin yin pa gda'/ yi ge 'di'i ngo po cong zhu zhing gi khrims ra na bca' tshe blangs 'dug pa/ de'i ngo bzhus sbag po ching sang gis dpon chen dbang phyug brtson 'grus bdag la byin nas/ yu gur gyi yi ge ngo bo ta'i dben thong ji deb ther hor yig ma dang lhan du yod pa/ yar lung pas khyer 'dug na'ang don 'di rnams blo la yod pas skabs don bris pa yin/ yang bsod nams can se chen rgyal po'i dus su/ mi chen sang gha bya ba de brgyud pa/ bka' ma log yin pa'i mi gzhon gcig hor skad/ rgya skad/yu gur skad/ bod skad la sogs skad rigs sna tshogs shes pa'i lo tsā ba zhig dang por bla ma 'phags pa'i drung du mdo smad rgya bod kyi mtshams su mjal nas/ gshe mong 'dab pa/ ja zhu byas pas lo tsā ba la bcug zu gur che ba byed kyin yod pa'i dus su khong shes rab che/ skad rigs mkhas pa'i don la/ bla ma mnyes nas rgyal po'i drung du yang yang mngags pas/ gong mas kyang shes rab dang yon tan la dgongs nas/ bla ma las blang / las ka rim par bskos pas go chod po byung / son jing dben gyi mi dpon bskos pa'i dus su/ khong gis me tog ra ba'i bde chen gyi rtsar/ bla ma la chos zhus pa'i sgos kyi mtshams khang gcig byas pa la/ tha'i sa sa skyon bzung nas gha btson du khyer ba'i skabs su/ ka le hu na sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sku bzhugs pa spyan drangs nas/ 15ma bu'i gling gi rol mo dang / ltad mo

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//yod pa la rgyal po'ang byon nas skor ba dang / gzigs mo mdzad pa'i sar bla ma gdan 'dren du btang bas/ bla ma'i gsung nas/ nged kyi bod yul na bu btson du khyer ba'i pha de/ srang la 'gro ba la'ang ngo tsha byed/ nga'i saṃ gha nga la chos zhu ba la dmigs pa'i khang chung zhig byas pa la/ tha'i sa sa skyon bzung nas btson du khyer 'dug nga mi yong gsungs nas/ gong ma la zhus pas/ bla ma'i gzim khang la dmigs pa yin na/ kho la skyon ma bzung bar mthong / bla ma la ltad mo la byon par gyis gsungs pa'i lung byung bas/ saṃ gha nyes pa las grol yon mchod zhal 'dzoms/ slar yang / /gha/ son jing dben du bskos yod pa'i skabs su bla ma sa skyar byon/ dpon chen kun dga' bzang pos dam nyams byas pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis/ gong du zhu ba btang bas/ sa skya pa dang sgos su 'brel che bas zhabs tog 'grub par dgongs nas/ mi chen saṃ ghas mgo byas khri dmag stobs che ba 'grim gsungs pa'i lung byung bas/saṃ lhas bod dbus gtsang sa rong dog dmag po che shong sa med/ rtsa ba'i hor dmag khri tsho bdun gyi steng du mdo stod smad dang bcas pas dmag 'bum phrag gcig lhag yod/ des 'chun pas de bzhin gyis bka' gnang dgosazhus pas de ltar yin chug gsungs par byung nas/ khri dmag bteg 'u yug me tog lung du slebs pa dang / sa khad yangs pas lha shangs nang la dmag lam byed rtsis yod pa/ cha li grong na bla ma 'phags pa'i gsol ja ba mi chen saṃ gha dang grogs mched/ slob dpon blo gros bzang po bya ba yod pa des/dmag snar du ja zhal la byon/ ma sdu ci zhu 'bul byas pas/ dmag lam

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/lang 'gro nang la skyog thub/ hor dmag gi kha 'bebs/ thum 'jug la/snga song lang 'gro khang dmar gyi sa mkhar phabs pas blangs/ de rting dpa' rnams bya rog tshang gi mkhar la skyogs skor rgyag drag po byas nas kun dga' bzang po khrims la bsgral/ dmag po che'i bya ba mthar phyin par byas/ bla ma dang dgon pa phra mo la mos pa dang / dad gus che ba'i stobs kyis sa skyar byon/ lcog chung brang khang shar 'di khong gis bzhengs nas/ sgo'i g.yang tshe yang rgya lugs su yod cing / bla ma'i drung du phyis kyang yong ba'i dgongs pa mdzad par gda'/ de rting khrims dmag byings po phyir log spo 'bor sgang nas nyi ma mgon dang / dar dges mgo byas/ dmag rag btus brgya dang drug cu/ slob dpon dharma pha la'i sku bsrung la bzhag hor dmag stong skor bdun gyi nang nas bdun brgya/ stod hor gyi so kha bsrung mi la bzhag gnam dgon sar du u dmar chag gis mgo byas/ hor dmag grangs can bzhi brgya bzhag rdo thas mgo byas sba rag gi dmag se ri rong la bzhag yus phur gyi dmag lcags rtse bri khu dang / yar 'brog tu dung reng gi kha gnon la bzhag hor ban thu man gyi dmag gdan sa spyi'i zhabs tog la 'dam/ na mar/na rong la sogs byang gi rtsa kha la bzhag pa'ang /saṃ gha de drin che/de man la byang kha'i 'ja' mo/ srog shag rtsi bar/ sha pho/ kong / dgon sar/ gya ba rnams kyi 'ja' chen bod dbus gtsang khri skor rnams kyis 'dzin mkhan lo khor mar sdod dgos pa'i dka' tshegs/ sbyong spyod shin tu che ba gcig yod par 'dug cing / bod mi rnams /sdu byang ma thub par yang yang bros nas/

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//'jams grang so ma zin pas/ hor bod kyi gser yig 'grul pa la'ang sa rim o ger kha'i 'u lag rang rang la bab pa'i don la thams cad kyis zhu ba bzhin/ mi chen saṃ gha ud phur dang sba rag la sogs kyi dmag mi byang khar yod pa rnams/ 'ja' mo'i zab bri 'then pa la tha dad du bzhag nas/ dbusapa khri skor rnams kyis/ dud rta mgo'i steng nas rta khal pa/ bzhon ma/ bshas lug 'jams brgyags kyi nas/ phya ther/ sbra/ sga/ gdan/ khal zhags/thab cha/ gdan chas/ sman rin/ dud mi dang bcas pa hor la ster ba'i khrims bcas nas/ dbus pa/ byang du sdod mi dgos pa hor dmag rnams la/bod rdzas kyi 'jams skyor 'di rnams lo lo bzhin yong ba 'grul pa rnams la 'ja' mo 'u lag stongs pa byung ba kun la phan pa 'di'ang saṃ gha'i drin/khong gis bod 'khor nas/ cong zhu zhing gi ching sang la bskos pa'i skabs su/sngar mkhar ba'i dor tshe 'grim pa/ cha 'or gyur pas gan pa'i zhabs tog dang rgyal khams la phan pa byung bas gtam snyan thob/ dang po mi dpon rnams kyis gsug pa za ba'i don la mi dpon nyes pa phog pa'ang mang po byung /khrims kyang yangs por song / saṃ gha ching sang gis sngon rgya nag po'i dus kyi srol rnying pa gcig btsal nas/ phyi dang nang gi khrims ra che chung gi mi dpon rnams la bza' btung dang / gyon rgyu'i shun rtsen/ bu mad la sogs pa la'ang za 'bras dmar po dang bcas pa byin nas/ gsug pa mi za ba'i khrims bcas pas khrims dam por song / mi sde yang skyid/ da lta'i bar du mi dpon rnams la/ hun rtsen 2 /'ang saṃ gha ching sang gi drin dran par

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ byed/ gzhan yang bstan pa dang bod du phan pa'i 'ja' sa dang / 'bul ba bstong ba la sogs pa la'ang khong gis bla ma'i zhabs tog la bsam nas zhus pas/ phan pa mang por byung gda'o/ /yang don gcig la/ saṃ gha ching sang shes rab che/ longs spyod ldan pas/ hor mang po'i mig tu ma shom par/ khong gis gan pa'i cha rkyen ma phangs byas nas/ res pa la gshe mong la mnan zer ba'i don la ching sang gi cha rkyen gsug pa blangs zer ba'i skad byas nas/gong ma phyir byon pa'i lam du/ res pa rnams kyis zhus gtug bsher byas pas/lung gis res pa'i gshe mong ji ltar 'chos/ nges shes med saṃ gha la don ci yod/ gsug pa zos nas/ gzhan gyis gtug mod/ kho la cha rkyen 'dug zer nas nyes pa tshol ba ga na nyan gsungs nas zhu ba ma bzhes kyang / res dpon rnams kyis res pa rnams bskur nas bskyar gin zhus pas/ de dgongs nas gnon thabs mdzad/ saṃ gha la snga lug dang khyed gnyis 'phrod pa gyis gsungs pa byung nas/ saṃ ghas snga kyi lug dgung gral la bzhag ston mo bzang po byin nas/ saṃ gha rang gis/ zhwa/ gos/ ske rags phul/ an ta byed byas pas/ zhwa/ gos/ smre rags khyad par mi 'dod/ ston mo rgyal pos gsol ras yin pas zos yod zer/ zhus skad de rting yang / res pa rnams kyis res dpon rnams dang u lug no yon bskul nas/ saṃ gha la sngar bzhin skyon bzung ste/ zhus pa'i mthar/ kho'i cha rkyen la snyad nas nyes pa len du gar nyan/ rgyal khams kyi cha rkyen rnams nga'i min/ de yin na nga rang gis dri ba byed gsungs nas/ saṃ gha la sngar /sdu che phangs byed pa'i don du/ rgyal po

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ rtonarang gi mkhyen pa'i nyes pa gsang zin rnams phyis rdol ba la/ saṃ gha khyod shang rdo nas ta'i tur mngags dus 'ur rdo 'grim pa'i lam du shing sdong po'i rtsa ba nged bsil grib la sdod pa'i khri thog tu khyod kyi sdad pa dang / ta'i tu nas nged la bskur ba'i sa thog gi sgam nyu la shig nas/ zas phud khyod kyi zos pa'i nyes pa med dam/ yang nged lus rdul che bas gos dri ma can bkrusate bskyar nas btsem dus/ dog mor 'gro yin 'dug pas/ de'i don la rgya mi thag mkhan gyis gos srubs med pa btags nas ston pa gnyis yod pa khyod la gsum 'dug zer/ nga las lhag pa byed pa khyod kyis nyes pa min nam gsungs te/ dri ba gsum po mdzad rting la/ deng sang rgyal khams kyi bya ba pher ba'i mi ji 'dra yod gsungs pa'i/ mi gcig gda' gzhan mi 'dug zhus pa dang / gcig su yin gsungs/ ching sang kho rang gi sna la 'dzub mo gtsugs byung de pho nya la bskur nas btang bas/ rjes na phar ching sang ci zer ltar mi btang bas/ khong sgrol ba'i sar sleb tsa na khyed rnams kyis mtshon rno ba dang / lag yang ba myur ba'i thabs kyis byas yod 'dug pa la sgrol mkhan gyis/ khyod kyi bzlas pa'i khar mi 'gro/ ji ltar byed nged kyi shes pa yin mod zer ba zhus pas/ rgyal po na re ngas saṃ gha 'gro khar sems sdug tu bcug 'dug mi ngan de rnams la dbyug pa brgya dang bdun re rgyob gsungasapa'i lung byung zer/ dus de tsa na bla ma 'phags pa bzhugs na thugs rje la brten nas tshe thar 'gro zer ba gleng bar gda'/ 'di 'das kyang phyag rjes can gyi/blon po bzang po yin par /steg pas gnas lugs bris pa yin no//

rgya bod yig tshang 'a mo/ su sti/ dang po mang pos bkur ba yis/ /sa zhag 'bras la longs spyad cing / /de nas rgyal rabs drug pa na/ /gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas la/brten nas mi dbang rgyal po yis/ /dge bcu'i khrims kyis longs spyod kyi/ /'gro 'di dga' ston ci yang 'gyed/ /mi dbang rgyal po de bsad nas/ /rgyal rabs sa ya phrag gcig dang / khri phrag bdun pa bzung rjes la/ /gdul bya'i dus la sleb pa dang / /rtsod pa'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ /zas gtsang rgyal po'i sras dag tu/ khi1kya thub pa 'khrungs gyur nas/ /lha bcas 'jig rten 'dun pa gsal/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi ma shar/ /de nas lo grangs sum stong dang / /nyis brgya dgu bcu song ba na/ /byang phyogs hor gyi sa'i char bsod nams chen po'i chu gter las/ /rgyal po jing gir gan zhes pa/ /sa 'dzin rin chen 'khrungs par 'gyur/ /mi dbang de nas rgyal rabs lngar/ /stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur mdzad pa/ /se chen gan zhes grags pa des/ /'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul sa skya pa/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa spyan drangs nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas mdzad/ /bla ma de'i phrin las kyis/ /bod khams gangs ris bskor 'di la/ /rgyal po'i mdzod du 'dab nor dang /khral dmag las gsum len pa med/ /chos dang 'jig rten byon pa la/ kha ba can du brtse ba'i mthus/ /mi dbang rgyal po'i pho brang nas/ /bla ma'i gdan sasaskya'i bar/ /ma dros pa nas chu bo bzhi/ /rgya mtsho chen por 'jug pa ltar/ /yon mchod gnyis kyi gser lam na//grong dang grong khyer yul ljongs kyis/ /yongs su gang ba'i skye rgu kun/ /rgya~X zlos bla ma la gus par/ /sgo gsum

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//bkur sti byed pa'i tshul/ /thams cad brjod pa su yis lang / /de'i nang nas dbus dang gtsang / /mnga' ris skor gsum dang bcas pa'i/ /yul khamasagatan la dbab pa dang / /stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur byed pa/ /rgyal po'i bla ma'i gdan sa mchog /dpal ldan sa skya'i mnga' 'og na/ khris skor chen po mang po yis/ /rgyal chen zhabs tog bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bla ma rgyal posagadan drangs nas/ /bcu phrag lo ni song ba'i dus/ /sa pho 'brug lo shar ba na / / gong nas mngags pa'i gser yig pa/ /a kon mi gling gnyis yong nas/ /mi sde sa cha dang bcas pa/ /chen po hor gyi ming btags pa'i/ /rtsaba'i dud grangs rtsis pa dang / /de ni lo'i phreng ba ni/ /nyi shu song tshe me phag la / khrims ra chen po nas mngags pa'i/ /ho shu u nu khan gnyis dang / /dpon chen gzhon nu dbang phyug gis/ /rgyal khams che gsal byas mthus kyi / / dud grangs rtsis pa gang yin pa/ /blo gsal kun gyi dga' ba'i rgyan/ /rin chen phreng ba bzung bar mdzod/ /stod kyi mnga' ris skor gsum po/ /pu rangs gangs ris bskor ba dang / /gu ge g.ya' yis bskor de dang / /mang yul chu yis yongs bskor ba/ /de rnams kun tu dril ba la/ rtsa dud nyis stong drug brgya dang / /sum cu rtsa lngar kun kyang 'dus/ /mnga' bdag 'og na yod pa yis/ /mnga' ris phyogs kyi mi sde la/ /bdun brgya drug cu rtsa bdun no/ /la stod lho pa'i dud kyi grangs/ /stong dang brgyad cu rtsa dgu yod/ /la stod byang pa la gtogs pa/ /nyis stong nyis brgya lnga bcur 'dus/ /lha sde gzhung pa zur na gsal/ /de nas chu mig khri // la/ /hor dud sum stong nyag gsum

rgya bod mig tshang chen rmo/yin/ /zha lu khri skor sum stong dang / /brgyad brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis yod/ /byang 'brog khri skor rting la byung / /yar 'brog khri skor khyad chos ni/ /leb ni bcu drug dag tu 'dod/ /lha sde gzhung pa 'di ltar 'dod/ /mang mkhar ba dang dril chen gnyis/ /brgya phrag gcig dang nyi shu yin/ /gtsang pa brgyad cu gya bdun no//bo dong ri seb bdun cu bdun//mdo spe dmar ba tshig brgya dang //nyi shu rtsa lngar 'dus pa yin/ /grom lung ra sa kha sgang pa/ /rtsa dud bdud cu rtsa lnga yin/ /jo bo'i khri 'og sum cu lnga/ /ra sa snang kur sum cur snang / /mar la thang pa hor dud bcu/ /de rnams yongs su bsdus pa la/ /hor dud drug brgya drag yin no/ /de nas gnas gzhi las go la/ /hor dud brgya dang so gcig yod/ /gzhan yang lha sde mi sde yi/ khri skor gang la'ang mi the ba ru mtshams sum brgya drug cu yod/ /gya ba bod 'brog brgya lnga bcu/ /thang tsha la ni rtsa ba'i dud/ /brgya phrag phyed dang gnyes su yod/ /tshong 'dus brgya dang bcu phrag bzhi/ /sa skya nang pa'i dge ru la/ /zhid sa g.yog po la gtogasapa'i/ /la stod lho dang sa skya'i skor/ /ko dre gro chung g.yas ru dang / /dang ra dang ni 'dar mi nyag /de rnams bsdoms pas sum cu'o/ /dge ru lho gdong bzhi bcu dang / /bra tsha a btsan bzhi bcu drug /sum stong drug brgya sum cu yod/ /'di rnams khri skor la mi gtogs/ /gtsang phyogs mnga' ris gsal byed pa'i//tshig gi sgron me mchog 'di'o//de nas dbus phyogs shes pa yi/ /rtsa dud 'byer lugs 'di la nyon/ /'bri khung bod 'brog gnyis po la/ /sum stong drug brgya sum cu yod/ /tshaX ༵ sum stong bdun brgya gnyis/ /phag

brtse chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'gung gtses bsdus/ (shemo gru pa nyis stong dang / /bzhi brgya sum cu rtsa brgyad do/ /g.ya' bzang pa la sum stong dbang / /rgya ma ba dang bya yul la/ /lnga stong dgu brgya phyed 'byer yin/ /stag lung pa la lnga brgya'o/ /bsam yas phu mda' drug cu gnyis/ /mchims phu ba ni brgyad du gsal/ /rdo'i phu mda' bdun cur 'dug /dgong dkar ba dang 'phrang pa gnyis/ /rtsa ba'i dud chen bdun cur 'dug /lho pa shes pa'i mi sde la/ /hor gyi dud chen drug brgya'o/ /gshad yang gtsang la yar gtogs pa'i/ /gru gu sgang gi char gtogs la/ /hor dud nyis brgya sum cu gnyis/ kha rags pa la gya cu brgyad/ /rab btsun pa la dgu bcur bshad/ /'brug pa nyis brgya nyi shu lnga/ /thang po che la rtsa ba'i dud/ /rgya dang lnga bcu tham pa yin/ /de rnams kyis ni dbus phyogs shes/ /tshul 'di hor dang sa skya pa/ /yon mchod 'brel nas dbus gtsang du/ /sa rtsis byasapa'i thog mar 'dug /stod kyi mnga' ris skor gsum nas/ /zha lu khri skor char gtogs yan/ /a kon ming gling zhes byas brtsis/ /de man 'bri khung yan gyi sa/ /si tu a skyid dag gis brtsis/ /mnga' ris skor gsum sa cha dang / /dbus gtsang ru bzhi kun bsdoms pas/ /hor dud sum khri drug stong dang / /bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa/ /so sor dbye na ma nga 'a ris dang / /ru mtsham/sa mar bcad gtsang phyogs la/ /chig khri lnga stong drug brgya dang / /dgu bcu la ni kun kyang 'dus/ /dbus phyogs yongs la nyi khri dang / /bdun brgya drug cu rtsa gsum yin/ /de dag kun la mi thi ba/ /yar 'brog leb ni bcu drug ste/ /hor dud phyed dang brgyad 2 1 6 yod/ /'di dag sa skya'i dpon chen

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ni / / zam klu gun ming dben hu yi/ /ming thob shākya bzang po de'i/ /deb zer shog dril can bzhin yin/ /mtha' dag phyogs kun gsal byed pa/ /nyin mor byed pa yin pa ltar/ /'jig rten gtsug lag nyi ma 'di/ /gang 'dod gsal bar bstan zin to/ /'di ni rags pa'i rnam gzhag tsam/ /rgyas par lta 'dod skye bo yis/ /tha dad sngon gyi yig tshang gzigs/ /gtsang phyogs a kon ming gling dang / /dbus phyogs si tu a skyid kyis/ /rtsa ba'i dud chen brtsis pa des/ /'ja' chen 'dzin lugs 'di yin no/ /gtsang phyogs mi sde mnga' ris dang bcas pas//'ja' chen bzhi 'dzin 'ja' re la mgo brgya/ /de la lho byang mnga' ris dang bcas pas/ /dpal ldan sa skyar 'ja' chen gcig dang ni/ /lho pas mar la thad du 'ja' chung gcig /mnga' ris mi sdes zhabs khar 'ja' chung dang / /gyang ring 'ja' chung spong len dmag 'ja' 'dzin/ /ma phang 'ja' chung pu rangs pas 'dzin cing / /gu ge lho byang gnyis kyi 'ja' chung gcig /me tog se rur 'dzin no shes ldan dag /chu mig khri skor sum stong nyag gsum gyis//dar lus 'ja' chen 'dzin pa yin//zha lu sum stong brgyad brgya dang / /dgu bcu rtsa gnyis yin pa la/ /bya rog tshang pa brgyad brgya dang / /sum cu rtsa gnyis zur bzhag nas/ /sum stong drug cus tshong 'dus 'dzin/ /yar 'brog leb ni bcu drug dang / /bya rog tshang gi rta mgo ni/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad de dang ni/shangs kyi chu phyogs rta mgo'i grangs//bcu gcig rnams kyis stag 'ja' 'dzin/ /yar srib 'ja' chung yar 'brog pas/ /'dzin no de dag gtsang phyo// 7yin/ /dbus pas sngon dus 'ja'

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//'dzin lugs/ /bstan par bya yis deng sang min/ /go pe 'ja' ru 'bri khung pa//hor dud stong phrag gsum gyis 'dzin/ /ga ra 'ja' ru bya yul ba/ /nyis stong drag brgya lnga bcu'i thog /tshal ba'i ri rtsa the ba'i dus/ /phyed dang bzhi brgya mnan pa yis/ /stong phrag gsum gyi 'ja' de 'dzin/ /sog 'ja' rgya ma pa yi dud/ /nyis stong drug brgya lnga bcu la/ /tshal ba'i zur khar rtsa ba'i dud/ /phyed dang bzhi brgya mnan pa yis/ /stong phrag gsum yod de yisa'adzin//rtsi dbar 'ja' mo phag gru pa'i//hor dud nyis stong bzhi brgya dang / /sum cu rtsa brgyad yod pa'i thog /sa stag zhes byas stag lung ba/ /hor dud lnga brgya 'dzin pa dang / /lha pa'i drug brgya mnan pas 'dzin/ sha pho 'ja' ru gru gu snang /kha rag 'brug pa dang bcas dang / /gra ma thang pa'i nyis brgya dang / /'ol kha ba yi bzhi 'ad/)ste/ /'di dag rnams dang lha ltag gis/ /'dzin pa lha ltag gong du bcad/ /gzhan rnams sa stag zhes bya bas/ /gtsang la yar gtogs gtsang la mnan/ /rkong 'ja' g.ya' bzang rtsa ba'i dud/ /stong phrag gsum gyi dga' bas 'dzin/ /'di dag tshul lugs sa skya pa'i/ /nang chen pa dang du dben sha /gzhen nu mgon zhes bya ba yis//deb ther nang bzhin brisa~X /na//zhe// ṭ+wāṃ me dang 'dra'i gtsug lag 'di/ /blo gros gsal ba'i snang ba 218

rgya bod mig67mo/ ༄༅/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs mdor bsdus don gsal bzhugs// bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo / / rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab mtha' yas pa/ /gcig tu bsdus nas rnam 'phrul gdul bya la//sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i//'khon ston rim par byon pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dri med gdung brgyud rim par byon chul dang / /de'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar mtha' yas pas/ /thub bstan gsal dang 'gro kun smin grol tshul/ /rnam thar ngo mtshar phreng ba bdag gis spel/ /de'ang bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rim po che 'di nyid/ thog mar 'od gsal gyi lha las babs par bzhed de dang por sa gtsang gnas mtho ba la stod mnga' ris kyi sa char/ gnam nas la mched gsum bya ba byon pa'i/ che ba gnam lha spyi ring / bar pa gnam la g.yu ring / chung ba gnam lha g.yu se bya ba byon/ de rnams la mi'i rje zhus pas chung ba des mi yul du bzhugs nas mi'i rje mdzad/ de la sras bzhi byung ba/se byi li spun bzhir grags so/ /de dag gis ldong rus chen bco brgyad dang 'thab skad/ de'i grogs la gnam lha g.yu ring gis gyon nas/ sdong rus chen bco brgyad btul te bran du byas skad do/ /'o na gdung rabs 'di gang nas 'dod na/ gnam lha g.yu ring 2 /mu'i bu mo dmu bza' ldem bu khab tu

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (shebazhes pas sras bdun byung ste ma sangs spun bdun du grags so/ /de'i gcen po drug yab dang bdun dmu thag dang rkyang thag dang lha yul du byen/ chung ba des/ thog lā 'od chen gyi bu mo thog lcam 'ur ma bya ba khab tu bzhes pa la sras thog tsha dpa' bo stag byung ngo / /des klu'i bu mo klu lcam bra ma khab tu bzhes pa la/ sras klu tsha stag po 'od chen byung / des mon bza' mtsho mo rgyal khab tu bzhes pa la/ sras gcig byung ba de g.ya' dang spang gi mtshams su skyes pas ming g.ya' spang skyes su btags so/ /des srin po skya rengs khrag med bya ba la chung ma g.ya' 'brum si li ma bya ba shin tu mtshar ba gcig yod pas srin po skya rengs khrag med bsad g.ya' 'brum si li ma 'phrog nas khab tu bzhes pa la sras gcig byung ba de srin po dang 'khon pa'i bar du byung bas/de'i ming la 'khon bar skyes bya bar btags te/ de nas gdung rus 'khon zhes grags so/ /des bcan bza' lcam bu sgron khab tu bzhes pa la sras gcig byung ste/ de nyid ni mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che ba/ blo dang rig pa ldan pa gzugs dang lang tsho 'dzom pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa shin tu mdzes pa gcig byung bas/ 'di 'dra mi yul du 'byon pa dkon zer nas ming dkon pa rje gung stag btsan bya bar btags so/ khye'u de yab kyis yul gang bzang lta ru btang bas/ la stod gnyen rtse thang gi ya chang la yul gyi dge brgyad tshang bar gzigs te/ yul de bzung 'khon gyi yul snga ba yin no/ /de'i dus su bod na sprul pa'i chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan bzhugs pa'i sku ring la / za hor gyi mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho /// drangs/ de'i slob bu bod kyi btsun

rgya bod yig tshang so mo pa la snga ba sad mi mi bdun du grags pa la/ rgan gsum/ ga 'one gsum/bar pa dang bdun zer ba yod pa'i/ rgan gsum ni/ dba' rat+na rak+ṣi ta rin chen bsrung ba/ sba dzñā nas rak+ṣita ye shes dbang po bsrung ba yin/ ra sne n+ta rak+ṣi ta rin chen dbang po bsrung ba'o/ /gzhen gsum ni/ pa gor be+e ro tsā na rak+ṣi ta rnam par snang mdzad bsrung ba/ 'khon rma gen+d+ra rak+ṣi ta klu'i dbang po bsrung ba / gtsang de len+d+ra rak+ṣi ta lha'i dbang po /srung ba'o/ /bar pa rlangs khams pa su ga ta warma rak+ṣi ta zhes bya ba bod skad du bde bar gshegs pa bsrung ba zhes bya'o/ /dkon pa rje gung stag 'di blo che zhing / 'jig rten gyi bya ba la mkhas pas/ bod rgyal po'i nang chen yun ring du byas/ de'i dus su dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa byung bas/ ming la 'khon dpal bo che zhes par grags so/ /de nas/ 'khon la mi chos kyi sgo nas grags pa chen po byung ngo / / des rlangs khams pa lo tsā ba'i lcam mo rlangs bza' yi chung khab tu bzhes pa la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba de/ sba ye shes dbang po bsrung ba dang / rang gi zhang po'i thad du rab tu byung pa ni 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba zhes bya'o/ /de ni lo tsā ba gzhen gsum gyi nang nas thugs rab che ba/sngags mtshan nyid kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' zhing / slob dpon pad+ma la rdo rje phur pa dang / yang dag la sogs pa mang du zhus nas/ yer pa'i brag la sgrub pa mdzad de sgrub pa brnyes so/ /de nas 'khon la lha chos kyi sgo nas grags pa shin tu che bar byung ba yin no/ /de'i gcung rdo rje rin chen zhesabya ste/ des kyang slob dpon pad+ma dang rang gi gcen la/ dbang dang gdams 22/

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (she/ngag mang du nod de mkhas par grags so/ /gsang sngags rnying ma'i srol yang 'di tsam nas mgo tshugs pa yin/ de'i gong du spyir bod dang / sgos su 'bon la / sngags pa dang / rab tu byung ba'i tha snyad ma byung ba 'dug go /'khon rdo rje rin po ches 'bro dgra 'dul gyi bu mo/ 'bro g.yang lon skyid bya ba khab tu bzhes pa la/sras 'bro tsha spun bdun byung ste/ 'bro snyan rtse'i gson gshid kyi ltad mo nyi ma gsum byas pa'i khong spun bdun pos nyi ma re la rta lus chas 'dra 'dra ba zhig spos nas/ rta rgyugs rtsal 'gran pas khrom thog chod pa byung /'bro'i bsam pa la/ khong la mtho 'tsham par go nas/ dmag bsag gcig pa byed zer ba la/ gcig par zhang po yin/ gnyis par 'grogs yun ring po song bas 'brug pa mi byed/ rgyal khams yangs po la dogs cher byed don med zer nas/ 'bro tsha spun bdun gyi che ba mang yul du byon/ de 'og gung thang du/ de 'og gad du/ de 'og gnya' lo rong / de 'og nyang shab/ de 'og grom pa g.ya' lung rnam bas su gyes so/ /tha chung gis yab yum dang bzhugs/'bro dang 'brug pa yang bcad/ de las gyes pa snyan rtse reng na/ ma 'khrigasasde gsum du grags pa yod do/ /tha ltag grom par byon pa de'i mtshan shes rab yon tan/ de la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba/ tshul khrims rgyal po chung ba khab so stag thog tu byon/ der yang 'khon ci rigs pa 'phel de nas g.yas ru byang du gyes pa'i 'khon tsho'i sde pa yang mang du yod do/ /'khon tshul khrimasargyal po la/ sras gsum byung ba'i/ che ba gtsug tor shes rab dang gcung chung ba g.ya' lung rang du bzhugs/ bar ༵ spya rdal chang tshang du byon/ gtsug tor

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ shes rab la sras bdun byung ba dang bcas pa g.ya' lung na yod/ sras bdu na po'i lnga pa 'khon dge skyabs des shab tu byon/ de la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba 'khon dge mthong bya ba byon/ chung ba snyel shab stod kyi 'khon mi rnams gyes pa yin skad/ dge mthong la sras gcig byung ba 'khon ston bal po/ des tsha mo rong glang gi brag la yang phur gyi sgrub pa mdzad pas grub pa brnyes shing brtan ma bcu gnyis bran du 'khol ba'i nus mthu can gcig byon no/ /de la sras shākya blo gros bya ba gcig byung des bya ru lung pa dang shab stod smad du yun ring du bzhugs shing / phyis sku tshe smad la yab mes kyi yul g.ya' lung mkhar thabs su byon/ de la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba/ 'khon rogs shes rab tshul khrims zhes bya'o/ /de nyid yab mes kyi chos lugs la rgyud sbyangs shing / rdo rje phur pa la grub pa brnyes nas mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan zhing / gzhon nu'i dus la lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi mkhan po shab bya ru dang 'phrad/ brag dmag gyi mkhan po mdzad pa'i zhu ston gzhon nu brtson 'grus bya ba'i drung du go mi'i dge bsnyen mdzad do/ /shin tu btsun zhing tshangs par spyod pas mdzes la/ mkhas pa dang bzang po'i grags pa cher thob pa gcig byung ngo / /'di gong mi'i dge bsnyen yin pas sras 'phel ba med / de yan chad kyi 'khon rim par byon pa thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa phyi mtshan nyid kyi chos rnams dang nang rdo rje theg pa la gsang ba sde drug snga 'gyur lnga/ phyi 'gyur bcu gsum/ phra mo nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos rnams la shin tu mkhas shing /223

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chog 'byung gces bsdus/ (//yang phur la thugs dam gyi mthil mdzad nas grub pa ci rigs pa brnyes la/chos skyong dkar mo nyi zla lcam sring la byed cing nus pa thon pa sha stag byon no//'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims kyi gcung po ni/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po zhes bya ste/ bla ma 'di nyid shing pho khyi'i lo la sku 'brungs/ gzhen nu nyid nas yab dang gcen la dbang dang gdams pa mang du zhus(shing / yab mesakyi chos lugs rnams la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs te/ gsang sngags phyi 'gyur la yang spro bar yod pa de'i skabs su/ 'bro'i lung par ltad mo chen po gcig byung ba'i tshe/ bla ma dkon mchog rgyal pos kyang byon ltad mo rtsed 'phyo mang du 'dug pa'i nang nas sngags pa 'ga' zhig gis dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi mgo brnyan gyon nas/ phyag mtshan so sor khyer/ ma mo ral pa can rngam stabs dang bcas te 'cham gyin 'dug pa de kha ltad mo che/ khrom thog kyang des chod song bas/ kho pas phyir log nas gcen la 'di lta bu gda' zhus pas/ gcen na re/ da gsang sngags 'chol ba bya ba'i dus byung ba yin phyin chad/ bod du rnying ma la grub thob mtshan nyid pa mi yong rang re la yod pa kun rang dbang che bas a po rgan po'i dpe cha lha rten kun gter du sba bar gyis/ de'ang mang mkhar na 'brog mi lo tsā ba mkhas par yod 'dug pas/ de las slob tu rgyug gsungs nas dpe rnying thams cad gter du sbas/der chos skyong gi cho 'phrul byung nas phur pa'i chos skor ci rigs pa dang /gtor ma'i chog dang / seng ldeng gi phur pa bco lnga pa cha gnyis dang / dkar mo nyi zla nyid kyis 'khon rogs shes2 sdub tshul khrims rang la zhal dngos su

rgya bod ga tshang chen rmo/ bstan nas mdzad pa'i gtor chog rnams ston nas gcung la gnang / 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rnams kyis da lta'ang dus gtor ma chag pa mdzad dgos so//de nas bla ma dkon mchog rgyal pos/ mang mkhar sku gu lung du 'brog mi'i spyan sngar ma thon pa/ g.ya' lung dur khrod du khyin lo cwa ba la brtag gnyis gsan/ de tshar la khad pa dang bla ma khyin sku gshegs de'i zhal chems la chos 'phro de mang mkhar du 'brog mi la zhus shig gsungs nas/ 'brog mi'i drung du phyin pas/ khyod kyi pha shi nas mes po can snyegs sam 'gro sa ma nor gsungs/ yul nas tshong 'grul byas pa'i rta bcu bdun khal dang bcas pa rnalarin la jo mo'i nor phreng bzang po gcig khyer yod pa de rnams phul nas gsungangag rin po che zhus pas rim gyis gnang zhing gzhan yang / gsar 'gyur gyi chos phal che ba la gsan skyongs rgya cher mdzad pas chos kyi mnga' bdag chen por gyur to/ /de nas zhang yul 'jag bsgongs su yab dang gcen gyi sku 'bum bzhengs/ de'i nang du phur pa byin rlabs can cha gcig yang bzhugs/phur pa cha gcig gang gshegs sar thugs dam la bsnams/ phyis sa skya na yod zer/ g.ya' lung chu skyar du'ang bzhugs/ bra'o lung par dgon chung gcig btab nas lo 'ga' bzhugs der sa skya gog por grags so/ /de'i tshe dpon slob 'ga' zung gis skyo bsangs la byon/ ri rtse nas gzigs pas spon po ri'i ngos 'gram na sa dkar zhing snum pa/ chu g.yas su 'bab pa bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan mang po tshang bar gzigs nas/ 'dir dgon pa gcig btab na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / 'gro ba mang po la phan par 'dug 225

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//dgongs pa byung nas/ jo bo gdong nag pa la zhus pas gnang sa de'i sgos kyi bdag po shad zhung gu ra ba dang / brnye grong bzhi/ lha mi grong bdun bya ba 'dug pa la sa cha 'dir nged dgon chung gcig byed pa la/ khyed rnams la 'gal ba med na rin zhig yang 'jal gsungs pas/ rin ye mi 'tshal dgon pa mdzad par zhu zer ba la 'on kyang phyis tshun chad 'di 'thad par 'dug gsungs nas/ rgod ma dkar po gcig mo gos gcig nor bu'i phreng ba gcig khrab gcig rnams kyis mgo byas pa'i rin bcal/ mon grog mar bcad 'bal grog yar btab gyi sa de bla mas bdag por byas skad/ bla ma 'di nyid dgung lo bzhi bcu tham pa bzhes pa'i dus thub pa'i dbang po sa pho 'jo/ga la bltams pa/ brgyad cu bzhes pa'i sa 51 phag la mya ngan las 'das pa'i rting /lo sum stong nyis brgya dang bdun song ba'i/ chu mo glang gi lo la dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdan sa 'gram gting nas/ bla brang shar gyi sa cha 'di la bla brang gi mthil mdzad lcags ri rtsa brgyad du byas pa gcig yod do/ /bla ma 'di nyid kyis gdan sa lo sum cu tham pa bzung zhing bstan pa'i bya ba chen po mdzad nas/ dgung lo drug cu re dgu pa chu pho rta'i lo dbyug pa zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la bde bar gshegs so/ /gdan sa chen mo 'gram gting pa'i chu mo glang lo de nas da phan shing pho stag gi gong dkar bzhi 'dzom la rkyen nas dbus gtsang bde bdog chen po langs pa'i lo srog sme brgyad dkar dbus na yod pa 'di yan la lo sum brgya dang drug cu re gcig song 'dug bla ma dkon mchog rgyal po 'di nyid dgung lo nga dgu bzhes dī sdu pho spre'u'i lo la jo mo gnyis yod

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ pa'i chung ba gu ra ba'i bu sring mo jo mo zhang mo bya ba la sras gcig 'khrungs pa ni / sa chen kun dga' snying po zhes bya'o/ /de'i rnam thar cung zad brjod na/skye ba bzhes pa'i khyad par dang / lung rtogs kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' tshul dang / slob ma'i mchog mang du byung ba dang gsum gyi sgo nas brjod par byas te/ rgyas par rnam thar chen mor blta'o/ /de'ang sras 'di 'khrungs pa yum gyi re zhig gsang nas yod pa la/ chen ma rdo rje dbang phyug mos tshor nas 'o skol gyi gdung brgyud 'di chad du phangs pa la/ zhang mo la sras gcig yod gda' ba nan ltar legs/ nga la gsang mi 'tshal da bdag la nor mi dgos/ bu'i ma la dgos pa yin zer nas sa skya mdun gyi mchod zhing ma gtogs/ gzhan thams cad shad mo yum sras la gtad/gzhon nu nyid nas chab klog yig rtsis la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs shing / thog ma kho nar yab la kye rdo rje'i dbang zhus/ de dag gi thugs la mnga' ba'i chos thams cad gsan no/ /dgung lo bcu gnyis lon pa dang / yab bde bar gshegs te rtsis byas pas/ gshegs rdzongs byed pa dang phyi rten gyi 'gram 'ding ba gdan sa bsko ba rnams nyi ma gcig la grub na rjes su phun sum tshogs pa 'byung zer ba la/ yum na re nyid rang gi yab kyi slob dpon yang lo tsā ba yin/ lo tsā ba dang 'brel ba'i chos 'di/nan ltar rdzun chung zer nas mnyes pa gcig yod/ khyed chung bas 'o cag gi gdan sa mi zin/gdan sa 'di ba ri lo tsā ba la gtad pa drag zer/ ba ri ba g.yu mkhar mo na yod pa gdan drangs nas gdan sa gtad pa dang / gshegs 227

ba chen 'od snang las/sa lha'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (nardzongs chos 'khor byed pa dang phyi rten gyi 'gram gding ba rnams nyin gcig la tshar ba mdzad/ zhing mo che ma gtogs gzhis thams cad bla ma ba ri ba la gtad do/ /ba ri ba'i zhal nas/ khyed jo sras kyi bu bya ba slob gnyer byed dgos pa yin/ de la shes rab dgos pa yin/ de'i lha 'phags pa 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa 'di sgrubs gsungs nas/ sgrub pas zla ba drug nas 'jam dpal dngos su zhal gzigs/ sgrub khang 'jam dpal brag khung du grags pa bla brang shar gyi dkyil na yod do/ /de ltar yi dam gyi lhas mngon sum du byin gyis brlabs pas/ shes bya phal mo che thugs su chud mod kyang /gang zag rnams kyi bsam blo dang bstun pa'i phyir/ gzhen nu nyid nas slob gnyer thugs 'a gtad de/ sngon la rong ngur smig tu brang ti dar ma snying po la mngon pa slob tu byen/ bla ma ba ri bas gdan sa lo brgyad mdzad ring la/dbus gtsang mnga' ris man gyi sa cha na bzhugs pa'i bla ma lo paṇa bzang tshad kyi 'khas la gtugs nas thos pa gsan sbyangs mthar thon pa mdzad cing /khyad par ba ri lo tsā ba'i thugs la yod tshad kyi yon tan bum pa gang byo gnang ste / lo brgyad thims nas gdan sa bla ma sa chen rang la gtad/ ba ri ba bar phug tu zhi bar gshegs so/ /de nas bgres po rnams gros byas nas da pha chos gcig brtsad bcad pa drag par 'dug zer/ 'khon sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar gyi drung du byon nas/ dbang bskur zhus pas/ sta gon gyi nub mo srid pa'i rgya mtsho yin zer ba'i/ chu bo chen po dmar me re ba zhig la/ zam pa gsum 'dug pa'i chu 'gram na/ nga rdoX8 bar zhu zer ba'i mi mang po 'dug pa/

rgya bod yig paṃ za mo/zam pa phyi ma la mi gsum/ bar ma la mi bdun/ nye ba de la mi mang po zhig bsgral ba rmis/ cung snyel nas nyi ma gcig la snyel gso ba snyam byed tsa na/mnal sad nangs par/ rmi lam dris dus/ 'di ltar byung zhus pas bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi mkhos khas mi gsum las ga na sgrol gsungs/ zhal bkur yang mdzad/ de nas bla ma de nyid kyis dbang bskur rgyud lung / man ngag thugs la mnga' tshad rdzogs par gnang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung bas/ chos thams cad tshar re gsan pa dang thugs su chud pa byung skad do/ /bla ma sgyi chu ba zhi bar gshegs dus zhal chems la/ kun dga' snying po khyod/ rab tu byung la 'khon tsho'i sde 'di skyongs gsungs bzhag pa bzhin/ rab tu byung dgos pa la bla ma gnam kha'u pa'i gsungs nas/ bla ma mnyam po'i nang nas khong gshin po las nga gson po'i ngag la nyon/ khyed rab tu ma byung na sems can la phan che bar 'dug gsungs nas ma gnang /rab tu ma byung yang / 'khon tsho'i dpon mdzad yang mnga' ris gung thang na la rtse gnas gsar du bla ma mal lo tsā ba la chos zhus/ bla mas/ mgon po'i rje gnang sgrub thabs/ las tshogs tshang ma gnang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten du bse 'bag nag po 'gro shes dang / dar nag la gri khrag gis rtsa sngags bris pa/ lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa gcig pa dang bcas te/ chos skyong la mi lab pa bzhin du/ da nga rgas pas khyod mi dgos/ khyod rang 'khon sa skya pa'i rjes la song zhig gsungs nas brdzangs/ de phyin chad/ sa skya pa'i chos skyong gur mgon la byed pa 'di byung ba yin cing / bse 'bag nag po ni sgo rum na 229

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /bla ma zhang ston chos 'bar la gsung ngag rin po che rdzogs par zhus/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa la chos skyong zhal bzhi pa'i sgrub thabasacha lag tshang ma zhus/de nas sa skya'i chos skyong che chung du grags pa 'di byung ngo //sa lam zin pa'i slob ma'i mchog kyang mang du byung zhing / bla ma sa chen 'di nyid kyis gdan sa lo zhe brgyad bzung ste/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad nas dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun pa sa pho stag gi lo tha skar zla ba'i dkar phyogs tshes bcu bzhi'i dus su g.yas ru skya bo kha gdangs su zhi bar gshegs so/ /de'i dus su kun gyi mthun snang du grub par sku'i bkod pa bzhi bstan te/ gcig ni bde ba can/ gnyis pa po ta la/ gsum pa u rgyan/bzhi pa byang phyogs gser mdog can gyi zhing khams su gshegs par grags so / / bla ma de nyid kyis jo mo gnyis khab tu bzhes pa la/ rigs kyi sras bzhi 'khrungs te/ thog mar jo mo chung shos jo lcam phur ma bya ba la/ sras kun dga' 'bar bya ba zha cings te/ de nyid gzhen nu la rgya gar du byon/ ma ga dhar slob gnyer mdzad rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur nas/ bod la 'byon pa'i grabs mdzad dus tshad pa'i skung gzhi byung nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la ma ga dhar zhi bar gshegs so/ /jo mo che ba tsha mo rong pa ma cig 'od sgron bya ba la sras gsum 'grungs pa'i che ba/slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo zhes bya ste yab dgung lo nga gcig pa'i dus/ chu pho byi ba'i lo la sku 'khrungs shing / bla ma 'di yang sku bltams pa tsam nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa zhig go /dgu ༷1 bzhi bcu zhe gcig pa chu pho stag gi

rgya bod yig tshang chen rmo/ lo smal po zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig la bde bar gshegs so/ /de'i gcung rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan ni yab dgung lo nga drug pa'i dus me mo yos lo smal zla'i tshes brgyad la sku 'brungs te/ bzod pa thob pa'i rgyal ba yin cing dbu rtse rnying ma bzhengs/ rgyas par rnam thar du blta'o/ /gdan sa lo zhe lnga mdzad dgung lo bdun cu pa me pho byi ba'i lo'i khra zla'i tshes bcu gnyis la bde ba can du gshegs so/ /gcung po chung ba dpal chen 'od po ni / yab dgung lo nga dgu pa lcags pho rta lo smin drug zla ba'i nyi shu lnga la 'khrungs te/ rtag tu gzhan la phan pa dang brtse ba'i bdag nyid de/ lnga bcu nga bzhi bzhes nga/ chu mo phag lo zla ba lnga pa'i nyi shu gcig la bde ba can du gshegs so/ /bla ma de'i rdzo mo ma cig gar bu ma nyi khri lcam la sras po gnyisagacings pa'i che ba chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid yab dgung lo so gsum bzhes pa'i dus chu pho stag gi lo khra zla'i nyi shu drug la sku 'khrungs te/ sku gzhon nu nyid nas yab mes kyi chos lugasathams cad ma lus par thugs su chud par mdzad/ rab byung ma mdzad gong gi mtshan ni slob dpon dpal ldan don grub zer bar 'dug cing / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga lon pa'i me pho stag lo la kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bod du byon dus nyang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang du paṇa chen pas mkhan po mdzad/ spyi lhasapa chen pos slob dpon mdzad zhu 'phrang pas gsang ste ston pa mdzad nas/ rgya bod kyi dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa yang de ltar mdzad do/ /bla huX/ shar shar pa sher 'byung la gnang /

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (//bzhi thog bla brang btab/ kha che paṇa chen la sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang du bsten cing paṇa chen gyi thugs sras/ paṇ+ḍita da na shī la bya ba yun ring gi bar la 'bral med du bsten/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la phul du phyin nas/ skyid grong du 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs mu stegs kyi ston pa drug btul/ de dag rab tu byung nas nang pa'i bstan pa la btsud/ chos kyi mnga' bdag chen por gyur/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum bzhes pa shing pho 'brug lo la hor gyi rgyal po e chen go dan gyis gdan 'dren la gser yig pa rdor tha che bya ba mngags byung dusang bla mas dgongs pa gtad/ rten 'brel brtags pas/ dang po khu bo rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas khyod la dus nam zhig shar phyogs nas gdan 'dren 'di lta bu yong / de'i dus su the ma tshom par song cig bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don la phan che bar yod do/ /gsungs pa'i lung bstan gnang ba thugs kyis zin nas/ sa skyar chos dpon la bla ma 'u yug pa bsod namasaseng ge dang /shar pa sher 'byung gdan sa spyi'i kha ta brjid khur la nang gnyer ba grom pa shākya bzang po bskos nas/ bla ma'i phyag phyir/ dbon po 'phags pa dang / phyag na gnyis kyang sku gzhon nu la khrid nas byon/ lam la lo gsum 'gor/ byang ngos su rta lo'i gzhug la phebs/ rgyal pos go yug rgyal po rgyal sar bton pa'i mjal 'phrad 'khor ba dang / me mo lug lo la yon mchod mjal gnam mchod pa'i rgan pa thob/ rgyal po'i bla ma dang hor yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ hor sa skya pa 'brel ba'i sngon ma yin no/ /bla ma 'dis gdan sa lo rdiX cu so lnga mdzad/ dgung lo bdun cu

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ pa lcags mo phag lo smal po zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te byang ngos sprul pa sde'i lha khang du bde bar gshegs so/ /de na sku 'bum mchod pa'i rgyun dang bcas pa yang bzhugs so/ /bla ma de'i gcung slob dpon chen po zangs tsha bsod rgyal ni/ yab dgung lo zhe lnga pa'i dus shing pho 'brug lo la sku 'khrungs te/ yab mes kyi chos lugs phal che ba la'ang sbyangs shing / zhang po phyogs de sngon cog ro zangs dkar bya ba'i rgyad pa chen po gcig byung ba de'i rigs brgyud kyi dbon po yin pas zangs tsha zhes pa yin pas blo dang sku rtsal shin tu che bar grags so/ khong rang gi mda' rgyang la tshad mdzad pa'i dan gyi lcags ri btab/ zangs tsha'i rgyal sgo ru grags pa bcug lnga bcu nga drug pa sa mo phag la la stod ldog gi ba ri ru sku gshegs so/ /des jo mo lnga khab tu bzhes pa la/ rigs kyi sras po bzhi dang sras mo bzhi gzungs pa'i thog ma ma cig kun skyid la/ sras gnyis kyi che ba bla ma 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba yab dgung lo nga gnyis pa'i dus/ shing mo lug gi lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes drug la sku 'khyungs te/ de nyid sna dang po nas sbyangs pa dang skyes stobs kyi thugs rab dpag tu med pa mnga' bas/ gzhen nu'i dus nas klog yig dang slob gnyer gsan sbyongs mdzad pa gang la'ang mthong ba tsam gyis mkhyen pa khro na byung bas thams cad kyis 'di lta bu khyad 'phags zer ba mtshan yang 'phags pa zhes grags pa yin la/ dgung lo bcu pa'i dus chos rje sa paṇa gyi phyag phyir/byang ngos la byon pa'i lam khar zul phur chos rjes mkhan po dang / zul phu 233

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//mkhan po chos kyi byang chub pas slob dpon mdzad nas/ rab tu byung zhing lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas rgyud mdzes par mdzad do/ /byang ngos sprul pa sder khu dbon phebs pa'i skabs su hor se chen rgyal po'i lung gis byang ngos nas sa skya bla ma bya ba khyad 'phags slebs yod 'dug pa/ nged kyi bla mchod la dgos gsungs pa byung nas chos rje pa sku na bgres pas ma byon/ bla ma 'phags pas byang ngos pa'i rgyal bu mong gor dang lhan cig tu rgya nag la byon/rgyal po se chen go pe la lu ba'i shan na bzhugs pa dang mjal bas shin tu mnyes nas/ hor gyi rta pa brgya skor gcig byang ngos la phyin nas sa skya pa blangs yon mchod du 'brel/ bla ma'i brtag pa mdzad rin dang byang ngos su chos rje bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs sogs la rgya hor gyi yul du lo mang por bzhugs/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa/ shing mo yos lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin rgya yul gyi he tse'u dang nye ba'i sar mkhan po grags pa seng ges mkhan po dang mkhan bu mdzad/ byang thang pa jo gdan bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / rne ba mkhan po blo gros grags kyis slob dpon mdzad/ yar lung pa bla ma byang chub rgyal mtshan pas gsang ste ston pa mdzad/ dad pa'i dge 'dun la bla ma ye pa dang / mkhan po sher mes/ rin po che nya sgom la sogs pa'i sdom brtson dam pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad do/ /de nas pho brang ta'i tur byon/ se chen rgyal po yab yum sras dang bcas pa la rgyud gsum gyi dbang mo dz+wa /skur/ti shi'i mtshan gsol/ dbus

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/gtsang gi khri skor bcu gsum sogs dbang yon 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ hor sa skya pa yon mchod du 'brel/ bod yul go pe la'i mnga' 'og tu tshud pa'i snyan grags sgrogs pa dang / 'ja' mo 'dzugs pa la mi chen sman bya ba sa skya man la mngags/ se chen gyis/ bod la gser yig btang ba'i sngon ma de yin no/ /rgya'i hwa shang mig char ba'i lta ba zhen pa tha'o shang la 'gyen bya ba'i rjes 'brang chos ltar bcos pa'i gzhung lugs la mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis dregs pa bcu bdun yang dag pa'i rigs pas pham par mdzad nas bstan pa'i sgor btsud/ hor yig med pa la hor yig brtsams nas dar bar mdzad/spyir bal po dang / rgya dkar nag mi lhag hor/ da'u le/ 'jang /yo gur/ khu sen la sogs pa'i dge slong pho mo dang / dge tshul pho mo/ rab tu byung ba stong phrag bzhi dang bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga'i mkhan po mdzad cing / bla ma'i dngos slob 'dul 'dzin chos kyi mgon po bya ba sman tshe'i rgyal khams su mngags nas/ lo gcig nang du rab byung dgu brgya bzhi bcu rtsa bsnyen gyi mkhan po mdzad de/ de rnams las brgyud pa'i dge slong dge 'dun dpag tu med pas gang nas bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /de'i phyi lo / me pho 'byug la bla ma bod la byon/ mdo khams rtso mdo gnas gsar du nye gnas chen po ston tshul gyis mgo byas nas/ nyin gcig la rin po che glegs bam stong phrag phyed dang gnyis kyis thog drangs/ sa cha/ sde dgon/mi nor gyi 'bul ba stobs che ba bzhes nas/ dbus gtsang du phebs/ 'brug lo de la dpon chen shākya bzang po do dam byas nas/ lha khang chen mo'i 235

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/ (//'gram gting / sa skya btab rting lo brgya dang bdun cu don brgyad song dus yin/ de nas da lta shing pho stag lo srog smre brgyad dkar dbus na yod pa 'di yan la/ lo brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gcig song 'dug go /sa skyar phebs pa'i tshogs ja gro 'gyed dang chos rje pa'i gshegs rdzongs sku skal/ nang rten rin po che'i sgo mang byang chub chen po bzhengs pa/ gser thog gser 'phru 'jugs pa / gcung gi 'dod dang bcas pa'i phyogs su phyag rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa btang zhing / lcags pho rta lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa la/ gtsang chu mig ring mor dbus gtsang mnga' ris kyi dge 'dun khri phrag bsnyen lhag la chos 'khor bskor ba'i chas la gser srang dgu brgya drug cu rtsa gsum zho gsum/dngul bre chen dgu/ na phyis dang / zab chen yug bzhi bcu rtsa gcig gos yug brgyad brgya sum cu so brgyad/ dar yug lnga stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ ja sigs chen brgya nyi shu/ sbrang bu drug brgya dang gsum/ mar khal chig khri sum stong bdun brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ nas khal sum khri bdun stong bco brgyad/ rtsam khal brgyad stong drug brgya/ gzhan yang phran tshegs grangasamed pa dang bcas pas bsnyen bkur ro/ /lcags mo lug lo la mdo gsum bka' 'gyur po ti brgya dang bco lnga bzhengs pa la/ gser rkyang srang stong phrag bzhi dang nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa gcig zho gsum btang ngo / /me mo glang lo la rgyal bu jing gin gyis chos 'khor mdzad dus dge 'dun khri phrag bdun lhag la gsung bar du gser zho re re phul 'dug de rting yang bla ma 'dis gong du byon/ dbang bskur rim par mdzad ༷༷ dbang yon la rgyal pos bod chol kha

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/ gsum dang / rgya yi yur ma chen mo phul bsngo bas rgyas btab zer ba 'dug cing / che ba'i yon tan mtha' yas pa mnga' bas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i tshul rgyas pa ni rnam thar chen mor blta'o/ /bla ma 'disagadan sa lo sum cu so drug mdzad de/ dgung lo zhe drug lcags pho 'brug gi lo smal po zla ba'i nyi shu gnyis kyi snga dro nyi ma dang me bzhi 'phrod pa'i tshe dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya chen po bgoms gsungs/ skyil mo krung mdzad/ rdo rje dril bu thugs dar snol nas rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i ngang la ngo mtshar ba'i bltas du ma dang bcas te dpal sa skya'i lha khang bla brang du bde bar gshegs so / / de'i gcung slob dpon phyag na rdo rje ni/ yab dgung lo nga drug pa'i dus/sa mo phag la sku 'khrungs shing / dgung lo drug pa'i dus byang ngos la chos rje pa'i phyag phyir byon/ sa skya pa rnams kyis dbon po mched gnyis sku na phra bsabyes mi thub 'jog par zhus pas/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod cing / 'gro ba sbyor sgrol thub pa'i ngo mtshar can zhig byon te/ chos rje pa dang gcen la dbang dang gdams pa'ang mang du zhus/ rgyal po go dan gyis hor chas su bcug dpon mo me ga dun gnang / se chen rgyal po dang mjal nas pa'i len dbang gi ming dang / gser gyi tham ga thong ji g.yas g.yon gyi khrims ra dang bcas pa gnang / bod spyi'i steng du bskos/ spyir bod dang / sgos sa skya la dbang gi lung las ka gnang ba'i sngon ma yin no/ /'di nyid dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa me mo yos bu'i lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gnyis la dpe khang gzim khang du bde bar gshegs so/ /ma cig jo mo 'bro la sras237

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//lcam sring gnyis byung ba'i/ gcen slob dpon chen po rin chen rgyal mtshan ni/yab dgung lo so gcig pa sa pho khyi lo la sku 'khrungs/ rgyud lung man ngag thams cad mkhyen nas se chen rgyal po'i bla mchod mdzad/ bla ma 'phags pas dbus gtsang la byon pa'i shul du me tog ra bar gdan sa lta bu mdzad/ pho brang dang nye bar dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don la brtson pa'i ngang dgung lo zhe gnyis bzhes pa me mo yos lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu la shing kun tu sku gshegs so/ /de'i lcam mo slob dpon ma cig me tog bya ba 'grungs so/ /yang gung thang rtsad po'i sras mo lha cig mdzes ma slob dpon ma bsod nams 'bum dang nyi ma 'bum gnyis 'khrungs te/ che bsarab byung mdzad/ jo mo gling btab btsun ma'i sde btsugs so/ /'di yan la btsun mo'i dge slong ma'i sdom pa 'bogs len yod par yang grags so/ /yang / lha cig mdzes ma'i nye gnas ma jo mo rdo rje ldan la slob dpon ye shesa'abyung gnas ni sa pho khyi lo la slob dpon rin chen pa dang dus mnyam du 'khrungs te/ bla ma shar pa chen po sku mched pa las slob gnyer mdzad/ yon tan du ma dang ldan zhing mkhan po shar la gzugs par grags pa phyis rgyal bu hu dkar che'i bla mchod mdzad/ 'jang yul du byon/ dgung lo so bdun pa shing pho khyi lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la mdo khams su bde bar gshegs so/ /yang jo lcam hor mo bya ba la/ slob dpon ma rin chen 'byung gnas gzungs so/ /de rnams zangs cha bsod rgyal gyi sras lcam sring brgyad yin no/ /slob dpon phyag na la/ jo rdo ḍi lu ma ma cig mkha' 'gro 'bum bya

rgya bod yig 67 mo/ba yod pa la/ phyag na rang bde bar gshegs nas zla ba drug song ba dang / sa pho 'brug lo zla ba dang po la bdag nyid chen po ṅgārma pha la rak+ṣi ta sku 'brungs te / 'phags pas zhal ta mdzad/ de'i bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir du/ shing khang bla brang du zha lu babs ched gnyer byas nas/ zha lu khang gsar bzhengs/ khu bos thugs brtsis shin tu che bar mdzad cing yon tan bum pa gang byo gnang /mdzad pa phrin las thams cad bla ma 'phags pa dang dbyer mi phyed zhes kun la grags shing / dgung 'o1 bcu gsum pa la 'phags pa bde bar gshegs nas/de'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rgya cher bsgrubs/ slob gnyer 'phro rnams shar pa ye seng pas mdzad/ bcu bzhi pa la gong du byon/ rten dge bsnyen yin yang bla ma'i gdan sa lta bu mdzad/ se chen rgyal po la zhus nas/ bla ma 'phags pa'i sku gdung ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i shel gyi mchod rten chen po dang / de bzhugs pa'i me tog ra ba'i sde chen po bzhengs/ rting la rgyal po ji big thi mur gyi sras mo/ dpal ldan gnang lo lnga bzhugs/ bde la bkod nas yar byon mdo khams su phebs shing / 'dis gdan sa lo bdun mdzad de / dgung lo nyi shu pa me mo phag lo smal po zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ mdo khams tre maṇ+ḍal du bde bar gshegs so/ /de'i jo mo stag 'bum bya ba la sras ṅgārma bha dra bya ba gcig 'khrungs pa gzhen nu la gshegs so/ /bla ma ye shes 'byung gnas dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa chu pho khyi lo la lung nag gnyer pa dpal rin gyi gzhi pa yod pa'i/ chos rin skyid bya ba la bla ma'i sras gcig 'khrungs pa ni/ bdag nyid 239

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (shechen po bzang po dpal ba de skyes stobs kyi thugs rab phun sum tshogs pa mnga' yang / sku gzhen nu'i dus slob gnyer la sogs mdzad rgyu cher ma byung /sman tshe'i yul sogs su yun ring byon dgos pa byung bas/ bdag nyid chen po dharma pha la sku gshegs nas/ lo bco brgyad kyi bar la gdung brgyud dri ma med pa dang phrin las dbyer med pa/ shar pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pas gdan sa mdzad/ 'chad nyan sgom sgrub/ gzhan phan bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad ces grags so/ /phyis khang gsar ti shi sangs rgyas dpal bas bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i dbu 'don gong du zhu ba legs pa la brten nas/ ol ja du rgyal pos bdag nyid pa sman tshe nas gdan drangs gdung brgyud du mnga' gsol/ nga'i bla ma'i gdung chad du phangs pas dbus gtsang du byon nas gdung brgyud 'phel bar gyis gsungs pa'i lung gnang nas thog mar gong du ma cig hor mo la sras slob dpon chen po bsod nams bzang po lcam sring gnyis 'khrungs pa'i bsod nams bzang po ni lcags mo yos lo pa yin/ gzhon dus byang ngos su gu'i gung mdzad/ de rting gong ma a yu par pa ta ge gan rgyal pos pa'i len dbang gi mtshan dang / sras mo dpon mo murnya gan gnang / yar byon mdo khams su sku gshegs so/ /bla ma bdag nyid chen pos dbus gtsang du phebs nas/ rgyal po'i lung bzhin jo mo lnga khab tu bzhes shing / gdung brgyud gcig pa'i gdan sa 'dzin mkhan gzhan med pa'i don gyis yab mes kyi chos lugs dri ma med pa rnams la gsan sbyong yang mdzad/ bla ma 'phags2 ṭ+wāṃ 0dang dharma pha la'i phyi rten bzhugs pa'i

rgya bod yig zung chen mo/gser thog g.yu thog dang / lha khang chen mo'i thigs khang du dkyil 'khor mi gcig pa drug brgya sum cu rtsa dgu 'bri ba shing mo lug la lcags ri chen po bskor pa sogs kyi zhal bkod mdzad cing bstan pa dang rgyal khams gdan sa'i phyir tu phrin las rgya chen po mdzad/ gdan sa'i dpal 'byor mnga' thang yang bla ma 'di'i ring las che ba ma byung zhes grags so/ /bla ma 'dis lha khang bla brang du lo bco lnga bzhugs/ bu yan du rgyal pos gu shi gnang nas gzhi thog tu bskos gdan sa lo zhe lnga nas re gsum gyi bar du lo bcu dgu mdzad do/ /re gsum pa shing pho byi ba'i lo la gzhi thog gzim khang du bde bar gshegs so/ /bla ma 'di nyid la sras yongs su grags pa dgu/gzhen nu la gshegs pa bzhi/ sras mo gnyis te rigs kyi sras lcam sring bco lnga byon/ gong du smos pa'i ma cig hor mo la sras bsod nams bzang po lcam sring gnyis bod du phebs nas/ yar 'brog dpon chen gyis jo mo phul ba'i ma cig mang mkhar ma kun dga' 'bum zhes pa ngang mor grags pa la/bla ma dam pa kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba ni yab dgung lo so brgyad bzhes pa'i dus sa mo phag la 'khrungs te/ 'di'i rnam par thar pa ni bla ma 'phags pa dang tshul mtshungs shing gong du byon/ si ti pha la yi khyung ge gan rgyal po'i bla ma mdzad/ ti shi'i mtshan gsol/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen por gyur te/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa me mo yos lo zla ba gnyis pa la me tog ra ba'i sde chen por zhi bar gshegs so/ /yang ma cig nam mkha' rgyal mo la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba mkhas btsun chen po nam 241

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//mkha' legs pa'i blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni/ yab dgung lo zhe bzhi pa'i dus shing pho 'brug la sku 'brungs te/ skyes stobs kyi thugs rab dang yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' zhing / khyad par chos skyong che chung la nus pa thon par grags so/ /gong nas ku sha la go lug rgyal pos kon ting gu shi'i mtshan dang shel gyi tham kha gnang / gdan sa lo bcu dgu mdzad/ dgung lo so dgu pa chu mo lug gi lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes brgyad la gzhi thog gzims khang du bde bar gshegs so/ /de'i gcung che ba gzhen nu la sku gshegs/ chung ba slob dpon chen po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni yab dgung du gshegs pa'i lo shing pho byi ba la sku gcings te ku sha la go lug rgyal po'i bla mchod mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu pa la pho brang dang nye sar bde bar gshegs so/ /yang ma cig kun dga' nam mkha'i rgyan la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba slob dpon chen po kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni/ yab mes kyi chos rnams thugs su chud nas gong du byon/ 'ja' yan du rgyal po'i bla ma mdzad ti shi'i mtshan gsol/bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen por gyur te/ me tog ra ba'i sder zhi bar gshegs so/ /de'i gcung che ba bla ma dam pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni/ yab dgung lo zhe dgu pa'i dus lcags khyi lo la sku 'khyungs te nyer gnyis pa la gong du byon/ ye sun the mur rgyal po'i dus su chang gu'i gung mdzad/ 'ja' yan du rgyal po'i sku tshe'i smad dang rin chen dpal rgyal po'i ring tho gan the mur rgyal po'i sku /sdo stod rnams te rgyal po rim pa gsum

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/gyi bla ma mdzad/ ti shi'i mtshan gsol/ bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad de dgung lo lnga bcu pa phag gi lo la/me tog ra ba'i sde chen por zhi bar gshegs so / / gcung chung ba gcig gzhen nu la gshegs so/ /yang ma cig red mda' ma lha cig nyi ma rin chen la sras lcam sring gsum 'khrungs pa'i gcen de gzhen nu la sku gshegs/ de 'og slob dpon ma kun dga' 'bum/ chung ba dbang kun dga' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni yab dgung lo zhe bdun pa'i dus sa pho spre'u'i lo la sku 'khrungs te/ gong ma tho gan the mur rgyal pos pa'i len dbang gi mtshan dang / gser gyi tham kha bod chol kha gsum la shes su bcug pa'i lung bzang po dang / sngar dbang bsod namasabazang po'i jo mo yin pa'i dpon mo'u bha gan dang bcas pa gnang / dgung lo nyer dgu pa me pho byi ba'i lo la srad phu'i sa cha blubs tshag tshig bya bar sku gshegs so/ /yang ma cig zha lu ma gzhen nu 'bum la sras mched bzhi 'khrungs pa'i/ che ba ta'i dben gu shi kun dga' nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba ni/ gzhen nu nas yab mes kyi chos lugs rnams phul du phyin par mkhyen te/ ti shi kun blo bzhugs dus gong nas gdan 'dren byung / byon nas si ti pha la yi khyung ge gan rgyal po'i bla mchod mdzad/ ta'i dben gu shi'i mtshan dang shel gyi tham kha gnang / 'gro ba mang po la phan pa rgya chen mdzad de chu pho khyi lo la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te ta'i tu'i pho brang chen por bde bar gshegs so/ /de'i gcung che ba 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni yab dgung lo zhe dgu pa'i dus lcags pho khyi la sku 243

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//'khrungs/ 'di ni 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos yin par phyogs thams cad du grags pas/ rgyas par rnam thar du lta'o/ /dgung lo so lnga pa shing pho spre'u'i lo zla dang po'i tshes bcu gcig la/ rin chen sgang gong ma'i gzim khang du zhi bar gshegs so/ /gcung bar pa bla ma dam pa chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni/ yab dgung lo nga gcig pa'i dus chu pho byi ba'i lo la sku 'grungs te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang dngos yin par the tshom mi za'o/ /gu shi'i mtshan thob cing tho gan the mur rgyal po'i bla ma la gdan 'dren rim par byung na'ang / chos kho na don du gnyer nas ma byon bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad nas dgung lo drug cu re bzhi pa shing mo yos lo zla ba drug pa'i nyi shu lnga la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i bla brang bkra shis sgang gi gzim khang du bde bar gshegs so/ /gcung chung ba gcig gzhen nu la sku gshegasazer/ de rnams kyis bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i sras lcam sring bco lnga'i rnam thar zur tsam bstan zin pa'o/ /bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i sras de rnams la brgyud pa ji ltar 'khrungs/bla brang gang gang gi zhal bdag mdzad pa ni/ gong du dbang bsod nams bzang po'i jo mo dpon mo bhan+da gan la slob dpon chen po ra sne shrī bya ba shing pho byi ba la gzungs nas dgung lo nyer lnga pa sa pho byi ba'i lo la rgya yul du sku gshegs so/ /ti shi kun dga' rgyal mtshan la bsnyen rdzogs ma mdzad gong du ma cig byang pa mo la/ slob dpon rte/ po chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/po ba chu pho spre'u'i lo la 'byungs shing / kun spangs pa'i lcam mo la slob dpon chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba yang chu pho sprel lo de ka la sku 'khrungs te/ tho gan the mur rgyal pos ta'i dben gu shi'i mtshan dang / lung bzang po gnang sku mched 'di gnyis kyis/ lha khang bla brang du bzhugs so/ /bla ma mkhas btsun chen po'i ma cig dpon mo dge 'dun 'bum la sras slob dpon chen po kun dga' rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba sa mo yos la sku 'brungs te/ tho gan the mur rgyal pos tho ling shi ta hu ta'i dben gu shi'i mtshan dang / shel gyi tham kha gnang gzhi thog bla brang bskyangs/ gdan sa mdzad de dgung lo drug cu re gcig pa sa mo yos lo la/ gtsang chu mig ring mor bde bar gshegs so/ /dbang kun dga' legs pa'i jo mo gung thang khab pa'i lha cig kun skyong rgyal mo la slob dpon ma bsod nams 'bum gzungs shing / ti shi grags pa 'od zer gyi dpon mo/ ma cig dge 'dun 'bum la sras che ba bla ma chen po bsod nams blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba ni/ yab dgung lo nyer lnga pa'i dus chu pho spre'u'i lo la sku 'khrungasate / yab mes kyi chos lugs dang che ba'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' zhing dgung lo nyer gsum pa'i dus/ khong rang gi dpon skya slob dpon rin bzang gi do dam byas/ rdzong kha'i rtsa bdag dpon chen kun dga' bzang po'i nu bo dpon gzhon nu dpal gyi tsha bo dpon don grub dpal bya ba las rdzong ri nyos nas/ stag tshang rdzong kha'i 'gram shing pho rta lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes lnga nas gting/ dgon rdzong bla chen pa sku mched la phul ba yin/ sum cu bzhes245

nga tshe tshe na 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//pa'i glang lo la tho gan the mur rgyal pos gser yig pa dharma kirti dang / a'i bu dben shi snga rting du mngags/ ti shi'i mtshan bod nas gsol cing gcung po la sa'i len dbang gi las ka dang / stag tshang rdzong khar chu mig khri 'og gang yin gyi mda' sgo sleb du chug gsungs pa'i lung bzang po dang bcas pa gnang / bla chen pa gong du gdan drangs/ rgyal po'i bla ma mdzad/ dgung lo so gcig pa chu pho stag lo zla ba bcu pa la me tog ra bar bde bar gshegs so//de'i gcung gcig gzhen nu la sku gshegs zer/ gcung chung ba slob dpon chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba ni/ me pho byi ba'i lo la yab sku gshegs nas zla ba drug song ba dang sku 'khrungs/ gong ma tho gan the mur gyis/ pa'i len dbang gi mtshan dang thong dzi g.yas g.yon gyi khrims ra nyi monub phyogs la shes su bcug pa'i lung bzang po dang bcas pa gnang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por grags shing khrims gnyis kyis mdzad phrin rgya chen po mdzad/ dgung lo zhe gcig pa me pho 'brug gi lo zla ba dang po'i nyer gnyis la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te stag tshang rdzong kha'i gzim khang rnying mar bde bar gshegs so/ /'di pa sku mched pas dus mchod bla brang 'dzin skyong mdzad do/ /'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa bsnyen rdzogs ma mdzad gong du ma cig zha lu ma la sras bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa 'khrungs shing / 'di pa yab sras khu dbon pas rin chen sgang bla brang 'dzin skyong mdzad/ phyis chos rje bla ma dam pas bla brang dus mchod pa la sbyar nas dbon brgyud rnams kyis /rdo 6khang bla brang skor dang shab dge lding

rgya bod mig tshang za mo/la sogs 'dzin pa 'di'o/ /yang bla ma mched de rnams la dbon sras ji ltar 'khrungs na/ lha khang pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa bsnyen rdzogs ma mdzad gong du ta'i dben byang pa'i jo mo la sras che ba/ chos rje kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba sa mo glang la sku 'khrungs te mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' zhing / dgung lo re bzhi pa'i dus chu pho 'brug lo la rgya nag rta'i ming rgyal pos gdan 'dren la mngags pa'i gser yig pa ta'i twa bzhin dang / a nu dri hor pa rnams kyis bsus nas gnam thad kyi pho brang dang / rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar byon/ rgyal po'i bla ma ti shi mdzad/ cing gyo/ ta'i ching / ha wam/ si then/ shang shen/ thim dang/ta'i kom/ kom mi'i/ ba wo bod skad du bsgyur na phrin las sna tshogs rgyas pa/dam chos mchog tu rgyas pa/ yang dag pa'i ye shes snying rje rgya chen kun la rgyas par phan pa/ zhing srungs shing / bstan pa bshad pa/ yang dag par rig pa / theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ nub kyi mchog tu dge ba/ rdo rje kun khyab/'od zer chen po'i sangs rgyas zhes pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'di rnams gsol/ shel gyi tham kha dang lung bzang po gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pas mgo byas pa'i 'bul ba dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa gnang /lha khang chen mo phyag tu len pa la sogs/ gdan sa'i phyag phyir 'gyur ba'i thugs khur chen po bsnams pa sa sa skya pa'i bstan pa me ro slang pa lta bur gyur pas na sku drin shin tu che zhing rgya nag tu lo ngo gsum bzhugs/ shing pho rta lo la bod du phebs nas bstan pa dang / 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad de/247
