ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//dgung lo don bdun pa shing mo sprul gyi lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu la lha khang chen mo'i yang rtser bde bar gshegs so/ /de'i gcung po bla ma chen po bsod nams bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes pa sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po 'di nyid kyis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don yun ring du mdzad de/ sa pho byi ba'i lo la dpal ldan lha rtse rdzong gi gzim khang du bde bar gshegs so/ /lcam mo gcig yang 'khrungs/ yang dpon chen dbang phyug dpal gyi jo mo dpon mo skyid dpal la drung chos rgyal ba'i sras gnyis byung ba ni/ bla ma rdo rje rin chen pa dang bla ma ṅgā mi dpal lo/ /gzhi thog kun rin pa'i jo mo nyi thog dbon mo la sras gcig 'brungs pas gzhen nu la gshegs shing / mnyam med dbon mo la 'khrungs pa'i sras che ba/ blo grosargyal mtshan pa la rgya nag rta'i ming rgyal po sa/ rta'i gu shi'i mtshan dang /gser tham gnang gdan sa mdzad/ gcung po grags pa blo gros pa gtsang chu mig ring po dang shab smad na bzhugs so/ /yang dbang grags pa rgyal ma/tshan jo mo byang pa ma cig lā mo rin chen la/ sras che ba kun dga' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni/ yab dgung lo nyer gnyis pa'i dus me mo bya'i lo la sku 'khrungs/ tho gan the mur rgyal pos rta'i dben gu shi'i mtshan dang / lung bzang po gnang / dgung lo nyer brgyad pa shing pho byi ba la rta nag ri khud/ gser khang bla brang du bde bar gshegs so/ /de'i gcung po dbang rnam sras rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba ni/ yab dgung spo nyer lnga pa'i dus lcags pho byi ba'i lo'i zla ba da ṭ+wāṃ la sku 'brungs te/ tho gan the mur

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/rgyal pos khong rang gi sras che ba dang mnyam pa'i las ka ri rtsing dbang gi mtshan gser tham/ gser sgor/dngul sgor/ dbang hu/ hu ye/ byang shi ji ma rnams dang g.yas g.yon gyi khrims ra brgyad/ khrims kyi thi sa pa pha ming gcig pa'i hu shi rnyi ma nub phyogs la shes su bcug pa'i lung bzang po dang bcas pa gnang nas khrims gnyis kyi phrin las rgya chen po la mnga' brnyes par mdzad/ dgung lo zhe dgu pa sa pho byi ba'i lo hor zla bzhi pa'i nyer bzhi la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te smon mkhar rtse gdong rdzong gi gzim khang du bde bar gshegs so/ /yang rtse gdong pa ma cig sras 'dren la pa'i len dbang gi sras po slob dpon chen po chos kyi bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa ni/ sa mo phag gi lo la sku 'khyungs te/ gzhen nu nas yab mes kyi chos lugs/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gi rgyud lung man ngag phyi nang gi yon tan mtha' dag thugs su chud cing khyad par du chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs la mnga' tshad kyi yon tan bum pa gang byo/ bla brang rin chen sgang la gtogs pa'i gtsang phyogs kyi rdzong gzhis/ sa cha dbang rigs gang yod dang bcas pa gnang / rim gnyis zab mo la g.yel ba med cing /spru gro ba kun la byams dang brtse ba'i bdag nyid/ sems dpa' chen por grags pa de nyid/ dgung lo bdun cu pa sa pho spre'u'i lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la 'ja' 'od me tog gi char la sogs pa dang bcas te g.yas ru srin po ri'i rnam rgyal sgang gi gzim khang dmar mor bde bar gshegs so/ /'di dang yab yum gcig pa'i lcam mo slob dpon ma bkra shis 'bum bya ba 249

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//yang 'brungs so/ /yang tho dzi dbon mo la pa'i len dbang gi sras mo slob dpon ma byang sems bsod nams rgyal mo yang gzungs so/ /de rting bla chen kun rgyal ba'i jo mo snye mo sku zhang gi sras mo/ ma cig nam mkha' rgyal mo la slob dpon chen po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa sku mched gnyis 'khrungs te shab dge sding na bzhugs pa'o/ /lcam mo zhig kyang gcings so/ /de rting lha rtse ba bla chen bsod nams bkra shis pa'i sras gcig nyi shar dpon mo nam mkha' rgyal mo la 'brungs pa ni/ slob dpon chen po bkra shis rgyal mtshan pa des theg chen chos rje'i gdan sa mdzad do/ /lha khang chen mo na bzhugasaso / / yang gzhi thog blo gros rgyal mtshan pa'i sras gcig yang zur du 'khrungasapa nang chen rim pas dbu 'don zhabs tog mdzad nas/ slob gnyer gsan sbyangs mthar thon pa dang / gzhi thog gi gdan sa'i 'os su byed do/ /yang ta dben kun dga' legs pa'i hu shi'i lcam mo zhes pa la slob dpon ma kun dga' 'bum zer ba gcig byung ngo / /yang dbang rnam sras pa'i sras po gnyis/ sras mo lnga gzungs pa ni/ snga sor ma cig nyi ma 'bum bya ba la slob dpon chen po kun dga' blo gros pa zhakhrungs te/ sa pho byi ba'i lo la bla brang rin chen sgang gong mar bde bar gshegs so/ /yar 'brog pa ma cig bsod nams 'bum la/ sras po slob dpon chen po nam mkha' legs pa'i blo grosargyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba yab dgung lo bzhi bcu pa'i dus sa mo yos lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga la 'brungs te/ dgung lo bcu drug pa'i thogashing pho rta lo la theg chen chos rje'i sdi sbyin las rgya nag rta'i ming rgyal pos hu

rgya pod yis tshang chen mo kya ho dbang gi mtshan dang / gser tham/ bod la shes su bcug pa'i lung bzang po dang bcas pa zhu ma dgos par gnang nas/ khrims gnyis kyi mdzad pa phrin las dar zhing rgyas par bzhugs so/ /de'i lcam mo che ba slob dpon ma nam yar 'brog ma/mkha' 'bum dang / 'dzom lha rtse ma/pa rgyal mo/ kun dga' shangs pa ma/'bum/ lha mo zur rtsa ma/rin chen/ nam mkha' rgyal mo phrag na ma bya ba dang lnga gcings so/ /mdor na dang po gnam lha mched gsum nas/ de lnga yan la/ gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa lnga song zhing so sor gyes pa'i rnam grangs ni/dgu bcu go bdun yod la lcam mo nyi shu rtsa gcig byung bar bzhed do/ /tshe rabs kun tu dpal ldan bla ma la/ /mi phyed dad pa 'i shugs kyis kun blangs nas/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar thor bu tsam/ /bris pa'i dge bas bstan pa 'phel ba dang / /brgyud 'dzin sku tshe dpal 'byor rab rgyas te/ /gdul bya rnam mkhyen sa la myur 'khod shog /'khon gyi gdung brgyud byon tshul mdor bsdus ni/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul sna tshogs las/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don la 'jig rten du/ /'khon gyi gdung brgyud mu tig phreng ba la / / byon pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus nyi shu lnga/ /rgyas par phye na rnam grangs dgu bcu bdun/ /hor gyi bla ma sa paṇa chos rgyal 'phags/ /kun blo kun dga' legs 'byung kun rgyal dang / /bla chen bsod blo yan la ti shi drug /rgya nag rgyal po'i ti shi theg chen yin/ /rgyal brgyud gtsug rgyan rnams kyi chos khrims dar/ /bla ma'i dbon po rgyal po'i sras kyi dod/ /'gro mgon phyag na bsod bzang kun dga' legs/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan bzhi po pa'i len dbang / /25/

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//tho dzi g.yas g.yon khrims ra gsol gzims yin/ /rnam sras rgyal mtshan bu'u che'i mtshan/ /ri rtsing dbang dang khrims ra brgyad po ni/ /dbang hu hu ye ja shī zi ma bzhi/ /g.yas g.yon 'jig sun gsol gzims yig tshang dang / /las chen ru gnyis bcas pa yin zhes lo/ /rtsa ba'i hu shi phing gcig mi dpon de / / dbang dang khrims ra byings po'i tha sar bskos/ /rgya nag rgyal pos nam mkha' legs pa la/ khu kya dbang bskos rgyal khrims bde bar skyong / khrimasaganyis dar zhing bde ba'i phrin las mdzad/ /'khon ston dkon mchog rgyal pos sa skya'i 'gram/ /chu mo glang gting drug cu skor drug ste/ /shing pho stag 'dis lo grangs sum brgya dang / /drug cu re gcig song zhing 'phags pa'i dus/ shwakya bzang pos me pho 'brug lo la/ /lha khang chen mo bzhengs nasashing stag yan/ /drug cu phrag gsum gnyis kyi chad pa song / khreng mo lug la bdag nyid chen po dang / /dpon chen ang len dus su dpon po ri'i/ /lcags ri lha chen lcags ri phyi ma'ang btab/ /'bri khung bcom pas stod hor rgol ba bzlogs/ /de nas shing stag srog rme brgyad dkar dbus/ /yod pa 'di yan lo grangs brgya phrag gcig /bdun dang bcas pa song zhes rgan rabs gleng / /sa skya paṇa chen drug cu re drug dus/ /me mo lug la e chen go dan dang / /byang ngos mjal nas sa sprel yan chad la/ /hor dang sa skya brgya dang bcu drug bar/ /yon mchod mdzad rting rgya nag rta'i ming byon/ /de nasashing stag yan la drug cu bdun/ /song zhing rgya dang hor gnyis bla ma dang / /232

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/dbang gi khrims ra 'dzin pa sa skya pa'i/ /gdung brgyud rim pa'i phrin las dar rgyas shog /༈ chos rje'i bu chen shar /zhu /༷ ri la sogs byon tshul su sti/ chos rje sa skya pa khu dbon gyi slob ma'i thu bo shar nub gung gsum/ khang gsar chen mo ba dang bzhi ru grags pa'i/ shar pa'i gdung rus ni zhang zhung sngags rnying ma ba jo 'bum zhes pa'i sras gsum gyi gcen po bla ma shar pa ye 'byung / chos rje pa la rab tu byung des dpon chen shākya bzang po las bla brang shar nyos nas bzung / dgung lo drug cu rtsa bzhi thub/ gnyis pa slob dpon rdo rje 'od zer/ shar gyi gdan sa lo bdun mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gnyis thub/ gsum pa slob dpon 'od zer 'phan/ rten dge bsnyen yin/ khong sku mched kyi lcam mo'i sras bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje pa dang shar pa ye 'byung gi slob ma yin/ gong ma se chen me gha la'i bla mchod byas/ bla ma rdo rje 'od zer gshegs rting shar gyi gdan sa lo bcu dgu mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa drug thub/ shar pa chen po rab tu ma byung gong gi sras phyug mo rje btsun skyabs la 'khrungs pa'i mched gsum ka 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i slob ma yin/ gcen po bla ma dus 'khor ba ye shes rin chen/bla ma 'phags pa shing kun na 2 5 /sa gdan 'dren pa la sa skya pa spyis

pa tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (shobardzangs/ phyis rgya yul du byon/ se chen rgyal po'i thugs la btags nas ti shi mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun la rtse lngar gshegs so/ /sras gnyis pa bla ma kun dga' seṅges sa pho sprel lo la bla ma'i gsung bzhin gong du byon/gong ma dang rgyal bu a nan+ta'i bla mchod mdzad/ dbus gtsang du phebs dus shar gyi gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa dgu mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad thub/sras gsum pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan sa pho rta la gzungs/ me mo phag lo nas se chen gyi lung gis sa skya gzhi thog gi bla mchod lo bco brgyad mdzad/ nyi ma re la chos dung lnga lnga 'bud pa byung / phyis gong du yol ja du rgyal pos gdan drangs nas ti shi mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu la gong du gshegs so/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga'/ dpal sa skya'i mnga' thang bla ma de'i dus su che ba lags/ bla ma shar pa kun seng dang ma cig mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi sras che ba slob dpon chen po seng ge dpal/ dgung lo sum cu la rgya yul du gshegs/ gnyis pa kun dga' bsod nams pas/ gdan sa lo sum cu so bzhi bzung / dgung lo drug cu rtsa gnyis pa me pho khyi lo la gshegs/ gcung po slob dpon chen po kun dga' rin chen pa dang ma cig nam mkha' rgyan pa'i sras che ba/ slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan pas gdan sa mdzad/ da lo dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes/ gnyis pa slob dpon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ gsum pa slob dpon nyi ma gzhen nu pa sku gshegs/ nub pa'i thog ma/ slob dpon 'u yug pa bsod nam seng gis chos rje pa la2 jug de la slob dpon zangs tshas nyi

rgya bod yig char mo thog phog de'i gcung po gcig gi sras bla ma kun smon yang chos rje pa la thug de'i gcung po kun dga' mdzes sku mched gnyis phyis dpon chen kun dga' bzang po'i phyogs su chad nas bla ma 'phags pa'i thugs dang ma ma thun pas/se chen gyi lung gis sprugs nas gcen po sman tshe'i yul du 'das/ de'i dbon po yon tan dpal/ nyis dbon po sangs rgyas dpal zer ba gcig gis nub kyi gdan sa mdzad/ gung pa ni chos rje pa'i slob ma skyo ston dri med/de nas dbon brgyud med par slob mas gdan sa bzung ba la/ bla ma dar ye/gung pa dpal rgyal/ gung pa sher rgyal/ gung pa bkra shis bzang po/ gung pa blo bzang / de 'das nas/ yang dge bshes bkra shis bzang pos gdan sabaskyar nas byas/ khang gsar chen mo ba'i brgyud pa ni/ dang por sum pa grags rgyal gyi sras/ bla ma grags pa 'od zer des bla ma shar pa rdo rje 'od zer dang / ye pa'i btsun pa yin/ phyis bla ma 'phags pa'i dbon gnyer rgan pa thob/ slob dpon dharma pha la'i phyag phyi la gong du byon/ bla ma dus 'khor ba'i rjes la se chen gyi dus su ti shi mdzad nas dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa la gong du sku gshegs/ de'i gcung po'i sras bla ma sangs rgyas dpal ba'i dus na khang gsar bla brang bzung / gong du ol ja du rgyal po dang / go lug rgyal po/ bu yan du rgyal po gsum gyi ring la ti shi mdzad nas/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad nga la/ gong du sku gshegs/ 'dis bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba sman tshe'i yul nas hor rgyal po sgrol ja du dang mjal ba'i mthun rkyen mdzad pas sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud kyi zhabs tog byas pa che bar byed 255

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ( )do / / de'i sras bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan pas gu shi mdzad nas/ rting la dbus kyi te tsha yon tan khang du khang gsar ba rang gi nye gnas nam mkha'i g.yog gis khrims med byas pas nyes blang nas sa skyar byon/ phyag rdzas thams cad dbus gtsang mnga' ris kyi dge 'dun la gser zho 'gyed byas/bla ma bdag nyid chen po la gser gar bu'i lha chen dang / khyad nor mang po phul/ khong pa rang khang gsar chen mo nas mar gseb nas spu bton pa bzhin du/ kun spangs mdzad pa'i dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug la rta nag gi brag ske rags can du grongs/ phung po lhag med du 'gro rgyu yin na'ang nye gnas kyis zhag bdun nas sbur la reg pas lhag ma dum gcig lus zer ro/ /de rting khang gsar ba'i pha spun ring po'i brgyud slob dpon chen po nyi ma rgyal mtshan pa/ gong du gu shi mdzad nas grongs/ de'i sras slob dpon chen po bde legs rgyal mtshan pa'o/ /sngon tshe sa skya bla mas bod khams bskyangs pa'i dus/ /dus bzang skal ldan slob mas chos bzhin byas pa'i mthus/ /mthu chen bla ma'i gdan sa rgyal po'i ti shi thob/ /thob pa de 'dra phyin chad 'byung pa'ang e srid ang / /bu gcig ma ltar 'gro la brtse ba'i sa paṇa gyis/ /bu chen slob ma'i tshogs kyi byon tshul 'di bris pas/ /bu ram shing pa'i brgyud kyi bstan pa 'phel byed pa'i/ /bu slob 'phags pa'i dge 'dun phyogs bcur dar bar shog/ //256

rgya bod mig tsha rim mo// sa skya pa'i blon po dpon chen dang nang blon rim pa'i byon tshul bzhugs/su sti/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa 'di dang /hor rgyal po yon mchod du 'brel nas gtsug lag gnyis da'i sgo nas/ bod khams bskyangs pa'i phyir/ zhar la byung ba dbus gtsang dpon chen gyi rim pa ni / thog mar dpon chen la snga ba shākya bzang po/ de la chos rje sa paṇa dgung lo drug cu re gsum pa/ shing pho 'brug lo la hor rgyal po se chen go dan gyis/byang ngos sprul pa sde'i pho brang du gdan 'dren la/ gser yig pa rdo tha shi byung nas/ gshegs pa'i dus bla ma 'u yug pa dang / shar pa ye 'byung ma gtogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyang phyag 'tshal du cugs sa skyar gzhi rgan pa la bskos nas bzhag bla ma 'phags pa'i dus se chen rgyal po'i lung gis zan klu gun min dben shu'i ming dang tham kha gnang nas dbus gtsang gi dpon chen la bskos/ khang gsar chen mo btab/ me pho 'brug lo la bla ma 'phags pa gong nas 'byon pa'i bsu ba la/ dpon chen pas kyang byon/dpon slob rnams gye re lha khang du phebs pa'i nub mo bla ma'i zhal nas mi kho pa la nye gnas go chod byung bas lha khang 'di lta bu bzhings thub 'dug ste gsungs pa dpon chen pa sku rgyab na yod pas gsan nas/ bla ma dam pa mnyes na 'di tsam gcig rgya mthongs nang du tshud pa'i lha khang gcig bzhengs 237

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa mi'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//pa lags zhus pas nan ltar legs gab/ngas/ de 'phral la thig tshad byas yar khyer/ 'dam sog yan dbus gtsang gi khri stong mi sde rnams la bka' shog bkrams mi lag bskul nas/ de kha'i lo la lha khang chen mo'i 'gram gting / lcags ri nang ma/ lcog spe 'bur lcog chung dang bcas pa brtsigs pa'i dus su/ dbus phyogs kyi bu slob rnams kyi kha 'dzin la dpon kun dga' rgyal po bskos nas/ spe tshal/ dga' mo grong / snang tshal la sogs 'dzin pa yin zer/ lha khang chen mo'i shing cha rnams drangs nas 'og thog ci rigs phugs tshar ba'i mtshams/ dpon chen gyi ngang la sa skyar sku gshegs so/ /'di sa skya pa la yus po che'i mi gsum gyi rgan pa blon po drin can du 'dug pa la khong gi dbon po bsod dbang 'das rting dus mchod kyang mi gnang ba la dpon chen dbang brtson gyis lha sa gro khud phul byung ba mo gzhung rnams la gzhis chung re yod pa rtsad nas dus mchod pa gtsugs yod pas/ dpon chen dang nang so sus 'dzin gyis 'di bzhin gyi do dam byed dgos so//dpon chen shākya bzang po'i rjes la nang gnyer ba kun dga' bzang pos dpon chen tshang ma lo drug byas/ de'i bar la lha khang gi 'og thog thig khang / lcags ri lcags chung zha khas su chug par byas/ gser 'phru chen mo gtsug chos rje sa paṇa gyi nang rten byang chub chen po'i gser sku dang / la khang gi khyams la ri mo thams cad kyang grub par bzhengs/ rin chen sgang bla brang dang / dbu rtse byang /lha khang bla brang dang bcas pa 'debs pa'i do dam byas/ kun dga' bzang por las ka gtad nas bya rog tshang 2 5 ṭ+wāṃ drug bsdad pa'i bar la dpon chen

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/shad bcun dang phyug po sgang 'khar ba/ byang rin gsum po/ bla ma'i zhal ltar rim gyis bskos/ kun dga' bzang po la/ bla ma ma mnyes nas rtse chen gyi lung gis sang gha ching sang gis mgo byas rtsa ba'i hor dmag 'bum phrag gcig gtang nas dmag lam stang tshang lung pa la zhugs/ khang dmar gyi sa mkhar la mtshon kha blangs/ de rting bya rog tshang la skor rgyag byas nas lcags pho 'brug lo la dpon chen khrims la bsgral/ de nas yun mi ring bar bla ma 'phags pa yang zhi bar gshegs pas/ gong du zhu ba la nye gnas gzhen dbang bltas / se chen gyi lung gis byang rin la dpon chen bskos/ son li si'i tham kha gling drug ma dang shel gyi sa tham yang gnang / rting la byang rin shangs sdong po thang gi sgar thog tu kun dga' bzang po'i g.yog snying dang 'dra ba bzhi yod pa'i gsum pa byang pa ye shes bzang pos bsad zer/ de nas dpon chen kun gzhon/ dpon chen gzhon dbang / de'i ring la phye gsal chen mo dang dbus gtsang gi khrims kyi zhib cha phal che ba byas/ de nas dpon chen byang rdor/ de nas/ dpon chen ang le bkra shis/ 'di'i ring la lha khang chen mo'i spen bad bkal/ rgya mthongs ka brgyad dang thig khang sogs la/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gyi thugs bzhed zhal ta bzhin/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mi gcig pa drug brgya sum cu rtsa dgu bzhengs/ shing mo lug lo la phyi'i ltags ri chen mo btod pa/ bla ma 'phagasapa dang dharma pha la'i phyi rten bzhugs sa'i gser thog g.yu thog 'gel ba/spon po ri'i lcags ri gtod pa jo mo gling 'debs pa/ dwags po dang / 'bri 259

'tshe tshen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()khung la dmag 'khyer ba la sogs gdan sa chen mo'i phyag phyi dang / zhabs tog byas pa shin tu che bar byed dwags por dmag 'khyer/ jus legs lon pa'i dus sa mtshams na brag la ang len gyi ming bris bzhag 'dug zer/gzhen dbang / byang rdor/ ang len gsum rka'i ring la sa 'bri 'thab/ ang len gyis dbon chen gyi ngang la rgya yul du byon/ a yu par pa ta bu yan du rgyal po dang mjal/ mi rabs kyi bar la yar 'brog khri dpon 'jags pa'i lung bzang po lon/ de nas yang dpon chen gzhen dbang la skyar nas bskos/che gsal la sogs pa rnams 'di'i skabs su byung bar yang byed do/ /de nasadabon chen legs pa dpal/ dpon chen seng ge dpal/ dpon chen 'od zer seng ge 'dis san jing dben gyi dam kha yang bzung / de nas dpon chen kun rin/ dpon chen don yod dpal/ dpon chen yon btsun/ yang dpon chen 'od zer seṅges bskyar nas byas/ de nas dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po/dpon chen dbang phyug dpal/ dpon chen bsod nams dpal/ dpon chen nam mkha' bstan pa'i tshab la yang dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po khyon gyis bskyar nas bskos/ de nas dpon chen dbang brtson/ dpon chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dpon chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ dpon chen dpal 'bum/dpon chen grags dbang / rting ma ming gi dpon chen la a mo gha pa rnams byung ngo / /mdor bsdus na chen po hor dang dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /yon mchad mdzad ring dpon chen byung tshul ni/ shākya kun bzang zhang btsun sgang mkhar ba / / byang rin kun gshon gzhon )sdung byang rdor dang / /ang len gzhon

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/ dbang bskyar ma legs pa dpal/ /seṅge dpal dang 'od zer seng ge dang / / kun rin don yod dpal nas yon btsun byung / /'od zer seṅge bskyar rnying rgyal ba bzang / /dbang phyug bsod nams dpal dang yang rgyal bzang / /dbang btsan grags rgyal blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / /dpon chen dpal 'bum grags dbang a mo gha/ /yan la nyer bzhi bskyar ma gsum thi ba'i/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun dbus gtsang dpon chen gyis/ /bla ma'i bka' dang rgyal po'i lung bzhin du/ khrims gnyis bskyangs nas rgyal khams bde ba dang / /bstan pa'i gsal byed gyur pa'ang byung bar gnang / /de mthun mdo stod gon gyo mdo smad gling char ste/ /chol kha re la dpon chen re yod do/ /sa skya nang chen gyi rim pa ni/ thog mar/ nang chen kun dga' bzang po / khong dpon chen byas nas de'i tsha'o dpon chen gzhen nu dpal/ dpon kun gzhon/ dpon don grub dpal/ dpon blo/ zhal lu dpon shes/ ston pa rin chen dpal lung gis bskos/ ston pa ring mo/ jo btsun kun shes/ nye gnas kun dga' 'phel/ dpon yon btsun grags pa dar lung gis bskos si tu'i tham kha byung / yang gsar bskos byang rin bsam du dban sha lung gis bskos/ nye gnas nam mkha' rgyal mtshan lung gis bskos/ dpon kun rin/ nye gnas 'bum skyabs/ nam mkha' dpal du dben sha nye gnas bzang po dpal/ dpon po chos rgyal/ dpon seṅge rgyal mtshan/ shes rab 'od zer du dben sha'/ de'i shul du dbon po dkon mchog rin chen/ nang pa 'phags pa dpal bzang po/ nang pa kun dga' 'bum/ nang chen kun 26

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//dga' 'phags/ nang chen rab 'byor 'phags so/ /'di yan la nang chen gyi rim pa nyi shu rtsa dgu bskyar bskos gnyis dang sum cu so gcig byung bar gda'o/ /dpon chen nang chen rim pa'i byung tshul 'dis/ /mi chen blon chen bya las 'dzin pa rnams//brtse chen khur chen 'khur cing chab srid kyis/ /sa chen bde chen thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ /// dbus gtsang khri skor gyi gtso bo zha lu pa'i dpon rabs byon tshul bdog go /su sti/ 'gro ba'i bla ma dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /'jam dbyangs rnam sprul rim pa'i sku drin las/ /dbus gtsang 'dir yang khri stong dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /sde dpon stobs ldan che snyan mang byung ba/ /de'i nang nas rigs bzang sku nye zhing / khri skor bcu gsum dag gi mchog gyur pa/ /zha lu sku shad byon tshul 'di ltar grags/ /de'ang 'di ltar thos te/ sngon bod rgyal po khri sde 'od srungs dang / btsun mo cog ro bza' rgyal mo legs la sras gcig byung ba / mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i btsun mo che ba tshe spong bza' skar rgyal la sras skyid lde nyi ma mgon dang / chun ma bal bza' phan rgyal la/khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal byung ba'i gcen 'dis/ sngon la stod phyogasasu byon/ gu ge pu rangs rnams kyi mnga' bdag mdzad pa la sras gsum byung ba ni/ dpal gyi mgon dang / ba/6 ༷sa nyi ma mgon/ lde gtsug mgon

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/rnams la stod kyi mgon gsum zer ro/ /yab sras de pa'i brgyud ni stod kyi rgyal brgyud rnams yin no/ /gcung khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal yang /rting la stod phyogs su sprugs/ mnga' ris gung thang man la chags/ sras dpal lde dang / 'od lde/ skyid lde rnams byung ba la smad kyi lde gsum zer/gcung skyid lde de 'jad rta nag skor du phog pa la/ sras drug byung ba'i lnga'i brgyud/ 'bro btsad dang mud 'jad la sogs byang phyogs la yod/ sras gcig gtsang grom pa dang / shab stod smad/ nyang stod smad du byon pas nyang yul du sras gsum byung ba'i che ba la khyung btsad/ bar pa la 'bre btsad/chung pa la lce btsad zer/ khong mched gsum gyis nyang stod smad la yul bgos/ sa ris byas pa ni phu ha'o gangs bzang nas/ mda' gcung g.yu ba gdong yan la bod 'brog cha mnyam pa'i yul sde chen po gsum du phye sde/ phu byang shar ri nang spang mkhar la gtad/ mda' lho nub/ gangs ye sham bu la bstan pa/ seng 'gros su yod pa la yul sde chen po gcig tu byas te/ gcen khyung btsad kyis bzung ba'i sa mtshams/ gtsang gang brag kha yan yin/'di'i sa khong gis phu na 'brog sde chen po gsum yod pa ni/ gam mā rgyang sanying ru gsum mo/ /bar na tshong 'dus chen po gcig yod pa ni/ sal ma tshong 'dus bya ba yod de phyis bkag nas gnas snying du 'phos pa'o/ /sa khog de rnams na mi rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis yod pa ni/ drag shos rnams shes rab che/dge las la brtson khyung rin chen grags la sogs mkhas grub bzang po rnams rim par byon pa'o/ /mi phal shos rnams/ sdig shas che nya dang ri 263

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i rmos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//dwags rngon pa'o/ /zong sna mi 'dra ba gsum yod pa ni/ zhwa mo/ snam phrug phad phyar dang gsum yod do/ /yul sde na phu'i 'brog sde che ba/ mda'i zhing sa khyon chung bas/ cha ma snyoms par sha se khog tu nyo tshong byed pa byung ngo / /bar pa 'bre btsad kyi dbang ris/ gtsang gad brag kha man sna'o brag thog yan la/yul sde chen po gcig tu byed pa/ de'ang phu byang shar/ sa la ba'u dang / mda' lho nub/ gab phya dkar la bstan pa seng 'gros su yod do/ /phu'i 'brog sde chen po gsum ni/ rgyang mkhar dang / skyid mkhar dang / ma ngag rnams so/ /bar na tshong 'dus chen po gcig ni mdzo sum brgya'i thug gu tshong 'dus byas pa yod do/ /mi rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis ni drag shos rnams shin tu phyug la/zhan shos rnams dbul zhing phongs pa'o/ /zong sna mi 'dra ba gsum ni/ rnga ma/phying pa/ sle khra rnams yod do/ /phu'i 'brog sde dang / mda'i zhing sa cha snyomasapas/ sha phyed tshong du byed pa 'byung ngo / /chung ba lce btsad kyi dbang rigs/sna'o brag thog man/ gcug pa yu ba gdong yan la yul sde chen po gcig tu byed pa/ de'ang phu byang shar/ 'khor stod la kha dang / mda' lho nub phyug sgo gzhung la bstan pa seng 'gros la yod do/ /de'i phu na 'brog sde chen po gsum ni/ sgrol/ lcags/ ra gsum mo/ /bar gyi tshong 'dus chen po gcig ni gtsang tshong 'dus mgur mo yin no/ /mi rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis ni/ drag shos rnams/ mdzangs shas che la/ phal shos rnams khram shas shin tu che'o/ /zong sna mi 'dra ba gsum ni/ gtsang ther/ dar skyegs/ star zon rnams yod do / / phu'i 'brog sde chung / mda'i zhi /khyon che bas ma snyoms pas/ sha

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/gzugs tshong byed pa byung ngo / /btsad po mched gsum/ de ltar du yul bgos byas pa gzhan gang dang gang cha snyoms par byung na'ang / gam ru'i g.yam pa legs po de la gang yang yong / mi 'dzad pa'i gter dang 'dra ba'i khyung za dang g.yam pa'i rgyal po zer ba byung zhing / da lta'i bar la khyung g.yam du grags pa yod do/ /dus phyis rting / mched gsum la dar rgud byung ste yul sde gsum ga gcung po lte btsad kyis bzung / de gong du/ nyang stod gzhung phal che ba zhing la thag ma dang mig chu la brten pa las med pa la/ lce btsad/ shes rab dar 'byor stobs che bas sa rgya 'di la bed chod thabs dgos pa 'dug zer nas/ nyang stod kyi byang rgyud du rtsa rnams kyi rgyal ka dang /lho rgyud du spang yul bzheng gi 'od rka bya ba dang / nyang smad byang du spa tshab ka mo che dang / lho ru pa snam rka mo che rnams bzos/ rka bo che re re'i 'og na zhing son khal khri tsho re yod par byed do/ /gnam ka mo che rnams bzos rka chen bzhi po ma 'jag bar la bsrung mi sdod pa'i sa mkhar gnyis bzhengs pa ni/stod du rgya grong lte mkhar ba/ smad du spa snam lte mkhar gnyis/ lce btsad kyis bzhings pas na lce mkhar du chags pa yin la/ de lta bu'i ka chen bzhi dang /mkhar gnyis ni da lta'i bar du yod cing sa gdan la bde chos che bar byung bas na lce btsad kyi byas pa lag rjes shin tu che bar gda' zhing / zhal lu ba'i dpon brgyud 'di gdung rus btsad po/ lce btsad kyi brgyud par byed cing / de nas gdung rabs mang rabs song ba/ bod du bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog ma la/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcus mdo smad du byon/ bla chen dgongs pa 265

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (//rab gsal las rab tu byung bstan pa'i me ro smad nas slang ba'i dus lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis nyang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ chos sde btsugs/ de la slob ma bu chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ba'i nang na mgo dmag g.yu drung bya bas sbre lha khang bzhengs rgyan gong du bzhugs/ de'i dngos slob bu chen lte btsun sher 'byung gis mkhan po la sa dmigs zhus nas/ zhal lu wa mo'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ chos sde btab/ khong rang gis rgya gar du byon/sdom pa skyar ma dang zab chos mang du zhus/ tshur phebs nas sde mnga' zhabasakun mched zla 'dzin du bston ste/ bstan pa'i bya ba kho na don du gnyer bas slob ma grags thon pa ka bzhi gdung drug bya ba byung bas/ da lta'i bar du zhal lu pa'i chos lugs zer ba 'di dar bar 'dug cing / de rnams lasamached pa zhal lu pa'i lha sde brgya skor zer ba gcig yang de dus byung bar gda'/ de rting / zhal lu ba'i mnga' thang stobs 'byor je cher la song ba'i tshul ni/ dbus kyi khri skor gzhan rnams las lhag pa'i che khyad rnam pa lnga bya ba yod de/ de'ang gdung rus btsad po yin pas che/ las kha bka' bzhi byas pas che/ dam chos rgya gar yin pas che/ de rnams ni gong du smos pa ltar ro/ /gdung brgyud sku zhad yin pas che/ sbyin bdag rgyal po yin pas che/ bya ba ni thog mar sku zhang bya ba'i lcam mo ma cig mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis/ 'gro mgon phyag na'i khab tu byon pa la sras bdag nyid chen po dharma pha la rak+ṣi ta 'brungs pa'i dus su/ zhal lu khri skor gyis dang slang byas nas/ dbon po'i bzhugs sa la shing khang bla brang dang sduX lu khang gsar bzhengs/ bkur sti

rgya bod yig tshang cha mo/ zha khas tog phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs pas bla ma dharma pha la nas gzung ste/chos rje bla ma sku mched/ bla chen kun rgyal ba yab sras la sogs/ deng sang yan la gdung brgyud khu dbon pa'i sku zhang na rim lnga'i bar du sku gnyer 'brel bas na/ sde bdag gzhan rnams las ches lhag par sa skya pa dang 'brel che ba'o/ /bla ma dharma pha la rak+ṣi ta gong du byon/ hor yol ja du rgyal po dang mjal dus/ bod dbus gtsang na nged kyi zhang po zhal lu khri dpon bya ba yod pa la lung las ka bzang po gnang dgos zhus pas bla ma'i zhang po yin na / nged kyi'ang zhang po yin du chug la khri stong byings pos phud du khur cig mi rabs kyi bar la khri skor 'jags su chug gsungs pa'i lung gtsang ma dang /rgyal po yon mchod kyi sku rim la dmigs pa'i gser dngul las grub pa'i rten gsum/ gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa bzhengs bar gyis/ gser bre chen brgya dang dngul bre lnga brgyas mgo byas pa'i gnang sbyin bzang po bskur/de'i cha rkyen gyis zhal lu gser khang du grags pa'i lha khang dbu rtse che chung rten ngo mtshar can mang du bzhengs/ tshong 'dus 'phrul dpe bzhengs/ de'i rting sku zhang kun dga' don grub dang / sku zhad grags pa rin chen pa'i ring la/phyi'i lcags ri mar btab 'di'i mtshams su/ rang byon 'phags pa gdan drangs/ zhal lu gnas khang dang / ri phug yang dgon btab/ chos dpon la chos rje bu ston kha che gdan drangs/ de pa yab sras la sogs mkhas grub mang po'i bdag rkyen zhabs tog mdzad pas da lta'i bar du thub bstan nyi ma ltar gsal ba 'di lags so/ /sku shad byon dang nyang yul chags tshul 'di bris 267

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//pas sku chen gyis mtshon bstan 'dzin yon mchod rnams sku tshe ring zhing / 'gro kun rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog // lha dbang sprul pa (rgyal rtse chos rgyal gyi brgyud )dpal ldan shar kha ba'i byon tshul bsdo kyigs/su sti/ 'gro kun mkhyen brtse'i thugs rje'i nam mkha' yangs pa las/shar ri'i rtse nas 'od zer stong ldan 'bar ba bzhin/ /shar phyogs ldan ma las skyes mi chen shar kha ba/ /rigs bzang khungs btsun 'di pa lha dbang rnam 'phrul ltar/ /'ga' zhig sa skya pa yi nang chen blon po rin chen 'dra/ /'ga' yis phas rgol dpung 'jom dmag dpon rin chen dang / /deng sang bstan pa'i srol 'dzin chos rgyal chen po'ang byon/ /des na gdan sa'i zhabs tog bstan jus 'phel byed thabs/ /mdzad pa'i rnam thar rgya che grangs mang yang / /ngo mtshar phrin las rags pa zur tsam bri/ /de'ang dpal ldan shar kha bar grags pa 'di pa'i/ rigs rus mchod 'phreng ni rigs bzang ba'i dbang du byas na/ byang phyogs hor bod kyi so mtshams la nye ba'i sa na/ pha wang chen po 'bri 'dra ba kha shar la bltas pa gcig yod pa/ de'i rgyab ngos nas 'bab pa'i chu po la tsha skye gtsang po zer/ nub la 'gro ba mdun nas 'bab pa la 'bri chu zer/ shar phyogs ldan ma'i yul la 'gro ba/ de'i byang rgyud la ldan nyin brgyud pa dang / zhe ༷/da la ldan srib brgyud pa zer/ lung

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/chen de'i phyed smad tsam sked stubs la rgya hor gyi 'ja' lam chen mos gcad yod pa'i stod phyogs de la ldan stod/ sga pa'i yul zer bar 'dug cing ldan chu rgyud kyi mdo na tre bo'i yul yod pas/ dga' ldan tre bo gsum la dbang bsgyur ba'i jo bo'i rigs su gyur nas/ dang por chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su ldan ma rtse mangs zer ba'i sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po dang /gzhan yang ldan ma chos kyi byang chub zer ba'i chos rgyal dang / ldan ma byang khri byang dmar la sogs/ ma sang gi sprul pa'ang mang du byung bar 'dugagadung rus btsun pa'i dbang du byas na/ bod yul 'dir mi byung pa la snga ba'i rus ming mi'u rus bzhi bya ba dang / mi'u rgyud drug bya ba byung ba'i nang nas dmu tsha lha'i brgyud par 'dug pas na 'dan stod sga'i yul du/ sga a snyan dam pa zer ba'i 'byor ldan dkar phyogs la mos pa gcig byung ba de nyid kyis/ sna 'dan tre bo'i sa khongs su lha khang rgya phigs khyung mgo can brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha khang re'i nang du rten ngo mtshar can dang / bka' 'gyur ro cog cha tshang ba re bzhengs pa'i drung du/ dkar me khor yug mchod pa rnam lnga rgyun ma chad pa'i dge rgyun btsugs pa la sogs mchod phreng phun sum tshogs pa'i phrin las rgya chen po mdzad 'dug de'i dbon sras kyi brgyud pa ldan ma dbon po / bzang po rgyal mtshan/ yab sras 'khor bcas 'ga' zung gis dbusagatsang dag pa'i shid khams dang / khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i spyan sngar 'byon bzhed nas yar btegs byon pa/ nyi ma dbus phyogs su sleb pa'i dus su / khong rang gi yab mes mi shi ba lha ru skyes pa ldan ma dbang rgyal du grags 269

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gu pa gces bsdus (shepa'i lha btsun bzang po gcig yod pa de rmi lam du byung nas/ khyod 'dir ma sdod/ gtsang ru'i sa na dbus gtsang ru bzhi ru phye ba'i lhag po ru lhag zer ba gcig yod pas/ der song zhig zer bas/ 'u yug mda'i ru lag tu lo 'ga' bsdad/ yang lha'i lung bstan byung nas/ da yang gtsang po nyang chu 'dzom pa'i sa na bcud pa yu ba gdong bya ba yod pas der song la bsdod dang byus kyi yu ba zin par yod do zer nas yu ba gdong du thogs cing bsdad/ dpal ldan sa skya'i phyogs la 'degs par 'dod pa'i mtshams su/ lha na re nyang chu yar deng ba'i g.yas phyogs na/ gser la gras pa'i gnas gzhi gcig yod pas/ der sdod cig zer ba byung nas/ zha lu gser khang bya ba dang gzhis kha gser lding zer ba 'dug pa gang yin snyam pa la/ gser lding du gzhi phab/grong dpon phyug po chen po gcig 'dug pa la gnas po bcol nas sdad pas/sa cha yang 'phrod gnas mgron yang mthun par byung nas/ lo mang rab song zhing sras po des/ gzhen nu nas klog yig legs po shes/ yon tan dang ldan pas yul thams cad kyi dpon yig bzang po 'dis/ rang re la phan thogs par byung zer zhing khyad par gnas po che 'gu nas dbon po pa'i bu chung 'di dang / nga'i bu mo 'di bza' mi byed dgos zer ba yang yang du sleb pas/ bu mo lha mo sman dang dpon yig bzang po dpal ba yab yum du 'brel/lo 'ga' song nas yab rgan sku gshegs/ bu mo'i pha mas grogs ldan byas nas yab kyi gshegs brdzong la sogs lugs can sgrubs/ de rting bu mo'i rmi lam du tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya gang dī /cig shar ri'i rtse nas shar byung ba/

rgya po dmig tshang chen mo/ rang gi mtshan ma la zhugs te khong du thim song ba zhig rmis/ zla grangs thims pa dang sras po gcig bya lo la 'khrungs pas/ mtshan dpal ldan dar zhes pa btags so/ /de phyin zhal lu gser sding de khar bzhugs par 'dod na'ang /yang lha'i lung bstan la 'di nas shar lho phyogs kyi la rgyab pa'i pha rol der song zhig der nga'i 'dug gnas kyang chos shig bya ba thams cad yar 'phel du 'byung ngo zer ba byung nas/ yab yum sras bcas rnams kyis/ yar byon thar pa dgon par dpyal ston chos 'phags kyi drung du/ sras po la dge bsnyen dang byin rlabs zhus/ bla ma'i mtshan las gras nas 'phags pa dpal bzang po zer ba'i mtshan btags/ 'phags pa'i ming can mi rabs bdun gyi bar la bstan jus mnga' thang yar 'phel du 'byung bar 'gyur ro gsungs pa'i bka' gnang / de nas la rgan la byon nas/ bod mkhar sngon mo lung du bzhugs pa'i nub mo lha byon nas da 'di khar gzhi thob/ stod kyi brag mtha' yod sar nga'i rten tshugs zer ba byung nas bzhugs pas/ ldan yul sngon mo lung du grags pa byung ngo / /de'i skabs su yul pa'i mi sde phyug po rnams sa skya nang sor 'dab skor 'bul du 'gro ba'i yig rigs dgos pa'i grogs ldan la dpon yig bzang po dpal bas kyang thengs 'ga' byon pas/ sa skyar nang chen gyi yig mkhan la sgor/ de nas yun ring ma 'gyangs par bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba'i sku drung du yig tshang pa'i 'thil bzhugs thob/ thugs rjes sa zung bas mnga' thang yar 'phel byung zhing / ma cig lha mo sman la sras po 'phags pa rin chen dang / ma sangs dar po ba sngon mo lung du 271

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (shā'abrungs so/ /bla mas zhal ta ba yig mkhan bzang po dpal gyi bu chung che shos kyang nga'i rtsar zhog pha rjes kyi las tshan la 'jug dgos gsungs pas/'phags pa dpal bzang po bas dgung lo bdun brgyad las mi 'gro na'ang /sa skyar bla ma'i sku drung du phul yab kyis bris klog legs par bslabs/ ma sangs kyi sprul par song bas gzhan las 'khrungs skyes che zhing / bya ba'i rnam dbye shin tu mkhas pa gcig byung bas de dus sa skya pas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum thams cad mnga' zhabs su bcug nas/ lho mon gyi sa cha rnams/ ji bzhin rang ma chug shar dung / lho dung du grags pa'i dung reng mang pos 'u yug gos sngon dang / shangs sdong po thang tshun lhor rgyud phal che ba'i yul pa rnams bcom/ hor bod kyi gser yig khrims 'dul ba la 'byon lam dog po rang byung bas bla mas zhal ta khams pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyi mgo byas khams gtsang gi drung skor dpa' rkyen 'dzom pa bdun/ dung reng gi kha mnon la nyang stong du song las/ dpung mi la gang dgos khri stong so sos thongs gsungs pa byung dus/ gzhan mi drug po'i dmigs tshang nas/ da nged rnams kyi grogs la yi ge shes pa gcig gtong bar zhu zhus pas/ 'phags pa dpal 'di na phra na'ang kha ta bslab bya byas pas bya ba shes pa gcig yod par 'dug de khrid song gsungs nas khong rnam pa'i zla la byon/ mi bdun po'i bzhugs sa 'thil bgol lung bzung du byas/ de'i shar thad kyi steng gong la phya ga'i na gzhung bya ba yod pa der/ dung reng yod pa'i skabs su/ dmag snar btab nas bsgug na gzhung de'i ༵༵ nang sa dmar gong kha/ lho na phra gong

rgya bod yig tsha ri chen mo/ kha / shar na khru lung gong kha/ de gsum gyi dkyil na/ sgar pa de yod pas na/gong gsum shar kha bar grags pa 'di de nas byung bar 'dug khams pa bzhugs ring la'ang / dung reng gi kha mnon rab tu byung mgo yul stong gsum/'bri mtshams gangs seng dkar po/ phag sgang tsho drug rnams kyis mi brtsis dud grangs pa dang khrims 'cha' ba la byon dus/ bong nag mdo chen du khams pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan sku gshegs/ zhal chems la da khyed rnams kha mang ro tshogs kyi rnam pa ma byed par/ dpon yig 'phags pa dpal 'dis mgo dpon pher ba 'dug pas/ nga'i tshab tu khur las dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zhabs tog grub pa zhig gyis gsungs pa'ang bzhag cing / de rting lha jo khrid dang / nam mkha' dpal ldan shis mgo byas/ dpon rnam pa drug 'tshogasanas khams pa'i rjes zin cing / dung reng thul ba zhig dgos tsa na/ rang re rnams mo phywa su bzang gcig la dpon tshab 'chol lo zer nas/ chu dmag rgyud gnyer chen a mo/ shel mgor/ ri chu thang gsum 'dzoms sar mo phywa byas pas/ 'phags pa dpal ba'i dgung lo'i steng du bya'u dang tshe dkar mo dang bcu gsum la ding ding kha le dkar po bab pas/ khong dpon thog tu ston/ gzhan rnams zhabs la btud nas/ mdun ma rtse gcig tu 'dril ba'i cha don 'gag don bsdams/ dpal ldan shar kha ba'i bstan pa'i mgo sngon ma de nyid nas tshugs par byed do/ /de mtshams dbus gtsang gi khri skor thams cad bcom nas/ dung reng 'dul ba'i bgros bsdur/ dbus pa khri skor gyi dmag rnams yar 'brog pho ma na khor bsags/ 'phags pa dpal 273

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//ba'i skor rnams gong gsum shar khar snar bcas sku zhang kun dga' don grub pas mgo byas/ gtsang pa'i khri skor gyi dmag rnams kyis 'u yug gosasngon nas dung reng rnams ded/ gtsang bye ma dkar nag gi 'gram shar ra gtsang kha la byas/ rong ri nang gi mtshams ri dpal ldan zur gsum la 'dur 'dud dung reng dpon don grub dar rgyas nas de bzhin gyis shog zer nas phobs pas/ zhal lu ba'i sgar thad thon nas gam byang sbud ri la byas/gur gzha' ri khug pa la dung reng rnams 'chur ba la/ gong gsum gyi sgar pas mthar 'ded byed rtsis la don grub dar gyi lab sprad nas/ dpon 'phags pa dpal khyod bsam pa che na/ nged mi chad rta chad rnams srog lasa'athong ngas zla ba rting ma'i nang du shar dung gang yod mi nor rnams ngo lta ba la slebs pa byed zer bas de bzhin phug byus che bar 'dug bsam/ bzang chad byas nas gtsang mar btang bas/ khri skor rnams kha chag nan ltar che zhing / sa skya nas kyang khrims phog pa tsam byung na'ang / ngas dung reng dang bzang chad byas yod pas dus tshes 'di bar brtag pa mdzad dgos/ de rting thog 'jog ma byas byung na nyes pa mi 'bur khag med zer ba zhus/ zla dus kyi mtshamasasu / don grub dar gyis shar dung la gtogs pa'i mi sna drag btus rnamasakhrid 'bul snod bzang po khyer byung nas/ mi khyod kyis bzang po byas phyin/ nga yang bzang po byed pa yin/ da phyin khyed kyi zhabs la 'thud zer nas/ nged ltar byas lho brag shar gyi/ chu skyed lung gsum lho brag gya ba bzhi/ phu 'a lung skyogs mo nas mda' tsag sa wa 2 7 4 yan gyi mkhar btsan sa phal che ba

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ thams cad phab/ mi nor dbang rigs thams cad mnga' 'og tu bcug shar dung gi mi drag ngo ltas pa rnams las 'dzin la bcug pas gzhi chags nas/dung reng gi mi brgyud nyang stod na da lta'ang mang rab yod do/ /de rting lho dung 'dul ba la dgongs nas phag ri rin chen sgang du phebs/ sto spas 'gro ban 'phrad pa'i blon po grags pa 'od zer bya ba 'jam bgros kyis kug zas chang dang / zhwa gos la sog thas ster sbyin bzang po rim par byas pa la gzhan yang 'gran 'dug pas lho dung gi slob dpon drag tshad mang po phag rir bos/ zas chang gi kha brid nas mi drag ba yis brgya drug cu tsam bsad/ mgo lag gnad che ba rnams rin chen snang gi mgon khang dang / sgo rnams kyi them 'og na yod/de rting phag ri rnam rgyal gyi rdzong / bla ma'i bka' bzhin brtsigs/ spa 'gro had stag lung la sogs lho dung gi sa cha thams cad 'og tu bcug phag ri'i las sgo che chung rnams btsugs/ rdzong dpon sngon ma gcung po phag rin pa bskos/ de ltar shar dung / lho dung rnams rim par thul bas dpal ldan saskya man/ sto byang gi so mtshams mi sde rnams bde ba la bkod cing / bla ma'i zhabs tog dang rang jus kyi bya ba don grub shin tu che bar byung 'dug de mtshams sa skya nang chen gyi go sar yang lo 'ga' bzhugs shing / mi tsag sag shi dar ra kha che ti shi kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i phyag phyir/ gong du brdzangs/hor tho gan the mur rgyal po la zhus nas ta'i si tu'i mtshan dang / dam tag 'ja' sa blangs/ sham po rtse dgu'i ldan ma lha khang dang / bde yangs chen mo bzhengs/ chos sde btab rdzong rtse chen bya bar ming btags/ rgyang mkhar 275

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'argyung gces bsdus/ (nagyi ri bsrung ba'i khang pa gcig brtsigs/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi pho brang gi sa yin pas rgyal mkhar rtse zer/ lcang ra dang / rgya grong gi mkhar brtsigs/ de rting phag mo gru pa si tu byang rgyal ba dang thugs mnyes 'brel zab yod pas/ sne gdong du byon zer byung ba la/ thugs bkal nasabyon pas si tu byang rgyal ba grongs pa dang thugs bros pa rnams kyis gsang yags byas mtshams su phebs/ gra phyi tshong 'dus su phyag phyi dge rgyuganyer chosargyal/slong shāka bzang dang / dpon g.yog gnyis bzang btson du sgor ba'i skabs su/ rtse chen nas a po bkras rdor dang / yar lung rgyud snang bu ba tshang dang / sa skya dgon chen la sogs kyi dpon zhen can rnams kyis sems khur byas pas dpon g.yog rnams tshang ma yar la thon/ gnas rnying du bzhugs/rtse chen/ lcang ra/ rgya gro rgyud dpon yig dpon seng / nang na 'phags rin pa sku mched bzhugs pa la sne gdong nas/ nag po tshul bzang dang / dpag shi dkon mchog gi mgo byas dmag dpung stobs can 'byer nas/ lcang ra la bskor rgyag byed grabs la dpag shi dkon mchog la mda' phog nas 'das pas dmag dpung bros thabs la phyir log dgos byung bas/ dpal ldan shar kha ba'i bstan jus kyi gzhi gcig de nas tshugs par byed do/ /ta'i si tu 'phags pa dpal bzang po ba'i sras che ba nang chen kun dga' 'phags pas rgyal mkhar rtse'i rdzong dang / 'dol chung gi sa khar bzhengs/ stag rtse rdzong phag gru pa'i lag nas blangs/ gzhan yang rdzong gzhis/ mnga' zhabs/bu rta gsar du chod pa mang bar byung /21skya nang chen gyi go sar bzhugs nas/

rgya bod mig cha 'a mo/ sde srid chen po'i bstan jus yar 'phel gyi mdzad phrin rgyas par byas so/ /gcung po ta'i si tu bsod nams dpal bas rdzong rtse chen bzung nas/ phyi nang du dgra thon gyi blang dor bde gzar ci rigs pa dgos pa byung nas/ ma sangs kyi sprul pa thabs la mkhas pa'i skyes bu dpa' mdzangs 'dzom par 'dug pas/ mthar thug dgra gnyen blang dor ma nor ba'i 'dul skyong sa skya pa'i zhabs tog srid la gtogs pa rnams kyi mgon tshul bzhin du mdzad pas ma las bu dga' ba'i rdzong gzhis/ shab seng ge rtse/ 'jad/ bo dong la sogs pa'i mnga' zhabs gsar 'phel rgya chen po rim par chod cing / phasargol gyi dmag dpung ji tsam byung yang 'jam rtsub gang la gang 'os kyi sgo nas/gnad theg par byung zhing rgya rta'i ming rgyal po ta'i si hu'i mtshan/ dngul tham/lung bzang po dang bcas pa gnang nas/ dpal ldan sa skya pas thog drangs/gtsang srid spyi sgos kyi bstan pa'i srog shing lta bur bzhugs pa 'di lags/de'i sras che ba dpon po rgya mtsho ba/ sku na gzhon rab la gshegs/ gcung po dpon po rin chen 'phags pa la/ rgya rta'i ming rgyal pos su si'i las kha gnang zhing / rgya bod kyi bya ba'i rnam dbye la mkhas pa sde srid 'dzin skyong gi mdzad phrin rnams/ yab las kyang mi zhan pa byung ba'i snyan grags yar 'phel du bzhugs so/ /'phags pa rin chen pa'i sras po che ba brtse chen chos rje pa/ mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud de rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po de nyid/ 'gro ba'i 'dren pa la sku brtan par bzhugs so/ /de'i gcung dpon po gang pa ba dang / chen po dbang rgyal 277

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (re/'phags pa/ rgyal chen pa/ yang dpon po shākya dpal ba dang / dpon po bde legs pa rnams byung bas/ chen po dbang rgyal bas sa skya'i nang chen bzung /nang ltar kyi mthun sbyor mdzad/ mi mthun phyogs pa gnam gyi thog tu ri bo ltar ljid lci ba zhig byon par gda'o/ /yang ma sangs dar po'i sras a chen bzang po dpal ba yin cing / de'i sras dpon po rgyal mtshan dpal ba dang /nor bu 'phags pa yin no/ /nang chen kun dga' 'phags pa'i sras mched gsum byung ba'i che ba/ rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pa ma cig bzang mo dpal ba la/ nyang stod rgya grong du sa mo sbrul gyi lo 'byung ba lnga ldan gyi thog tu sku 'khrungs pa/ 'di ni nges par byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa ste/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rags pa tsam brjod na/ chos khrims dang rgyal khrims gnyis da'i sgo nas bstan par bya ba la/ dang por sku gzhon nu'i dus nas zhi dul dang ldan pa la sogs chos mthun gyi yon tan du mas mdzes shing /dgung lo gsum pa nas sems dpa' chen po chos kyi rin chen pa de nyid kyis rjes su bzung / bcu bzhi pa nas/ dam pa de'i zhabs rdul spyi pos blangs te/sems bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i dge ba'i las sgo du ma nas bsgrubs shing /dgung lo nyi shu pa la mes po bdag chen/ g.yung lu ta'i hu ta'i si tu 'phagasapa dpal bzang po ba sku mched kyi thugs rgyud la tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir du / phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mang po zhal phye ba'i sgrub mchod chen mo dang /bshad sgrub kyi gzhi btsugs srol gtod/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la/ yab rje dam pa nang chen kun dga' 'phags pa da~X 8/ ma cig bzang mo dpal ba'i sku drin

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ bsab phyir du/ dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi sgrub mchod yun ring dang /sman lha/ 'jam dpal/ sgrol ma la sogs 'bum gter lnga lnga dang / gzungs sngags byin brlabs can rnams kyi bzlas brjod/ sa ya/ bye ba/ dung phyur bsgrubs shing / bsgrub pa rgyun ring pa'i gzhi rten bzang po btsugs/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug dge legs dpal ba spyan drangs nas/lcang rar chos gzhi gting lung rigs smra ba brgya phrag bzhi lhag res chos kyi dga' ston spel/ nyi shu rtsa drug pa la chu bo chen po nyang chu la bkod pa phul du phyin pa'i zam pa chen po btsugs/ de'i steng du bkag chen bzhengs/ sum cu pa'i dus sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad rgyal phur 'dzoms pa nas brtsams te gos sku chen mo mthong ba don ldan gyi dbus na ston pa'i sku khru brgyad cu pa/mdzod spur de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs pa/ ldem la mchog gnyis g.yas g.yon na mar me mdzad dang byams pa khru lnga bcu pa/ mtha' bskor du gnas brtan bcu drug khri'i dkyil na/ mgon po ben dang / zur gnyis na dharma ta la dang / rnam sras/ mtha' ran la lan tsha'i gzungs mang pos bskor ba bzhengs/ gang gi lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba'i mthus/ /gos bzang du ma las grub ston pa'i sku/ /brgya phrag khru'i mthar son med byung 'di/ /skye bo kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir bsgrubs/ /de rting gser 'phan chen mo'i dbus na/ byams pa'i sku tshad khru bcu phrag bzhi/ ldem la/ 'jam dbyangs dang / spyan ras gzigs/ nyan thos mchog gnyis khri'i 'og la/mgon po gri gug can bzhugs pa'i/ gser 'phan chen mo gcig dang /279

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//gzhan yang / gos dar la mtho bcu phrag bdun pa'i 'phan brgyad kyi dbus na / nye ba'i sras brgyad mtho bcu phrag bzhi dang ldan pa bzhengs/ sngon chad skye bo kun gyi blo yul du/ /gang gi bkod pa tsam yang ma shar ba'i/ /gos bzang du ma las grub mdzes pa'i sku/ /yid 'phrog 'phan gyi gzugs la bzhugs pa rnams/ /lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i thugs ldan pa/ /mi dbang chen po'i rnam thar phrin las las/ /skal ldan skye bo 'bum phrag du ma yi/ khri/da la thar ba'i sa bon bsgrub phyir bzhengs//sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel ba'i phyir du / rgya mtsho'i mtha'/ ka tsa ma'i grong khyer du sku gcings nas/ /dbus 'gyur rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan ngo mdzad pa paṇa chen shrī sha ri sur+ya mahā so nas thog drangs/ rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta rim par spyan drangs bdag rkyen bzang po mdzad/de rting bstan pa'i bdag po 'di nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ 'di ltar byung ste skye 'gro rnams kyi phan bde ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las 'dug bstan pa'i gsal byed lung rtogs thos bsam la rag las 'dug pas bstan pa dar zhing yun ring du gnas pa'i ched du/ dge 'dun gyi sde chen po / gtsug lag khang gcig cis kyang bzhedas dgos dgongs pa la/ yang yang du byung nas/ ma ga dha rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhing khams/ theg pa chen ngo 'i chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa'i gnas mchog gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i ljongs/ bstan pa rin po che nyi ma ltar gsal ba'i sa chen/ kha ba can zhes grags pa'i nang tshan rdo rje gdan nas dpag tshad brgya dang 2 /zha bgrod pa'i sa/ mkhas grub du mas

rgya bod yig char mo/ byin gyis brlabs shing / skye bo rig pa'i nor gyis phyug pa mdo sngags bstanapa rin po che'i 'byung khungs/ nyang stod rig pa'i 'byung gnas khyad par du mang pos bkur ba'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi pho brang / rgyal mkhar rtse zhes grags pa 'di'i nye logs chos kyi sde chen po/ nyin mo legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston gyi nyi mas blo gros kyi pad mo rgyas par byed cing / mtshan mo lung dang rigs pa'i chu rgyun gyis thub bstan yid bzhin nor bu'i byi dor legs par byed pa'i/ lung rigs smra ba brgya phrag bcu dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i dgongs don legs par rtogs nas/rim gnyis zab mo'i tshul la brtson par mdzad pa/ brgya phrag lnga dang spong ba bsam gtan gyis sgrub pa la bzhugs pa/ brgya phrag sogs dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i bzhugs gnas/ ri bo rtse lnga dang ldan pa'i ngos pad mo kha bye ba lta bu 'dir/ chos grwa chen po dpal 'khor bde chen gtsug lag khang bcas pa bzhengs pa'i dus ni/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po chos kyi dbyingasasu mdzad pa bsdus nas/ lo sum stong lnga brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum song ba'i dus/ sa pho khyi'i lo chu stod zla ba yar ngo'i tshes gnyis/ rgyal phur 'dzoms pa la 'gram gting gtsang khang ka chen brgyad rgya phibs khyad chos du mas mdzes shing / rnam thar sgo gsum dang ldan pa/ khyams ka ba bzhi bcu zhe brgyad kyi sa/yongs su ka ba brgya dang lnga bcu'i khyon/ phye 'bur chen bcu gnyis/ thog rim pa gnyis mda' yab kyis 'khor yug tu mdzes pa/ gser 'phru khru nyi shu rtsa lnga'i tshad dang ldan pa de'i dbus su ma ga dha rdo rje gdan gyi mahā bho dhi'i sku 281

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (shetshad bzhin du byang chub chen po'i sku/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'adi lcags pho byi ba'i lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad rgyal phur 'dzom pa la/sprul pa'i bzo bo dpon mo che skyabs pas bzhengs shing / de'i g.yas g.yon du mar me mdzad dang byams pa/ sems dpa' bcu drug mgon khang du gur mgon lcam dral/sgo bsrung / rgyal chen sde bzhi rnams lder sku ba/ dpon mo che rdor rgyal gyis bzhengs/gtso bo'i ldem gnyis dang /gas la'i dbus su/bkra shis sgo yangs/ bar du cho 'phrul dang / lha babs/ mtha' gnyis su dbyen 'dums dang rnam rgyal/ rigs lnga la sogs sku gzugs du ma lan tsha'i yi ge'i rgyan rnams sprul pa'i lha bzo ba/ bal po dze'i te tsa dang zangs mgar ba a war pa rnams kyis sa bzhengs/rgya chen phul du byung ba'i gtsug lag khang / /phun tshogs lha'i bkod pas mdzes pa can/ /rab dkar grags pa'i ba dan g.yo ba 'di/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu las myur du grub/khyad par du/ byang chub chen po'i sku 'di nyid lcags mo glang gi lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes brgyad/rgyal phur 'dzom pa la zhabs su byon nas/ gzungs bzhugs la dbu'i gtsug tor na/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i ring bsrel bcu phrag gsum la sogasapas thog drangs pa'i sku'i stod smad pad gdan dang bcas pa'i cha la byin brlabs che ba'i rten bkra shis pa'i rdzas bsam las 'das pa bzhugasa'itshul mdor bsdus ni/ 'dzam gling yangs pa'i skyed tshal 'dir/ /mkhas grub pad mo'i ge sar las/ /sku gdung ring bsrel sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /dad ldan bung bas bsdus pa dang / /rnal 2 /da kyi lha tshogs rnams/ /yid 'phrog

rgya bod yig mo pan na slo/ ri mor bzhengs pa dang / /mdo sde'i gsung rab yongs rdzogs rnams/ /rnam dag thugs da'i khyon la bzhugs/ /sku smad lha'i skyed tshal du/ /gzungs bzhugs pad mo rnam mdzes pa/ /byin rlabs bung ba 'khrigs pa 'di/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing du bsgrubs/ /rten gyi rnam grangs bcu phrag ni/ /sku smad tsam la'ang bzhugs gyur pas/ /'di las phul du byung ba'i rten/ /'jig rten 'di na ci zhig mchis/ /gzhan gyi brgya phrag dka' bas bsgrubs gyur kyang / /gzungs bzhugs tsam gyi cha yang mi 'grub pa/ /med byung 'di 'dra sgrub pa'i mi dbang mchog /dam pa'i rjes su bzung ba'i rnam 'phrul yin/ /blo gros nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i khyon/ /bsod nams rta ljang shugs kyis rab drangs nas/ /gtsug lag khang gi skyed tshal yangs pa 'dir/ /phul byung lha'i pad mo rgyas par mdzad/ /'di dag gi rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan (dang po'i thig rtsa dang bzo bkod kyi ra 'dro ga mkhan kyang rje 'di yin no/)pa dang / sku zhang nam mkha' mchog grub dpal bzang po bas gtso mdzad pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa lnga brgya cam 'khor dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po dang bcas nas rab gnas mnga' dbul rgya chen po mdzad pa'i skabs su/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rnam pa sna tshogs pa skye bo kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa byung bas na/ brgya phrag lnga ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs/ /gtsug lag khang chen 'dir ni mngon khrig ste/ /phyi nang dkyil 'khor brgya phrag zhal phye nas/ /rab gnas rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ji bzhin bsgrubs//rgyal ba sras bcas dngos su bzhugs pa'i sku/ /'di ni 'dzam gling 'di na kai 83

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (shernam mdzes zhes/ /lha dbang shin tu dad pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /sna tshogs me tog char rgyun 'bab par gyur/ /gtsang khang chen mo dang / steng gi gzhal yang khang / khyams/ skor khang steng 'og bar gsum/ steng gi 'khor g.yab/ glo 'bur shar nub steng 'og mgon khang la sogs pa rnams na/ gser sku/ lde sku / gzhal yas khang blos slang logs bris/ ngo mtshar can rnams kyis yongs su gang bar bzhugs shing / rten gtso bo'i spyan snga na/ gser kong / dngul kong / dngul gyi lhung bzed dang / maṇ+ḍal chen mos thog drangs/ lha khang spyi sgos kun na mar me khor yug dang / mchod pa'i rgyun phun sum tshogs pa btsugs gda'/ dgung lo sum cu so bdun pa shing mo sprul gyi lo la/ lcagasari chen mo phyogs re la gzhu 'dom nyis brgya brgyad cu re yod pa/ lcog bcu phrag gnyis kyis spras shing sgo chen drug dang ldan pa/ ljon shing gi ra bas yongs su bskor ba bzhengs/ so dgu pa/ lug gi lo la sku 'bum chen mo bkra shis sgo mang gi 'gram gting nas/ lo mang ma 'gyangs par zhabs su phyug cing 'di'i mtshams su/ sku 'bum dang gos sku rting ma'i dkar chag ri khrod dga' ldan btab lugs rnams mdor bsdus 'jug cing / de'ang dge 'dun gyi sde chen po/ gtsug lag khang / rten dang bcas pa dang / ngo mtshar can 'di rnams bzhengs pa'i sbyor ba brtsams pa nas/ sa phyogs der/mtha' dmag dang rgya nad la sogs pa'i yams nad ngan pa/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad kyi mtshan ma tsam yang med cing / chab srid dar la/ dkar phyogs 'phel ba/ dge ba bcu la 2 8 4 spyod pa la sogs dge zhing bkra

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/shis pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan par gyur to/ /kun gyi mngon sum du mthong ba'i/ phun sum tshogs pa chen po bco brgyad dang / nye ba'i phun tshogs bco brgyad dang ldan par grags so/ /gzhan yang / 'di'i dmigs rkyen bzang po la brten nas/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir gser sku/ gos sku/rdo sku / lde sku/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa gsung rab bri ba/ chos sde 'i byegs pa / ri rgya klung rgya bsdom pa la sogs dge ba'i las la longs spyod pa du ma'i rtsa ba'i rgyur gyur to/ /phun tshogs dge la brtson pa'i mthu ldan pa/ /mi dbang mchog gi mdzad pa'i dmigs rkyen las/ /gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i 'dzin ma 'dir/ /rgya chen dge ba'i 'bras bu phyogs bcur rgyas/ /dri zhim me tog rgyas pa'i skyed tshal nas/ /bung ba'i na chung 'phur lding g.yo ba'i sgras/ /rna ba'i dga' ston dgyes pa ji bzhin du/ /gang gi grags pa'i rnga sgra phyogs bcur khyab//sa skyong gang de'i lag bsam dkar ba'i mthus//'khor 'bangs thams cad dge ba'i gos gyon zhing / khrel yod rin chen rgyan gyis legs spras te/ /sems can thams cad bde ba'i lam la bkod/ /mi dbang de'i rnam dkar thugs rgyud las/ /'khrungs pa'i dge las byas dang byed 'gyur dang / /'gro kun phan bde bsgrubs pa 'dir ltas na/ /byams mgon rgyal ba'i sprul par kun gyis bsngags/ /ces pa rnams chos khrims dar bar mjad pa'i tshul zur tsam bkod pa'o/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i blon chen gyi thu bo / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i srog shing lta bu/sde dpon chen po 'di nyid kyis rgyal khrims bde bar bskyangs pas chab srid mnga' thang yar 'phel du byung ba'i 285

brtse chen 'od snang la /ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (shetshul ni/ sku gzhen nu'i dus nas rtsa ba'i dpon sa/ 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rin po che rnams la/ dad gus dang ldan zhing / zhabs la thug gcung po sa skya nang chen gyi go sar skyal/yang / khu bo bgres rim rnams gtsug phud du 'bur/snga sor mnga' zhabs bde thabs la dgongs nas/ yar lung sne gdong la skor gcig byon dgos pa byung dus kyang / chos 'jig rten gang gi phyogs la'ang kun gyi mthun snang du grub cing smon par byung / 'di nyid kyi thugs rgyud dge ba'i shugs kyis/ nang ltar gyi sde gzar la'ang / gting 'jags gtsang ma thon/ sde srid chen mo 'dzin pa'i go sar phebs nas kyang / rgya rta'i ming rgyal pos ta'i si tu'i mtshan dang / tham kha/ lung / gnang sbyin bzang po dang bcas pa zhu ma dgos par gnang / stag tshang rdzong pa dang / dpon slob srid jus sngar las kyang nye bar 'brel nas bdag po mi dbang chen po nam mkha' legs pa'i thugs sras dam par gyur/ dpal ldan lha rtse rdzong gi gnyer lasabazung nas zhabs tog tshul bzhin du bsgrubs/ gzhi thog gdung brgyud pa'i sku phra mo nas dbu 'don zhabs tog gang dgos/ nye gnas chen po'i bya ba rnams don dang mthun par mdzad/ mnga' zhabs spyi mthun du lus sems dge ba la bskul ba'i ngang nas drag zhan go ma 'dzol zhing / spyi snyoms che ba'i skyong thar mdzad pas/ kun gyis chos rgyal chen por mtshan gsol/ sku nye 'brel chab srid du gtogs pa thams cad la'ang legs nyes byung dus/ sku lus kyis skyod pa'am/ mi go chos kyis bsdus pa'i spung mi lags/ rgyu zasanor gser yig bran thag gang dgos/sdu byung yang / ngal dub dang / phangs

rgya bod yig si mo/ sems med pa'i thugs 'khur bzhes nas/ srid pa mtha' nas ma zing pa'i lhos thub blo 'khel bar mdzad nas/ srid rtogs yar 'phel du byung mi mthun phyogs pa rnams kyi thad du'ang / snga sor dpa' dpung 'dzom pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ yar mar gang du su dang thug kyang / jus kyi rgyal kha lon cing nor bu khyung rtses mgo byas pa'i sa smad kyi rdzong gzhis mang po 'brel chags su chod cing / g.yul rgyal lha rtse'i 'og gi sa gdan khor chod/ stod du/ ldan mkhar rdzong / smad du yar 'brog lho brag skor la sogs/ thag nye ring kun nas rdzong gzhis sa gdan bu rta gsar 'phel mang du chod cing / phyir skor/ gtan rlings gtso bor ston pas/ chen pos dgra la byams byas na/ /tha mar dgra bo'ang dbang du bsdus/ /mang pos bkur bas kun bskyangs pas/ /kun gyis rgyal por dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pa dang mthun par/ srid pa mi gcig pa rnams kyang dam pa 'di nyid kyi sku che ba'i yon tan mthong bas/ sde pa phra rags thams cad rim pa bzhin du de'i zhabs la 'thud par byed la/ rang srid la gtogs pa rnams kyi ni phud du 'khur bar byed pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ 'di'i sku bsod dang / skur skyongs/ 'grog lam/ dgra zur gyi blang dor la sogs 'jig rten lugs kyi mdzad phrin rnams/ ma nor zhing / legs par mkhyen pa'i stobs kyis/ sngar gyi mnga' zhabs/ bu rta gang la'ang / bo zag med kyi steng du gtsang srid byings po'i gtso bor gyur cing / gdan sa chen po dang / dpal ldan lha rtse/ ldog pho brang ba/ chu 'dus dkar po man/ gong dkar/ 'phyong rgyas stag rtse yan 'brel chags su zin/ byang phyogs kyi srid pa 287

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byurig ces bsdus/ (//rnams kyang / de nyid kyi bka' lung dang du len cing de dag thams cad kyi rgyal khrims kyi bdag por gyur pas na/ sku'i gzi 'od gsung gi nga ro dang / /thugs kyi stobs kyis rgyal khrims mnon pa dang / /phas rgol 'joms tshe phyag na rdo rje yi/ /sprul pa yin zhes tshig don mthun par grags/ /gcung po che ba/ nang chen/ rab 'byor 'phags pas kyang sa skya nang sor phebs nas/ti shi chen po theg chen chos kyi rgyal po nas thog drangs gdung brgyud khu dbon pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ gang la gang dgos kyi zhabs rtag dang / nang so'i 'dzin lugs lugs mthun mdzad/ gcen gyi bka' zhal dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i chos phyogs kyi zhal bkod dang / sde srid chen mo 'dzin skyong spel ba'i thabs la/ gzhi thub byes thub kyi thugs 'khur chen po bzhes pa/ rang phyogs la byang sems dang ldan zhing / gzhan phyogs su non brjid shin tu che'o zhes/ phyi nang kun gyis bstod cing smon pa'i gnas su gyur to/ /gcung po dmag dpon bkra shis 'phags pa ni/ sku gzhen nu nyid nas/ yab mesagong ma rnams kyi mdzad srol dang mthun par dgra rigs kyi phyogs la/ zhal bstan pa tsam gyis pha rol pham par nus shing / gcen dam pa nyid kyis bka' bsgo ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ dmag khyer snga rting gang la'ang / jusadang / dgra 'thab la shin tu mkhas pas/ dus kun tu/ g.yul las rgyal ba kho na byung bas na/dmag dpon rin po che dang mtshungs la de'i don gyis gnad gang che'i rdzong sa zur du bzhugs pas/ mnga' zhabs yar 'phel du chod pa kun gyis mthun snang du grub pa 'a/spya/ /mi'i dbang po/ sku mched rnams

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ kyi dbon sras/ drung bkra shis rab brtan dpal bzang po 'di nyid kyang / rigs rus khungs nas byung ba'i chos 'jig rten gnyis ma'i phyogs la mkhyen rab che zhing / che btsun gyi yon tan thams cad tshang bas/ chos rgyal chen po'i zhal nas/ 'dis ni sde srid kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bur 'gyur ro gsungs shing mdzad phrin mthong thos kyi skye bo thams cad kyang / mgrin gcig tu/bstod cing bsngags pa brjod pa'i ngang la bzhugs pa lags so/ /chos rgyal sku mched yab sras mnga' thang dang / /chab srid spyi mthun bsod nams las byung ba'i/ blo chen sde jus khur gyis mi ngal zhing / /zhi drag thabs la blo gros bang mdzod rgyas/ /sdug bsngal nad gso sman pa'i rgyal po dang / /shes rab spyan ldan 'jam dbyangs dpon btsun dang / /'jig rten bya ba mkhas pa pad rgyal gsum/ /'di 'dra'i blon chen na rim gzhan ma yi/ /sde pa su la'ang 'dug pa thos ma myong / /des na de yang chos rgyal chen po yis/khrims gnyis dar ba'i ched du sprul par go /slar yang rje dpon sku mched brtan pa dang / /zhal ngo 'phel zhing blon chen snga ma ltar/ /rim par byon nas /snal 'byor rgyas pa dang / /chab srid thams cad yar 'phel 'byung bar 289

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (ne༈ ma sangs sprul pa stag sna rdzong pa'i byon tshul bzhugs/su sti/ 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /chol kha gsum la kha lo bsgyur ba'i dus/ /de'i phrin las bsgrub pa'i dpon chen dang / /slob dpon dge bshes blon chen rim pa rnams/ /mkhas mchog stobs ldan grangs las 'das mod kyis/ /thog mar yus po che'i mi gsum po/ /grom pa sa skya'i dpon chen shāka bzang dang / /shar smad tsong kha'i dge bshes rin brtson dang / /mdo stod gyon ni hor chen ston tshul yin/ /de gsum nang nasarigs mtho blo gsal ba/ /dge bshes chen po nas brgyud deng sang bar/ /bla ma'i zhabs tog dbus gtsang bya ba dang / /bkur skyong phyogs la blo gros spyan ldan zhing / /mi mthun dpung 'joms ma sangs bka' babs zhes/ /snan pa'i grags pas phyogs bcu kun khyab pa/ /blon chen 'di pa'i byon tshul 'di ltar ro/ /de'ang 'di ltar thos te/ sngon bod du chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang / de'i sras bzhi pa khri lde srong btsan rgyal po'i sku ring la / mtha'i dmag 'gyed pa'i bod yul gyi phyogs bzhir bgo ba bsrung ma bskos/ khyad par du bod dmag khri tsho mang po khyer nas/ bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa bcom/ g.yul rgyal gna' bcad nas phyir byon dus/ de phyogs kyi sgo bsrung la / bod dmag seb nas snyen btus pa'i dpa' bo mi dgu/ dmag brgya phrag dgu dang bcas pa hor bod kyi ṭ+wāṃ ༵tshams su bzhag de dus rgyal po'i

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ zhal nas khyod rnams kyis so kha bsrung e thub/ mi thub na dpung gi mnon kha 'jogs pa yin gsungs pas de dgus rgyal por bsrung thub pa byed zhus nas bsdad pas/ dgu thub kyi yul zer ba'ang byung 'dug pa la/ da lta mgo thom gyi yul zer ba'ang snang / khong rnams kyis nged rnams ji tsam la log yong rgyu yin zer ba zhus pas rgyal po'i lung gis/ nged kyi bka' ma byung ba la / bzlog rgyu min gsungs pas de phyin nas dpa' bo mi dgu po'i rus ming /bka' ma log zer ba chags te/ der yun ring bas bka' ma log gi bod 'brog sde tshan mang po yod/ se chen rgyal po'i blon chen sang gha ching zer ba de yang / rus pa bka' ma log tshang yin zer bar 'dug de rnams kyi che brgyud las chad pa/ shar tsong kha mtsho sngon gyi mthil na skad gsar pa bya ba dang / bya rong pa/ cu ku mer bya ba/ yul khams chen po gsum gyi bdag po skya ming /dbon po rin chen rgyal mtshan zhes pa/ blo gsal zhing skye mched dwangs pa gcig byung ba/ de nyid gzhen nu nas dkar po'i phyogs la mos pa gcig yod pas/ yul khams rnams mched zla kun 'dzin du bcug nas/ gtsang sa skya bla ma'i snyan grags tshor/ mos gub khug ste zhabs la gtugs(par 'dod nas/ yar byon pas/ mdo stod kyi/ hor che ston tshul yang chos don du gnyer ba la/ sngon la 'bri khung du byon/ der ma bsten sa skyar chas pa dang / khong rnam gnyis rgya ba lung par mjal/ mdo stod smad kyi phyogs srid dang / sku tshe sngon ma'i 'brel shugs kyis sbun pho nu ltar/ thugs shin tu mthun par byung nas/ de'i dbyar ngo gya ba 'brong du dgon par sdad/ ston de 'gro ba'i mgon 291

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (//po chos rgyal 'phags pa gong nas yar phebs dus 'brong du dgon pa bas gdan drangs/ bsnyen bkur zhus/ de thog tu khong rnam gnyis pas kyang mjal/rab byung zhus/ dbon po'i mtshan rin chen brtson 'grus bya bar btags/bdag slob gnyer mthar phyin pa gcig byed 'dod pas rjes su bzung du gsol zhus pas/ de bzhin legs slob dpon shar pa ye shes rin chen gyis/slob gnyer gyi mgon gyis la/ dge bshes chen po gcig mgyogs par yod byed do gsungs pas/ dge bshes snga ba rin chen brtson 'grus zer ba yang de dus rang nas byung bar gda'o/ /de gnyis das phyag phyir byon/ sa skyar phebs/ slob gnyer mdzad pas/ shes rab dang / thugs rus che ba'i tshad thub par byung nas/ ring po ma lon par sa skya ba'i dge bshes rnams kyi nang nas mkhas pa'i grags thon par byung / bar skabs nas bla ma 'phags pa'i phyag phyi zhabs tog mthil zhugs yun ring du mdzad/ bya ba'i brjid khur chen mo mang du gal/ de mtshams sa 'bri 'khrug pa'i mgo tshugs/ gong du/ khrims kyi gtug gsher la phyogs phyogs nas/ mi drag pa 'gro dgos byung dus dpon chen shākya bzang po dang / dge bshes rin chen brtson 'grus rin po che ston tshul gsum mo/ /bla ma dang / bstan pa/ gdan sa chen po'i phyis la bsam ste blos blangs nas byon/ khrims lugs su song bas/ tshal gung thang nas pho brang shang rdo'i bar la an khur nas/ rkang thang la byon/ gong du gtug bsher legs sa skya pa'i bya ba rnams gang 'dod legs par grub nas/ yar 'khor dus khong rnams sa skya la yus che ba'i2 ṭ+wāṃ gsum du grags pa byung zhing / chen

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/por gyur/ spyi sgos su bla ma'i gnang sbyin/ brgya stong so sos bya dga' chen po byas/ khyad par dge bshes chen po la/ ja rin du/ sa skya'i drug cha ma'i 'dab sgo dang tshong 'dus khang leb kyi mgo byas/ gra khang ga ra phu'i gyog gzhis ka rnams gtsang mar gnang / skya btsun thams cad kyis bkur sti zhabs tog che bar byung / de'i skabs su mched grogs/ ston tshul ba'i gros la slob gnyer gyi dka' spyad/ dge bshes kyi snyan grags ni thob/ sa skya pa gsang sngags zab mo'i bdag po yin pas da gsang sngags dang mthun par mdzad na/ sku khams kyi 'tsho skyongs su'ang 'gyur la/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bu slob rjes 'dzin sogs la'ang khyad che bar yod zer ba la gsan nas/ nyang stod byed mda' ba'i ma cig mkha' 'gro 'bum mngon chung ngu gyog gzhis khar bzhagaphyag rgya bsten pa la sras gsum byung ba'i/ che ba ban rgan blo gros rin chen/bar pa dharma dkon mchog chung ba dpon kun dga' rdo rje rnams 'brungs/bar pa 'di 'gro mgon phyag na'i sras dharma pha la rak+ṣi ta dang / lo zla zhag dus mnyam du 'khrungs pas na/ mtshan 'di 'gro mgon 'phags pas btags par byas so/ /'di'i dus na hor rgyal bu chos dpal/ bod 'chos pa la byon pa'i bsu skyel zhabs tog dgos la/ dge bshes chen pos de bas 'bad rtsol bskyed pas/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi bya ba rnams legs par grub nas/ phyir byon dus sog la mdo bar skyel thung la byon par/ rgyal bu mnyes nas/ byang re thag phyir 'then gang 'dug rin chen brtson 'grus mi brgyud dang bcas pa shes su chug cing / khyod kyis gshe mong 'dab pa bzhin/093

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ rtonabu tsha bo rnams kyis kyang gong ma yon mchod chen po la gshe mong 'dab tu chug zer ba'i lung ljid bzang po gnang / de nas dge bshes chen po sa skya pa'i tshong 'dus khang leb du bde bar gshegs rting / sras che ba ban rgan pas yab kyi rjes su zhugs nas/ khrims gnyis kyi bya ba dang / sa skya pa'i zhabasatog nang so'i mthil len/ sgos su bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs la gtugs/ gshe mong 'dabs ta'i tu'i pho brang du byon nas/ bla ma'i sku drin la o la ja du rgyal po'i lung lha rgod mdung rtse yan dang ra g.yu mtsho man 'di blo gros rin chen brgyud pa dang bcas pa shes su chug gsungs pa'i 'ja' sa gtsang ma gnang / gcung gnyis po phyogs ris med par bskyangs/ gcen la byang gi khri dpon dang gcung la du dben sha'i mtshan zhus nas bskos dharma dkon mchog gi gzhis pa la/ ma cig chen mo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi nye gnas ma cig dang / dpon kun rdor la ma cig 'od 'bum gyi tsha mo gcig blangs na'ang / gnyis ka la sras ma byung / ban gon pas zhes ta mdzad/ zhal ta ma re re 'og tu bzhag pas/ khri dpon dharma dkon mchog la sras khri dpon chos rgyal dang / dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po byung / du dben sha kun rdor la srasakhri dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan byung / khri dpon chos rgyal gyis yab kyi shul du byang re thag 'then pa'i khri dpon thog gcig byas/ sku gshegs/sras med pas dkon mchog rgyal mtshan khri dpon la bskos/ bla chen kun blo'i phyag phyir gong du byon/ yar phebs/ jo mor seg zhing ma blangs nas/mthong smon sa / lha khang / spang gro ṭī kha 'dzin byas/ sras bzhi byung ba'i

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ che ba dpon po dkon mchog 'od zer dang / dkon mchog rin chen/ mkha na po bsod nams blo gros/ chung ba rgod po rin chen rnams byung ngo / /gcung po 'di ma sangs kyi sprul pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'di'i skabs su dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po de nyid/ 'brog khri skor gyi ru thog mtsho mo ru khyung gi skor na sgar chen bzhugs pa'i dus/ nang gcig chibs sgar ba stobs chen bya ba bor nas lha 'dre mi gsum la bca' hu bkrams/ rtsad gcod mi phyogs bzhir btang ba'i shar phyogs pa'i mi gnyis kyis kha ba skya ri ba babs pa'i steng la/ rta rjes 'dug pa mthar ded pas zhag gsum la sog la skya bo'i zhol na/ sgar chen zhig 'dug par slebs/ de'i khrod na chibs pa yang 'dug nas mgron gnyer ba la rgyu mtshan bshad/ sgar 'di su'i yin dris pas ma sangs kyi sgar yin/ ge sar dang / lha ldi la sogs yod zer/ gur nang du khrid bza' btung sna tshogs byin/ lhu ldi yin zer ba de na re nged kyis khar sring nas byang stod la yong / dpon chen pa dang mjal rtsis da lan ma 'phrod/rta 'di 'di bar g.yer ba yin/ da bzod khyod kyi dbon po gcig yod pa de dang yang yang 'phrad zer ba gyis la/ rta dang mda' rgod sgro ma 'di phul zer nas/ khyer yong / dpon chen pa la phul bas/ de rting dbon po rgod po rin chen pa gcings pa'o/ /dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po ba de nyid kyis/ ti shi kun rgyal ba'i zhabs la gtugs/ yig tshang bzung / gong la phyag phyir byon/bla ma'i sku drin dang khrims kyi bya ba mkhas pas/ sngon la/ dbon shi'i ming dang / de rting dbus gtsang gi dpon chen snga ma thob/ yar phebs nas ban 295

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (//rgan pas zhal ta mdzad/ jo mor/ bla ma mus chen pa'i dpon mo dang dpon mo jo ro rim par blangs na'ang / sras ma byung bar/ zhal ta ma 'bum rgyan bya ba la sras che ba grags pa rgyal mtshan pa byung zhing / bar skabs su zur du sras dbon po hor tsha bya ba gcig yang byung / dpon chen pas dbon po dkon mchog 'od zer/ byang khri dpon la bskos/ sras po grags pa rgyal mtshan pa sa skya nang sor bzhag dbus bde ba la bkod nas/ dbon po dkon mchog rin chen pa phyag phyir khrid de/ yang gong ma yon mchod kyi zhabs drung ci du byon/ son jing dben gyi rtsa ba'i dpon chen li shang lan gsum mdzad lung gu ta hu'i zon gnang / snga rting sgril bas lo bco brgyad tsam gong du bzhugs/yar 'byon khar nga'i sbra ber khyung gsum gyi tshong pa bod la lo re bzhin yod pa 'bab sa'i gnas gzhi zhig da lha/sa zhus pas/ gang 'os 31la gsungs pa la/shangs nang g.ye dmar sgang rgyud na sa che bar 'dug pas/ 'di dgos zhus pas gye re bab la gdong yan/ thag ma ral gdong / nya ngar shing gcig man gyi sa cha rgyal ba bzang po'i rta sga 'bogs sa la byin cing / de khongs gang 'os su gnas gzhi rtsig tu bcug gsungs pa'i lung bzang po gnang bas/yar phebs nas shangs mthong smon gyi sa 'di na/ chu gnas pa'i rdzing gcig 'dug pas/ ming dang gang sa nas rten 'brel legs pas/ 'di khongs su chug pa gyis gsungs/ lcags ri spel cog rnams/ dkyil du khang leb chen mo dang bcas pa btab/ de rting gong ma yon mchod kyi sku rim/ smon lam 'debs shing spos sreg pa'i mchod /bye zhig bzhengs su 'jug dgos zer

rgya bod yig cha 'a mo/ ba'i zhu ba gong du btang bas/ de bzhin yin du chug gsungs pa'i lung phebs nas/ nyug rgyal khang rgyal po'i pho brang la dpe blang ba bzhengs/ chos sde 'di sngon bod rgyal blon dus kyi/ bka' bstsal rnying pa gcig dang / ram sding ma ba'i dgon lag rnying pa/ dar cha med pa gcig 'dug pa'ang / dpon chen pas rgyal khams bzhengs pa dang mnyam du/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med grags pa chos dpon la gdan drangs/ sgos kyi mnga' zhabs la btsun khral thengs gnyis su rgyab nas bshad grwa btsugs/ chos sde'i gshe mong bskyed/ chos khrims dar zhing rgyas par mdzad cing / yab yum gyi phyi rten la/ g.ye dmar snang stod du sku 'bum chen mo bzhings/ zhal lu bu ston rin po che gdan drangs nas rab gnas dbus gtsang du rgyas pa'i dpe thub pa mdzad/ lung gis bkod pa'i dpon chen gnyis/ byang sa'i tshag dang bcas pas/ gong du dbus gtsang du dpon chen thengs gsum mdzad pas/ de'i bar la/ gdan sa chen po'i zhabs tog bla ma la bkur sti/ mnga' 'bangs kyi skyong thar/phag gru khri dpon dang / khams pa la sogs khrims 'gal mu med byed mi rnams la drag las kyi 'jun 'dur/ gzhan yang rgyal khams chen po'i bya ba gang la'ang /nye ring med cing blang dor mi 'dzol bar byung bas/kun gyis byang chub sems dpa'i dpon chen du grags shing / grong nas rting ma phebs rjes la / sras gcig byung ba si tu blo gros rgyal mtshan pa yin cing / gcen dpon chen grags rgyal ba/ dgung lo bcu bdun bco brgyad pa lon dus 'brungs pas na/ khong gi sras yin pa'ang byed pa yod la/ khong rnam gnyis kyi bar du 297

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus (//dpon po tor tshas dpon thog tu lo gcig gnyis bzhugs zer ba'ang 'dugadapon chen rgyal ba bzang pos/ khrims las kyi bya ba dpon chen dbang brtson la 'phrod pa'i skabs su/ lha rtse'i gzim khang lho mar bde bar gshegs nas/spur zhu dus thugs thag dang bcas te byon pa de/ gzim khang gung ris la chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sku 'dra bzhugs pa de'i thugs por thim pa kun gyis mthun snang du grub bo/ /phyi skor gyi dpon chen la/ 'di nyid bla ma la gus cing / khrims gnyis kyi bya bar mkhas par byed do/ /dpon chen pa'i sras po grags pa rgyal mtshan pas/ snga sor sa skya nang chen bzungs/ rting la dpon chen gyi ming thob/ shangs mthong smon bzung ba'i skabs su sku gshegs so/ /gcung po/ dpon po hor tsha'i sras sna dkar ba dpon kun dga' rgyal po brgyud chad/ blo gros rgyal mtshan pas si tu'i ming dang / lasaka thob/ dpon chen pas/ dbon po 'di dang / mthong smon sbrags nas ta) si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan la sprad/ gtsang phyogs kyi sde pa dar lcogs dkar po 'dzug pa'i sngon ma byed zer ba'ang 'dug 'di'i ring la/ mthong smon pad chen bzhengs/ sgo pad/ zur lcogs rnams kha sgron/ 'bos/ lcags chung bzos/ de'i sras bzhi'i che ba du dben sha byang chub rgyal ba dpal bzang po/lcog thung du grags pa/ thugs rgod cing rtsom rkyen pas/ de'i ring la rdzong shangs dang / phyi nang gi sde 'khrugs mang / de 'og mkhan po kun dga' blo gros pas/ nyug chos sde'i mkhan po mdzad/ de 'og tu dben sha kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas rgyal mthong bzung / // dang mthun pa'i lugs shas che bar

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/byung / gcung po chung shos dpon po kun rdor ba'o/ /du dben sha kun rgyal bas gdung brgyud lcam mo khyab tu blangs pa'i sras gcig byung ba ni/ du dben sha rin chen rgyal po ba sku brtan par bzhugs pa'o/ khri dpon dkon mchog 'od zer gyis byang ru thogs kyi khri dpon byed cing / dbon po dkon mchog rin chen das rgod po rin chen pas/ nyug rgyal khang gi mgo byas 'dzin/mkhan po bsod nams blo gros kyis/ seg zhing mkhan po byed pa'i skabs su/mthong smon na dpon chen grags rgyal ba yod pa/ dpon skya g.yog rigs kyi dbang du song nas/ shangs pa nang ma bde/ dbon po sku mched che ba gnyis sku gshegs rting dbon po rgod po rin chen pas/ stag tshang rdzong khar bla chen bsod blo ba sku mched pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ rgyab bcol nas rdzong blangs sde gzar yun ring / dgung lo bco brgyad pa la bla chen pa'i phyag phyir gong la byon/ g.yas ru'i las chen mdzad/ bla ma'i sku drin la tho gan the mur rgyal pos phing gcig pa'i mi dpon/ hing son jing dben gyi hu shi'i mtshan dang /dam rtags/ ban rgan blo gros rin chen pa'i dus ji ltar gnang ba bzhin gyi bod 'brog dbang rigs rnams/ rgod po rin chen hu shi'i mi brgyud dang bcas pa shes su chug gsungs pa'i lung bzang po dang bcas pa gnang /yar phebs bla ma sku mched pa'i zhabs tog sde pa stag tshang rdzong pa'i phyi'i dgra 'dul/ dmag dpon gyi bya ba gang la'ang sde pa'i mtshan jus gtso bor ston pas/ dpon sa nas kyang thag rta nag gi gnyer kha gnang / sna dmar rdzong brtsigs/ bshad pa nang ltar gyi sde gzar gyi 'pho 'chug mang na yang phyi 299

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byujug ces bsdus/ (//nang sus kyang rgol bar ma nus pas rgod pa'i snyan grags shin tu che zhing / me pho stag lo nas rdzong stag sna don grub rtse bzung ste/ de'i char gtogs pa'i mnga' zhabs bod 'brog mang du chod nas da lta'i bar la brtan zhing 'phel ba dang bcas pa'o/ /de la yum mi gcig pa'i sras po gsum byung ba'i che ba rta nag pa dpon po sha kya rin chen/ bar pa byang ngam rings pa rgyal ba rin chen/chung ba skyor mo ba sog po rin chen rnams te/ sha kya rin chen pas yab kyi gnyer las kyi rjes rta nag bzung / de la sras dug 〉ra rin chen dang / nam mkha' rin chen/ dge sbyong dkar por grags pa rnams so/ /rgyal ba rin chen pa la sras dpal ldan rin chen dang / rnam rgyal rin chen byung ba gnyis ka yab kyi sngon la sku gshegs/ sog po rin chen pas lha bu khong lam rdzong gsar brtsigs/ sras rgyal po rin chen dang / dge sbyong bsod nams rin chen pa dang / grags pa rin chen pa dang gsum byung ngo / khri dpon dkon mchog 'od zer ba sku mched phyogs gcig pa'i dus kyi sras po gcig byung ba/drung chen glang po rin chen pa/ de nyid/ yab grongs pa'i rjes la stag tshang rdzong khar 'brungs/ dpon po bla brang dang / khu bo rgod po rin chen pas 'tsho skyong mgo 'don yang dag mdzad/ cher skyed nas da bar grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i zhal gzigs dbang rnam sras pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ gzim dpon mdzad khu dbon phyogs gcig tu 'dril nas dgra 'dul/ gnyen skyongs/ dpon sa'i zhabs tog burnya'i sog rum/ skyong thar/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang la'ang shin tu mkhas shing / thugs rtsol che bar sdugs pas phyogs kun tu khyab bo/ khyad
