rgya bod mig sgo za slo/ par dbus pa bdag po grags pa rgyal mtshan pas/ phag mo gru pa srid la gtogs pa'i dbus gtsang gi dmag dpung stobs che ba bsdus nas/ me pho khyi lo ston stag sna rdzong la bskor rgyag yun ring ba byas/ nang yan/ 'tshag skyel/ bred sdigs ji snyed cig byung na'ang yab sras/ dpon g.yog rnams kyis legs par sra bcas/ phur btsugs/ 'thab rol sprad pas dbus gtsang du/ 'khregs pa'i tshad thub pa byung zhing / stag shar/ gtsang srid du drag pa'i mgo de nas tshugs pas sa skya pa'i bstan jus yar 'phel du byung ba blon chen de nyid kyi thugs zhen dang phrin las la brten pa'o/ /de'i sras lnga'i che ba drung chen nam mkha' rin chen pa ni/ sku gzhon nu nas klog yig la sogs bslab shes kyi che ba'i yon tan mtha' dag sngon du phyogs nas/ mi dbang rnam sras rgyal mtshan pa dang / mes po hu shi chen po'i zhabs la gtugs/gsol ja bzung / pho rtsal sna dgu/ bkur skyong / 'grogs lam/ sde srid 'dzin pa'i bya ba la yon tan sgor mor 'dzoms pas/ kun gyis ma sangs kyi sprul par 'dzin cing khyad par khyi lo dmag chen gyi dus rdzong gi rtse zhol bsrung ba gang khag pa thams cad du phebs nas/ skyogs dang mda' rdo'i gnad sprad pas/ gshin rje ngo dmar du grags shing / phyi nang gdong len mi su yang med pa byung ngo / /gzhan yang dmag che chung / 'thab rol snga phyi mang po'i mgon la byon pa/ dus nam yang / gdong phud ngor lang kho na mdzad cing / phyi skor bya ba gang la'ang gtan rlings gtso bor ston pas phyi nang kun gyis 'di ni dpa' mdzangs 'dzoms pa'i skyes bu chen po yin zhes grags so/ /de'i gcung 30

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (//po rgyal bzang rin chen pa/ rgya mtsho rin chen/ nor bu rin chen/ grub pa rin chen rnams yin la gcung chung ba 'dis/ rdzong rab 'byor rtses mgo byas mtshar zhan mnga' zhabs/ gsar 'phel du 'dzin pa'o/ /gcen gyi khab tu gdung brgyud lcam mo slob dpon ma nam mkha' rgyal mo ba blangs pa'i/sras che ba chos rgyal rin chen pa mched gsum ste sku mched khu dbon zhal ngo mang la hrags pa/ sku brtan par bzhugs pa lags so/ /blon chen che brgyud ma sangs sprul pa'i rigs/ kha drag mi dpung 'dzoms pa 'khor bcas 'di/ /phal rgol mi cig phyogs las rgyal ba dang / /dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas // bye/ pho/ rtsal sna dgu'i rnam grangs ni/ dpa' gshed lus kyi rtsal gsum dang / smra ba ngag gi rtsal gsum/ blo gros sems kyi rtsal gsum dang dgu las/ dpa' gshed lus kyi rtsal gsum ni/ 'theb kyis non pa dang gcig rkyal gyis chu chod pa dang gnyis/yang sor bya lta bu dang gsum mo//smra ba ngag gi rtsal gsum ni/lo rgyus kyi dge thon pa dang gcig 'gran bshag gi lce non pa dang gnyis/ khyom tshod bzhad gad thon pa dang gsum mo/ /blo gros sems kyi rtsal gsum ni/ dpa' la sran bzod pa dang gcig mdzangasal blo myur ba dang gnyis/ go gsal la gting sus kyang mi rtogs pa dang gsum mo/ /de lta bu'i pho rtsal sna dgu 'dzoms pa de ni ma sangs kyi sprul par 'dzin pa'o/ /pho rtsed sna dgu bya ba ni/ mda' rdo 'chong gsum/ sho phras rtsis gsum/ bang shags rkyal gsum rnam:2 yin par byed do/ /phyi 'brog byang

rgya bod yig sgo za slo kha'i ri dwags la/ zhib tu brtags na rigs dgu las med par byas te/ pho ra mo ra gsum ni/ 'brong dang gnyan dang gna' ba gsum/ pho yu mo yu gsum ni / rkyang dang / gla ba/ ri bong gsum/ pho ra mo yu gsum ni/ shwa ba/ dgo ba/gtsod gsum de rnams ma yin pa'i ri dwags byang kha na med zer bar gda'o//ri dwags dang gcan gzan gyi dbye ba ni chu 'thung lugs las 'byed de/ ri dwags rnams chu la mchu btsugs nas 'thung bar byed la/ gcan gzan gyi rigs gang yin pa rnams/ lces ldags nas 'thung ba'o/ /yang lce thag med pa'i leb gsum de/ 'phyi ba/ grum pa/ sbal pa gsum/ mkhris pa med pa'i rgur gsum de/ rta dang / rkyang dang / shwa ba gsum/ shul ni med pa'i skyod gsum de/ byi la/ ri bong / sag pa gsum/ mkhal ma med pa'i lding gsum de / khyung dang / rgod dang / bya glag gsum/ de bzhin tshig don mthun par yod bya bar gda'/ bya chen dang byi'u'i dbye ba mig las 'byed de/ che bya gang yin pa rnams mig mas 'geb la/ mig zur nas 'geb pa thams cad byi'u chung la gtogs par byed do/ /bya dang ri dwags dbye ba rnams/ /byang pa mkhas pas bshad pa tsam/ /phra mo'i tshig la mkhas pa rnams/ /mi 'dod byis pa dga' phyir bris/ /pho rab blo'i grwa gru na/ /byang ma'i mdung skor byed pa gda'//pho 'bring blo yi grwa gru na//lug mthong ba gcig gi nyal sa gda'//pho tha'i blo yi grwa gru na/ /rtsid skya nyag gcig gi shong sa med/ /pho rab la gtang ma dgu 'gyur gda'/ /pho 'bring la rang mthong sna lnga 'dug /pho tha ma la 'gyod pa rnam gsum yod/ /skyes pho la dgos pa 'di la tshang / /303

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (/// gnod sbyin sprul pa rnam rgyal gling pa'i byon tshul bdog /su sti/ 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /sku drin las byung dpon chen nye gnas sogs/ /rab dang rim par byon pa mang mod kyi/ /phyi skor bla brang kho na'i bya ba rnams/ /ches lhag phul phyin bsgrub pa'i nye gnas mchog /dam tshig gtsang zhing bsod nams dpal gyis mtho/ /zas nor dbang 'byor gnod sbyin sprul par grags/ /byas pa lag rjes che ba 'di ltar byung / /de'ang sngon spur rgyal bod kyi yul 'dir/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku'i ring la/ za hor gyi yul nas mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho gdan drangs nas bla'i mchod gnas su bkur/ bod du btsun pa la snga ba sad mi mi bdun bya ba rab tu byung nas 'khor mang po dang bcas te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ de dang dus mnyam du nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs/ bod kyi lha klu gdug pa can thams cad dam la btags/ rgya gar bya( tan ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas/ ri rab/ gling bzhi/ gling phran/ nyi zla/ lcags ri mu khyud dang bcas pa dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis sdo/ba pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs/ bod rgyal po'i bla mar mnga' gsol ba/ de'i dus su/u rgyan pad+ma'i dngos slob gnyags dang / 'bon rdo rje rin chen dang / so zur snubs gsum la sogs dkyil 3 slo brgyad du grags pa byung /de rnams

rgya bod yigazung mo/kyi nang nas/ dbas kyi ston pa a mes bla chen rdo rje rgyan mtshan bya ba/ bdud rtsi yon tan gyi lha tshogs la thugs dam gyi gtso bor mdzad cing / chos skyong tshogs bdag dkar dmar bran du bkol nus pa'i gsang sngags rnying ma'i grub thob chen po gcig dbu ru skyi shod kyi lung par gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ de nas bzung ste brgyud pa bcu tsam gyi bar du/ gnam la rdo rje'i gur ma zhig pa sa la dkyil 'khor gyi bkrag ma yal ba bar du rak+ta'i mtsho ma skam pa'i sngags 'chang grub pa thob pa kho na byung ngo / /de skabs hor sa skya pa yon mchod du 'brel bod chol kha gsum po la sa skya pas kha lo bsgyur ba'i dus su/ gnas gsar sngags pa'i dpon brgyud/ dbon po mgon po skyabs zer ba gcig byung ba des dpal sa skyar bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba yab sras pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ sa skya nang so dang chu mig khri khang lo 'ga' bzung / nye gnas chen po mgon po skyabs zhes par grags/ de'i ring la gtsang stod lha lung gi sa cha dang spa snam phyogs kyi gzhis phran 'dra bdag tu bzung bar 'dug 'di yan la so sor gyes pa'i ru mtshams ni/ rta nag phug pa/ dpon dgos pa rin chen pa skor yang yin par byed cing / zul phu phyogs na'ang da lta'ang sngags rus 'dzin pa mang rab yod par snang / nye gnas chen po mgon po skyabs pa la sras po mched gsum byung ba'i/ che ba chen po don grub rgyal mtshan des bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ti shi kun blo'i zhabs la gtugs/ mdo khams su/ gdan sa bar pa gtso mdo bsam grub kyi nye gnas chen po dang / sho tham kha sna bshan bzung / 'phags 305

ba chen 'od snang la /ga 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//pa kun blo gshegs nas ti shi kun rgyal ba'i phyag phyi mthil byas/ gong la byon bla mas thugs la btags nas pho brang ta'i tur rdzong khang hu'i khrims ra dang / dpal bo dong e'i chos grwa chen por spang lo tsā ba blo gros bstan pa'i drung du rab tu byung nas/ mngon pa mdzod la slob gnyer mdzad pa'i dge bshes su grags/ de'i skabs su bla chen bsod blo ba sku mched/ dus mchod bla brang nas/ stag tshang rdzong khar phebs pa'i phyag phyir byon/ gsol gzim mdzod pa gang la'ang 'jug pa'i las tshan gyi mthil bzung / zhabs tog la brtson cing phyi nang gi bya ba la mkhas pas/ bla chen pa shin tu mnyes nas/gong la byon pa'i phyag phyir khrid bla ma'i sku drin la gong ma tho gan the mur rgyal pos ri tsing dbang gi las 'dzin/ khrims ra brgyad yod pa'i che shos g.yasaphyogs kyi dbang hu'i mtshan dang / tham kha stag mgon lung lag rtags bzang po dang bcas pa gnang / yar phebs nas pa'i len dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i bka' lung ji ltar gnang ba bzhin/ stod mnga' ris kyi phyogasal lam phrang dgra gnyen gang la'ang ma bsam par byon nas/ dgra phyogasa'adul ba dang rang phyogs srung ba la sogs bya ba chen po rnams/ dpon sa'i dgongs pa dang mthun par bsgrubs nas/ phyir phebs dus/ dpon sanasakyang mda' ral gsum gyi gdan sa/ lha sde mi sde ya mi snyan gyi rus sde dang bcas pa/ zhes dpa' mtshan gnang / stag tshang rdzong gong 'og gi gnyer las nye gnas chen por bskos/ mi dbang chen po rang gi sras mo byams semasabasod nams rgyal mo ba khab tu gan ༵ la sogs/ gdung rus las chad

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ pa'i ngo bo dang 'dra bar dbon sras 'jogs so/ /thugs 'dogs shin tu che bar mdzad cing / dpon sa'i thugs rje dang / khong rang yang rgyal khrims kyi bya ba la mkhas shing / sku bsod kyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho bas dgra 'dul/gnyen skyongs/sde srid kyi mdzad phrin mtha' dag lhun gyis grub nas chu mo phag gi lo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga la gza' skar dus tshes 'phrod sbyor kun bzang po'i nyin nas rdzong gnam rgyal gling chen gyi 'gram bting yun ring por ma thog par 'khas su chug pa bzhengs/ mnyam mid rgyal ba bzang po bas thog drangs bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang hrags mang pos rdzong la rab gnas gsol/ sbyin bdag rang gis/ yi dam kyi mtshan dang mthun pa byed gsungs nas rnam rgyal gling chen zhes par ming btags/ son li'i mi dpon chen po de nyid ni bzang zhing dpa' ba/ mthu stobs zas nor la dbang 'byor bas rang gzhan gyi mnga' zhabs thams cad bde ba la bkod pa'i snyan grags kyi dbus gtsang thams cad khyab par gyur cing gnod sbyin tshogs kyi bdag po'i sprul par grags so/ /dbang hu chen po'i jo mo sngon ma 'bri khung dgung mkhar dbon slo la sras gcig byung ba ni/ drung chen chos rgyal dpal bzang po ba yin cing gdung brgyud lcam mo la/ thog mar sras mched gnyis byung ba grub chen gong ma 'dra'i sku skye bzhes par 'dug na'ang gzhon nu nas sku gshegs/ drung chen chos rgyal dpal bzang po 'di nyid dgung lo brgyad pa la nub chos lung dgon par mkhan chen rin po che mnyam med rgyal ba bzang po ba'i sku drung du bzhugs nas/ chaX 0sdig yig rtsis la sogs pa sku mched

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//pa'i yon tan mtha' dag la thugs goms par mdzad/ bcu gnyis pa nas ri rtsing dbang rnam sras rgyal mtshan pa'i zhabs drung du byon gsol dpon gyi mthil yun ring du mdzad/ sku lus dang grib ma bzhin du/ 'bral ba med par phyag phyi zhabs tog la brtson zhing / rdzong gong 'og gi gnyer las kyang yab sras gnyis pos lo sum cu rtsa bdun tsam mdzad pa'i ring la/ bla brang gi nang du gsol bzang zhing / phyi nas dgra tho skad cig kyang ma phog pas bu rta 'dabs rgyas pa dang / mi sde mnga' zhabs bde skyid la longs spyod pa byung /yab bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa dang / phyi rten nang rten bzhengs pa la sogs/ bsgrub bya gang dang gang la gtsang g.yas ru'i phyogs su bzang zhing ngo mtshar che ba'i tshad thub pa bsgrub/ rang re'i rdzong gi mnga' zhabs la pha rol pa'i dmag dpung stobs chen gyis bskor rgyag yun ring dang / gnod 'tshe byung ba'i dus su'ang dpon pos/ bu rta skyong lugs dang/ g.yog gis dpon chen 'khur lugs la phyi nang thams cad smon cing ma khrel ba'i sra phur legs par bcas pas/ gzhan phyogs pa'i blo brid mgo bskor dpa' dpung gang gis kyang rang sde gzhom par ma nus kyi steng du/stag tshang rdzong pa'i bstan jus zin pa dang gtsang srid kyi mgo tshugs pa'i skyes bu sde dpon chen por gyur cing / de rting nas sa jus kyis rdzong sa gdan sa mnga' zhabs bu rta gsar du chod pa shin tu mang la 'di pa yab yum dkar phyogs la mos shing / thugs dgyes dpa' mdzangs ldan pas/dpon rigs la bkur sti zhabs toX rdo srid/ sku nye/ 'brel chags rnams

rgya bod mig tshang za mo/dang 'brog lam 'khor 'bangs ltos bcas kyi skyong thar/zas nor gyis 'dzin tshul la sogs la sus kyang 'gran du med cing / snyan grags kyis kun tu khyab la/ mtshan dang don du ldan pa'i chos rgyal chen por gda'o/ /drung chen de nyid dang / gdung brgyud lcam mo byang sems bsod nams rgyal mo ba la sras po sku mched gnyis byung ba'i gcen po drung rgyal ba dpal bzang po ba yin cing / gcung po nang so chos skyong rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba 'di pas mi dbang nam mkha' legs pa'i gsol dpon bzung bkur skyongs/ 'grogs lam sde srid chen po yar 'phel du 'byung ba'i mdzad phrin la g.yel mi mnga' bar sku brtan par bzhugs pa lags so/ /sngon chad sku bsod rnam dkar phrin las kun/ khri spya rkyen 'dzoms pas yar 'phel byung ba bzhin/ /phyi rabs//da 'dzin sku tshe brtan pa dang / /dpal 'byor mnga' thang che cher dar rgyas / rgya bod du gsang sngags dar tshul bzhugs/hūṃ/ chos sku kun bzang longs sku rigs lnga dang / /sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po la sogs pa'i/ /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha klu gnod sbyin srin po mi rnams kyi//rig pa 'dzin pa'i mchog gyur rnam lnga sogs/ /rig 'dzin brda brgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skal ldan rgyal po rwa dza rnam gsum nas/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad kyi/ /309

ba tshe na 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (she/gang zag snyan brgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar brgyud pa gsum ldan byin rlabs las/ /dbang gi chu bo bzhi ldan gsang sngags rgyud/ /lha yul rgya bod dar tshul zur tsam bstan/ /de'ang gsang sngags kyi chos 'byung gsal byed mun sel las/ gsang sngags zab mo'i babs tshul dngos ka ni/ bstan pa thams cad kyi snying po/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse/ bka' gsang ba bsakyang ches gsang ba/yang gsang med du byung ba/rdo rje theg pa/lta ba'i zhe phugs/rtsol med rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa byung tshul dngos/ dang po/ rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud tshul ni ston pa ngo bo nyid kyi skus 'og min du/ rang gsal ngo bo nyid kyi chos gsungs pa ni/ skye 'gag med pa'i ston pas/ don gyi 'og min du 'gag med kyi rig pa de/mtshan ma'i sku gsum mi mnga' bar//kun bzang nyid du byin brlabs nas/ /brjod pa med pa'i rang sgra sa /bzang ngan blang dor med par bzhad/ /ces so/ /ston pa chos kyi sku'i byin rlabs kyis rang grol mngon sum du gsungs pa ni/ chos sku cir yang ma grub pa nyi ma lta bu'i ngang nas/ rang shes rig gi rgyal po/ kun tu bzang po'i zhal phyag gi rnam thar bzhengs nas/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang dgongs pa mi 'bral ba bshad/ ces pa ni/ thugs rje gsung gi byin brlabs kyis/ /bzang ngan blang dor med pa sa /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs rgyud la/ /ji ltar chos rnams kun shes kyang / /ngo bo nyid kyis gsungs pa med/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis bshad pa'o//ces so//ston pa gsang ba'i skus bde chen thabs kyis gsungs pa ni/ thabs gsum la brten nas/31)ga 'a ba bzhi'i rang bzhin lhan cig

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/skyes pa'i dga' ba des kun la khyab par gsungs pa'o/ /ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus/ rang gi ngo bos gsungs pa de rnams/ ston pa gsang ba'i bdag pos sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje la/ bstan pa'i bdag por dbang bskur nas lha khang mi'i yul du grags pa yin te/ de'ang dang po gsang sngags 'byung ba'i dus drag la bab pa'i tshe/ rtsol med a ti yo ga'i bstan pa 'di/ lha yul du byung ba yin la/ dus drug ni nyon mongs sam rgyud drag pos mthu zhan/las kyi tshe thung bka' don ston//bstan snyigs grub mtha' ngan ༄ //gnyen pos mi non bsgrub rtsol zhan/ /de tshe rig pa'i rnam rtog shar/ /zer ba yin no/ /de'i dus su/ sum cu rtsa gsum na/ lha bde ba bzang po la bu lnga bcu rtsa gcig yod pa/ gzhan rnams rtse 'phyo la dga' ba la che ba kun dga' snying po ni/ gcig pur don sems shing rdo rje'i bzlas pa kho na la brtson pas/ brgya byin gyi sems lhag can zhes par ming btags so/ /de la chu mo glang lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros nas thub pa drug gis bskor ba byas/ rang gi spyi bor thims pa'i rmi ltas byung ba brgya byin la bzlas pas/ dgyes nas/ sems lhag can la/ e ma snying po rnal ma 'byung ba'i dus/ /'jig rten mun sel dus mtha'i sa non pa'i//thugs sras 'dzam gling dpal gyur ngo mtshar lang //zhes pas bstod cing / dang po'i rmi ltas de sangs rgyas kyi thugs su lon nas/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal tshab byed pa'i rtags yin/ gdul bya'i mun pa sel ba bstan pa'i sgron me byed pa'i rtags yin rtsol med kyi 'bras bu lhun 311

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//gyis grub pa'i rtags yin gsungs nas brgya byin gyis phyogs bzhir zhal gzigs te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la bskul zhing / gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas nam mkha' gang ba 'dus nas/ mgrin gcig tu rdo rje sems dpa' la 'di skad ces bskul te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi / / thugs rje'i rang bzhin khyod yin pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzad pa shar/ /tshig gcig don du rdzogs pa'i bdag /rin chen 'byul gyi snying po'i sgo / / skal ldan rnams la bstan du gsol/ /ces bskul bas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka las phyag na rdo rje nyid byung nas/ rin chen rang 'bar gyi 'khor lo lag tu gtad de/ 'di skad ces bskul to/ /dri med ye shes gsang ba'i don/ /byar med rtsol med ye sangs rgyas/ /dbu ma chen por drangs ba'i lam//'dus pa'i tshogs la bstan par gyis//ces bskul bas/rdo rje sems dpas/ 'di skad ces zhus so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' che/ /tshig gis spyod yul ma yin pas/ /bdag gis sgrol ba shin tu dka'/ /ma rtogs pa la tshig sgo nas/ /mtshon par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /ci rigs par ni rnam par sgrol/ /zhes bshad par zhal gyis blangs nas/ phyag na rdo rjes/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa dang mi 'gal ba'i phyir/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad/ rigs lnga'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la/ gzhi 'bras kyi don 'di the tshom phye bar zhus pa ni/ shar phyogs rdo rje 'bar ba'i zhing khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje gsang ba zhes bya ba/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi gdan la bzhugs te/ de sdo) 'dus pa'i 'khor la/ gsang sngags

rgya bod mig tshang za mo/kyi de kho na nyid kyi chos ston pa'i drung du byon nas/ sems nyid rdo rje lta bu la//skye 'gag 'byung ba ji ltar lags/ /zhes zhus pas/ sems nyid mi 'gyur rdo rje la/ /skye dang 'gag pa yod ma yin/ /rnam rtog blo'i skye 'gags byung / /gsungs so/ /lho phyogs rat+na snang ba'i zhing khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rat+na zhabs/ rang 'bar snang ba'i gdan du 'khor la chos ston cing bzhugs pa la/byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin la//rgyu rkyen rtsol bas ma bsgrubs par//yon tan 'bras bu ji ltar 'char/ /zhes zhus pas/ de dag shākya'i rgyan bzhin du / / rgyu 'bras mthar phyin ye nas rdzogs/ /thams cad rang byung snying po'i mchog /gsang ba thabs kyis rtogs gyur na/ /nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'bras bu 'char/ /zhes gsungs/ nub phyogs pad+ma brtsegs pa'i zhing khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma'i 'od/ dri ma med pa'i gdan las/ 'khor la chos ston gyin bzhugs pa la/ sems nyid pad+ma ltar dag la/ /gzung 'dzin dri ma ji ltar 'byung / /zhes zhus pas/ pad ma 'dam na gnas bzhin du/ /'dam gyi skyon gyis gos pa med/ /zhes gsungs/ byang phyogs rnam dag grub pa'i zhing khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa grub pa gnang ba/ rang bzhin gnang ba'i gdan las/ 'khor la chos ston kyin bzhugs pa la/ rtsol med sems kyi rang bzhin la/ /'gro don mdzad pa ji ltar byung / /zhes zhus pas/ rang byung ye shes rtogs gyur na/ mdzad pa'i byin brlabs rang la 'char/ /zhes gsungs/ mthar dbus phyogs mtha' dang bral ba'i zhing khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' ltar gnang ba'i gdan las/3 3

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chog na ning gtses bsdus/ (ne'adus pa'i 'khor rnams la/ gsang sngags kyi zab don de kho na nyid kyi chosaston gyin bzhugs pa'i drung du phyin ma thag tu/ ston pas mdun bsus nas/'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs khyed kyis ni/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi bcud/ /ye shes gsang don rtogs par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / phyag na rdo rjes/nyid rang gi gdan las lang ste/ khyed kyi gsung gi seng ge des/ /ye shesagasang don gsung du gsol/ /zhes zhus pas/ sems dpa' rdo rje de nyon cig /ye shes gsang ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med/ /nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab/ /ma rig ye shes tha dad med/ /ma rtogs rtogs pa'i lam du gcig/ye shes gsang ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sangasargyas sems can 'ad)/ /rang rig 'od gsal rnam par dag /rnam rtog ye shes nyid du gnas/ /gzhi bzhag rang lugs rin chen mdzod/ /rang byung ma rtsal gdod nas dag /ye shes gsang ba'i rnam pa ni/ /sna tshogs snang la ngos bzung med/ /mi dmigs sgyu ma lhun grub ni/ /rtag tu gsal na lta ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /med du byung ba bstan pa'i snying po/ rgyu 'bras las 'dasapa'i chos/ a ti yo ga'i don rnams/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i bcud/ phyag na rdo rjes de ltar du blangs nas/ lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum du/lha'i bu sems lhag can yod par byon te/ dngos kyis gsungs so/ /sprul sku shākya thub pa sku dngos su bzhugs dus/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams la/ theg chen gsang sngags kyi chos rnams gsal bar ston pa'i skabs la ma sleb pa la dgongs nas/ sprul pas gsungs dī ni/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal du sprul

rgya bod yig tsha ri chen mo/te dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du byon nas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la bya ba'i rgyud gsungs/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed du byon nas spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs/ 'og min du byon nas rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs/ rgya gar lho phyogasakri dha pha la chos kyi 'byung gnas su byon te rdo gru gsum bsnol ba'i steng du bzhugs nas/ mi ma yin pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs so/ /theg chen bla med kyi chos 'di mi yul 'dzam gling du byung tshul ni/ thub pa'i dbang po dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes nas/ mya ngan las 'da' bar dgongs pa'i zla ba gsum gyi gong na/ da ni nga mya ngan las 'da' bas/ khams gsum gyi lha mi thams cad chos kyi tha ma nyan pa dang / blo the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs dpyod pa la bos shig gsungs pa ltar/ mo'u gal gyi bus bskul nas/ 'khor thams cad 'dus pa la/ ston pa'i zhal nas snangs 'gro ba'i don thams cad byas zin gyi/ da myur du mya ngan las 'da' bas/the tshom yod pa kun chod cig de rting mya ngan ma byed cig gsungs pa'i dus su / 'khor gyi nang nas rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po kun dza ras stan las langs nas ston pa'i drung du seng ge'i lta stangs kyis/ mig mi 'dzum par ltas te/ ston pa khyed kyis gzhan mdzad pa thams cad rdzogs par bstan na'ang / bstan pa'i snying po zab mo'i lam gsang ba bla na med pa/ theg chen gyi chos ma gsungs pa zhus pa'i lan/ nga ni 'di nas mi gnang nas/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ /'og min dang /ri rab rtse zur bzhi'i lcog dang / lha gnas gsum du grags pa yi/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /'dzam gling shar gyi phyogs 315

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'gung gces bsdus/ (3)su / / mi las skal ldan gra ma che//rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la//sngon du ltas rnamasa'abyung 'gyur te/ /drag shul can zhes bya ba'i rtser/ /grogs kyi sems dpa' dman pa'i lus/ /lang ma'i bdag po la sogs la/ /phyag na rdo rjes ston par 'gyur/ /zhes pa/ mdo gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal por gsungasashing / gsang ba lung bstan pa las kyang / rgyu la sbyor ba rgyu'i chos/ /'khor lo bzhin du bskor byas nas/ /'bras bu'i theg pa nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs pa na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / dpal sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud phyi ma nasakyang / nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis nas/ /dag pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /lha gnas gsum du grags pa ste/ /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri bo la/ /phyag na rdo rje mthu ldan 'gyur/ /mi las skal ldan dam pa zhig /theg chen gsang sngags rgyasapar byed/ /de la rim 'gro rtag tu gyis/ /zhes lung bstan mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud tshul ni/ rgyal ba g.yung ston rdo rje dpal bas mdzad pa'i rgyud sde'i khog dbub las/ mi ma yin pa la brgyud pa dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa gnyis ka la brgyud pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi bar la rgyal ba rigasagasum gyi brgyud pa/ 'jam dpal gyi lta ba/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub pa/phyag na rdo rjes spyod pa bstan zer yang / gsang sngags kyi lta spyod sgrub pa gsum po'i don 'jam dpal gzhen nu mdzes pa'i sku dang ldan pa des/ lha rnams lus dang bsam pa dang mthun3 sdur chos bstan te/ 'jam dpal rnon

rgya bod yig tshang chen rmo/ pos lha grags ldan chos skyong la bshad/ de nas rim pa bzhin du rin chen 'od 'bar/skye rgu'i bdag po tshangs pa/tshangs pa kun grol/ tshangs pa gtsug phud 'dzin/ dbang po brgya byin/ des lha'i rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum sde la bshad de/ de thams cad kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i rig 'dzin yin zhing /rgyal ba rnams kyi gdung 'tshob par 'gyur co/ /spyan ras gzigs bdud rtsi'i ska dang ldan pa des/ klu gdug can rnams kyi lus dang / bsam pa dang mthun dror klu rgyal mgrin pa nag po la bshad/ de nas rim pa bzhin du klu mo kha 'dul ma/ klu mo tshangs 'dul ma/ klu yid 'od dga' ba/ klu rgyal 'jog po/des klu tshom bu 'bum sde la bshad de/ de thams cad gong ltar du gyur to/ /phyag na rdo rje 'jigs tshul sdig pa'i sku dang ldan pa des gnod sbyin rnams kyi lus dang / bsam pa dang mthun par gnod sbyin grags ldan phyogs la bshad/ de nas rim par gnod sbyin kun tu bzang po/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / des gnod sbyin tshom bu 'bum sde la bshad de/ de thams cad kyang gong ltar gyur to/ /mi dang mi yin pa gnyis ka la brgyud pa ni/ gsang ba'i bdag pos/ lha grags ldan chos skyong / klu rgyal 'jog po/ gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong srin po lang ka mgrin brgya/ mi lasaskal ldan li tsa byi dri ma med par grags pa la sogs pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams la/ ri ma la ya'i rtser gsungs shing brgyud pa'o//yang chos 'byung gsal byed mun sel las/ gsang sngags zab mo'i chos la bka' babs tshul gnyis ni/ phyi dang / nang ngo / de dang phyi pa thub pa rgyud la gsum 3 7

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//ste / kri ya dang / u pa/ yo ga'o/ /kri ya/ bdar na ser bram ze'i rigs 'khababs pas/ gtsang sbra la spyod do/ /u pa yo ga'o/ /u pa ri rab kyi khong seng 'dus pa'i rtser blon rigs la babs te chos kyang de lta bu spyod do/ /yo ga me ri 'bar ba'i rtser rje rigs la babs te chos kyang de mthun du spyod do/ /de la phyi zer ba'i rgyu mtshan/ lta bas phyir gyur te chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dbyer med rang byung ye shes su smra mi nus/ sgom pas phyir gyur te dam tshig pa dang / ye shes bzang ngan dbyer med du bsgom mi nus/ dbang gis phyir gyur te zab mo'i dbang gsum pa yan ston mi nus pas na phyi pa'o/ /thub pas zhal nas gsungs pa dang / rigs gsum mgon po la sogs la byin gyisabarlabs nas/ gnas dar na ser phyag rdor gyis bya ba'i rgyud kyi chos 'khor bskor/ gnas me ri 'bar ba'i steng du rnal 'byor rgyud kyi 'bor lo bskor ba la sogs pa rnams/ phyi pa thub pa rgyud yin no/ /nang pa thabs kyi rgyud la'ang gsum ste/ skyed pa mahā yo ga rdzogs pa a nu yo ga rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'o/ /nang pa zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ lta ba'i khyad par che bas phyi pas/ bden pa dbyer med du ma rtogs/ don dam pa'i bden pa stong nyid dag pa'i mtha' gcig pa'am spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral bar 'dod la/kun slob rigs gsum rigs bzhi'am rigs lngar 'dod de/ nang pa ni/don dam rang rig spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa rtogs tshad thams cad sku dang ye shes su snang ba/ de nyid kyang sems kyi steng na dbyer med par 'dod de/don da/ stan rdzob dbyer med pas/ /ces so/ /

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/'bras bu'i khyad par ni/ phyi pa mi tshe bdun nam/ lnga'am/ rigs gsum/rigs bzhi'am/ rigs lnga rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob par 'dod de/ nang pa ni/dbang bskur gdams ngag bstan pa tsam gyis/ sa dang po'i bden pa mthong /bskyed rim bsgoms pas sa brgyad pa non/ rdzogs rim gyis sa dgu pa non/'od gsal gyis sa bcu pa non/ zung 'jug gis sa bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa non pas so/ /mthar thug sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las nyi shu rtsa lngar shar nas/ sems can mtha' yas pa'i don mdzad pa'o/ /nang rgyud la gnas gsum du rgyas/ /sprul pa phyis 'byung lung bstan te/ /'das nas lo brgya bcu gnyis na/ /nang rgyud theg pa sngags kyi char/ /'dzam gling u rgyan gling sogs babs/ /dza dang 'jam dpal gshin rje sogs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa dpag med 'byung / /de nas rgya gar yul du rgyas/ /grub pa brnyes pa chad las 'das/ /zhes pa'i/ lha gnas gsum ni/ gtsang ris dang / dga' ldan dang / sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /sprul sku 6kya thub 'a/)'das nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad na u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas der/ rdzogs chen rgyud sde phal cher babs so/ /de rnams nang pa thabs kyi rgyud yin no/ /gsum pa gang zag snyan du rgyud pa'i tshul ni khog dbub las/ thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo brgya dang bcu gnyis lon pa'i tshe ri ma la ya'i shar lho/ tri sham a su ra'i brag phug rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ngo mtshar can de na/skal ldan rgyal po dza zhes bya ba de/ gsang sngags phyi rgyud la bsgrub pa mdzad kyin bzhugs pa'i nangs gcig gsang bdag gis ri ma la ya'i rtser/319

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//gsang sngags nang gi chos 'khor bskor ba'i byin rlabs las ngo mtshar ba'i rmi ltas bdun byung ba'i rting ma de la nam mkha'i mthongs nas/ gzugs su ma grub pa'i sgra skad la las dang skal bar rab ldan pa'i/ /bsod nams chen po'i gra ma khyod/ /sprul pas ji ltar lung bstan bzhin/ /rgyal ba 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /bskal ldan khyod la bsgrog par bya'o/ /zhes pa rmis nas/ rgyal po mnal sad 'phral la/ yang thog tu byon pas/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i sku rin po che smug po las grub pa / yi/ gang ba gcig bzhugs 'dug pa la phyag 'tshal/ bskor ba byas/zhabs spyi bor blangs nas/ e ma ngo mtshar mchog gi sku/ /'dren pa mchog gi dpal legs gang / /mos pa'i yid kyi lha mchog khyed/ /sngon tshe gong nas bsgrubs pa yis/ /las kyis 'brel pa'i lha mchog khyod/ /bskal pa brgyar yang mi btang ngo / /gsungs te yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ zla ba bdun bsgrub pa mdzad pas/ po ti glegs bam rmi lam du byung ba de rnams/ mngon sum du yang thog rtser babs shing / de'i byin rlabs kyis snang ba thams cad dpe char shar ba yin skad/ der rgyal pos po ti glegs bam rnams ma brtags pas rtogs par 'dug na yang / gdul bya zu sum ras chod can rnams dag par bya ba'i phyir du ma rtogs pa skad mdzad nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams na mkhyen pa su che dris pas/ za hor gyi yul na rgyal po u pa ra dza mkhyen pa che zer ba de'i drung du po ti glegs bam rnams bskur nas/ rtogasapar zhus pas yig 'bru gcig kyang sdu/ ma khrol/ sngar gyi lung bstan dang

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ sbyar na rgyal po khyed rang gis rtogs par 'gyur ro gsungs nas/ phyir phul/yang mkhyen pa che bar grags pa sangs rgyas rin chen mang gis sprul pa dge slong ku ku ra dza bzhugs sar btang nas rtogs par zhus pas/ des sgyu 'phrul dra ba le'u stong phrag brgya pa'i rgyud bya ba'i nang nas rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs sgrub pa'i le'u 'am rdo rje sems pa'i zhal mthong gi rtogs te zla ba bdun sgrub pa mdzad pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin gyi ngos las byon te/ rigasakyi bu sirnyi ci 'dod gsungs pa la/ bstan pa mtha' dag rtogs pa'i dngos grub zhu/ zhus pas/ phyag na rdo rjes lung bstan par 'gyur gyi gsungs nas/mi snang bar song skad yang / zla ba bdun bsgrubs pas/ phyag na rdo rje mngon sum du byon nas/ rdo rje lan gsum spar te spong len brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang / dge bas bskul na sdig pa med/ rtsol ba dang bcas pa mtshan nyid kyi theg pa spangs nas/ dun la ba med pa gsang sngags kyi theg pa nyams su len pa khyod la/ don gyi bstan pa dang theg pa thams cad rdzogs par dbang bskur ro/ /tshig gis bstan pa de dbang dge bsnyen li tsa byi dri ma med pa la zhus shig ces lung bstan to/ /de'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs shing sgyu 'phrul dra ba le'u stong phrag brgya pa'i rgyud la tan+t+ra sde chen po bco brgyad du phye nas/ dge slong ku ku ra dzas skal ldan rgyal po dza la gsungs/ tan+t+ra sde chen po bco brgyad las/ sku'i rgyud gsum ni/ sangs rgyas mnyam stor/ glang po che rab 'bogaglang po che chur zhugs/ gsung gi rgyud gsum ni/4zla gsang thig le/ gcig las 'phros pa/ du ma las 'phros pa/ thugs kyi rgyud gsum ni/ gsang ba 32/

ba chen 'od snang la /sa ci'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//'dus pa/ ri bo brtsegs pa/ rtse gcig 'dus pa/ yon tan gyi rgyud gsum ni / dpal mchog dang po/ bdud rtsi'i mchog dang po/ yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyud/ phrin las kyi rgyud gsum ni/ skar ma ma le/ sgron me 'bar ba/ gi la ya yig 'bru bcu gnyis kyi rgyud/ spyi'i rgyud gsum ni/ de dag thams cad kyi spyir rgyud sde/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud/ dam tshig sa ma ya 'bum sde bkod pa'i rgyud/ rdo rje thabs kyi zhags pa'i rgyud do/ /de rnams rgyal po dzas sirnyi ra dza la / des sras mo mgo ma sa la/ de nas rim pa bzhin khyi'i rgyal po ku ku ra dza / ro langs bde ba'i dngos grub/ rdo rje zhad pa/ za hor gyi rgyal po pra ha ti/slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ des slob dpon bi ma la mi tra la sogs pa rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya la gsungs pa'o/ /rgya gar du gsang sngags phyi rgyud dang / nang rgyud gnyis ka yongs su rdzogs par mkhyen cing / grub pa brnyes pa/ grags pa thon pa byon tshul ni/ chos mdzod rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo brgya dang bcu gnyis na skal ldan rgyal po dza byon/ lo lnga brgya na 'jam dpal bshes gnyen lo stong na/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen phyi ma/ lo phyed dang nyis stong na/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ lo nyis stong lha gnas shrī sidha rnams byon/ /de rnams kyi ring la gsang sngags phyi nang chos grwa'i mkhas pa lnga brgya/ mkhas mchog nyi shu rtsa gcig grub pa thob pa bco brgyad la sogs pa mang du byon pa'i rting / bod du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa byung tshul ni/ chos mdzod rnam bshad las chos rgyal lti ༷1nga lde btsan gyi sku'i ring la dpal

rgya bod yig sgo 〉mo/bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i sa 'dul la/nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs te/ des bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs la sogs gsungs pa rnams la/bod du gsang sngags kyi babs dang po'o/ /de rting rab gnas kyi dus su/sharnying gar pa byon nas kri ya'i rgyud gsungs pa la sogs la babs gnyis pa'o/ /de nas lo tsā ba gtsang de len+ta dang / bran ka murting / 'jam dpal go cha gsum pos gangs ti sir slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba la rnam snang byang chub pa'i rgyud la sogs zhus nas spel ba las gsungs pa la babs gsum pa'o/ /de rting rngog lo tsā ba dang / sad mi mi drug byung pa ni gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ 'bre rgyal ba'i blo gros/ tu gong ba byi ra dza/ gru gu u pe shaglang dpal gyi seng ge lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas rnams kyis rgya gar du slob dpon hūṃ mdzad grags pa la yang dag gi rgyud la sogs zhus nas dar bar byas pa la babs bzhi pa'o/ /de nas/ mkhas pa be+e ro tsā bas 'jam dpal rgyud sde dpag med bsgyur ba la sogs rnams la babs lnga pa'o/ /rgyal po khri lde srong btsan sad na legs 'jing yon gyi sku ring la kha che dzi na mi tra dang / dharma ka ra dang / shi len tra bo skyi la sogs pa rnams spyan drangs nas/zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ka cog zhang gsum dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba ldan ma rtse mangs la sogs pa mang pos gsang sngags sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud phal cher bsgyur ba ni babs drug pa'o/ /chos rgyal khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can gyi sku ring la dri med bshes gnyen spyan drangs nas lo tsā ba mkhas pa mi drug bya 323

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//ba ni/ g.yu sgra snying po ku ma ra/ dran pa nam mkha' rin chen mchog dran pa ye shes rgyal byang rnams/ de bas sngar phan gyi 'gyur sna tshogs pa thams cad rgya gar gyi skad zhe gcig tu bsgyur/ gzhung ma tshang ba rnams tshang bar byas/ skad gsar bcad kyis bstan la phabs te sems klong dang / sgyu 'phrul/ mdo lung la sogs rgyud phra rags mang po bsgyur ba ni babs bdun pa'o/ /mthar bod rgyal glang dar mas bstan pa brnubs rjes/ phyi dar gyi skabs su me gnyags kyi slob ma'i slob ma gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che nas lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi lon nas kyang / bod na sngar yod pa'i gsang sngags kyis thugs ma tshims par bal por byon/ rgyal po bha su dha ra dang / rgya gar du ar+ya gsal rgyan dang / rom po dzu ya tsan+t+ra la sogs dang mjal gsang sngags bstan srung phyi nang gsang gsum bsgyur ba ni babs brgyad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas ye shesarin po ches rgya gar nas bru zha'i yul du'ang byon de'i paṇ+ḍi ta dha na rak+ṣi ta dang lo tsā ba me btsan skyes/ khams pa dar mkhar dang bcas pa la dgongs 'dus bru zha'i skad du bsgyur zhing de rgya gar skad mthar bod skad du bsgyur ba'o/ /spyir khong gis rgya bal gyi yul du lan bdun gyi ring la byon/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi rgyud mtha' dag blangs nas dar bar mdzad pas sku drin shin tu che'o/ /spyi khyab tu bod du gsang sngags phal che ba'i babs ni gsum du bshad de/ dang por slob dpon pad+ma/ bar du be+e ro tsā na/ mthar gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che rnams la zer ba mang ngo / /yang gsal byed mun sel las gsang sngags gsar sdiX gi go don ni/ kha cig na re rdo rje

rgya bod yig tshang chen rmo/ gdan nas bsgyur ba gsar ma yin la/ u rgyan nas bsgyur ba rnying ma /mkha' 'gro mas bsgyur ba gsar ma/ rig 'dzin pas bsgyur ba rnying ma yin zer/ kha cig tshad med pa bzhi dang bdun rnam dag la bkod pas/ rgyu'i rdo rje 'chang las 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'chang du bsgyur ba 'dug na/ de gsar ma yin la / 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'chang de phal cher yongs rdzogs su grub pa'i gru gzhung de rnying ma yin zer/ rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa gsar ma yin la/ kun tu bzang pos gsungs pa rnying ma yin zer te/ de rnams thams cad la rgyu mtshan dang nges pa bzhag tu med la/ khyad par kun tu bzang po dang rdo rje 'chang ngo bo gcig yin pa la gnyis su 'byed pa shin tu mi 'thad do/ /de yang gnas lugs la mtshan gsol bas ngo bo nyid kyi sku zhes bya/ spyod yul yongs su dag pa la mtshan gsol bas kun tu bzang po zer/ rigs la mtshan gsol bas rdo rje 'chang zer/ ye shes kyi grangs la mtshan gsol bas rgyal ba drag pa'i bdag nyid zer ro/ /mdor na rnying ma'i rgyud sde mang po na yang ṭaṃ rje 'chang gis gsungs zer ba mang po yod cing/ gsar ma'i rgyud sde mang po na'ang kun tu bzang pos gsungs bya ba yang mang po yod pas na/ bod du 'gyur snga phyi la gsang sngags gsar rnying gi ming du btags ba tsam mo/ /bod du lha bla ma ye shes 'od yan gyi 'gyur rnams la snga 'gyur rnying ma zer/lo chen rin bzang man gyi 'gyur rnams la phyi 'gyur gsar ma zer ba'o rgya gar na gsang sngags gsar rnying bya ba med 'di bcos ma yin zer te/ rgya gar na rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i theg pa zer ba ma gtogs gsang sngags 325

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//gsar rnying gi dbye ba med de tshig don la dbye ba med pa yin no/ /rnying ma snga 'gyur du grags pa 'di'i/ bstan pa brgyud tshul chen po gsum la brten nas da lta yan chad du dar zhing rgyas pa'i tshul ni/ dang por gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra la bka' bskyed rdzogs gsum ma'i chu bo bzhi ka dus gcig la babs/gnyis pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che dang / gsum pa zur po che shākya 'byung gnas la bka'i chu bo chen po bzhi babs pa yin pas rang gi chos lugs da lta yang zam ma chad pa'o/ /bod yul la thub pa'i bstan pa spyi gang la 'phel 'grib byung bar byed na'ang gsang sngags kyi chos 'di bod rgyal glang dar mas bstan pa bsnub nga 'i das skabs la'ang lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje la sogs grub ba thob pa dngos su bzhugs pas na bstan pa rgyun ma chad par gnas par sems so/ /yang rgyud sde'i khog dbub las mnga' bdag khri ral gyis mkhan po klu'i dbang po dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ nyang so klu'i dbang phyug rnams rgya gar la brdzangs/ slob dpon bi ma la mi tra spyan drangs nas bsam yas su lo tsā ba snyags ku ma ras mdo dang sems phyogs bsgyur/a tsar+ya me rin chen mchog gis mtshan nyid dang / sgyu 'phrul bsgyur/ de yang sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad la sems dang ye shes rang snang du ston pa/ sku 'phrul rtsa ba'i rgyud gsang ba snying po/ rol pa mngon par brjod pa lha mo sgyu 'phrul/dkyil 'khor rdzogs par ston pa sgyu 'phrul brgyad pa/ phrin las rdzogs par ston pa smu 'phrul bzhi bcu pa/ dbang gtso bor ston pa sgyu 'phrul bla ma/ yon tan mthar phyin par ston pa sgyu 3 lhaXrgyad cu pa/ sde snod yongs la khyab

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/ par ston pa 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen mo/ dam tshig mchog tu ston pa sgyu 'phrul le lag dang brgyad do/ /bshad rgyud sde bzhi la/ grol lam rim par ston pa dang gcig char ston pa ye shes snying po dang rdo rje me long gnyis/thabs lam rim dang gcig char ston pa sgyu 'phrul thal ba dang rgya mtsho gnyis bcas bzhi'o/ /de rnams las bshad rgyud sde bzhi ma gtogs pa rnams/ lo tsā ba rma rin chen mchog gis gtsug tu rin chen gzhen nu dang / gye re mchog skyong la bshad/ de nyid kyis dar rje dpal gyi grags pa dang / zhang rgyal ba'i yon tan la bshad/ de gnyis las mkhas sna dar rgyas mkhas/ bla ma yang gang zag yin pas/ brtags la bya gsungs nas/ bla ma'i bka' ji ltar ba bzhin ma mdzad pas bka' yongs grags par grags/ 'gro phan cher ma byung / shad rgyal bas ni bla ma'i bka' bzhin mdzad pas/ bka' mchims phu bar grags/ 'gro phan shin tu che bar byung skad/ mtshims phu ba'i lugs ni zhang la gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po ches/ sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad gsan nas 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba ma gtogs pa rnabs so ye shes dbang phyug la gsungs/ des ngab thung byang chub rgyal mtshan la/ des rkong btsun shes rab ye shes la/ des gtsang gi ra thung pa shes rab tshul khrims la / des nyang shes rab mchog la/ des nyang ye shes 'byung gnas la/ des lha rje'u ba lung pa la gsungs pa'o/ /yang lugs gcig la gnubs sangasargyas ye shes rin po ches/ khu lung yon tan rgya mtsho la/ des sras ye shes rgya mtsho la/ des nyang sher mchog la/ des nyang ye shes 'byung gnas la/ des 327

'tshen na 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos na snang gces bsdus/ (5zur po che shākya 'byung gnas la/ des 'bangs rtse mo bzhi rtse lkog dang lnga/sgom chen brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs la gsungs/ rtse mo bzhi ni/ ra sa'i shad 'gos chung ba mkhyen rgya'i rtse mo/ shangs mtsho nya'i bzang sgom shes rab rgyal po sgom sgrub kyi rtse mo/ span gyi mi nyag 'byung grags la bshad pa'i rtse mo/thag gi bde gshegs rgyal po la lta dgongs kyi rtse mo'i/ /rtse khog gcig ni zur chung shes rab grags so/ /bde gshegs zur po ches thugs dam du sram pa sgrub khang rtsigs/ rgyu'i he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gtso 'khor rnamasabazhengs/ bla ma de'i yon tan thugs la mnga' ba thams cad zur chung shesarab grags pa la bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang zhing grub pa thob pa'i gang zag chen por grags so/ /de la slob ma ka ba bzhi/ gdung ma brgyad/ gdung bran sum cu rtsa gnyis/ yus po che mi gnyis la sogs mang du byung ngo / /de'i ka ba bzhi ni/ gong bu'i skyo ston sher ye shes/ rdzogs chen gyi ka ba nag mo ri seb kyi brda rig chos shag phrin sgrub kyi ka ba skyed lung gi yang gyed bla ma/mdo'i ka ba chu bar gyi rlan shākya bzang po sgyu 'phrul kyi ka ba'o/ /gdung ma brgyad sna/ sna nam gyi gnubs ston bag ma/ chu sgo'i la thog byang 'bar/ yi ser gyi skya chos seng dbus pas 'thor dang / rtse 'brom byang dpal/ byang pa zla grags/ btsag bla ma/ rlan nya tshal ba rnams so/ /yus po che'i mi gnyisani bha sgom dig ma dang / bon bsgom ngo bo'o/ /lha rje zur chung gi sras/ shākya rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / shākya seṅge gnyis las shākya seng gis/ yab kyi slob ma ka bzhi gdung brgyad kun la gsan3 rting / bzhug brlan nya tshal ba la

rgya bod yig cha 'a mo/ gtugs skad/ lha rje shākya seng shes sgro phug bzung ba'i dus su slob ma mang du byon kyang de rnams kyi nang nas bu chen nag po bzhi/ ston pa bzhi/ mes bzhi bya ba byung ba las/ nag po bzhi ni/ zur nag 'khor lo/ brgya nag skyi mkhar ba/ nyang nag rdo po/ lce nag dpal yong ngo / /ston pa bzhi ni/ nyesaston/ zhang ston/ rgyabs ston/ rgyas ston no/ /mes bzhi ni/ gtsang ba byis ston/g.yung ston hor po/spong ston lcags kyu/ dbus pa chos seng rnams so//gtsang pa byis ston dang slob dpon nyes ston gnyis kyis slob dpon gtsang nag 'od 'bar la gsungs/ des bla ma g.yung ston sangs rgyas dpal la/des rgya gab gong ba la des bla ma dpa'i shag 'od dang / bla ma sna bzhi pa'i sras g.yung ston chos mgon la des bla ma bha ston gzi brjid la/ des bdag g.yung ston rdo rje dpal la/ dbang bka'/ bshad bka'/ lung bka' rnams kyi gdams ngag phyag len dang bcas pa gnang ba lags so/ /yang lugs gcig la/ gtsang nag gi mes ston mgon po la bshad/ des bla ma dpa ga shi ba dang / bla ma rta nag pa bdud 'dul la/ des mda' shākya 'phel la / des zur byams pa seng ge la gsungs/ de gnyis ka las/ bdag g.yung ston rdo rje dpal gyis tshar mang du thos pa lags so/ /rdo rje theg pa'i byon tshul 'di bris pas/ /gsang sngags dar zhing rigs sngags rgyas pa dang / /gzungs //sna /thu dang rab ldan 'gro drug kun/ /snying po kun bzang yab yum myur 329

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (go/ bod du bstan pa phyi dar la mkhas grub dang sde dgon byung tshul bzhugs so/ /e ma ho/ chos rgyal mes dbon mkhyen brtse'i nam mkha' las/ /thub bstan nyi mas bod yul gsal ba'i dus/ /sdig rgyal dar ma'i sgra gcan gdong pa yis/ /chu mo phag nas drug cu rtsa brgyad bar/ /mun pa'i rgyal khams bzhin du nag por sgrib/ /bod khams phal cher bstan pa'i sgra mi grags/ /bstan 'dzin thams cad gab dang bros la rtsol/ /dbus gtsang mthil du chos min sna tshogs dar/ /rgyal khrims chen po'ang rang kha sil bur thal/ /de la rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bzod par/ /mnga' bdag tshwa la na yi thugs brgyud bskul/ /bla chen spyan sngar chos zhu rim par brdzangs/ /bstan pa'i me ro smad nas slangs tshul dang / /phyi dar byung bar 'byung lugs 'di ltar snang / /zha lu bu ston chen po'i chos 'byung las//bod yul kha ba can gyi yul ljongs 'dir//sangs rgyas bstan pa phyi dar byung tshul ni/ sdig rgyal glang dar ma de nyid/ chu mo lug lo pa yin la/ sum cu so dgu lon pa'i dus su mnga' bdag khri ral grongs nas khong gis rgyal srid bzung / lo gnyis rgyal po tshul bzhin byas/chu mo phag gi lo mjug nas thugs la gdon gsol ba dang blon po rgyal to re stag rna can la sogs sdig la dga' ba rnams kyis bsgyur nas/ sngar nu bo la rgyal srid bskos pa'i snying nad /sdu/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa

rgya bod yi ga zung chen mo/bsnubs/ lo phyed dang bzhin sdig rgyal kho na byas/ zhe bzhi lon pa me pho stag lo'i dus/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes lha sa'i rdo ring rtsa ru rgyal po glang dar ma bkrongs so/ /de'i dus su 'jad kyi gyel mi gtsang rab gsal dang / bo dong pa g.yo dge 'byung / stod lung pa dmar shākya mu yi dang gsum po dpal chu bo ri la sgom gyin yod pa la/ btsun pas khyi ra byed pa mthong ste/ dris pas rgyal pos bstan pa bsnubs par shes te/ 'dul ba'i po ti drel khal gcig bkal nas mnga' ris stod du bros/ gar log la lam byas hor yul du phyin nas skad rigs mi gcig pa'i sa char bstan pa dar bar bya snyam pa la/ lo tsā med pas dar bar ma nus te/ mdo smad lho ngos kyi be ra tshwa mtsho na tshur byung nas rma lung rdo rje brag ra an byung gnam rdzong dan tig shel gyi yang dgon du slebs/ sgom gyin yod pa la me chu kha'i phyugs rdzis mthong nas/ yul mi la smras pas las dang skal bar ldan pa/ mos par spyod pa'i sa dpal mu zu gsal 'bar bya bas ltar phyin pas dad nas rab tu byung bar zhus pa la/'dul ba'i po ti bstan nas/ 'di la ltos/ dad na rab tu byung gsungs ltasapas/ shin tu nas dad de mchi ma byung ngo / /der gtsang gis mkhan po g.yosaslob dpon byas nas/ dge tshul gyi ming mkhan slob la sbyar nas dge ba gsal du btags so/ /phyis thugs rab che bas dgongs pa rab gsal du grags/ de nas lo gcig song ba dang bsnyen rdzogs zhus pas/ dge slong lnga ma tshang bas mi yong gsungs nas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes ni/ ngas rgyal po bsad pas byar mi rung / gzhan nas btsal gyis gsungs te/ rgya nag hwa shang 331

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//ko wang dang gyi wan bya ba btang byung ba dang / sngar gyi mkhan slob kyi mkhan po dang dmar gyis gsang ston byas/ rgya'i dge slong gnyis pos kha skong byas te lnga'i tshogs kyis bsnyen rdzogs byas so/ /de nas lo lnga lon pa dang bsam yas nas rgyal brgyud mnga' bdag tshwa la na yab sras kyis mdo smad na rab byung yod pa'i rgyu mtshan tshor nas/ dbus gtsang gi mi shes rab dang snying rus che ba rnams chos 'tshol ba la nges par btang dgos dgongs pa shar te/dbus nas glags pa lam pa/ klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ 'bri ye shes yon tan/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sba tshul khrims blo gros/ sum pa ye shes blo gros dang lnga/ gtsang nas mgur mo rab kha ba lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug shab sgo mnga' ba'i tshong btsun shes rab seṅge/ mnga' ris 'od brgyad spun gnyis/ bo dong pa u pa de dkar ba dang lnga ste/ mi bcu khams la brdzangs nas/ gcang g.yo dmar gsum la bka' drin zhus pas/ gtsang na re da nga gos pas mkhan po mi skyongs/ bla chen po la zhus gsungs nas/ zhus pas ngas bsnyen rdzogs byas nas lo lnga las ma lon pas mkhan po mi btub gsungs pa la/ gtsang na re dmigs bsal la btub par gyis gsungs nas/ bla chen pos mkhan po dang gtsang g.yos/ las slob dang gsang ston byas/ dmar dang hwa shang gis kha skongs byas te/ thams cad chog rdzogs byasaso / / bla chen gyi zhal nas/ da khyed rnams yar song la dbus gtsang du bstan pa dar ba zhig gal che bas/ lo ston mthu che bas bstan srungs gyis/ klu mes btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ tshong dge1 snro rno bas ston pa gyis/ 'bri kha bkod

rgya bo yig tshang chen rngo /mkhas pas gnas gzhi bzung / gsungs nas byings pos yar yong/ klu mes kyis grum ye shes rgyal mtshan la 'dul ba nyan cing sdad do/ /de'i dus su / rag shi dang / sba'i gcung gnyis phu bo gnyis po bsu ba la yong / ldan glang thang du mjal ba dang gcung gnyis dang bo dong os mkhan po dang phu bo gnyis kyis slob dpon byas nas rab tu byung ste/ da lta sba rag gnyis gcig tu sdebs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no//de nas/lo ston na re khyod tsho 'di khar stod cig ngas dbus gtsang du phyin la/ bstan pa dar nus mi nus brtags pas nus na bsdad kyi/ khyod rnams yar byon mi nus na nga yang mar la log yong gis gsungs nas/ ldan ma'i tshong pa dang 'grogs te byon pas tshong pa rnams/ gsum 'phrang du tshong sprad nas phyir bzlog par 'dod 'dug pa la/khyod rnams 'dir tshong ma sprad pa gtsang du song la mgur mo rab kha bya ba na lo nag gtsag bya ba yod kyi de la khyod kyi bu rab tu byung nas dbus na yod gyis shig byas nas btang bas/ 'phrin 'phrod tshong yang legs so byung bas/ deng sang bar du mgur mo'i tshong 'dus byung ba 'di'ang lo ston gyi drin yin no/ /de'i phyis lo klu mes kyis mkhan po la kho bo dbus gtsang du 'gro bas/ mchod pa'i rten gcig zhu byas pas bon po'i zhwa 'bos su phog nas sa ser po btab pa gcig gsol 'phro la gnang ste/ 'di gyon la rjes su dran par gyis gsungs/ yar byon te thams cad dbus su 'dus pa dang /sngon mkhas btsun rnams kyi gdan sa lha sa yin yang / chad pas gcod pa'i sa yin pas 'gro ma nus par/ bsam yas su byon/mnga' bdag tshwa la na yab sras dang mjal/333

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gi tses bsdus/ (//sdig rgyal glang dar mas/ chu mo phag nas bstan pa bsnubs/ kho rang gis lo mang ma thub na'ang de'i smon lam log pa dang las ngan shugs che bas/ lo drug cu rtsa brgyad kyi bar la dbus gtsang du bshad sgrub dge las gang gi'ang sgra mi grags pa byung ste/ lcags pho rta lo la dbus gtsang gi mi bcu po/bsam yas su slebs/ rgyal pos bkur sti dang bya dga' chen po mdzad/bstan pa'i me ro smad nas slangs te nyin mo ltar gsal zhing dar rgyas 'phel bar byas pa'o/ /de dus klu mes kyis/ ka chu bzung / sba mched kyis sbu tshal dang / dbu rtse bzung / rag shi mched kyis dge rgyas bzung / 'bring gis zangs kha bzung ngo / /de nas dbus pa lnga pos rang cag rnams gnas gzhi brtsigs dgos gsungs nas/ klu mes kyis la mo chag de'u brtsigs de la mkhan bu bzhi byung ba'i gru mar tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis sol nag thang chen brtsigs/ de la mched pa la thang skor zer/ zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis ra tshag dang / rgyal brtsigs de las mched pa la zhang skor zer/sdog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis yer pa ba ring brtsigs/ smad kyi las mched pa zangs gi lding ba dang / chu shul gyi na bo che dang / sbus sde lto gong dang /yol thang dang / las so dang / gral ma thang dang / mkha' stag po gnyis rnams brtsigs/ de nas gtsang du gzhu'i kun dga' ra ba dang chu mig rtsigs kyi gzhod du/ sdog dang / sum pa ye shes blo gros kyis g.yu sgro khang dmar brtsigs te de las mched pa la sdog tshe skor zer/ rlan ye shes shes rab kyis rgyal gsar sgang dang glags ma~X lha khang dang tshal chu gnyis bzung /

rgya bod mig tsha za mo de las mched pa la rlan tsho skor zer ro/ /sum pa ye shes blo gros kyis 'bre sa thang du rme ru brtsigs te zhig nas mched pa'ang med do/ /rag shis ra shi 'phreng 'og gi lha khang brtsigs/ sbas gzhung nya mo 'gyur brtsigs/ de nas lan pa spyil bu bzung / de'i mkhan bu mal sems dpa' shes rab kyis stod lung tsha theg bzhengs/ de nas thag ma lha khang dang mon gra bzung ste/ de tsho la sba tsho zer ro/ /sba'i gcung gis gye re tshar sna'i mda' grong lha khang brtsigs/de nas bzhi'i chang khang bzung / rag shis/ ka tshal dang / zha bzung de las mched pa la rag tsho zer ro/ /rag shi'i gcung gis dge rgyas bzung / de'i mkhan bu mtha' rgyal 'phags kyis kyang de ka bzung / de'i mkhan bu zhang btsun shes rab 'phags kyis lan pa rta bres brtsigs/ de las mched pa la rag shi'i gcung gi brgyud pa zer ro/ /'bring gis ngan lam spyi mi brtsigs/de nas skar chung bzung / de nas snye thang brag sna bzung de'i lam btegs la brang ra mo che brtsigs/ de las mched pa la 'bring tsho smad pa zer ro ngan lam pa'i 'bring tsho la 'bring tsho stod pa zer/ klu gong nas mched pa la 'bring tsho bar pa zer ro/ /gtsang gi lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis rgyan gong brtsigs de la mkhan bu nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ba'i rgya shākya gzhon nus las stod mar la thang brtsigs/ de la bri ba rnams kyi/ sdog lhag lha khang la sogs gyes pa la rgya tsho zer/ skyo shes rab rdo rjes don mo ri brtsigs stod kyi de nas mched/stag la byang chub gyis stag lo lha khang brtsigs/ de nas mched pa la stag tsho zer/ a mes zhu gcig mas 'phrang dang brag dmar bzung de nas mched pa 335

ba chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (nel zhu tsho zer ro/ /'dar shākya yon tan gyis gzus po bzung de nas mched pa 'dar tsho zer/ li blo gros gzhon nus jo mo brtsigs de nas mched pa la li tsho zer ro/ /smad kyi lnga la/ rgyan gong ma'i skor dang glags byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis chu mig brtsigs de nas mched pa la glags tsho zer/ chags pa'i gha shes rab bla mas snyems brtsigs/ rdo rje ye shes 'byung gnas kyis spang dkar lha lung brtsigs te de gnyis kyis skya ma thub pas glags tsho las gzhan med do/ /glang btsun byams pas 'om phug brtsigs/ de nas gtsang 'gram bzung / de nas bum thang chags mgo ston khrol ma la sogs pa la tsho stod smad zer ro/ /mgo mag g.yung drung gis sbre lha khang bzung ngo / /de'i mkhan bu lte btsun sher 'byung gis zhal lu 'a mo brtsigs te rgya gar du byon nas sdom pa bskyar nas blangs/ shul du mgo ma g.yung drung gis zhal lu bzung / de la bu chen ka bzhi/ gdung drug de las mched pa la zhal lu brgya skor zer ro/ /kyi ye shes dbang pos shangs phu'i mkhar lung dang / gye re glang ra/ de gnyis kyi lam btegs la/ mu shangs kyi ro skam brtsigs glang ra nas mched pa la glang ra skor zer/ nyug gi u lung nas gyes pa la sna tsho zer/ de gnyisaganyis la/ kyi tsho smad pa zer ro/ /glang ra nas 'khris kyi kha chad dgon pa bzung a mes kyi mkhan bu shad ston tshul 'phags kyis bya kyus bzung / a mes kyi mkhan bu kong po thar pa rin mkhan bu bzhi byung ste/ gzu ston 'phan grags kyis sgro'i lce mtshams dang rgya mkhar stag lung bzung / de las mched pa la gzu tsho zer/ lce btsun dkar /sdu ang yig bzung g.yu ston dza ka ri

rgya bod yig tshang 'a mo/pas 'or bzung / de gnyis gcig mo'i skor du song nas mched pa med/ shang rtses shar rtse lha khang brtsigs te de tsho la rgod tsho zer zhing / kyi tsho bar pa yang zer ro/ /a mes kyis kha chad dgon pa nas sad kyi la gtod ra bzung /der stod kyi mkhan bu zhang dbon po rnam gsum pa byung ba'o/ khri ston brtson 'bar gyis sho sna ra bzung / de nas mched pa la khri tsho zer/ sa bod btsun chung gis brang chung bzung / de nas mched pa la brang chung skor zer/ rgya ston ar+ya de was sgo ru ru sna bzung / de nas mched pa la rgya tsho zer/ mkhan po gzhon nu shākyas se phug bzung / de nas mched pa la sar tsho zer/ de rnams la stod kyi khul tsho bzhi ste kyi tsho stod pa'o/ /a me'i mkhan bu spangs kyis 'bri skyangs/ shad btsun bsod nams grags kyis bya kyus bzung ste/ de gnyis la kyi tsho bar pa zer ro/ /kyi tsho stod nas mched pas mkhan bu gzhen nu 'byung gnas kyis rgyang mkhar thur la bzung / de nas gyes pa la thur tsho zer ro/ /kyi btsun dpal gyi ye shes kyis zhu kun dga' ra ba bzung de tsho kyi tsho stod nas gyes pa yin no/ /tshong tsho khral tsho dgu byung ste/ tshong tsho stod pa la skal skor dang rgyan skor gnyis byung / tshong tsho bar pa la gnas gsar dang /gnas rnying gnyis byung / smad tsho la khral tsho lnga yod de/ a mes tshong btsun gyis rtsis kyi yang dben bzung ba'i dus su rtsis lha khang phul/ de nye gnas sba btsun blo gros yon tan la gtad/ des mkhan po byas nas bskyangs pa tsho la sba tsho zer te/ de'i mkhan bu yol chos dbang gis skegs gnas snying bzung /de nas mched pa la sba tsho stod pa zer/ rtsis nas mched pa la sba tsho smad pa 337

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ( )zer ro/ /de nas a mes la nyan tsho phul nas mkhan bur blo gros bzang po dang / khams pa gnyis la nyang tsho gtad nas ngur smig bzung / khamasapas lcags mkhar bzung ste ra tsho dang / khams pa tsho zer zhing / gnyis pa nyang tsho skor du grags so/ /a mes la stag tshal gyi bya chos mkhar po che phul nas mkhan bu rgya tshul seng la gtad/ rgyas rkong po ye shes 'byung la gtad/rkong pos rmu'i gnas mo che dang bya chos gnyis ka bskyangs/ dmu thang brtsigasade rnams bya chos skor zer ro/ /de nas a mes la/ mar shul ma yon bdag mos nyos mos smon khro phul/ des mkhan bu mar pa ye shes rdo rje la gtad/de'i mkhan bu rnal po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis rong stod mkhan bu bzung ba dang phyis a mes phyugs mtshams kyis stag tshal kyus thang bzhengs nas phul ba dang / mar pas bran mo rkang po brtsigs/ lang 'gro stag tshang gnas dang bzhi po la smon khro'i ma dang mnyam pa'i bu bzhir grags te/ de rnams la smon tsho skor zer ro/ /de nas yang a mes kyis/ gser gyi gong khro bzung nas de mkhan bu shad pa rtser khrod pa la gtad/ des gser gyi brags gshongs brtsigs/ de nas btsan mo sdings bzung / rtsis kyi yang dben dang ra sogasa'atshar la dang stag tshal mkhar po che rnams bzung nas/ mkhan bu sba dge mthong la gtad/ des rong gi ba de bzung / des mkhan bu 'bre btsun sngon mo la gtad/ de rnams la da tsho zer ro/ khral tsho 'dus nas mdun ma byed pa'i dus su de'i pa'i btsun chung gsum byung ba la khyod kyi dpon gar song byasapas shi zer/'o na khyed do phrug tu 3 /8 pa byas pas/ ming do tshor chags so//

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ gzhan yang 'a zha mgo bo che'i bu 'a zha ye shes g.yu drung gis/ khams su sdom pa len pa la 'gro bar 'dod nas lha sar phyin pas lha sa'i steng khang la 'gro ba'i skas gcig gi mar zur dpal mgon po'i gzugs ri mor bris nas yod pa la/ yar 'gro tsa na ri mor 'dug pa la/ mar 'ong tsa na dpal mgon po dngos thod pa'i nang na mi'i snying dang khrag bsres nas/ mi'i rtsib mas thur ma byas te gsol zhing 'dug pa la gsol ba btab pas/ ngas khyod kyi chosaskyong bya'i zla ba gcig la 'khor bar nus zer ro/ /mtsho mthu che ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /de nas 'a zhus khams kyi grwa nas bla chen pa'i mkhan bu tre bo'i mchog bla bya ba la bka' drin zhus pas/ ngas chab gtor btang la 'ongs kyis zer nas nang du song phyir yong long med pa la 'das na'ang 'ong gi zer ba de tsam la sdom pa thob par byas nas/ de la dge tshul chu gtor ma zhes par grags so/ /des mkhan po byas nas sna nam 'dre bdes dang / 'u yug mda' ra sha de gnyis kyi lam stegs su stag gi gnas po che bzung ngo / /de'i mkhan bu/ shi'u snye nam pas lhan gyi ba so thang dang / 'khor re skyid khang /nyang ro bud mdo/ 'khor re ba 'khor/ lha tre gzhongs rnams rim pa bzhin du bzung ngo / /de'i mkhan bu sog tshul khrims bla mas ba so thang bzung / de'i mkhan bu spangs 'dul 'dzin gyis/ stag gi spen can bzung / de'i mkhan bu sbubs rin chen grags kyis khu lung lha dral bzung / ra sha nas 'u yug gsal sgang bzung ste de rnams la 'a tsho zer ro/ /yang 'breng gzhen tshul gyis khams su sdom pa len du phyin pas/ khams kyi khri mkhar snar bla chen 339

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (5po'i mkhan bu ya zi bon ston bya ba dang mjal nas/ bka' dris zhus pas de bas zer nas/ sbyin long med par 'das pa dang / ngas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa thob pa yin te mkhan po na re der bas zer ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer bas der bas kyi bsnyen rdzogs su grags so/ /des rta nag phu'i bya tshang bzung des nas shangs kyi bye phug bzung / bya tshang nas mched pa la 'jad kyi gnas brgyad byung ste/ de tsho la 'bre tsho zer ro/ /de ltar khams su dbusagatsang gi mi bcus phyin kyang / dbus kyi sum pa dang / gtsang nas 'o brgyad spun las mched pa med pas mi drug tu grags shing / 'a 'bre gnyis/ de rnams la ma gtogs so/ /a mes bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal dang /bod rgyal yum brtan brgyud kyi mnga' bdag tshwa la na yab sras/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcu dang bcas pa de rnams kyi thugs rje dang mdzad phrin la brten nas bstan pa'i me ro smad nas slangs/ bod yul mun pa'i smag rum gsangasate dgon mang po btab/ bshad nyan gyis bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas na bka' drin shin tu che'o/ /de rting yang bod rgyal 'od srungs brgyud/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od khu dbon rim pa stod na bzhugs pa rnams kyis/ rje btsun ga ya dha ra dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha pha dam pa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī la sogs rgya gar kha che'i grub thob mang po spyan drangs pa dang / bod du 'khrungs pa'i lo chen rin chen bzang po/ khu rngog 'brom gsum bla ma sa skya pa khu dbon/ shangs pa bka' brgyud dang / gzhan yang dwags po la sogs lo paṇa mkhas grub bzang la mang po ri/4 sbyar byon pa rnams kyis mdo rgyud man

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/ngag dang bcas pa'i 'chad nyan sgom sgrub bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad pas na dam pa'i chos yar 'phel du rgyas te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che gangs la nyi ma shar ba bzhin du/ gsal zhing dwangs bar bzhugs pa 'di lags so/ /bstan pa phyi dar dar tshul 'di bris pas/ /bstan pa'i chu rgyun rgyun ring gnas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes mchog mchog tu rab 'phel nas/ /bstan zhugs 'gro kun kun mkhyen myur thob shog /'dul ba smad 'dul du grags pa 'di'i bshad brgyud ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ nye ba 'khor/ kun dga' bo/ sha na'i gos can/ nyer sbas/ dhi ti zha nag po/ legs mthong / blos mi 'bebs/ yon tan 'od/ shākya 'od/chos kyi bshes gnyen che chung gnyis/ de gnyis gas seng ge'i gdong can/des dha na shī la dang / dzi na mi tra/ des cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ des g.yo dge 'byung / gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu rne gsum la bshad do/ /de mtshams bod rgyal glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i skabs su g.yo gtsang dmar gsum gyis dpal chu bo ri nas/ 'dul ba drel khal gcig bkal nas stod phyogs la bros/ hor yul bskor nas mdo smad an chung gnam rdzong dan tig shel gyi lha khang du phebs dus bon rgan mu zi gsal bzang gi bu mu zi gsal 'bar bya ba lo bco lnga lon pa gcig dang mjal/de shin tu dad nas rab tu byung bar zhus pas 'dul ba'i las chog gar ma sha tam gyis dpe bstan nas/ 'di ltar nus na rab tu byung ngo gsungs pa la/'di bzhin cis kyang nus pas rjes su bzung du gsol zhus pas/ g.yos 341

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (she/mkhan po dang / dmar gyis slob dpon/ gtsang gis las slob byas nas/rab tu byung ste ming dge ba rab gsal bya bar btags/ de lo lnga song ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad pa'i mtshan dgongs pa rab gsal du grags shing/ de rting mkhan slob gnyis la 'dul ba mdo rtsa man chad kyi phran rnams zhus/ las slob gtsang rab gsal la pra ka ra sde brgyad zhus/ de nas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi slob ma la snga ba khams kyi thog po mi drug tu bya ba byung ste/ ya gong ye shes g.yu drung dang / par rin chen gsal/ 'al pa rdo rje dbang phyug gdubs phag shi ta/ jo bo ye shes seng ge cog ro shes rab byang chub rnams yin/ dang po mkhan slob cha ma tshang bas gzugs btsun byas/'dul ba la sogs pa'i chos rnams ni gnang bkar rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi bya ba zhwa theb kyi mu thums dang / bla gos kyi mtha' tshems/ gtor bu/ ka li'i nang rnams sngon por byas pa yang khong drug po la gnang bar byed cing / de ni bla chen dang po bon po'i brgyud par song ba'i thugs zhen brda mtshon du byas pa'o/ /yang bar gnyis kyi slob ma/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des grum g.yu drung rgyal mtshan shing lag can la bshad do/ /de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan/ bsam yas su yum brtan brgyud kyi rgyal po mnga' bdag tshwa la na yab sras kyisatshor nas dbus gtsang gi mi drug gam bcu bla chen dpon slob la rab byung dang /chos zhu ba la gtang dus shing lag can la lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang /tshong btsun shes rab seng ges 'dul ba zhus gtsang du dar bar byas pa'o/ /klu mes tshul khrims shes rab dang su/ rdzu ye shes blo gros kyis zhus nas

rgya bod yig tshang 'a mo/ dbus stod smad du dar bar byas pa'o/ /yang 'a btsun shākya rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ dbus su dar zhing 'bre ston tshul khrims gzhon nus gtsang du 'dul ba dar bar byas pa'o/ /me byang chub 'od kyis kyang khams su thug nas smad tsho dar bar byas pa la sogs pa de phyin/ 'dul ba'i bshad rgyud so sor gyes pa mang ngo / /chos mdzad rnam bshad kyi lugs la klu mes kyis gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan la bshad/ des rnal po grags pa rgyal mtshan la sogs gtsang pa mi bzhi la bshad/ de rnams la rgya dbang rdor dang / 'jag rdor dgas zhus/de gnyis la bya brtson 'grus 'bar gyis zhus/ de la rtsis pa gzhen seng gis zhus/ de la gnyer chung bzang ston gyis zhus de la shākya'i dge slong thub pa shes rab bdag gis 'dul ba'i skor tshang bar zhus pa lags so/ /smad 'dul bshad brgyud 'di bris dge ba yis/ /'dul khrims gtsang zhing 'chad nyan dar rgyas shog/ /// jo po'i slob brgyud bka' gdams pa'i byon tshul bzhugs/na mo rat+na gu ru sa gangs can ljongs 'dir thub bstan gsal ba dang / /snyigs dus 'gro rnams smin grol 'god pa'i phyir/ /jo bo yab sras bka' gdams brgyud pa rnams/ /byon pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar 'di ltar snang / /bod du bka' gdams pa'i brgyud pa byon tshul ni/ dang por/ rgya gar mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho rab tu bzang po'i gdung brgyud yin pa/ dpal rdo rje 343

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (re/gdan gyi shar phyogs/ yul chen po bha gha la za hor zhes bya ba'i grong khyer/mi khyim 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa bdun yod pa'i dbus na pho brang gser gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba/ longs spyod rgya nag stong kun rgyal po dang mnyam pa/ de'i rgyal po dge ba'i dpal gyi sras gsum gyi 'bring po zla ba'i snying po zhes bya ba/chu pho rta lo la sku 'khrungs te/ gzhon nu nas rdo rje gdan ma ti'i gtsug lag khang du/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyi bka' brgyud mkhan po rgyun du zhugs pa gcig la/ dge 'dun phal chen sde pa'i bye brag 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba'i sde pa la rab tu byung ba/ bri ka ma shī la'i gnas brtan jo bo rje di po ka ra shrī dzñā na dpal ldan a ti sha zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis thog mar rgya gar shar nub thams cad du mdo rgyud kyi chos la mkhas par sbyangs shing / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod na sgra'i gnas ka ba drug la 'jug pa paṇ+ḍi ta phal che bas ma shes pa je bos mkhyen pa sogs gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur te/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa la bod rgyal po 'od srung gi brgyud lha bla ma ye shes 'od khu dbon gyis rgya brtson seng dang /nag tsho lo tsā ba gdan 'dren rim par byung ba dang / yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa bzhin/ bod la byon nas bal yul du lo gcig mnga' ris stod du lo gnyis/ gtsang du lo gcig dbus phyogs su lo bdun zla ba lnga'i bar la bzhugs/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad nas/dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gsum pa/ shing pho rta lo dbyug pa zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la snye thang 'or du bde bar 3 4 4 pa'i tshul bstan te dga' ldan du

rgya bod yig tshang 'a mo/gshegs so/ /de'i slob ma rgya bod du mang du byon pa'i nang nas/ thugs sra sakyi thu bo khu rngog 'brom gsum/ bod du byon de'i nang nas kyang / bka' gdams kyi mes po 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ stod lung gnam gyi bye ma lung pa/ rten dge bsnyen yin/ jo bo rje dang mnga' ris mtho lding gser gyi lha khang du mjal nas/ bde bar ma gshegs bar la sku lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'bral ba med par bzhugs nas/ jo bo'i yon tan thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang zhing / bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i bdag por bskos so/ /des ra sgreng dgon pa btab/ de la slob ma mang du byon kyang srasakyi thu bo sku mched gsum ni/phu chung ba gzhen nu rgyal mtshan dang / pu to ba rin chen gsal/ spyan mnga' ba tshul khrims 'bar/ gzhan yang khams pa lung pa dang bzhir grag pa'ang yod do/ /phu chung pas slob ma ma bsten/ pu to ba la slob ma nyis stong brgyad brgya tsam 'dus/ ra sgreng gi gdan sa lo gsum mdzad/ thugs sras bu chen brgyad du grags pa gtsang du ram sdings ma ba pa/ gnas rdo rje snang dre'u lhas pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gnyis/ mnyam du glang gnyos gnyis su grags pa'i gnyal pa chos 'bar dang / bun pa lha rje gnyis/ don las 'be mon bu chung ba dang / rog dmar zhur ba gnyis/ dbur stod nas zhang sha ra ba yon tan rgya mtsho dang / glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge de gnyis la nyi zla zung gcig tu'ang grags so//glang ri thang pa'i slob ma/sha'o snang pa nas/ glang thang shad /dge bshes gnyen/ slob dpon sgom pa/ dge bshes mgar/ slob dpon gtsang pa rnams so/ /glang thang zhang gi slob ma/ chos rje phag mo gru pa yang 345

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//yin/ de nas/ sangs rgyas dbon pos glang thang rgya ma ba la phul/ zhang shang ra ba la grwa pa sum stong drug brgya kha yar tsam byung ba'i nang nas/ bka' babs bzhir grags pa'i/ byang sems kyi bka' babs/ bya 'chad kha ba/ rnam thar gyi bka' babs nyi ma la 'dul 'dzin longs spyod kyi bka' babs rnal 'byor shes rdor/ 'dis gdan sa lo gsum mdzad/ gzhung bshad kyi bka' babs/dam pa stabs kha ba dang bzhi'o/ /snar thang pa chos lung sku gshegs pa dang lnga zer ba'ang yod do/ /sngar gyi stabs kha bas/ 'od 'jo/ ngar dgon/ khra phu/stabs kha ba dang dgon pa bzhi btab bo/ /bya chad kha ba'i slob ma/ so spyi'asabu ba dang / rnal 'byor byang seng /gan pa dar re la sogs pa rnams yin/ se spyil bu btab/ de'i slob ma/ lto rin po che/ des lha 'gro ba'i mgon po/ /des lha lung gi dbang phyug rdzo bo grags rin gyi khu bo skyo mo dar rgyan gyi bu yin/des lha zur khang pa/ des jo bo grags rin gyi sras rnal 'byor byang chub seng ges gro sadagon pa btab bo//sangs rgyas dar res mkhar ru dgon pa btab bo//po to ba'i slob ma gtum ston blo gros grags kyis dpal snar thang btab ste/ chos lung du sku gshegs su grags/ de'i gdan sa gting dkar sku gshegs shesangarab grags kyis snar thang zhes pa'i ming btags de'i gdan sa/ zhang btsun rdo rje 'od/ de rnams kyi slob ma dpal ldan gro bdud rtsi grags/ des sangasargyas sum cu so lnga dang / rje btsun sgrol ma dang / gnas brtan bcu drug grub thob nya ri khrod pa rnams kyi zhal gzigs/ sangs rgyas stong gi ya gyal du grags/ de'i slob ma zhang ston chos rdi ṭ+wāṃ ma/ de'i rjes su sangs rgyas sgom pa

rgya bod yig mos za slo/seng ge skyabs 'gro mgon zhang dang dus mtshungs yin/ de'i ring la/ dha na shi la'i slob ma skyes nag grags seng / mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa btsugs/ bcom ldan ral gri la sogs byung byang chen btab/ de'i gdan sa/ mkhan chen mchims nam mkha' grags chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bla ma yin/ lha khang rnying ma bzhengs/ chu mig chos 'khor chen mo'i gral dpon mdzad/ de'i slob ma/skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ des snar thang gi gtsug la ga khang chen mo dang lcags ri chen mo bzhengs/ de'i gdan sa chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ des/chos khrims stag brgyad bskos/ chos khrims kyi dag zer cher mdzad/ de rting mkhan chen 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa brtson 'grus ze'u bas/ se chen dang ol ja ru rgyal po'i dus su gong du bzhus nas bstan pa dang gdan sa la phan pa mdzad/ de'i slob ma mkhan chen grags pa shes rab/ de'i gdan sa/mkhan chen mchims blo bzang grags pas sha khrims dang / khams pa mi brten pa'i khrims mdzad/ de la sogs gzhung 'chad nyan byed pa rnams po to ba'i rgyud sde bka' gdams gzhung par grags so/ /spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar gyis lo pa'i gnas brtan bgres po gcig 'dug pa la/ brid skol byas/ tshogs pa nam tshogs dus rngan pa ster ba'i dam bcas nas lo dgon pa btab/ de'i slob ma stod lung pa rin chen snying pos btsan gro dgon pa btab/ stod lung pa'i dpon po spyan snga ba'i gsol ja ba gzhon nu 'od kyis bya yul btab ste bya yul chen por grags skad/ de'i slob ma chen po bcu bzhir grags pa'i nang nas khams su rab kha ba chen po dang tshangs pa chen po/347

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//dwags po shar pa gling pa chen po dang bo thang pa chen po/ g.yer ri mor ba chen po dang / rgya ri ba chen po/ gtsang du brag dmar ba chen po dang brag nag pa chen po bu sman pa chen po des rgyal po steng btab/ khrom bzher ba chen pos dam dam btab/ smad du dam bu ri pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' zla rgyal gyis dum bu ri btab/ sgyer sgom chen pos rgya ma'i mchod khang rnying pa dang rin chen sgang btab bo/ /bya yul du gnubs mchod gnas dang / gtsang pa jo sras rin chen glang lung pa lor dge bshes gnas brtan gtsang pa rin po che glang lung pa nas bya yul dang gnyis ka bskyangs/ de nas slob brgyud rim pa bzhin du/ se rnal 'byor/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ zem tshe ring mo ba/ khams pa lung pa/ sangs rgyas gtsang ston de 'bri khung pas dkrongs/ de rting slob dpon jo bo des lha khang gsos/ de nas/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ slob dpon sgom pa/ slob dpon rgyal stengs pa/ slob dpon btsan khro ba/ spyan snga tshulakhrims mgon rnams so/ /bya yul ba 'di pa'i gdan sa chos pa gang bzang res 'dzin pa min pa/ dbon rgyud kyis 'dzin pa'i srol med do//rgya ma'i skyer sgom chen pos rgya ma rin chen snang dang / mchod khang rnying ma btab pa'i rjesasu / bya yul ba chen po'i skye ba yin zer ba sangs rgyas dpon ston gyis/ rgya ma'i lha khang gsar ma btab/ de nas dbon brgyud rim pa bzhin du/ slob dpon gsang yon/ dpon po gzhon nu seng ge slob dpon dam dgon pa gzhon nu 'bum/ slob dpon 'od 'byung / slob dpon gzhan nu 'od/ slob dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan rnams 3 4 8 / /'di pa'i gdan sa snyer gyi gdung

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/brgyud kyis 'dzin pa'i srol yin/ yang jo bo'i slob ma bla chen bzhi las rnal 'byor pa phyag dar mchog rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje/ rnal 'byor pa 'dzing dbang phyug rgyal mtshan des slob ma ma bskyangs/ rnal 'byor pa chen po lung a mes byang chub dpal ldan/ dgon pa bar grags pa/ de'i slob ma zhad ka ma ba/ gnyan sna mo ba/ 'bre ko de lung pa/ tsho skong sne zur ba dang bzhi la dgon gyi bu bzhir grags shing / kha rag sgom chung dang lnga ste/ 'di rnams so so'i slob brgyud dang / khyad par sne zur pa'i brgyud la/ gtsang na drang po lung pa dang / spyi bo lhas pa la sogs pa dang / dbus na rgya ma rin chen sgang pa spun ste de la sogs pa rnams gdams ngag gtso bor ston pas bka' gdams gdams ngag par grags so/ /yang jo bo'i slob ma/ nag tsho lo tsā ba / de'i slob ma rong pa phyag sor ba sku tshe hril po sku mtshams la bzhugs/lan cig 'brug 'dum la ston pa rma tsho byang rdor gyis wu shang rdor spyan drangs te grwa pa lnga brgya dang bcas pas chos zhus pa'i nang nas/ zur chos pa bzhig zin ris so sor byas pas/ bstan rim bzhi byung bas/ rong pa'i bu bzhir grags pa ni zul phu'i bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po/ rog stag can pa/gtsang na zhu ldan pa chen po/ rnam par ba chen po 'dis rnam par dang / ram pa lhas sdings btab/ gsang phu ni'u thog gi gdan sa'ang lo bdun mdzad/ de dag ni rong pa'i bka' brgyud lags/ rong pa phyag rdor ba'i dgon pa bcom chung gi phur ra sgrong gi 'og na yod pas bka' gdams 'og ma bar grags/de dang ra sgreng bka' brgyud gnyis la bka' gdams gong 'og tu grags 349

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (//so / / bka' gdams brgyud pa 'di bris rgyal ba'i bka'/ /bka' bsdu gsum nas ma 'chug brgyud pa'i bka'/ /bka'i zab don gdams pas bstan pa'i rgyun/ /rgyun mi chad cing 'gro kun smin grol shog/ /// rngog khu dbon gyis thog drangs bshad grwa dar tshul bzhugs so//na mo mañdzu sto ṣa ya/kha ba can ljongs dbus gtsang gangs ri'i rtser//'chad nyan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i lo chen khu dbon gyis/ /mtshan nyid sde btsug bstan pa ji ltar spel/ /de'ang ston pa sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo sum stong nyis brgya dang brgyad na/ bod kha ba can gyi ljongs yar 'brog tsho dang nye ba'i phyogs su/gsang sngags rnying ma'i dge bshes rdo rje gzhen nu zhes pa la/ sras lnga byung ba'i che shos rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis jo bo rje la sogs pa'i mkhasagrub du ma bsnyen cing gsang phu ni'u thog gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs te/bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ de'i gas po jo sras klu khri/ klu byang / chosaskyabs thub pa dang bzhi'i/ chung ltag jo sras chos skyabs kyis dpal mo zhesapa khab tu bzhes pa la/ sras sems dpa' chen po thugs rje dang / smon lamagyi stobs can blo ldan shes rab zhe sdu lcags mo phag gi lo la sku 'khrungs

rgya bod yig tshang tho mo/te de nyid gzhon nu'i dus nas brtson 'grus dang blo gros dang brtse ba med du byung bas/ lo bcu bdun gyi bar du khu bo dang gzus kyi slob ma ka chu'i sbo chung ba tshul khrims shes rab la sogs kyi drung du/ klog yig skad rigs/ 'dul ba la sogs pa'i bstan bcos la legs par sbyangs shing / lus ngag gi zhabs tog gis kyang mnyes par mdzad do/ /de nas khu bos kyang bstan pa'i khur bskur zhing / thugs rje'i dbang gis/ bal po dang rgya gar dbus phyogs dang / kha che'i yul du byon te paṇ+ḍita sa na dang / 'bum phrag gsum pa dang /pa ra he ta dang / mahā dzñā na dang / su ma ti girti dang / skal ldan rgyal po la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa du ma bsten te lo bcu bdun gyi bar du / lung rigs pa bka' mdo rgyud/ 'grel pa man ngag la sogs legs par sbyangs shing mnga' brnyes par mdzad/ mthar bod du byon nas de dag rnams ma lus par bsgyur zhing 'chad rtsod rtsom pa grub pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal bar mdzad/ dbus gcang myo bal/mdo stod smad/ shar myong kha/ rgya/ mi nyag la sogs kyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa slob ma dang ring slob tu ma gyur pa med cing / des dbus gtsang du lo bcu bdun 'gro don mjad do/ /de'i thugs sras zhang tshe spong chos kyi bla ma/shangs gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ khyung rin chen grags/ 'bre shes rab 'bar rnams la sras kyi thu bo bzhi zer/ gzhan yang gangs pa shes gung bu ra can sham po me dig me lhang tsher/ dmar sgas lang /rdog skya bo la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa smin par mdzad pa'i nang nas zhang tshe spong ba chos 351

ba tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ (//kyi bla mas/ ne'u thog gi gdan sa lo sum cu so gnyis mdzad/ de'i rjes la gnyal pa ri lus lo gnyis/ gnam 'phar bas lo brgyad mdzad do/ /bla ma de gsum gyi slob ma phywa pa chos kyi seng ges khyung rin chen grags kyi slob ma rgya dmar ba byang chub grags/ stag pa kha che la/ nyang stod stag tshal ba/ smon khro la sogs su bshad pa mdzad pa'i drung du byon te stod lung rgya dmar dang bla ma zur du bsnyen te/ lung rigs kyis sgro 'dogs bcad nas/ rne'u thog gi gdan sa lo bco brgyad kyi bar la mdzad/ de mthar yang gro lung pa'i drung du byon nas kyang spros pa bcad nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad snyan gragasadang bu slob kyis khyab par mdzad/ de'i sras kyi gtso bo/ gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge dan bag pa smra ba'i seng gi gru zha bsod nams seng ge me bya rtsod pa'i seng ge rtsags dbang phyug seng ge nyang bran chos kyi seng ge ldan ma dkon mchog seng ge gnyal pa yon tan seng ge ste seng ge brgyad zer ba/kha cig gtsang pa 'jam seng 'dren pa'ang 'dug go/'khon jo sras rtse mo rngog jo sras ra mo/khu jo sras yi tsho/ gnyos jo sras dpal le rnams la jo sras bzhi zer/ gzhan yang 'jad pa ston skyabs/rdo rje 'od zer la sogs/ sde snod 'dzin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang khams pa rnal 'byor rdor rgyal la sogs grub thob du ma/mdor na/ mdo stod smad/ dbus gtsang / lto gnyal gyi cho ris btsun zhing /blo gsal ba dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad de/ bstan pa ches gsal bar mdzad do/ /de'i thugs kyi sras rtsags dbang phyug seng ges gdan sa lo lnga/de gnyis kyi slob ma/ gnyal pa da/ 31 bzang pos lo bdun/ 'dzam tsan
