rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/zhes lo bdun/ bzad pa dar ma 'od dang bzad pa don grub gnyis kyis lo sum cu mdzad do/ /yang / 'bre shes rab 'bar gyis gnas rnying du chos bshad cing / khyad par bstan pa'i snying po phar phyin don du gnyer ba phal che ba 'dus pa'i nang nas las stod dkon mkhar gyis gdan sa mdzad cing deng sang gi bar du'ang de'i mi brgyud kyis 'dzin no/ /gtsang pa 'bre sgur gyis dga' ba gdong dang bya rog tshang la sogs su bshad pa mdzad/ khu sher brtson gyis thang po cher bshad cing grwa pa khri lhag 'dus/ ar byang yes gnam rtse ldeng dang /gzhu kun dga' ra ba/ gnam rdzing kha la sogs su bshad do / / dkar chung ring mo dang / khu'i slob ma zhang e pas/ man 'dra dang / rgya grong / 'or/ skyo rog me tog 'u shang rdo la sogs su mdo smad tsho bzhi'i grwa pa la chos gsungs shing / mkhas pa bsod rin dang / gnyal pa zhig po dang rgyal ba so ston la sogs dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad cing / gral gdan za 'og la byed pa dang / dus chos re la/ ja sig chen lnga bcu re tsam skol ba la sogs longs spyod kyang de dus kho na che bar grags/ de'i rjes su mkhan po bsod rin gyis gdan sa byas/ de grub thob la stod smad pa'i sras che ba yin/ las kyi me long la sogs bstan bcos kyang du ma byas/chos blo bshad byed pa'i srol byung / rjes su 'gral sher rgyal gyis gdan sa mdzad/ sku tshe'i smad la shab 'bre sgang du grwa pa btsug de'i slob ma ra gragasashe la sogs pa yin no/ /yang shad e pa dang / dan bag pa'i slob ma gnyal pa zhig pos/ 'u shang rdo la sogs su bshad pa las bu dgur grags pa byung 333

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//ste / bzad ring / phu thang dar dkon/ gtsang grub gu la snga tshar gsum zer/'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge /bo dong rin chen rtse/ slob dpon jo nang gsum la bar tshar gsum zer/ rgya 'phying ru ba/ chos rje 'jam gsar/skyel nag grags seng gsum la phyi char ga rna/ma zer bar grags pa las/ dar dkon gyis/ yar lung dang / mtsho smad lha khang la sogs par bshad de gnyan dar ma seng ge dang / bya yul dkar mo la sogs pa'i slob ma byung ngo / /gtsang zha lur bshad grwa btsugs so/ /'u yug pa sa skyar byon/ shad mdo sde dpal la sogs pa'i slob ma byung ngo / /bo dong rin po ches brag ram gyi bshad grwa btsugs so/ /slob dpon dar 'od dang / dbus pa sher 'bum/ bu ston grags seng la sogs pa'i slob ma byung ngo / /gcang po jo nang gis 'gral gyi slob ma byas nas/ de'i gdan sa mdzad kyin yod pas rne'u thog tu bzad pa don grub kyis gdan sa gtod de gnyis ma'i gdan sa mdzad nas/ chos gzhi rnams dril nas lo bco lnga'i bar du gdan sa mjad cing / rog dang mdo sde mgon po la sogs pa'i slob ma byung ngo / /de'i rjes su/ rog gis zla ba drug mjad/ de nas slob dpon mdo sde mgon pos lo sum cu so lnga byas cing /slob dpon chen po shāka gzhan dang tshad ma'i skyes bu slob dpon chen ngo don grub dpal/ kha rag pa byang gzhon/ smar brtson rnying / lo re ba dar ma 'od/chal pa shākya bkra shis la sogs dpag tu med par mdzad/ slob dpon chen po shākya gzhen nus chal gung thang du bshad grwa btsugs nas lo drug seng ba na/ni'u thog tu spyan drangs nas gdan sa 3༷ nyi shu rtsa bdun mdzad cing / blo gros

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ mtshungs med dang / phyogs las rnam rgyal/ e rdor gzhon/ rgyal sde ba gzhon nu seng ge la sogs mkhas pa'i skyes bu du ma dang / chos rje dme pa dang rtogs ldan grags seng la sogs/ mkhas grub du ma smin par mdzad do/ /de'i rjesasu rgya ma bas lo brgyad gdan sa byas/ de'i rjes su phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis lo brgyad/ yar 'brog pa gzhon rgyal gyis zla ba gcig slob dpon gzhon seng gis lo brgyad/ gtsang dkar gyis lo gsum/ slob dpon blo gros seng ges spre'u lo la slob dpon shākya gzhen nu dang slob dpon don grub dpal dpon slob kyis gung thang gi bshad grwa btsugs nas/ lo drug dang /slob dpon shāka gzhon ni'u thog tu byon cing / gung thang du slob dpon don grub dpal gyis/ stag lo nas rta lo'i bar lo bzhi bcu zhe gcig gi ring la mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyis bshad grwa legs par bskyangs te slob dpon chen po dkon mchog seng ge dang / jo bo gnyis dang kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / mkhas btsun blo gros bzang po dang / slob dpon shes rab 'phel dang / smra ba'i skyes mchog bsod nams dpal la sogs pa nyi zla ltar grags pa rnams dang / slob dpon bka' bzhi pa dang / slob dpon chosamachog la sogs gsung rab sde snod kyi don la blo gros rgyas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / mkhas btsun ri khrod pa la sogs mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad/ sras kyi thu bo shes rab rgyal mtshan rta lo la rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur nas/ gdan sa lo bcu bzhi mdzad/yos lo nas slob dpon blo gros bzang pos gdan sa lo bcu gcig mdzad de/355

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//slob dpon bsod nams dpal bskos pa'o/ /yang 'jam can dus gtsang pa 'jam seng gis bshad pa mdzad pas gling stod pa gyes te/ dbon po jo spun zhes pas bdag rkyen byas nas/ 'jam ston/ zhu ston/ blo gros 'bar zhes pa gsum gyis rim par bshad/ de'i rjes su slob dpon gnyal zhig 'u shang rdo nas spyan drangs te/ lo brgyad bshad pa mdzad de/ de nas rgyal ba lo ston gyis byas/ khong bros pa'i rjes su/ rgya 'phying ru ba bde ba can nas bos te gdan sa mdzad/ de'i slob ma chu mig pa seng ge dpal gyis lo bco brgyad gdan sa mdzad cing / ldan ma grags rin/ las stod pa grags rgyal/ lasastod pa 'bum mdzes/ 'phying ru ba sangs rgyas/ lho brag pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ snyags grags tshul/ yar lung pa spyan ras gzigs/ btsan thang pa bsod nams dbang phyug zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus la sogs mang du byon/ldan ma grags rin gyis gdan sa lo brgyad mdzad/ myo brag pas snga phyi dril nas lo nyer gnyis mdzad cing / thog ston dang / nyang stod pa dang / btsan dgon pa gzhen nu bsam gtan/ dben dge ba/ zhang shes rab ye shes la sogs smin par mdzad/ nyang stod pa ye shes mgon gyis lo bdun bla mchod mdzad/ yang lho brag pa rang gis byas/ de rting btsan dgon pa gzhen nu bsam gtan gyis lo nyi shu'i bar la gdan sa byas shing / chos grags gsar ma dang / bla brang dbon po/ lha sa ba ru mtshams pa sher rgyal la sogs pa btsan dgon pa'i slob ma yin/de rting bla brang ba dang / chos grags gsar ma/lha sa ba/ ya rtse ba/ lha yul ba/ zlo/ chen grags pa/ yon tan rgya mtsho/

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ yang rgya 'ching gi dus su bde ba can du gnyags grags tshul gyis bshad cing /las stod pa 'bum mdzes dang / las stod pa grags rgyal/ rgya ston bsod rin sogs smin par byas/ rjes su rgya ston bsod rin gyis bshad pa byas te/dge grags pa dang / don grub seng ge ral dkar dben dmar la sogs pa rnams smin par byas/ de rjes dben grags pas gdan sa byas/ de rting snye thang ba bkra shis seng ges byas so/ /yang bzad rings kyis khro phur bshad grwa btsugs te mags pa dang / stag ston spyil bu ba la sogs slob ma mang po byon ldong gis gdan sa byas/ de gnyis kyi slob ma lho pa grub seng gis byas te rong pa dang / rigs thigs dang / gzhen mdzes dang / zhang la ma dang /nyag gcig la sogs slob ma mang du byon/ rigs thigs pa'i slob ma zha lu bu ston kha che yin yang / skyel nags kyis snar thang du tshad ma bshad pa'i slob ma skyel nags grags 'bum dang / chu mig seng ge dpal la sogs byung / kyi ston grags 'bum gyi slob ma bcom ldan ral gri/ de'i slob ma mkhan po zi dbon/ dbu tshad pa rin bzang gi ston shag 'bum/ grags rgyal/ gra ring /gra thung / rtsed ring / rtsed thung la sogs pa yin/ rjes su dngon po rin 'byung gis bshad/ de'i slob ma sdong ston yin no/ /bshad brgyud rim pa rim par byon tshul 'di/ /'di phyi gnyis phan phan bde 'byung phyir bris/ /bris pa'i /sna mthus mthu chen bstan pa'i rgyun/ /rgyun chags ring du ring du gnas par 357

ba chen 'od snang la /sa sbya'i chos 'gu pa gces bsdus/ (sho/ bod du dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel dar tshul bzhugs so/ /na ma7gle kā la tsa grwa ya/ skal ldan ston pas dpal ldan 'bras spungs su / / rigs ldan rgyal ba dpal ldan dus 'khor gyi/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud gsal de'i 'grel chen sogs/ /rgya bod yul du dar tshul mdor bsdus bshad/ /de'ang thams cad mkhyen pa chos rje bu ston chen pos mdzad pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i byung tshul rin chen 'byed pa'i lde mig zhes bya ba nas mdor bsdus pa ni/ 'grel chung pang ma can nas/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dus kyi 'khor lo 'di sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas/ sham+bha lar/ rtsa rgyud gsungs ces pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan nges pa can rgyud 'grel gang nas kyang bshad pa med do/ /yang kha cig ston pa mya ngan las 'das kha'i mthor 'bras spungs su gsungs zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ 'grel pa las sa ga'i nya'i skya rengs shar ba'i tshe ston pa sangs rgyas te/ de nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing / theg pa gsum bstan pa mdzad nas/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nag pa'i nya la shrī dha na ka ṭa ka zhes pa sangs rgyas pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa la bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zla ba bcu gnyis pa lo re bzhin yod pas skyon med do snyam na/ de ni mi rung ste nag zla ni dpyid zla dang po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na / lo 'di nas ni drug brgya'i los zhes pa dang / ye le las mya ngan lasa'adas nas lo drug brgya na zhes bsha(3 sdu na nga 'gal zhes na skyon med de/ de

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/ni mya ngan las 'das yan chod chos bstan pa yin la chos bstan zin pa'i lo nas/ drug brgya dang mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya gnad gcig tu gsungs pa'am/ yang na 'phags pa'i yul du chos phyi ma rnams ston pa'i bar thams cad kyi cha 'bras spungs su rgyud bstan pa'am/ yang na/ tshig 'di ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pas/ ma 'ongs pa chos bstan zin pa'i lo 'di nas zhes/dgongs pa yod pas skyon med do/ /des na/ rang lugs ni rtsa ba'i rgyud las/de nas sham+bha lar grags nas/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa ni/ /mi bdag zla bzang rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rang nyid dpal ldan chos dbyings byon/ /dang por g.yas su bskor byas nas/ /ston pa'i zhabs kyi chu skyes gnyis/ /rin chen me tog rnams kyis mchod/ /yang dang yang du phyag btsal te/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas gyur nas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar 'dug /zla bzang rgyud kyi gsol 'debs dang / /ston pa sdud par byed pa po/ /zhes pa dang / ston pas bya rgod phung po sa khres rab pha rol phyin tshul bzhin/ /chos bstan dpal ldan 'bras spungs su/ /de bzhin gsang sngags tshul rab gsungs/ /gang la gang gnas bstan pa ni/ /su yis rgyud kyang lung gcig bstan/ /gnas ni gang du 'jig rten pa'i/ /'bor ni su yis rgyu ci yis/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri chen por/ /theg pa chen po bla na med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bstan/ /de nas gcig tu mchod rten cher/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /byang chub sems dpa' sogs rnams kyi / / thabs cig de bzhin gshegs/ 59 / /nam mkha' bem min shin

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//tu dwangs/ /go skabs med par rab tu gsal/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i khang pa gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings dang yid 'ong 'bar/ /rgyud ldan skyes bu rnams kyis ni/ /bsod nams ye shes dgongs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par ston pa sangs rgyas nas/ zla bcu gnyis song ba/ nag zla'i nya la gnasadapal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten gyi nang du/ steng 'og tu rgyang grags lhag pa'i dpag tshad drug yod par 'og tu chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor dang / steng du dpal ldan rgyud skar gyi dkyil 'khor spros te bde ba chen po'i gnas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po dang / ston pa shākya thub pa rdo rje seng ge'i khri la dus kyi 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs nas/ dkyil 'khor ma bkod pa'i 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems khro bo lha mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ nyan pa po'i 'khor rgyal po dgu bcu rtsa drug la sogs skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams dang / zhu ba po zla ba bzang pos gsol ba btab pa las 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang byin nas/ lha dang lha min la sogs sangs rgyas nyid du lung bstan te/ chos rtsa ba'i rgyud/ stong phrag bcu gnyis pa bka' bstsal to / / mdor bsdus dang po'i 'grel par rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi lung drangs pa las/ston pa go'u ta ma ston pa po/ /gnas ni dpal ldan chos kyi dbyings/ /'khor ni byang chub sems dpa' sogs/ /mi bdag zla bzang zhu ba po/ khri/da bstan pa ni mi rnams kyis/ /bsod nams ye shes dgongs pa can/ /zhes so/ /'di bsdus tshul ni gsang ba sgron maX /da las/ gsang ba chen po'i rgyud

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/'di ni/ shes pa dang ni bshad pa su/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa / / byang phyogs su dpal phyag na rdo rje'i gnas su de'i sprul pa o rgyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bo ti zhes pa sa bcu'i dbang phyug des shes pa dang / bshad sa dang sems can la gsal bar byed do/ /zhes gsungs la/ rgyud sde gzhan gyi lugs kyi'ang phyag na rdo rjes ston pa bzhugs dus rang bsdus nas/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo ti 'khor bcas la byin/ grub pa thob/ o rgyan stongs nas mtshor gyur pa'i klu rnams la phyag rdor gyis rgyud rnams glegs bam du bkod nas byin pas de dag thams cad kyang mir gyur te chos 'di la spyod cing de nas rim gyis yul dbus la sogs par 'phel lo/ /phyag rdor gyi sprul pa zla bzang gis dus 'khor rtsa rgyud bsdus shing de'i 'grel bshad stong phrag drug cu pa mdzad nas/ sham+bha lar rin po che las/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ lha'i dbang phyug ston pa por bkod nas mya ngan las 'das par gsungs so/ /ston pa po dang bsdud pa po de dag thams cad gdul bya'i snang ngor bstan pa tsam yin gyi/ don la gsang ba grub pa las/ 'di yi bsdud par byed pa po/ /gzhan dag yod pa ma yin gyi/ /bdag nyid 'ba' zhig smra bar byed/ /rgyud mdzad pa ni thugs rje'o/ /ces gsungs so/ /'di'i chos yun ji tsam gnas tshul ni/ dus 'khor ba'i lugs kyi gling bcu gnyis po 'di/ gling rer lo stong brgyad brgya re/ dril bas lo nyi khri tshig stong drug brgya gnas par gsungs so/ /rigs ldan rim par rgyud tshul ni/ lha'i dbang phyug nas/ gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang po/ sna tshogs 36/

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rnams kyis brgya brgyar chos bstan cing / 'di yan rtsa rgyud rtsa 'grel la 'chad nyan byed pa yin/ rtsa rgyud las/ lo 'di nas ni drug brgya'i lo/ /zhes pa la/ chos ston pa'i lo ste zhes pa dang / nga mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo drug brgya na/ zhes gsungs pa dang / zla bzang mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya rnams/ gnad gcig tu rtogs dgos so/ /de nas grags pas 'o brgya rtsar rgyud bstan pa'i rjes su/drang srong rnam sa kyis ngor rtsa rgyud nas bsdus pa'i/ bsdus rgyud me tog 'phreng 'dzin/ tshigs bcad stong dang sum cu pa ma dzad do/ /de nas pad dkar gyis lo brgyar chos bstan/ 'grel bshad stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mjad/ de nas bzang po dang rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen bzang po phyag dmar/ khyab la jug sbas pa/ nyi ma grags/ shin tu bzang po rnams kyis lo brgya brgyar chos bstan te/ rigs ldan rigs kyi dbus su las pas bsgyur ba'i dus kyi bu dang cha bo dag ni 'das gyur pa/ /de'i dus su nges par ma ga'i yul du kla kle'i chos ni rab tu 'jug pa dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes grags pa'i bu nas bgrangs pa'i mi rabs brgyad 'das pa na/ kla klo'i chos la jug par gsungs la / yang na de nas klus lo brgya dang / rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang / rgyal dka' yis kyang / lo brgya brgyar chos ston par gsal te/ kla klo byung nas/ lo brgya brgyad cu gnyis na/ rgyal ka yis rtsis gzhi brtsams la/ brgya ni/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal gyi dus yin la/ rgyal ma'i chos bstan pa brgyad cu gnyis na bsdus rgyud kyi rtsis gzhi mdzad dam snyam sdi/2 /de nas nyi ma dang / sna tshogs

rgya bod yig tshang cha mo/gzugs/ zla ba'i 'od/ mtha' yas/ sa skyong / dpal skyong seng ge rnam sdon/stobs po che/ ma 'gags pa/ mi'i seng ge dbang phyug chen po/ mtha' yas/rnam rgyal/drag po'i 'khor can te/des kla klo'i stobs 'joms par byed do//de ltar rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rjes su drag po 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir/rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa drug shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal po bdun te/ sprul pa'i rgyal po sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /zhes gong ma dag bzhed do/ /rigs ldan phyi ma rnams kyi sku tshe'i tshad kyang lo brgya brgyar bla ma mkhan chen lo tsā ba'i gsung las byung ngo / /de'i lugs ltar na/ rgyal mas rtsis gzhi brtsams nas/ chu pho stag lo yar bcad la/ lo lnga brgya dang drug song ba'i phyir/ dpal skyong 'ong dgos par mngon te/ sngon gyi gtam rgyud dang mi mthun par snang ngo / /rgya gar du ji tsam la dar tshul ni/ lugs gnyis las/ ra lugs ni/dus 'khor la sogs byang chub sems pa'i skor du grags pa'i chos 'di rnams/ rgya gar shar phyogs pa'i rgyal po re ha pā la dang / lho phyogs na dza'u ga pa/ nub phyogs na/ ka na pu dza zhes pa dang / rgyal po gsum yod pa'i ring la/ shar phyogs kyi yul sde chen po o dri'i sar sku gzungs pa'i slob dpon chen po sde sdod thams cad mkhyen pa tsi lu paṇ+ḍi tas/ sangs rgyas tshe gcig la 'ji1ba pa la sngags kyi theg pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pas gsal bar ston pa gcig dgos pa/ de sham+bha la na yod pa 'tshol bar dgongs nas byon pas/ mi dkar po gcig dang mjal ba 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa yin par go nas zhus pas/ des dbang rgyud 'grel pa man ngag 363

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (nematha' dag gnang / ma lus pa khong du chud par byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyir byon pas/ rgya gar shar phyogs su 'phel lo/ /yang lugs gcig la tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta de rnal 'byor pa gcig gi bu yin pas/ phas sham+bha lar khrid/ dge slong gcig dang mjal/ des byin gyis brlabs/ khong du chud nas yul du byon te rab tu byung ba'i mtshan tsi lu pa zhes grags so/ /slob dpon des ka ta ga'i rgyal po'i sar bzhugs pas/ slob ma gsum byung ba/ de bas rgyud 'grel rnams/ glegs bam du 'bri bar zhus nas bris so/ /slob ma gsum po'i nang nas/ shar phyogs bha sgo lar sku 'khyungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta a tsar+ya sa zhus nas ma lus par thugs su chud cing nyams su bzhes so/ /de'i skabs su/rgyal po gzhan gcig gi dmag byung nas rgyud 'grel gyi dpe rnams dngos su sbas/ rting la ltas pas bde kye gnyis kyi 'grel pa'i bsham ma tshang 'dug pa/'bri bar zhus pas mkha' 'gro mas sbas pa yin pas/ 'brir mi rung gsungs nas ma gnang / tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta slar rgya gar du gshegs so/ /de nas paṇ+ḍi ta a tsar+ya sa/ nā len+t+ra ra sku 'khrungs pa'i dus zhabs pa chen po la gsungs so/ kha cig dus zhabs pa de la/ sgrol mas lung bstan sham+bha lar byon pa'i lam du spyan ras gzigs kyis/ ma la ya'i tshal gyi dkyil 'khor nang du khrid nas dbang bskur rgyud 'grel rnams bshad nas/ dpe thams cad kyang gnang ste byon no/ /de la slob ma mchog bzhi'i nang nas/ shar phyogs su 'byungs pa'i dus zhabs pa chung ba mtshan bo sti pa yang zer nā len+d+ra pa'ang zer ba des/ nā le rgyur /sdu 'khor lha khang bzhengs/ sgo gong la

rgya bod yig mo ri chen mo/rnam bcu dbang ldan dang / de'i 'og tu gang zhig dang po'i sangs rgyas mi shes pa de rnams kyis mtshan yang dag par brjod pa mi shes ces pa nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam dang bral ba ste 'khor ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar bris pas gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya tsam gyi rgyud ma rangs pa btul nas/thams cad slob ma gyur to/ khyad par du mañdzu kirti dang / zla mgon dang / tsa mi la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang du byung zhing shin tu dar bar byas shing / de nas bal po ye rang du 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā shrī bha dras mkhas pa lnga la gsan/ khyad par du mañdzu kirti'i rjes su 'brang ngo / /'bro'i lugs ni rigs ldan rgyal po dpal skyong chos 'chad dus/ gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa yab yum gnyis kyis de'i rgyud las byung ba khye'u gcig 'khrungs pa de cher skyes nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos skor tshol ba la/ sham+bha lar byon pa dpal skyong gis mkhyen nas/ de'i gdong du byon nas zla ba bzhi'i bar la chos gsungs/ de'i bum pa gang byo thugs la bzung nas/ phyir byon pas 'jam dpal gyi sprul par grags shing / de'i mtshan yang dus zhabs pa zer ro / / de'i slob ma mang du byung ba'i nang nas/ yon tan bla ma dang mtshungs pa sras nā len+d+ra pa/ dus zhabs pa chung bar grags so/ /de'i dus su kha cher bram ze'i bu zla mgon zer ba blo rno ba gcig byung bas/ snga sor phyi rol pa'i chos bslabs/ de rting yum gyi 'dod bzhin/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍita bram ze zhabs la zhus dbang mdor bstan gyi dpe gzigs pas/ shin tu dad nas ma ga dhar byon/ dus zhabs pa yab sras dang mjal/ byang chub sems dpa'i 365

nga ge chen 'od snang la /tsho skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (shochos skor ma lus par zhus so/ kha che rin chen rdo rje la gtsang pa zla mgon ma thub pa/ rin chen rdo rje na re/ nga la slob ma mi dad par 'ong bas/ khyod bod du byon gsungs/ de nas/ chos 'di bod du spel dgongs nas/ bod yul du byon nas dar bar mjad pa'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo bod du dar tshul la'ang / lugs gnyis te/ 'bro'i lugs la/ kha che zla mgon/ bod du byon/ kha rag gnyos la babs/ 'grel pa dri med 'od kyi byed bsgyur/ de'i 'phro la 'phan yul grab tu byon no/ /zhang phu chung bas/ sbyin bdag dang 'bros lo tsā byas nas tshang mar bsgyur/grab tu 'khrungs pa'i sgom pa dkon mchog bsrung la gzhung man ngag ma lus par gnang / des nor bzang gi sgro gnam la rtsegs la gnang / 'di la rting ma kha che zla mgon gyis kyang gnang bar byed do/ /sgro gnam la rtsegs kyis gangs te sir sku 'khrungs pa'i rngam khrom pa dad pa rgyal po'i sras bzhi'i chung ba bla ma yu mo ba la gnang / des/ sku'i sras dharma sha ra la/ des grub thob nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la/ des 'jam gsar la g.yas ru smon mkhar grong chung dgon par gnang / de la bla ma rga los gsan pa'o/ /rwa lugs la/ snya nam snang yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i/ rwa lo tsā rdo rje grags kyi dbon po ra lo tsā ba chos rab kyis/ dus 'bor gyi chos don du gnyer ba la bal yul du byon/ paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī bha dra la lo lnga zla ba bcu zhag lngar sbrel nas zhus lha pas/ ra / da 'grel/ bshad bka'/ dbang bka'/man ngag dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ 66 / paṇ+ḍi ta bod du spyan drangs

rgya pod yig tshang chen mo/nas bshad bsgyur gtan la phab ste/ ches dar bar mdzad do/ /des sras bla ma ye shes seng ge la gnang / des rwa 'bum seng la gnang / de la sngon gyi khams pa rgya lo chen po'i dbon rgyud dang / skye ba bzhes pa/ rje btsun rga los zhus pa yin te/ yab mes ni mi nyag gzhon nu snying po la sras gzhon nu seng ge de'i sras rig 'dzin snying po/ des rong gi rgya ma ba'i yul bzung / de'i sras rdo rje seng ges rong mkhar phug bzung / de la sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba/ye shes rdo rjes gdan sa g.yen dmar bzung grub thob dbang phyug rgyal po yang zer ro/ /de'i sras/ rje btsun rgya lo yin te dgung lo gsum pa la kha che paṇa chen shākya shrīs saṃ sla ta'i skad kyis chos gsungs/ 'od gsal chung ngu slob gnyer la bzhugs dus/ bar chad brtsams pas thar par dpyal chos bzang la gshed dmar gyi dbang zhu ru byon pas bar chad kyis ma tshugs/ de rting rwa 'bum seng la/ dus 'khor gyi gtso byas rwa lugs kyi chos thams cad ma lus par zhus nas/ 'gro ba'i don rgya chen mdzad nas dgung lo brgyad cu pa chu pho rta lo/ cho 'phrul chen po'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad kyi snga dro sku gshegs so / / de'i sras che ba/ rgya gar grags rab tu byung ba'i mtshan slob dpon nam mkha' dpal/ des g.yen dmar gdan sa bzung / gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ sras gnyis pa bla ma shes rab seng zhes kyang gdan sa bzung /dus 'khor la sogs yab chos rnams tshang bar mkhyen/ dgung lo bzhi bcu pa la/ dbon po rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gtad nas/ rmu'i sha sa bar btab/gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ 'gro don /7 cher mdzad nas/ yos lo zla ba dgu

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (nepa'i tshes bcu la shangs bar du sku gshegs so/ /sras gsum pa slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi sras bla ma dharma ka ra sirnyi de'i sras/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba chu mo lug lo la 'brungs/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal ba dang / slob dpon sher rgyal ba la/ dge tshul gyi mkhan slob zhus/ dgung lo bcu drug pa la dus 'khor gsungs/ g.yen dmar gdan sa bskyangs/mkhan ka bzhi pa dang / mkhan po zhal snga ba la mkhan slob zhus te bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ dus 'khor bshad grwa bskyangs/ bla ma shes rab seng ge'i drung du dus 'khor gyi gtso byas pa'i/ mdo rgyud dbang bka' man ngag thams cad bum pa gang byo zhus pas gnang / shin tu mkhas pa'i grags pa che bas hor rgyal pos/ khyi lo la rgya nag du gdan drangs/ 'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas glang lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig la zhi bar gshegs so/ /bla ma dam pa de'i drung du bdag gis zla ba dgu'i bar la 'brel nas dus 'khor rgyud 'grel/ man ngag dang bcas pa dang / gsung gi bdud rtsi myangs pa'o/ /gzhan yang / dus 'khor la tsa mi'i lugs la sogs/ 'gyur mi gcig pa bco lnga bcu drug tsam yod kyang / bshad pa'i bka' man ngag dang ldan pa ni gtso che ba gsum gyi rgyun las byung ba yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i chos skor gsum ni/ dus 'khor la spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa rgyal po pad ma dkar pos mdzad pa'i pad ma dkar 'grel/ kye rdor lha gnyis la byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa/ rdo rje snying 'grel bde mchog la phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa phyag rdor 3spyad 'grel de rnams la sems 'grel

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/skor gsum zer ba'o/ /pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis su med pa'i rgyud/ /rgyud kun snying po byang chub sems dpa'i chos/ /chos kyi gter mdzod dus 'khor byon tshul 'dis/ /'di phyir 'gro kun dam chos spyod par shog/ /// paṇa chen shākya shrī'i slob ba// /mis pa sde bzhi'i mkhan rabs na mo budha bo rnyi :/ tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs thub pa'i rgyal tshab mchog /tshogs kyi lam zhugs dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso/ /tshogs pa sde bzhi'i bslab brgyud mkhan rabs dang / /tshogs sde bzhi'i spyi dang bye brag 'di ltar snang / /de'ang dam pa'i chos nyin mo ltar gsal zhing / bstan pa'i rgyun chu bo ltar ring bar mdzad pa'i/ tshogs sde bzhir grags pa 'di nyid kyi slob brgyud ni/ thog mar thub pa'i dbang po/ shā ri'i bu/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin/ klu sgrub/ gu na mi ti/ rat+na mi tra/ dharma pā la/gu na pa ti/ chos kyi phreng ba/ 'byung gnas sbas pa/ des kha che paṇa chen shrī bha dra la'o/ /paṇa chen 'di ni sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo sum stong nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad song ba'i chu pho stag gi lor/ kha che khri brtan gyi grong khyer bye brag dza sho dha ra zhes dbang phyug chen po'i gnas su yab tshong dpon sa ma ya dang / yum su bha ga'i sras su sku 'khrungs mtshan chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes par btags te/ gzhon nu nyid nas nang pa'i bstan pa la rab tu 369

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ rngonamos shing / dgung lo bcu nas tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen nod/ sgra rig pa lasogs pa dang / phyi nang gi mdo rgyud bstan bcos mtha' dag la sbyangs/ nyi shu rtsa gsum pa la dge 'dun yod par smra ba'i sde la rab tu byung / dam bca' bzhi mi spong ba'i dam bcas/ sum cu pa la mkhan po sharnya ka ra dang / lasaslob da sha bha la/ gsang ston da na ka ra la sogs dge 'dun mang po'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad de gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur/ yi dam lha mang po'i zhal gzigs/ u rgyan gyi zhing skyong mkha' 'gro dang / sing gha la'i dge slong dgra bcom gyis ma byon sangs rgyas gsum par lung bstan thob/ rtsa ba'i bla ma paṇa chen sbo wa pukhye dang / rje btsun byamasamagon gyis byang phyogs su 'gro ba'i don che bar lung bstan cing / gtsug tor gdugs dkar dang / gser mdog can dang / rnam thos kyi bu la sogs pas byang phyogs su song zhig par yang dang yang du bskul bas/ 'jig rten gyi nyi ma shar nub tu rgyu yang 'gro ba'i nyi ma 'di ni/ lho nas byang du rgyu bar chad pa'i dus su/ chos skyong mgon po dang gza' skar la sogs pas kyang sprul pa bstan nas/ lam du bsu skyel dang grogs mdzad cing bod rgyal 'od srungs kyi brgyud yar tshe ba pri ti smal gyi bka' dang / khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi mos mthu la brten nas paṇa chen gyis dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa/ me pho stag lo la khro phur phyag phebs/ 'khor paṇa chung dgu dang bcas pas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar la bod dbus gtsang du bzhugs nas thub bstan nyin mo ltar gsal sdu/ mdzad cing / sa khro dpyal gsum/

rgya bod yig rmang 'a mo/gtsang po ba tshul khrims mdzes dang / rdor byang rnam gnyis la sogs gdul bya mang po smin par mdzad/ gdan gcig pa'i srol btsugs nas/ dgung lo dgu cu rtsa bdun pa la/ rgya gar la bzhud lam dang bsdoms rgya gar la lo gnyis song rting dgu bcu rtsa dgu bzhes pa sa mo yos bu'i lo la chos kyi dbyings su gshegs so/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bod du byon pa'i dus phyag phyir rgya gar pa'i paṇa chung dgu yod de/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ga ta shrī bod skad du bde gshegs dpal bya ba de dbu ma dang phar phyin la mkhas so/ /paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya rat+na rgyal bas sbyin sngags dang 'dul ba la mkhas/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra rnam par sbyor ba'i zla ba sgra dang mngon pa la mkhas/ paṇ+ḍi ta dwa na shī la sbyin pa tshul khrims de tshad ma dang chos mchog la mkhas/ paṇ+ḍi ta saṃ gha shrī dge 'dun dpal de sgra tsan+d+ra pa dang mngon pa mdzod la mkhas/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti gar+bha blo bzang rgya mtsho de mngon pa gong 'og la mkhas/ paṇ+ḍi ta ka la tsan kri dus 'khor la mkhas/ paṇ+ḍita dzi na gu sna rgyal bas sbas pa byams chos la mkhas/paṇ+ḍi ta mahā bho ti byang chub chen po bya ba de phar phyin dang spyod phyogs la mkhas de thams cad la khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis rang rang gi chos de pa la dri ba byas pas dpon slob thams cad thugs shin tu mnyes nas/ mang nya lo tsā bar mtshan gsol lo/ /paṇa chen dbus su phebs dus chu shul sprog ma dgon par dge 'dun bcu gcig bsnyen rdzogs mdzad pa'i nang nas gtsang po ba tshul khrims mdzes kyis bla ma rgya gar la gshegs rting lo dgu'i bar la gtan gcig pa'i mkhan po lo dgu mdzad/ de dus tshogs pa sde gcig yin/371

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//mkhan po rdo rje dpal dang / byang chub dpal gnyis kyis paṇa chen gyi phyag phyir 'gro bar zhus pas/ zul phu'i nam za 'phred gsol la 'dul ba nyon gtsang po pa'i bla mchod gyis la/ dge slong bzhi sde dang ma bral bar gyis gsungs pa bzhin mdzad/ gtsang po ma gshegs nas snye mo mtsho mtha' ba/mkhan po rdo rje dpal bas mkhan po dang / lho brag pa byang chub dpal bas slob dpon byas nas lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bar la'ang tshogs sde gcig yin/de mtshams/ logs su 'then bzhed nas so sor gyes pas/ tshogs pa sde gnyis byung / mkhan po rdo rje dpal ba'i rjes la snyi mo ba mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal bas lo sum cu rtsa bdun mdzad pa'i lo bzhi song nas/ gzhu sgra po ba mkhan po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zur du gyes nas bye rdzing tshogs par grags/ mkhan po lo bcu mdzad de nas yar lung shel sa mkhan po thugs rje dpal gyis lo nyi shu rtsa gsum/ btsan thang pa mkhan po dar ma dpal bzang gis 'e sna lnga/ gan pa ba mkhan po kun dga' dpal gyis 61 lnga/ yar lung thang po che ba mkhan po gzhen nu bzang pos lo gnyis/ mal gro ba mkhan po tshul khrims dpal gyis lo bco lnga/ shel snang pa mkhan po sangs rgyas gzhen nus lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ gye re glang ra ba mkhan po dar ma bzang pos lo brgyad/sbu sde ba mkhan po tshul mgon gyis lo bcu gnyis/ sreg zhing pa mkhan po bsod nams 'od zer gyis lo bco lnga/ bu sde gnas gsar pa mkhan po rin chen tshul khrims kyis lo gcig rdzong sgre mang pa mkhan po bsod nams shes rab kyis lo dgu/ 'thon pa mkhan ṭ+wāṃ ri rab mgon pos lo nyi shu rtsa lnga/

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/gzhu kun dga' ra ba mkhan po grags bsod pas lo bdun/ gzhu dge ba mkhan po shes rab 'phags pas lo bdun/ gnam ngang tshangs pa mkhan po shes rab tshul khrims kyis lo lnga/ 'chad drod pa mkhan po rin chen shes rab kyis lo bdun/ mag lam pa mkhan po chos dpal bas lo lnga/ mthon pa mkhan po shes rab 'od pas lo lnga/ gzhu ni kha ba mkhan po kun dga' shes rab pas da lo yan la lo grangs brgyad tsam 'gro bar 'dug cing / bye rdzing tshogs pa'i thog ma mkhan po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa nas da lta'i mkhan po kun dga' shes rab yan la mkhan rabs nyi shu tham pa song 'dug tsha mig pa'i mkhan po'i thog ma g.yag sde pa mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal bas lo lnga/ tsha mig pa mkhan po 'od zer dpal gyis lo bcu bzhi/ g.yag sde phu pa mkhan po bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis lo bcu bzhi/ g.yag sde pa mkhan po sangs rin gyis lo gnyis/ snyi mo mdo khra ba'i mkhan po bsod nams dpal gyis lo bcu gsum/ rgyal gsar sgang pa mkhan po sher mgon gyis lo drug snye mo bye ma thang pa mkhan po seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis lo bcu gsum/yar lung sne chung pa mkhan po bsod nams dbang phyug gis lo gnyis/ yar 'brog pa mkhan po bkras tshul gyis lo gcig de rting zhig po tshul rin pa/sangs rgyas blo gros pa/ rgyal dbang pa/ bkra shis seng ge ba/ yon tan rin chen pa/ mkhan po byang chub bzang po ba da lta bzhugs pa 'di yan la mkhan rabs bco lnga song 'dug 'di pa la da lta tsho gos chen par grags 'dug cing /tsha mig pa dang bye rdzing pa gnyis po mkhan chen rdo rje dpal ba'i dngos slob/373

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ rtonamakhan po sangs rgyas dpal ba'i dus nas sde gnyis gyes pa yin no/ /chos lung pa'i thog ma ni/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bas lo brgyad/ snye mo mag lam pa mkhan chen bsod nams stobs kyis lo drug g.yag sde pa mkhan po bde ba dpal gyis lo bdun/ lhan mdzes pa mkhan po grags pa gzhen nusalo brgyad/ snye mo phu gsum pa mkhan po bsod nams grags kyis lo bzhi/tshong 'dus pa mkhan po bsod nams bzang pos lo gsum/ snye mo ru tshang pa mkhan po gzhen nu mgon pos lo drug nyang smad pa mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan pas 61 bcu bzhi/ de nas grags pa tshul khrims/pa/ grags pa bshes gnyen pa/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pa/ bka' bzhi pa bshes gnyen rgyal mchog pa/ rgyal dbang ba/ zla ba blo gros pa/ rgyal ba phyag na ba da lta bzhugs pa'o/ /'di yan la bye pa'i mkhan rabs bcu drug song 'dug dge 'dun sgang pa ni dang por lho brag pa mkhan chen byang chub dpal ba la chos rgyal 'phags pas rgya bod mtshams su bsnyen rdzogs mdzad pa'i mkhan po la gdan 'dren byung nas 'byon dus/snar thang ba mkhan po dbang phyug grags pa gdan sar bskos bzhag byang chub dpal bas 'di thug byon 'phags pa'i bsnyen rdzogs mdzad tshar zer nas/ yar phebs zur du bzhugs pas/ sde gnyis byung ba yin cing dge 'dun sgang ba'i thog ma mkhan po dbang phyug grags pas lo brgyad/ khong gi dbon po/ chu sgo ba mkhan po gzhen nu byang chub kyis lo bcu gsum/ stag rtseb 'dul tshang pa byang chub bzang pos ༷/ bcu bzhi/ yar 'brog pa 'dul tshang

rgya pod yig sgo 4 mo/pa don grub dpal gyis lo nyi shu rtsa lnga/ bong ra ba yon to rgya mtshos lo brgya bzhi/ de rting dpal grub pa/ yon tan blo gros pa/ brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan pa / seng ge dpal ba/ mkhan po chos grub pa da lta bzhugs pa'o/ /'di yan la mkhan rabs bcu gnyis song 'dug paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra chu pho stag la sku bltams nas/ da lan shing pho stag srog smre brgyad dkar dbus na yod pa 'di yan la lo sum brgya sum cu so gnyis song zhing / bod du paṇa chen me pho stag la phebs nas gdan gcig pa'i srol btsugs pa nas da lo phan la lo nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe bdun song 'dug kha che paṇa chen brgyud rabs 'di bris pas/ kha ba can 'dir thub bstan seṅge'i sgras/ kha na ma tho'i chos kun zil gnon nas/ kha ṭaṃ gyis mtshon sku gsum myur thob shog/ /// bla chen mkhan brgyud rna spya ṭ+wāṃ bzhu/ /rgyud paṇa chen mkhan brgyud na mo burnya ya/ thub bstan gangs ri'i khrod du gsal mdzad pa'i/ /smad 'dul 'byung khungs mkhan brgyud rim pa ni/ /kun mkhyen rgyal po thugasasras shā ri'i bu/ /sras mchog sgra gcan bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin/ /klu sgrub skyes mchog legs ldan dpal sbas dang / /ye shes snying po zhi ba 'tsho la 'dud/ /sbas ston rat+na gtsang ston rab gsal dang / /bla chen dgongs gsal shes rab seng ge dang / /byang chub ga//5 nu byang chub rgyal mtshan dang //mjad

ba tshe nan 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (shepa ston skyabs byang gzhon zhabs la 'dud/ /rtses 'dul chen po mkhan po bde ba dpal/ /byang sems rin mgon thogs med bzang po dpal/ /yon tan 'od sogs bla chen mkhan brgyud kyi/ /sdom brtson dam pa rnams la gus pas /dud/ /bla( rtsen tho brgyud ni/ rgyal sras thogs med pa las brgyud pa 'a /ga zlo sto —bye thu/ba/ bstan gsal zhing stod 'dul rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /spu tsho mkhan brgyud dam pa'i rim pa ni/ /thub dbang shā ri'i bu dang sgra gcan 'dzin/ /legs 'doms nag po pa dang dha ri ka /grags mchog legs skyong rgyal ba shes rab ste/ /mu gro 'dul 'dzin chen po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /byang sems zla rgyal dar ma rgyal mtshan dang / /mnga' ris sgra bcom mkhan chen dbang phyug mdzes/ /mdzes pa'i 'od zer mdzes pa bzang po dang / /seng dpal kun mkhyen mdzes pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nam mkha' dpal bzang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang / lta nā kya rgyal mtshan spu tsho mkhan brgyud kyi/ /bslab gsum rgyan ldan rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /spu tsho mkhan brgyud/ /stod 'dul gyi khungs 'di/ gtsang g.yas ru 'o yug zam tsher ba las brgyud pa 'di dag par byed do/ /na mo sa rgo ya/ thub bstan rtsod ldan dus 'dir gsal mdzad pa'i/ /paṇa chen mkhan brgyud tshogs pa sde bzhi'i khungs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas dngos slob shā ri'i bu/ /sgra gcan 'dzin gnyis klu sgrub tsho ma ti/ /rat+na mi tra dharma pha la dang / /tsho na pa ti chos phreng 'byung 3༷nas sbas/ /de slob paṇa chen shākya shrī

rgya bod yig tsha be mo/zhes pa/ /ston pa sku 'das sum stong nyis brgya dang / /lnga bcu brgyad song chu pho stag la bltams/ /brgyad cu lnga zhes me stag khro phur phebs/ /lo grangasabacu gnyis bod du 'gro don mdzad//dgu bcu bdun la rgya gar yul du byon//go dgu lcags pho 'brug la mya ngan 'das/ /paṇa chen thegs nas lo dgur tsam song bas/ /gdan gcig sgol bskyangs de rting rdo rje dpal/ /sangasargyas dpal nas gzhu pa dkon rgyal gyis/ /bye rdzing par grags de nas thugs rje dpal/ /dar ma dpal bzang kun bzang gzhen nu bzang / /tshul dpal sang gzhon dar bzang tshul khrims mgon/ /bsod 'od rin tshul bsod shes shes mgon dang / /grags bsod shes 'phags shes tshul rin shes ba/ /chos dpal sher 'od kun dga' shes rab yan/ /rdor dpal man la mkhan rabs nyer gnyis byon/ /paṇa chen me stag phebs nas deng sang yan/ khreng stag brgyad dkar dbus gnas yar btang la/ /lo grangs nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa bdun song / /tshal mig pa la mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal/ /'od gsal chos kyi rgyal mtshan sang rin dang / /bsod dpal shes mgon seng rgyal bsod dbang dang / /bkras tshul tshul rin sang blo rgyal dbang dang / /bkras seng yon rin byang chub bzang po yan/ /bcu phrag phyed dang gnyis po deng sang dus/ /tshogs chen par grags thub bstan dri med kyi/ /srog shing mkhan brgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos lung thog ma lho brag byang chub dpal/ /bsod stobs bde dpal grags gzhen bsod nams grags/ /bsod bzang gzhon mgon mkhan chen grags rgyal dang / /grags tshul grags 377

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chog 'byung gces bsdus/ (//pa bshes gnyen nam rgyal ba/ /'jam dbyangs rin rgyal rgyal mchog rgyal dbang grags/ /zla blo rgyal ba phyag na deng sang yan/ /bcu phrag gcig dang drug bcas byes par grags//bslab gsum rnam dag shākya'i bstan pa yis//gsal byed mkhan brgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun sgang pa byang chub dpal nas gyes//dbang grags gzhen byang 'dul tsha don grub dpal/ /yon tan rgya mtsho dpal grub yon blo dang / /brtson rgyal seng ge dpal dang chos grub yan/ /bcu dang gcig gis 'gro kun smin grol la/ /'god mdzad mkhan brgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gro mang pad mo'i gnyen/ /bod yul mun pa sel bar mdzad pa yis/ /paṇa chen ༵༵༵ pa/da rim pas sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i phrin / dwags po bka' brgyud kyi byon tshul bzhugs/na mo rat+na gu sa rdo rje 'chang gis byin rlabs pa/ /te lo nā ro'i brgyud 'dzin cing/ /gtum mo'i chos la dbang 'byor ba/ /dwags po bka' brgyud 'di ltar byon/ /thub bstan lnga brgya tha ma'i dus su/ bod gangs can gyi khrod 'dir/ theg chen gsang sngags zab mo 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa dwags po bka' brgyud du grags pa 'di ltar byung ste/ de'ang rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen pos dngos su byin gyis di/bas pa'i grub thob chen po te lo shes

rgya pod yig chos chen mo/ rab bzang po'o/ /de la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus thob nas dus thabs bsten pas sa lam bgrod de mchog thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes nga ni/ jo bo nā ro pa ye shes dngos grub ste/ dwag ro snyan brgyud kyi bstan bsrung/ te lo pa dam la btags pa 'i sha za ma bdun ni/ za byed chen mo rngams pa cho / /'bar ba chen mo khro gnyer can/ /drag po chen mo gtum pa mo/ /'jigs byed chen mo chang 'thung ma/kha 'bar chen mo ral gcig ma/ /sngo sa'i sa chen mo myur 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro chen cho 'jigs pa mo/rnam so/ /dpal nā le spro'i khu ka ma shī la'i yin/༄nga sgo bsrung ba'i paṇ+ḍita chen po'o/ /des smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i dngos slob/ lho bong pa sgra bsgyur gyi rgyal po mar pa lo tsā chos kyi blo gros zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de ni/ dang por mar yul gyi mar she lugs rtse'i sras mar pa khri 'jam pa/ lho phu chu skyer gyi shab steng du byon/ de'i sras gsum gyi 'bring po mar ston dbang phyug 'od zer dang / yum rgya mo 'od de'i sras lnga'i tha ltag bya lo la sku zhakhrungs/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes dang / se lo tsā ba la lo tsā bslabs/ rgya gar du lan gsum byon/ rje 'gran gyi do med rnam gnyis dang / khyad par grub thob zhal mnga' chos kyis 'brel ba'i bla ma bcu gsum rnams bsten cing / de rnams kyis dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs pas bka' bstan bcos lung man ngag du ma thob/ yi dam zhal gzegs dngos grub brnyes/ chos kyi mnga' bdag chen por gyur te/ mthar/'pho ba grong 'jug gi gdams ngag zhu ru byon dus/ bla ma nā ro pa chen pos bu khyod la/ bod na gdul bya snod ldan yod cing / rigs brgyud nam mkha'i me tog yal yang / chos brgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar ring / lo tsā ba 'di yi 'og 379

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//rol du/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob 'gyur zhing / khyod kyi slob brgyud bdun yan la/ /bla ma nga yis byin gyis rlobs/ /de la'ang mchog gi dngos grub ster/ /ces lung bstan/ rgyal tshab tu bskos nas/ bod du phebs bsgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar du gsal bar mdzad/lho brag sku mkhar skya'o dgu thog la brtsigs nas 'gro don bskyangs/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa byi ba'i lo rta zla'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma rtse shar la/mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /de'i sku'i sras bdun gyi che ba/ dar ma mdo sde pa / sku yon tan phun sum tshogs na'ang bar chad byung nas gzhen nu la sku gshegs/ phug ron gyi ro la 'pho ba grong 'jug byas te 'phur nas rgya gar dur khrod du bram ze gzhen nu'i ro la 'phos pas ti phu par gyur pa yin zer/gcung dar ma bsam gtan la sogs pa drug byung / thugs kyi sras ni byang gi mar pa mgo g.yag dang / skyer phu'i dge bshes klog skya jo sras la sogs dang / khyad par ka chen bzhir grags pa gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor dang /dol gyi 'dzur ston dbang nge / gtsang rong gi me ston 'a po/ gung thang gi mi la ras pa rnams yin te/ snga ma gsum ni/ bshad rgyud gtso che/ phyi ma gcig pu sgrub rgyud gtso che'o/ /gzhan yang gnyal gyi shud sgom dpal le/ skyi ston skya rgyal/ ba rang lnga ba can la sogs/ slob ma mkhas grub bzang la mang po byon no / / g.yi gi rngog ston chos rdor ni/ gdung rus sdong gi nang phywa rngog bod rgyal po'i blon brgyud rngog ban chen bya ba/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i dge bshes chen po gcig gi sras su gzhuX / bor 'khrungs/ rang gi yab dang /

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/rje mar pa la dbang bshad sgrub pa mtha' dag thob/ rjes la 'bul mo che thengs gsum la sogs kyis zhabs tog cher byas shing / thug ba/rab kyis bla ma'i thugs zin par byas/ gzhan yang rwa rdo rje grags pa la sogs mkhasagrub du ma bsten/ ram rtsa can dang / can drug gi mi la mthu chen la sogasapa'i slob ma mang du bskyangs/ bshad sgrub mthar phyin nas spel tsha thil du bzhugs dus dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad la sku dngos su mkha' spyod du ga snyen gas so/ /de'i sras/ rngog mdo ston las stod pa sbrum ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi skye ba yin/ chung ngu'i dus rje mar pa dang mjal chag lo la sogasalo tsā ba brgyad bsten thos bsam mthar phyin/ yab kyi gdan sa mdzad/bdag med la mo bco lnga'i zhal gzigs/ nya mo gur du rje mar pa'i sras mo gcig la gral dpon zhus nas brgya 'bul byas/ mchims chen po/ dge bshes phyu pa/ 'khon bsod nams rtse mo la sogs dbus gtsang gi dge bshes lnga brgya bsags nas zla ba phyed dang gnyis chos 'khor mdzad/ de'i bzang lan la sras mo des mar pa'i sku gdung phul/ sdum chung btab/ chos gzhis mang du btsugs/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bdun la gshegs so/ /de'i slob ma tsag ṅgārma ra dza/dran ston mtha' bral lho nag la sogs mang du byon no//bla ma'i sras/ jo sras tshul khrims shes rab dang / thogs med grags pa sogs mched lnga byung ba/ thams cad yon tan dang ldan yang / yab bzhugasaring la snga rim gyis 'das so/ /thogs med grags pa'i sras rgyal tsha ra mo dang / rdor seng ra mo/ ston chung dbang mo'i skye ba yin/ gdan sa lo brgyad 38/

'tshe tshen 'od snang la /ga skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (//bskyangs/ mar pa yab sras kyi sku gdung bzhengs/ rab gnasang zhang rin po che la zhus/ gcen jo tshul gyi sras bla ma kun dga' rdo rje'o/ /des spel zhing gi gzim khang sto ma btab gdan sa mdzad/ lo bdun cu rtsa bdun la 'das so / / de'i sras slob dpon dge slong dang / bla ma gzi brjid/ slob dpon rgyal po dga'o/ /bla ma gzi brjid kyis gzim khang byang ma dang gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ gdung khang yang der spyan drangs/ gdan sa mdzad/ lo brgyad cu la gshegs/ slob dpon rgyal po dga'i sras seng ge sgra/ ri bo ba rin chen bzang po/ slob dpon chos rdor 'od/ ri bo bas dgung lo bcu pa la bshad pa mdzad/ bco brgyad la zul phur dge tshul dang / so gsum la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'i dus khu bo 'das nas gdan sa mdzad/ so lnga pa la khams su byon/ lo gnyis la 'khor nas tshal pa'i yang dgon sgom sde dang / dpon brgyud kyi bla mar gyur/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/ lha khang dang gdan sa rgya chen bskyed/ spel zhing dang zul skyor gyis thog drangs/dbus gtsang gi dgon sde 'brel yod kun la tshogs gsog rgya chen mdzad/jo bo nā ro pa dang mar pa'i sprul par grags/ 'gro don dpag med mdzad nas/ bdun cu rtsa bdun la gshegs so/ /slob dpon seṅge sgra'i sras slob dpon rin rgyal spun gsum mo/ /slob dpon chos rdor gyi sras gsum gyi che ba bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gdan sa mdzad do/ /rgyal tsha ra mo'i brgyud sdums chung ba rnams so/ /dol gyi 'tshur ston dbang de ni lo/ gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po ni/ gtsang 3 8 /da stag tshang du sku 'khrungs/ mtshan

4 bod yig par mo/bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje mar pa bsten/ zhabs tog gis thugs zin/ rong po do'i gnas bzhengs/ gdung brgyud med/ mar pa dang / mes ston gnyis ma'i slob ma zhang bsod nams 'khar de nas sras brgyud lnga song ba'i zhang ston grags 'byor te/ chos kyi lugs brgyud pa'o/ /gung thang gi mi la ras pa ni/ sngon na ro pas/ mar pa la lung bstan pa'i/ bod na gdul bya snod ldan yod gsungs pa de yin cing / mar pa'i bu chen gyi mchog go /de'i gdung brgyud ni/ khyung po yab mi la sher rgyal dang / yum nyang bza' dkar rgyan gyi sras su/ las stod gung thang smad kyi skyar rnga rtsa'i ko ron du 'byungs/mtshan thos pa dgar gsol/ pha mtshan gyi yul du sdod du ma ster bar/ rong du lha rje snubs chung dang / dbus su gnyags g.yung ston khro rgyal gyi sar byon/dgra thams cad tshar gcad/ rog ston lha dga' la rdzo gas chen zhus/ der rje btsun mar pa'i snyan grags nas/ lho brag tu byon bla ma dang mjal khong gi dgra mar pa nag ngo btul/ sngar gyi sdig sbyongs la bla mas sras mkhar dgu thog ma sgyel gin brtsig bcug pas/ rgal rma drug byung ba brdol ba la sgal bskor byas kyin brtsig pas/ lo re la thog re zin gdams pa sna re gnang / dbang re bskur/ thog lnga pa la rgyud gsungs/ drug pa la yi dam zhal gzigs/ skabs der rngog ston chos rdor gyi phyag phyir byon/ mi la phug tu sgrub pa mdzad/ khong gi dgra dol mal po ba btul/ mar pa la yum bdag med mas zhu grogs mdzad/ mos gus kyis thugs mnyes nas/ chos ma lusapa gnang / byin gyis brlabs/ mar pa rgya gar la rting ma byon dus/ mi la 383

ba chen 'od snang la /ga skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (//sras kyi thu bor mnga' gsol/ lung bstan nas la stod la brdzangs/ 'jig rten spangs shing / la phyi gangs rdzong drug la sogs su dka' spyad bsgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad/ lo dgu'i bar la/ nyams rtogs ci yang ma byung yang / 'bad pas zla ba phyed la nyams rtogs dus gcig la 'bar zhing / 'chong lung dang /la phyi chu bzang / srin bu dbar rnams su 'dre dmag thengs gsum gyis bar chad brtsams kyang / rnal 'byor spros bral ro gcig rim par rdzogs/ bar chad thengs re sel ba dang /bogs re thon/ tshe ring ma spun lnga dam la btags/mi las dam la btags pa'i sha za ma spun lnga ni dbus su bkra shis tshe ring ma gsang mtshan rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum/ shar du mthing gi zhal bzang ma rdo rje khros ma/ nub tu cod pan mgrin bzang ma rdo rje dpal mo/ lhor mi g.yo glang bzang ma rdo rje gzhad ma/ byang du rta dkar 'gro bzang ma rdo rje gar mkhan ma rnams so/ /dogs med kyi rnal 'byor la mngon du phyogs shing / rdzu'aphrul du mas gdul bya mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad btul/ rgya gar ṅgārma pha la dang / dam pa rgya gar la sogs dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran/ bod du byon pa'i grub thob la grub rtags bzang zhing ngo mtshar che bar grags/ dgung lo brgyad cu la zhi ba mya ngan las 'das so/ /de la bu chen dpag tu med pa yod pa'i nang nas/ sras kyi thu bo brgyad ni gung thang gi mnyan chung ras pa dang / cim lung gi ngan rdzong ras pa/ nya ma'i 'bring sgom ras pa/ mdo khra'i se ban rasapa / snyi shangs kyi khyi ra ras pa/ ras pa zhi ba 'od/ bde ba skyongs/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje rnams so/ /dang sdir che ba'i sras bzhi/ bar du nye ba'i

rgya bod yig tshang 'a mo/ sras brgyad/ tha ma sku bgres khar 'khrungs pa'i jo bo bka' gdams pa gsum yod ces grags so/ /gnyan chung ras pa ni/ yul gung thang phrang ra ba mtshan rdo rje grags/ thog mar mi la dang mjal/ thugs zin/ rgya gar lalan lnga byon/ ba la tsan+d+ra bam/ pham thing pa/ ti phu pa/ ma grub pa'i rgyal mo la sogs mang du bsten/ chos skor tshan che ba thob/ phyag rdor bsgrub pas mdze thon/ phyis bod du bla ma la zhus nas/ dbus su byon/ byi chung rtsad po'i mdze bsos mag pa mdzad/ pho brang skyegs ldan du lha lcam ldems bus dam tshig nyams nas bral te gnyal lo ro la sogs par bzhugs/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga la sku gshegs so/ /de la slob ma nye gnas rin chen grags/ bur sgom nag po/ sum ston chos dar/ dge bshes khyung po la sogs mang po byon/sngon mtsho bre chung du rje mi la dang mjal ba'i bu mo dbus na ma des/ ras chung pa la gtad nas bsgoms pas/ sen mo dor lus ma spang par mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i grub thob ma gcig byung ngo / /ras chung pa dgung lo gya gnyisapa la gshegs so/ /ras pa zhi ba 'od ni/ brag sgye chur bsgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad pas/ brag phug spyi bo brtol nas mkha' spyod la gshegs/ nya mo gling kha'i 'bring sgom ras pa ni/ gangs pa she'u dang / rngog lo/ dpyal lo la sogs bla ma mang du bsten/ rje mi la rtsa ba'i bla mar gyur nas/ mi lo sum cur sgrub pa mdzad/ yi dam zhal gzigs dngos grub brnyes/ mal yer pa la sogs slob ma yang mang du byung gda'/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje ni/mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po dang / snying rje pad dkar du sangs rgyas kyis/ 'di 385

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//dge slong 'tsho byed du gyur nas/ bstan pa 'dzin pa la bskos shing / mthar rgyal ba dri ma med ces su sangs rgyas par lung bstan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa yin la/ de dang lhan du bstan pa 'dzin par khas blangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' stong lnga brgya yang 'di'i 'khor dang /brgyud 'dzin pa rnams yin par mdo de nyid las gsal bas rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab/ gdul bya'i snang ngor yang / rje mi la'i thugs sras kun gyi mchog tu mar pa dang mi la gnyis kas lung bstan pa yin no/ /'khrungs yul ni/ gnyal rus snyi ba/ yab snyi ba lha rje'i sras gsum gyi bar pa mtshan snying po kun dga'/ lha rje mdzad cing dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la dge bshes phywa pa gling pa la rab tu byung / bsod nams rin chen du mtshan gsol/mkhan po dang / bya 'dul ba la 'dul skor zhus/ mar yul bsam gtan la gsang sngags gsan/ dbu ru byang du/ dge bshes snyug cas pa/ lcags ri gong kha ba byang chub dpal/ dge bshes bya yul ba rnams la bka' gdams zhus/ zhag bcu gsum tsam re mi 'chor ba'i gnas pa bzang po byung / rtogs pa non/ sa bcu non pa'i rmi ltas byung / yab mes kyis brtsigs pa'i gser chung lha khang du bzhugs dus/ sprang po gsum las/ mi la'i snyan pa thos ma thag mos pa skyes byin rlabs zhugs nas yid 'phrog nas la stod la byon/sprang po gcig la lam sna bcol ba'i/ tshong 'dus nas 'gror ma nyan/ khong rang gis byon/ mjal ma thag bla ma mnyes nas/ sna len gyi mgur gsungs/sngar gyi nyams zhus pas gshad nas/ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ bcir bas mar ga la yong / nyung

rgya bod yig tshang tho mo/dkar btsir na yong ba yin/ thabs lam sgoms gsungs nas/ gdams pa rnams rim gyis gnang / bsgoms pas zhag bdun nas bde drod rang 'bar la song / rtags snang nyams myong khyad par can skyes pas ring po ma thogasapar/ sprul sku/ longs sku dang mjal chos sku myur du mthong bar lung bstan/byin gyis brlabs shing rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur nas/ lcags ri gong khar byon/ se ba lung du bka' gdams pa'i gseb tu bzhugs pas/ thug ba(dam cung zhig 'gribs/ yar byon mi la bsten pas sor chud zer ba'ang 'duga'ol kha nas sgam po zangs lung du byon/ bsgoms pas sor chud/ sgam po mthong ba'i la khar bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin chos nyid bden pa dngos su rtogs nas bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi mos gus skyes/ 'od de gung rgyal gyi bu dwags la sgam pos sbyin bdag byas nas sgam po'i ri khrod btab/ ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul du ma thob/ snang sems 'dres shing dbang du 'dus/ nyams rtogs mthar phyin/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bdun pa la mya ngan las 'das so/ /bla ma des don gnyis kyi gter kha phye bas 'gro don dpag med mdzad cing / bu chen gdugs thogs lnga brgya byung ba'i snga tshar la dwags po sgom pa dang rgyal ba khyung tshang pa la sogs/ bar tshar la grub thob dbu se dang khams pa rdor rgyal shad gsum thog pa la sogs/ phyi tshar la / byang gi 'ba' rom pa chen po/ shangs rmog cog pa la sogs gnam gyi skar ma tsam byon/ bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa mdzad do/ /dwags po rin po che'i gcung po lha rje rdo rje 'bar gyi sras/ dwags po sgom pa ni thog ma'i 387

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//mtshan zla rgyal gling dgung lo bcu gcig pa la bla ma'i drung du yong / chos ma lus par thob/ bcu gsum pa la spros bral gyi rtogs pa shar/ bcu drug pa la mkhan po mnga' ris pa sher snying la dge tshul zhus/ mtshan tshul khrims snying por btags/ bco brgyad pa la bsgoms pas ro gcig pa rtogs/ nyi shu rtsa lnga la sngar gyi mkhan po dang slob dpon shab rtse yon tan blo gros la sogs la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ sum cu rtsa lnga nas gdan sa bskyangs pas lo gnyis nas bla ma gshegs/ bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs/ de nas dbus su byon/ lha lung brag ram la sogs su bzhugs/ jo bo rin po che'i thugs rje dang bsrung mas bskul nas/ lha sa'i gso thabs mdzad/ rgya 'bri'i sde 'khrugs 'dums/shad rin po che la gnas gzhi gtad nas/ sgam por byon/ mkhyen rtogs dang thugs rje ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar dpag med mnga' ba de/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa glang lo dbyug gu zla ba'i tshes nyi shu la gshegs so/ /de'i slob ma grub thob dbu se/ shad rin po che mkhan chen bye dkar ba/ jo btsun rog po / shad ston ka lo ga dung ston la sogs pa byon no/ /bde gshegs khamasapa rdor rgyal gyi gdung rus ni/ rme 'dor ba'i nang ོ dbas de'i nang tshan dbe na/ yab dbe na a dar gyi sras su/ me pho rta lo la mdo khams rdo rje khrom du sku 'khrungs/ ldong yan byang chub kyi bu tshul khrims la rab tu byung / u ring rgya 'bar la chos gsan/ nyi shu rtsa lnga la dbus su phebs bul phur bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ slob dpon phywa pa chos kyi seng ge dang / dge bshes rdiXr gnyan/ dmar tsang bu kha pa/ dam

rgya bod yig tsha 'a mo/pa gnyal chung ba/ bur bsgom nag po/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ nyang sgom rgan po / byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan/ bla ma brag dkar ba la sogs la sngags mtshan nyid kyi bka' lung gdams pa mang du zhus/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa la dge bshes zhang gsum thogs pa dang 'grogs nas sgam por byon te/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje dang mjal/ rtogs pa gcings/ lo gsum bsnyen/ yar byon tsha rong btsan pos sbyin bdag byas nas lcags pho khyi lo la phag mo grur 'jag spyil dgon pa btab/ chos khrims bcas/dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga nas 'gro don bskyangs/ drug cu re gcig pa me pho stag gi lo ston zla tha chung gi nyi shu lnga la phag mo gru'i mthar tsar mya ngan las 'das so / / de'i thugs kyi sras bzhi ni/ bsod nams mthar phyin 'bri khung pa/mos gus mthar phyin stag lung pa/ shes rab mthar phyin par bu ba/ rtogasapa mthar phyin sna bu ba rnams so/ /nye ba'i sras bzhi ni/ skal ldan ye shes seng zhe kun ldan gtsang pa ras chung ba/ rtogs ldan mi nyag bsgom rin/grub thob nyag re se bo'o/ /gzhan yang / mkhan po zhad gsum thog pa dang /khro phu ba'i rgyal tsha rin chen/ chos rje sdum/ rlangs seng ge rgyal mtshan/ smon ston chos blo/ seng ge sding pa/ seng ston sding pa/ nyang shan grong pa/ zhang ston tsi ba ri pa/ kye'o dge ba dpal/ dge bshes ston 'jam/ rgyal tsha/ me sgom la sogs te/ sku 'da' ba'i lo grwa pa mkhas grags thon pa brgyad brgya tsam byung zhing / sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'o/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing mkhas grub rnams/ /byon tshul rnam thar ba dan 389

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsas/ (//cher g.yos pas/ /zab don nor bu'i tog 'dzin mkhas rnams kyis/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rgyun ring 'dzugs par shog /༈ zhi byed bar/da pa bzhugs/zhi byed brgyud pa'i spyi mes/ pha dam pa rin po che'i gcings yul ni/ rgya gar lho phyogs bha ga'i gling gi grong khyer tsa ra sidha ra/ yab ded dpon brtson 'grus go cha dang / yum bram ze mo gtsang sgra ldan ba hang ni bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs te/ dgung lo bcu na rab tu byung / mdo sngags kun la mkhas par sbyangs/ bod du thengs gsum byon pa'i dang por rab byung gi cha byad nas mon mtha' 'khob nas tshur byas kha rag snying khung par byon/ rgya gar la phyir logabar pa spyod pa'i cha lugs mdzad nas yar lung phu la byon/ de nas bal yul la byon/ de rting bod du phebs dus la stod ding ri glang 'khor du bzhugs/'gro ba mang po smin grol la bkod nas sa pho byi ba'i lo dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes bzhi la mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /slob ma'i nang nas thugs kyi srasabazhi ni bla ma dharma tsakra dang/ bla ma gu na shrī/ dam pa char chung ba/ bla ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' rnams dam pa rin po che snyung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i dus su bla ma dharma tsakra dang / dam pa kun dga' dang / bla ma gu na shrī rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i tshe dam pa'i zhal nas/ ngas mi yul du lo lnga brgya dang bcu bdun sdad 'dug spya /kha' spyod du 'gro gsungs nas/ sa

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/mo lug gi lo dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes brgya gcig gi nyi ma dgong kha'i dus zhi bar gshegs so// /// dpal phag mo gru pa'i yang dgon btab lugs dang de'i gdan sar rlangs lha gzigs kyi bla rabs byon tshul lo/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lhums bzhugs byang sems sprul pa'i sras//lhun po'i ngos la 'ja' 'od gur bcas bzhugs pa de/ /mes pos blangs dus bar snang lhas gzigs de'i phyir/ /gdung rus 'di la lhas gzigs zhes su grags pa'o/ /de'i brgyud pas phag gru yang dgon btab/ /gdan sar dpal ldan dwags po'i chos lugs rnams/ /legs par bskyangs pa'i grub thob byon tshul rnams/ /chos bdag bla ma gong mas da rgon pa btab lugs sogs/ /rnam thar ngo mtshar phreng ba 'di dag bdag gis spel/ /de'ang 'di ltar thos te/ thog mar bla ma gong ma/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po grub thob khams pa rdor rgyal zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid/ gdung rusani sme 'dor ba'i nang tshan dbas/ de'i nang tshan dbe na yab dbe na a dar gyi sras su/ me pho stag lo la mdo khams rdo khrems su sku gcings/ sdong yan thub kyi bu tshul khrims la rab tu byung / dbu ring rgya 'bar la chos gsan/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga la dbus su phebs/ zul phur bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ phywa sdu chos kyi seng ge dang / 'khon sa skya pa

'tshe run 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (5chen po dang / mnyam med dwags po lha rje ba la sogs pa dbus gtsang gi mkhas grub bzang la mang ba bsten/ nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs/bzhi bcu zhe lnga bzhes pa lcags pho khyi lo la/ tsha rong btsan pos sbyin bdag d+nghabyas nas/ phag mo grur 'jag spyil dgon pa btab/ de lo nas 'gro don bskyangs/ sgom sgrub kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad cing / grwa pa nyis stong brgyad brgyar grags pa dang / dge bshes gdugs thogs pa lnga brgya tsam byung nas/ dgung lo drug cu re gcig pa me pho stag lo ston zla tha chung gi nyi shu lnga la phag mo gru'i mtha' tsar mya ngan las 'das so/ /bla ma de'i thugs sras mthar phyin bzhi ni/ bsod nams mthar phyin/ 'bri khung pa skyu ra rin chen dpal/ mos gus mthar phyin stag lung pa/ gzi bkra shis dpal/shes rab mthar phyin par bu ba blo gros dpal/ rtogs pa mthar phyin/ sna phu ba gling chen ras pa'o/ /nye ba'i sras bzhi ni/ skal ldan ye shes seng gekun ldan gtsang pa ras chung ba/ rtogs ldan mi lhag sgom rin/ grub thob lhag ra se ba rnams dang / gzhan yang dge bshes zhang gsum thogs pa la sogs mkhas grub grangs las 'das pa mang po smin cing grol bar mdzad de/bde gshegs phag mo gru chen po mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su/ dge bshes zhang gsum thogs pas phag gru'i gnas sar byon nas mkhan po lo lnga mdzad/khong gshegs nas thugs sras thams cad kyi thu bo 'gran zla dang bral ba skru ra rin chen dpal bas 'bri khung nas phag gru gdan sa yang dgon gyi mkhan po yang lo gsum mdzad/ 3 9 2 gnyis kur du phebs nas/ grwa

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo slob yar 'phel du bskyangs/ mdo stod smad kyi grwa pa rnams kyi nang nas/ rus pa rlangs lha gzigs yin pa'i dge bshes bla ma la lhag par dad pa zhig yod pa de/ sku drung du nye bar bsten gsol gzim bcol/ bla ma yang gdul byas g.yengs nas shas che ba 'bri khung rang du bzhugs pa'i skabs su/phag gru mthar rgya'i grwa tshogs byin 'byung zhes sogs lung bstan/ shad dgon pa bas mgo byas gnas dgon brgya rtsa brgyad lo gsum la btab/ grwa pa khri tsho lnga tsam 'dus pa la bshad grwa chen mo bas phrag dog byas nas/ ser dmag khyer byung ba la/ bla mas sprul pa'i dmag dpung bkye nas pham par byas te mthar gus btud zhus/ khams gtsang gi grwa pa tshogs che dus 'bul ba snga rting gros su bsdur bla ma rin po che sku rgas kyang yar byon/ gdan sa khag gnyis skyong dgos pa sa thag ring bas 'byon bzhud kyang dka' ba yin 'dug tsa na/ da rang re rnams kyi mgo btud gdan sa pa gcig bskos la zhus pa drag zer ba la kha 'chams/ rin po che bgres pa 'ga' yang 'bri khung du btang / rje dang mjal/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ de bzhin cis kyang legs so/ /de'i 'os su 'dug khyed rang rnams kyis ltos shig gsungs pa la/ khong rnams kyis rje rin po che'i spyan snga na bzhugs pa'i gsol ja ba 'di 'dra zhig bskos par zhu zhus pas/ 'o de shin tu yang legs pas ngas kyang byin gyis brlabs/ khyed rang rnams kyis gdan drongs la song zhig gsungs pa'i bka' gnang / gdan par bskos/ rje'i spyan snga nas byon pas/ de phyin spyan snga chos rjer grags pa 'di byung ba yin cing / khor rang gi mtshan ni/ grags393

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//pa 'byung gnas zer la lha gzigs kyi zhal ngos/ phag mo gru pa'i gdan sa mdzad pa'i thog ma 'di yin no/ /des phag mo gru pa'i lha khang rnying ma bzhengs/bstan pa dang gdan sa'i bya ba cher mdzad/ phyis ku ra rin po che grongs nas/khong gis kyang 'bri gdan gnyis ka bskyangs shing / phag gru'i gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis mdzad nas/ khong rang 'bri khung du bzhugs/ dbon po lā rgyal ba dang / rin po che grags pa brtson 'grus pa/ phag gru'i gdan sar bskos nas btang ba yar 'gro la thog tu phebs pa dang / mal gro gzi chen la sogs phar tshur gyi gzhi bdag gdug pa can 'ga' res bla ma'i nyams sad pa'i ched du/ glo bur bar sprin bsdus/ 'brug sgrags/ thog ser phab pa dang bla mas chos gos thu bar gnang mas bzed nga sa/ thog yas lnga/ thu ba na sran ma blug pa bzhin/ phar ril tshur ril du 'dug ste bla ma dpon slob mi nor gang la'ang thog gis gnod pa ma nus pas rgyal ba thog gdugs par grags shing / des gdan sa lo sum cu so gcig mdzad pa'i bar la gdul bya dang snyan grags shin tu che/ khyad par sku tshe'i smad la stod hor rgyal po hu la hu dang yon mchod du 'brel nas/ des brgya 'bul nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sna grangs pa'i 'bul mo che byung ba blangs/ de nas zhag bcu bdun song ba dang rgyal ba rin po che grongs/ de'i gcung po bdu gnyis rin po che rin chen rdo rjes gdan sa lo bcu bzhi mdzad/ rgyal ba rin po che'i nang rten la gser gyi sgo mang bzhengs/ gdan sa mthil gyi sgo mang sngon ma yin no/ /de'i slob ma la spru tog zer/ khong grongs nas spru tog /sdu bla ma'i nang rten la sgo mang gcig

rgya bod yig mo ri cha mo/bzhengs/ gdan sar bla ma sku mched kyi dbon po che ba/ gcen grags pa ye shes pa bskos/ de'i slob ma la sdom bu zer/ spru tog gi chags de nas byung /bla ma des gdan sa lo dgu mdzad pa'i ring la/ sa skya pa'i bla ma 'phags pa la rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa zhus/ bla ma shar pa ye shes rin chen pa la 'ong rang gi snag tsha dpon po brag sle phul/ de sa skya pas phag gru'i gdan sar bskos rtsis byas pas gcung rgya bos skyongs de 'tsham/ rin po che grags ye ba grongs nas/ gcung rgya bo grags rin pas gdan sa mdzad/ sa skya pas brag sle dbon po'i kha mchu rtsod rtsis byas pas gcung rgya bo'i rting /'bri khungs pas mnan pas sa 'bri 'khu/ga pa'i mgo tshugs/ phag gru pa rang la'ang skyon cher ma byung na'ang sa 'bri yun ring 'khrugs/ phyis gcung rgya bos phag gru'i bla dpon sbrel nas mdzad/ de grongs nas sku mched gnyis dbon po rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan pa sa pho byi ba lo la bskos nas/ gdan salo lnga bcu nga gcig mdzad/ de rting gcung po grags pa shes rab pas gdan sa lo bcu gsum mdzad/ khong grongs nas de'i dbon po ring brgyud spyan snga grags byang ba gdan sar bskos/ lo 'ga' sne gdong khri thog dang / bla dpon sbrags pa'ang mdzad/ de gshegs rting gcung po grags pa rin chen pa phag gru'i gdan sar glo bur du bskos/ de'i rting de'i gcung bsod nams grags pas kyang gdan sa lo 'ga' mdzad nas/ khri dpon shākya rin chen pa'i sras po spyan snga bsod nams dpal ba dang / bsod nams bzang po ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa sku mched de rnams kyis gdan sa rim par mdzad/ chu mo 395

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//glang le'i gzham la spyan snga chos rje bsod nams rgyal ba sku gshegs/ rgyal mtshan pa sku mched de rnams kyis gdan sa rim par mdzad/ chu mo glang lo'i gsham la/ spyan snga chos rje bsod nams rgyal ba sku gshegs de'i gshegs rdzongs kyi skabs/ shing pho stag lo srog sme brgyad dkar dbus na yod pa'i ston nas phag gru nang mkhon gyis rkyen pas dbus gtsang srid sdebs kyi bde dogs chen mo langs pa yin no/ /dpal phag mo gru pa'i sgrub khang 'jag spyil dang / gdan sa yang dgon/ lcags pho khyi lo la btab nas/ da lan shing pho stag lo 'di yan la lo grangs nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe lnga song 'dug cing/gdan sar zhugs pa ni thog mar/ grub chen khams pa rdor rgyal ba rang dang /mkhan po zhang gsum thogs pa/ kyu ra rin chen dpal ba gsum mi the ba'i/rlangs lha gzigs kyi gdung brgyud pas gdan sa rim par mdzad pa la/ snga sor spyan snga rin po che grags 'byung pa nas/ spyan snga bsod rgyal ba yan la zhal ngo bcu gcig byon pa'i bar la/ chos tshugs dang mthar rgya'i grwa slob yar 'phel du 'byung zhing / bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don la thugs brtson sha stag byon gda'o/ /bde gshegs bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje yis/ /dbus gtsang bod zhing thub bstan gsal ba dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i gdan sa ma stong bar/ /sgrub brgyud nyi ma'i 'od ltar gsal bar shog /dge'o//396

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo// dpal phag sdi gā snaX ṭ+wāṃ // sdo ༵ ༷/ sna snas lha gzigs kyi dpal phag mo'i khri skor la/ rlangs lha gzigs zhal ngo nang rim gyis/ /dbang 'khor los sgyur cing yar 'phel du/ /dus snga phyir byung tshul 'di ltar snang / /de'ang thog mar hor sa skya pa yon mchod du 'brel nas/ dbus gtsang gi mi rtsis/ dud grangs hor dud 'cha' ba'i dus na/ dbus phyogs su gser yig pa/ si tu a skyid bya bas rtsis pa la/ phag gru'i khri skor rang la hor dud tshang ma nyis stong bzhi brgya sum cu rtsa brgyad kyi thog tu/ lha pa'i dud drug brgya dang / stag lung pa'i steng nas dud grangs lnga brgya mnan pa des/ khri skor gcig gi bya ba bsgrub cing / hor 'ja' byang kha la 'gro dus rtsi dbar 'ja' mo'i brdzid khag phag gru khri skor gyis 'khrur dgos la/ gong ma yon mchod bka' gros skor bas/ khri dpon bzang po re bskos par 'dug par/ snga sor 'bri gdan gnyis sde dgon khag cig par byas nas 'bri khung pa sgom pa shag rin gyis spyi'i kha ta byed/ de'i nye gnas ldan ma sgom brtson zer ba gcig gis/ tshong 'dus brag khar khri khang brtsigs nas rkang yengs dang smad hor la ngo ltas/ khri dpon gyi ming lo sbrel byas/ de rting spyan snga rin po che grags 'byung ba'i gsol ja ba lto brag shong sde'i mkhan po byas pas mkhan po rin rgyal zer ba gcig gis khri daX/ lo sbrel nas byas/ de mtshams mdo

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chog༅— gces bsdus/ (nekhams nas dpon rdo rje dpal zer ba'i khams gzhon gzugs dang spyod lam mdzes pa gcig spyan snga'i drung du byung nas/ bdag lha gzigs kyi rus chen gcig yin pas rjes su bzung du gsol zhus pas/ 'o skol rus nye bar 'dug gsungs nas/ re zhig gsol ja ba bcol bya ba che chung gang la'ang rnam dbye phye ba zhig 'dug pas/ rgya yul la brdzangs pas gong ma yon mchod kyi thugs la btags nas phag gru khri skor mi rabs kyi bar la 'ja' sa'i bka' lung bzang po dam rtags dang bcas pa gnang / yar slebs nas de 'phral shing pho stag lo la khri khang yar lung rnam rgyal dang sne rtse khri dpon lo bcu gsum byas pa'i bar la gong 'og phyi nang kun dang mthun cing / byas pa lag rjes che ba la/sne gdong gi mgo byas/ha la sgang /sna cho/lcags rtse gru gu/thang po che'i gling smad/ 'chos gzhis kha/ mon mkhar bkra shis gdong / rgya thang / tshong 'dus gra kha/ zangs ri pho brang sgang / mkhar thog 'chad dkar do la sogs mdor na tsha dung gtong ba'i gzhis kha bcu gnyis zhabs su chug par bzhengs pas khri dpon pher po byung bar grags so/ /de 'das nas/ de'i nu bo gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyis/ khri dpon lo gsum bzhi byas/ de 'das rting / kho rang gi dpon skya yar 'brog chu brgyud pa'i rigs nya pa yin la byang gzhen zer ba zhig gis khri dpon byas/ skabs der sa 'bri 'khrugs pa la byang gzhen gyis sa skya pas gang gsungs pa byas/ dpon chen ang len gyis phag gru bsreg par byung ba la byang gzhen gyis zhus pas 'tsheng / byang gzhen shi nas/ gzhen nu rgyal 3 9 8 gyi tsha bo gzhon nu yon tan gyis khri

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/dpon byas te/ hor rgyal po the mur bho kha yum sras/ bod du bzhugs pa'i zhabs tog dang / dmag gi phyag phyi cung ma 'grub phyi go ma chod kyang nang du zhing pa ya gsum la sogs pa gzan po byas pas rin po che gcung rgya bo la ma mnyes par/ rgyal bu yum sras la zhus nas gzhon nu yon tan babs gong du zhu bar btang / de ma 'khor ba la rgyal bu'i ma ma go cha/ sa skya pa'i chos khrims pa rin chen bkra shis/ spyan lnga'i nye gnas brtson 'grus dpal/gzhon nu yon tan gyi dpon 'og ma/ grags pa 'od zer/ sngar hu la shus bskos pa'i yul bsrung ba go go chu'i bu rdo rje yar lung pa jo bo grags rin rnam 'dzom kun khris skor gyi bya ba bsgrubs/ de mtshams gong du ti shi gragasa'od pas mgo mdzad nas rin po che gcung rgya bo la khri dpon gyi 'ja' sa grub nas bla dpon sbrags/ gzhen nu yon tan la brten bor 'chos mon mkhar byin/ gcung rgya'o grongs rting / rin po che grags rgyal ba'i gcen po rgyal mtshan dpal gyis gong du byon lha rje phag mo gru pas zhus/ lung gis khong khri dpon la bskos nas lo sbrel byas de'i lag nas/ 'ong rang gi nu bo gragasabazang sa skya pa la zhus nas bskos/ de'i lag nas gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyi bu rgyal mtshan skyabs kyis 'ja' sa sa glang rin po che grags rgyal ba'i gcung po byang chub rgyal mtshan pa shing pho stag lo pa yin/ sa skyar bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i drung du lo bcu bzhi lon pa yos lo la phyin nas phyag phyir sdod dam gnyer pa bya/ bla ma'i gsung gis khyod rin po che byed dam khri dpon byed gsungs/rin po che byed lags zhus pas de mi 'ong bar 'dug khri dpon byed dgos 399

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (//pas/ g.yul rgyal dang legs bshad sogs la lte snas gsungs pa/ thugs mkhyen yod par 'dug de nas bdag chen pas sprad nas bla ma mnyam med chen po las slob gnyer zhus/ brtag gnyis bslabs/ stag lo'i ston gzhug la / khong gis bshad gsar dang / gcen po slob dpon grags bzang pa khri dpon la sa skya nas khyod bskos byas pa'i tshogs ja mnyam du bskol/ ti shi kun blo ba gong la byon dus/ rgyal mtshan skyabs phab nas khri dpon la bskos rting la gtsang dbang rgyal po'i 'ja' sa sa ta'i si tu'i ming thob/ rgyal mtshan skyabs kyi tsha bo bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi lung gis rtsad cing khyon gyi bsko bzhag la sogs mtho dman mang du byung yang sus kyang ma thub par rgyal khams dbang du bsdud pa'i mi de 'di yin no/ /si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan pa de sku na gzhon dus phyi nang gi sde gzar dka' dgu sbyong spyod che na'ang /dgung lo nga lnga pa'i thog chu pho spre'u lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes lnga la dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po lha khang bla brang pas/ lha rtser sgor de 'don phyir du dbus gtsang khri skor rnams kyi dmag bsdus pa'i dpon thob nas/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin sa skyar bca' ho btang bas dpon chen thob/ de 'phral dmag 'gyes dus/ dpon chen pas dbon po si tu blo gros rgyal mtshan pa dang /tham kha gling drug ma rgyal mthong rang bcas pa si tu byang rgyal ba la phul nas/gtsang pas dar cog dkar po 'dzugs pa'i sngon ma byas te/ de dus nas bstan pa mgo tshugs nas mtshan jus yar 'phel du byung zhing / khri dpon byings dang gros mthun nas sa skya rwa 0 0 ho btang ba bya bzang sgang yin

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/pas/ bya ba bzang po grub pa'i rdzong 'di la bya bzang rdzong zer ba'i ming thog gsungs pa yin zer ro/ khong gi ring la/ rang re lha gzigs kyi brgyud pa 'dis mis mi go chod bzhin du chos kyis chos go chod pa gcig dgos pa 'dug gsungs/ rtse thang gi dgon pa gsar du btab/ bshad grwa btsugs/sne gdong dang srol gcig par byas/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gdan drangs/ chos sde'i rab gnas dang khong rang gi dbon po slob dpon shākya rgyal mtshan pa mchod dpon la bskos pa'i mkhan po dang / gral dpon zhus/ chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang la'ang / mkhyen rab dang 'bad rtsol shin tu che bar grags shing / phag mo gru pa'i sde srid kyi bya ba la byas pa lag rjes dpon rabs snga rting su las kyang/ 'di nyid mchog tu che bar byed do/ /dgung lo re gsum pa me pho 'brug lo la sne gdong dga' ldan rtser bde bar gshegs so/ /de nas dbon po shākya rgyal mtshan pas sne gdong khri thog tu'ang bzhugs/ bla dpon sbrags nas mdzad ring la rgyal khrims 'jags shing / chos khrims dar dbus gtsang bde ba dang / mnga' zhabs skyid par byung na dgongs pa'i thugs dge ba kho na bzung bas/ kun gyis 'jam dbyangs shākya rgyal ba zhes bstod cing bsngags pa'i snyan grags che bar byung zhing / tshul de dang mthun par gyur to/ /hor tho gan the mur rgyal pos kyang chang gu'i gung gi ming dang las ka gnang / khong gshegs rting /gcung po khri dpon shākya rin chen pa sne gdong khri thog tu ston nas dbus gtsang gi gzhi bskor la 'byon par chas/ gzhung skyid mo bzhong du phebs nub khang 401

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gu pa gces bsdus/ (//bskor byings la me stobs chen shor/ dpon g.yog rnams nyen can la gtad pas rtog bcas kyi phyir log nas mkhar thog dgon gsar du bzhugs su bcug thugs ma bde nas mu med mang rab mdzad pas/ khri bdag spyon par grags pa byung la/ spyan snga grags byang pas 61 shas bla dpon sbrags nas bzung / de rting gcung po grags rin pa sne gdong du lo 'ga' bskos/ de mtshams rdzong rgyal mtshan bzang po ba khu dbon gyis do dam byas nas/ bdag po grags rin pa slo bur du gong dkar nas gzhung ko la gdan drangs/ spyan snga grags byang pa'i gdan sar bskyal/ sne gdong khri thog tu khri dpon shāka rin pa'i sras che ba grags pa rgyal mtshan pa dgung lo bcu gcig lon pa'i shing pho byi ba lo la dpon sar ston/ sku tshe'i stod la/ dbon zhang gi 'bon rtsod dang / e gnyal gyi sde gzar la sogs dka' dgu mang po rang byung na'ang rting la sde pa nang 'jags/ dbus gtsang gi khri stong phal che ba dbang du bsdus/ rgya nag rta'i ming rgyal pos/ ko rnyeng gu shi dang / tshan hi dbang gi mtshan dang / gser tham lung lag rtags bzang po rim par gnang / stobasadang dpal 'byor mnga' thang phun sum tshogs pa byung zhing / dgung lo bcu gcig pa nas lnga bcu nga dgu'i bar la go sa mthon por bzhugs nas/ sde srid yar 'phel du byung bas phag mo gru pa'i dpon brgyud khri thog tu bzhugs pa la 'di pa yun ring zhing sku bsod che bar grags so/ /lnga bcu nga dgu bzhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo la sne gdong rtser sku gshegs so/ /mdor bsdus pa ni / hor sa skya pa'i bka' lung gis ༵༵sa gtsang gi hor dud grangs pa'i khri

rgya bod yig tshang za slo/ skor so sor bcas pa nas/ phag mo gru pa'i khri dpon sngon ma ldan ma sgo ma brtson dang / bskong sde mkhan po rin rgyal gnyis kyis khri dpon ming thogs re byas pa mi the ba'i/ rlangs lha gzigs kyi dpon brgyud kyis khri dpon mdzad pa'i thog ma/ dpon rdo rje dpal nas bzung ste/ bdag po dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pa yan la/ zhal ngo khri thog bzhugs pa nges can bcu gnyis dang /khri thog ston tsam shāka rin pa'o/ /sde pa'i nang nas/ bla dpon sbrags pa gsum byung bar byed cing / bar skabs su lha gzigs ma yin pa'i khri dpon byas pa yar 'brog pa byang gzhen dang / thus mi mi drug 'dzoms nas byas pa dang /tshog la tho )ni tshog dzo sto tshog 'tshom sa mo/rje/ tshog zug sa ma de tekhra dpan ngas gnyas byung nga / khra dpan rda dpal gyas/ shang pha stag la la / khri khang yar lung rnam rgyal dang / sne gdong brtsigs nas da lo shing pho stag lo srog sme brgyad dkar dbus na yod pa'i dbus gtsang srid sdebs kyi bde dogs chen mo langs pa 'di yan la lo grangs nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu song bar rtsi'o/ /lha gzigs byon tshul 'di bris lha bsrung gis/ /'gro la phan bde stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ // lha pa'i chos lugs dang brgyud rabs byon tshul bdog go /su sti/ lha pa'i thog ma gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags pas rgya gar du byon nas/ slob dpon wo po bha ling ta a tsar+ya la/ chos don thog dril la / kha zin che ba gcig zhu byas pas/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs kyi skor 403

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (goganang / las kha tshar tshang ma ga ga zhu byas pas/ gshin rje dgra nag gnang /la chung gcig gi rtsa na yod pas bka' bsrung zhig yang zhu byas pas/'jigs byed la ṭa ka shad sbrel nas gnang / pha rgyud skor gsum du grags te dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ de'i sras slob dpon rdo rje bla ma/ pha rgyud skor gsum la mkhas shing / bod kyi mi chen bzhir grags pa'i ya gcig yin/ de'i sras dpal seng ge'i sras/ gnyob(nag grags pa dpal/ chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi sku skye yin par zhang rin po ches lung bstan/ khong gi sras ras chen gnyosalha nang pa de rgya gar gyi nag po spyod pa chung ba yin par zhang rin po ches lung bstan 'dug cing / rtsa rir byon dus mkha' 'gro mas kyang lung bstan no/ /zhang gi drung du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ 'bri khung chos rje'i drung du nā ro'i chosadrug gsan/ rtsa ri te si sogs la byon sgrub pa la nan tan cher mdzad/ mon gyi pa 'gro bcal kha la sogs par tshogs pa yang thog re bskyangs byang du lha nang btab/ lha pa nyis stong brgyad brgyar grags pa yang de nas byung / khong gi dbon po lha rin chen rgyal po de nyid lha sras mu yi btsan po'i skye ba yin skad/skyor mo lung du rab byung mdzad/ pha rgyud skor gsum la mkhas bcal kha sagayos kyis 'gyel ba'i tshab la phag ri rin chen sgang brtsigs/ lha nang du gdan sar bzhugs pas rgyal khrims 'cha' ba'i dmag sna'i gnod pa byung bas skyid smad du byon pas/ rab grong brtsigs/ lha nang du khu bo'i slob ma ba thob 'dam seng gdan sa la brdzangs/ 'dam pa ri pas nye gnas mdzad nas gyer re dgon pa btab cing / gyer ṭ+wāṃ lha khang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/de'i dbon brgyud bla ma dar ma rgyal po dang de'i dbon po lha gzi brjid rgyal po'o/ /chos kyi brgyud pa ni/ lha rin chen rgyal po khu dbon gnyis la/ mkhas pa dge brag pa/ tshul khrims khag zhen nubs thugs/ de'i thugs mkhas pa byang dar/de'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs gzi brjid rgyal po ba lags so/ /lha rabs bris pas lha mi kun/ /kun mkhyen rgyal po myur thob shog /dge'o/ // shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi byon tshul bzhugs so/na mo rat+na gu sa zab don thar lam nye ba mkha' 'gro'i chos/ /sgyu lus rmi lam sprul sgyur dbang 'byor zhing / /chos skyong mgon pos phrin las legs bsgrubs pa/ tanangs pa bka' brgyud byon chul zur tsam bstan/ /de'ang shangs pa'i chos lugs zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'chang dang bla ma khyung po rnal 'byor gyi bar la/ ye shes kyi ḍā ska ma mched gnyis las med pas brgyud thag nye zhing / brgyud pa bka' babs dang ldan pa mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa / gdams pa'i mgo zhabs bar gsum gang thob kyang rin po che'i ras ma lta bu yon tan dngos su byung ba/ nyams su blangs pas dbang po rab rnams smin/ 'bring chag cha tha ma yang bar dor sangs mi rgya mi srid pa 'di'i chos kyi byung tshul/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar zur tsam bstan pa ni/ thog mar mkhasagrub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor gyi rnam par thar pa rgyas par brjod na bsam gyis mi khyab na'ang 'dir dad pa gso phyir chu thig tsam zhig bkod pa las/405
