ba chen 'od snang la /skya'i cho 'byung ga rtse bsdus/ (re/bla ma de'i 'khrungs yul snye mo ra mangs/ rus khyung po/ yab khyung po stag skyes/yum bkra shis skyid kyi lhums nas btsas ma thag tu rgya gar gyi grub thob a mo ghas lung bstan/ lo lnga lon nas pha mes lung bstan bshad/ lo bcu lon nas klog yig rgya rtsis la sogs yon tan thams cad shes/ pha mes bon po yin pas bon bslabs/ de rting bla ma 'byung gnas seng ge las phyag rgya chen po zhus na'ang de gnyis ka la the tshom re byung nas bzhag lta sgom spyod gsum 'dzom pa'i chos gcig rang 'tshol dgos snyam nas/ lha sa stod lung dang sho ma ra kor rnam ru ba'i spyan sngar phyin/ phyag chen zhus pasang la slob ma nyung dkar zho gcig gi grangs dang mnyam pa yod kyang / nga'i chos rnams ma lus par shes pa khyung po rnal 'byor las med do gsungs nas/ shin tu mnyes shing mos pa thob na'ang / da cis kyang rgya gar la chos 'tshol du 'gro ba'i dgongs pa gzungs te/ sru mo'i g.yu la sogs cha rkyen mang po khyer byon nas/bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bha su na ma ti dang / rgya gar shar phyogs su paṇ+ḍi ta ma thu badz+ra dang mjal/ chos zhus bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i drung du song zhig ces lung bstan thob nas byon te/ bram ze rat+na phalas/ lde tsho lte bsgrur gyi gdams pa gnang nas sru mo la skyel ba byon/ yang gser grang lnga brgya phrag drug tsam phyag tu byung ba la sogs khyer nas rgya gar dge /bal po/ li yul la theng bdun byon/ pham thing pa dang/ brda chen po dang / su ma ti girti chen mo dang /dharma pha la dang /gha pa dang /rin chen lha mo/grub thob snying po/ sbas pa'i rnal 'gyor/rol pa'i rdo rje /ār+ya de ba/mkhan 'gro ma gha dha ra/ kun tu bzang mo/ bde ba'i rdo rje rnams mjal/ gdam pa mang du zhus/ rgyal sras mai tri pa chen po dang / daX sha ba ri dbang phyug gis mgon po phyag drug pa'i

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/cho skor tshang ma gnang / nā ro paṇa chen gyi lcag mo sang rgya dngos la chos zhus pa'i ye she kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhe gu ma sgyu lu rmi lam gyi dbang bskur/ gnyid thun gcig la chos drug gi khrid tshad gcig rdzog par gnang nas/ mi rab bdun thub chig brgyud las ma spel cig gsungs/ bka' rgyas gdams/ ḍa sgom su ka ma sirnyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ ga dmasang na thamasacad rdzog par gnang / gsang yum mdzad/ 'di na bde ba can du 'byon par lung bstan/ thog mtha' bar gsum du drin che ba'i mo pa thob/ bla ma a ti ya badz+ra/ gdam pa zab mo dang / nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rdor dril/ bum pa/thod pa mtshan ldan rnams gnang / lotsā ba glan dar gshesarab dang /rdzo bo ga ya dha ra dang sdebs nas tshur byon dus/ma gcig ri mtho la lding gi lha khang du/ paṇ+ḍita di po ka ra shrī sgo na dang mjal gdams pa zhus/chos mang po bskur/ yul du phebs/ lha sar byon pa'i rmi lam du jo bos chos gsungs/ glang ri thang pa chen po'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ 'phan yul 'jog po'i ri la sgrub pa mdzad pa grwa slob mang nas ma shong bar mda' ru cha dkar dgon pa btab/de skab su bsung ba la rgya gar nas grub thobs mo lha'i sprul pa tsar+ya gcig byung na bskung la phan par mdzad/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa'i gdams pa ster/ rgya gar la 'gro gsungs pa la ma byon/ bal snyel zhug bskyal/ snye mo ra mangs su sprul pas dmag gi gsal ngo bzlog cho 'khor btsugs/ seng ge'i gdong can la sogs ṇa gi ma mang po ming yang byon/shangs na dgon pa bod pa gshegs zer ba dpon slob sum stong gi byon/ ma ga dha rdo rje gdan du byon nas/ dge tshul gyi mkhan po zhus mtshan tshul khrims mgon por btags nas/ bla ma shangasakhrag brdal nas/ mtshan khyung po rnal 'byor las pod ma thub/ de nas rje btsun shrī dzñā na dang / be+e ro tsā na rak+ṣi ta dang / kha che dgon pa ba dang / zhing gi rdo rje dang / mi mnyam rdo rje dang / rin chen rdo rje dang / mkha' 'gro ma ka na shrī 407

'tshe tshen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()dang mjal/ gdams pa mang du gnang / khyad par rdo rje gdan pa chen pos bde mchog dkyil 'khor rang byon gyi sa sa gdul bya khri phrag la ma mchams dus chos khri brgya rtsa'i steng du bla ma re re bzhugs par sprul nas/'bul ba thams cad nyin gcig la blangs/ grwa tsho gis che/ khong rnams longasaspyod la yengs/ dge sbyor g.yel bar 'dug pa la/ 7 mo dang / gshin rje'i sprul bsgyur mdzad pas blo skyed che bar byung / tre bo byang chub rgyal gyi 'bul mo che dang / rong po dkon rgyal gyis rta brgya dngul bre bcu gcig dar zab mang po phul dus sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur sprul pa sna tshogs mdzad/ yi dam mkha' 'gro'i zhal snga rting du gzigs pa la kye rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu/ mtshon cha can la bcu gsum 'jam dpal sgrol ma lha bcu gsum/rnam 'joms sras rnam sras rta bdag brgyad mgon po dkar nag byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzhi/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa dang / ye shes kyi ḍā gi ma mched gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i mang du mjal zhing / chos gsan/ dag pa'i zhing khams mang po gzigs/ rgyal chen sde bzhi/ klu rgyal ma dros pa/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa/ yar lha sham po/ gnyan chen thang lha la sogs pas sbyin bdag byas/ ban chen la sogs pa'i gnod byed mang po sprul bsgyur mdzad nas ba lha pa/ mu ge chen po gcig byung dus snga dro thang chen po la sa bon btab nas/ dgong khar 'brasabu bsdus chog pa sprul nas/ 'gro ba mang po bkres pa'i sdug bsngal las thar bar mdzad/ de nas rgya gar gyi spra 0sdu rnams dang mgon po tshe dpag med

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/byon nas bde ba can du byon gsungs pa la/ bdag chos 'phro rnams bshad la yong zhus pas da lan phyin na lus ma spangs par phyin chog pa yin te/ da rnam smin gyi lus 'di bor nas bde ba can du sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /gdan sa 'di ni rdo rje gdan dang mtshungs so gsungs/ der rting lo gsum du chos 'khor bskor grwa slob mang 'dus khri phrag brgyad re 'du ba byung ba/ thams cad chos kyis tshams par mdzad do/ /de skabs/ ye shes kyi ḍā sku ma kun tu bzang mo byon nas/ tshogs pa'i mthar thug khri tshogs brgyad/ /slob ma'i mthar thug lnga dang gcig /tshe yi mthar thug brgya lnga bcu/ /zhing khams mthar thug bde ba can/ /zhes gsungs pa/ de rnams yong ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ tshes bcu'i snga dro grwa slob thams cad bsags/ mang skol mdzad pa'i tshogs su byon nas de ring nga'i chos kyi phyi ma dang gtam gyi tha ma yin pas thams cad nyon cigang khyung po rnal 'byor gyis/ rgya gar dang / bal por lan bdun phyin/ bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu bsten mos gus dang / 'bul bas mnyes par byas/ rgyud lung sgrub thabs gdams ngag zhal gdams dang bcas pa mang du zhus/ byin gyis brlabs/ khyad par can gyi bla ma lnga bcu dang /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam bzhi/ 'gran gyi zla med ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma zhal gnyis la / zab chos gdams ngag chig brgyud bka' brgyad dang bcas pa zhus nas/chos ci dgos thams cad la lhag ma ma lus par byin nas/ tshims par byasapa yin pas nyams su longs shig 'di lta bu'i gdams pa rgya bod gang na yang med pa yin no/ /slob ma'i thu bo rme'u ston pa dang / g.yor po rgya mo che/409

ba chen 'od snang lags skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ ( )dngul ston rin dbang /zhang bsgom chos seng /la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar rnams snga bu lnga dang / sgyu lus rmi lam gyis 'bras bu smin/ rig brgyud kyi bka' babs pa'i rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus dang drug po 'di/ bla ma yi dam gyi lung bstan thob cing yi dam mang po las chos zhus/ de ji lta ba bzhin thugs su chud pa'i skyes bu yin pas mched grogs rgan gzhen thamasacad kyis phrag dog ma byed/ spyir nga dang dbyer med du lta bar bya'o/ /gsungs pa dang / tshogs pa rnams dang gzhi bdag la sogs mi ma yin mang po yang /mya ngan dang cho nge 'debs kyin 'dug pa la/ nam mkha' la bla ma'i sku lus kyis bkod pa sna tshogs ston cing / kye ma 'dus byas mi rtag ste/ /nam mkha'i sprin bzhin 'dus kyin gyes/ /bden med sgyu ma'i chos rnams la/ /bden par bzung bas slus pa yin/ /nga yi lus 'di rgyal ba'i sku/ /skye 'chi can du ma lta cig /nga yi ngag 'di rgyal ba'i gsung / /brjod bral skye med rang sgra sgrogs/ /nga yi sems 'di rgyal ba'i thugs/ /rtogs bral mkhyen pa'i ye shes ldan/ /ces gsungs pa dang / 'ja' 'od dang / me tog gi char chen po babs so/ /de nas gzims khang du byon te/ phyi nang gi ngan sngags/ gnod byed dpe skor thams cad gter du sbas/ bu che rnams bos nas byin rlabasacan gyi rten thams cad nam mkha' la bzhugs 'dug pa la me tog phul/ bla mas phyag mdzad/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzhi dbu'i steng du bkod nas/'di bzhin nyams su long zhig nga la rgya gar gyi bla ma rnams kyis/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba'i dus su 30 shes sems dpa' dngos su stim pa

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/yin pas/ ye shes pa ma gshegs par spur zhu ru mi btub/ da lta bod na nga las lhag pa med de/ nga dang mnyam pa'ang med pas spur ma sbyangs par rin po che'i ga'ur bzhugs su chug la/ mchod pa phul/ de ltar byas na zhing 'di rdo rje gdan dang mnyam par 'gyur zhing / nga'i chos brgyud 'di/ chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du 'ong bar 'dug ste/ khyed rnams kyis gros nyes pa gcig mi byed dam gsungs/ de nas 'pho ba ye shes skar khung ma bsgoms nas/ 'di bzhin nyams su longs shig gsungs tsa na/ dbu thod lag mthil tsam zhig nam mkha' la 'phar te/ sgra 'od 'ja' tshon du gyur nas bde ba can du gshegs so / / de nas spur rin po che'i ga'ur bzhugs rtsis la khams pa'i grwa pa dbang che la mang bas bla ma'i spur mi sbyong na nged kyi skal ba la dbu khyer nas mdo khams su dngul gyi gdung khang bzhengs pa yin zer ba byung nas/ spur sbyangasapas/ rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs dang / lha bzhi la sogs pa'i sku dang gdung ring bsrel/ dung g.yas 'khyil la sogs pa'i rten mang du byon no/ /sgra dang 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du byung ngo / /de rjes sku 'bum bzhengs ring me tog gi char rgyun du bab pa dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lha klus mchod pa phul nas/ bum pa'i phyogs bzhi nas me tog gi 'od phreng ba lta bu yun ring du byung zhing / da lta phan du lha mi thams cad kyi mchod pa'i ngo mtshar can du gyur to/ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus 'di ni/ rtogs ldan zhang sgom chos seng dang rme'u ston pa/bla ma rmog cog pa/ nye gnas rin chen rdo rje dang bzhi la/ bla mas gsungs pa 411

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/ (shernams/ phyogs gcig tu sdebs 'dug pa'i nang nas/ rang gzhan dad pa gso ba'i phyir/ zur tsam yi ger bkod pa'o/ /bla ma rmog cog pa mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus ni/ 'khyungs yul/ lha phu spang rtsa/ rus she yab shor rgan sman chung / yum 'be mo pad ma sgron/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa la/ zheng stod du mkhas grub khyung po'i drung du chos sgor zhugs/ khyod kyis sems can la phan thogs par 'dug pas thos pa gcig gyis gsungs/ de bzhin byed rtsis la 'brom ston zer ba'i dge bshes gcig dang/ dbus phyogs su po ti theg tshad khur ba'i ston pa gcig thos pa la blo sun 'dug pas/ rkyen byas nas thos pa mi byed gdams pa zhu zhus pas/ btsun chung bsgom snga na 'dres 'khyer ba yin gsungs nas ma gnang / bla ma'i dngos slob slob dpon la chings pa'i mtsho skyes bskyed rdzogs gnang / bsgoms pas nyams myong en tsam byung / de rting bla mas mgon po dang nyi khri la sogs 'ga' gnang nas/sngar bzhin gsungs na'ang / snam rdzing khar grub thob khams pa a seng la/gdams pa zhus pas/ khyed bla ma shangs pa gdub bu ba'i slob mar 'dug pas/ da lta bod na khong las mkhas pa med pas/ rta las babs nas/ bong bu la 'dzegs gsungs pa la nan skyed zhus pas bla ma shangs pa'i lta ba don dam phan med gnod med de skyor gsungs/ bskyor bas mnyes nas/ rdul tshon dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/gdams pa zab la mang po gnang / bur sgom nag po la gdams pa zhus/ bla ma'i phyugs la shun brag ru pas(ja/ 11 byas pa la ser ba phabs/ bla ma'i

rgya bod yig tshang chen smo/don du/ sdig byas pa la rnam smin mi yong gi steng du sa lam bgrod nye ba yin/ khyod kyis mgon po dang ri khros kyi gdams ngag de/ nga la'ang byin cig gsungs nas phul lo/ /dge bshes dkon mkhar ba dang / dge bshes ra ba / nyang sgom gad po/ rgya grags bsod/ dge bshes zhu/ slob dpon zhang /dge bshes 'bal sgom rnams la chos zhus nas/ zhong stod du bla ma'i drung du phyin nas/ sgom nyams re tsam phul bas/ sngon ma mnyes na'ang ḍā zhi'i lung bstan yin gsungs nas rne gu ma'i thugs dam thang sku/ dgyes rdor rdo sku dang ka pā li dang / thod pa mtshan ldan/ bum pa 'di rnams khyed khyer chig brgyud kyi gdams pa rnams khyod la 'bogs gsungs nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam bzhi dang / mkha' 'gro mched gnyis kyis gsungs pa'i gdams pa thams cad rim pas gnang / sgrub pa la mi gnod pa gcig yod pa de/ rtse gcig tu bsgom pa yin pas sgoms shig gsungs/ bla ma rgyud sde lnga'i lha dang / lha mo sgrol ma dkar ser du bzhugs pa mthong / sangs rgyas dngos kyi dad mos skyes/ bla ma khyung po snga rting dril bas lo drag zla ba bdun bsten nas/ bde bar gshegs so/ /dngos po thams cad gshegs brdzong la btang / de rting sding mar bsgoms pas sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs nas/ u rgyan la sogs gnas dang lha tshogs mang po mthong / sgam po la byon pa'i lam du bla ma 'jim dang mjal/ khong rang la mdze nad byung ba gsos/ grogs la rmi lam bzung pa 'dra bshad pas/ btsun chung rmi lam rnon por grags/ rje sgam po pa dang mjal/ gdams pa zhal gdams dang bcas pa gnang / slob dpon g.yor 413

ba chen 'od snang la /sa ci'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (she/po ba'i gsung byin/ gnod byed mang po btul/ rmog lcog gi brag la rtse gcig sgrub pa lo bcu gnyis mdzad dus su ka ma sirnyis chos gsungs pas/lto gos kyi 'phri ba chod/ lha tshogs mang po'i zhal mthong / zad sar gyi sprul bskur mdzad pa lug rdzi mos mthong ba dang / brag logs thad kyi nam mkha' la dkyil dkrungs su bzhugs pa mis mthong ba byung nas/ rgad po shug pa pad ma mkhan la sogs pas/ gdan 'dren dang gdul bya che bar byung na'ang 'dzin chags 'dzad/ btsun pa byed pa dang chos zhu mang bar byung / bla ma bur sgom dang rje sgam po ba sku gshegs dus/ rmi lam du byon byung / slob ma la mkhas pa dran don/ dbus pa ye rdor/ sgam po nas dbu che bcu gsum/las stod pa/ lha cig 'od 'bum dpal tshul/ glo bo ba dge bshes rgyal ba/rta nag pa dkon rgyal la sogs mang du byung zhing / chig brgyud kyi gdams pa ni skyer sgang pa dpon ston la phobs te/ grwa slob tshogs pa che bas rmog lcog tu ma shong pas skung lung dgon pa btab/ 'gro don che bar mdzad do/ /de rting bde ba can nas sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi rim gro pas/ rta khyer nas bsu ru byung ba la chos 'phro bshad dgos yod pas mi 'gro gsungs pas rnam smin gyi lus 'di zhog las/ bde ba can du byon cig zer nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas lo gsum gyi bar la chos gsungs/ 'gro don mdzad/ lan cig glo bur du slob dpon jo btsun dge 'dun sogs mang skol gyis gsungs/ tshogs su byon nas chos kyi phyi ma gsungs/ nga 'das nas mngon dgar gsol ba thob/ // brgyud 'di dbon ston skyer sgang pa/

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/de'i slob ma yang slob dang bcas pas 'dzin/ dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro gsungs nas/ tshes bco brgyad kyi tho rangs rdzu 'phrul 'od kyis lam la byon/slob dpon jo btsun 'gro mgon la//brgyud pa mi nyams dbang zhus dkon//dbon po shes rab ras pa la/ /rigs brgyud mi gcod chos gos gtang / /rje yi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /phyin chad thugs rjes 'dzan par zhu/ /ces so / / skyer sgang pa dbon ston thugs rje chen po'i 'brungs yul nang gong gnam la / rus pa 'bal yin/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa la/ khu bo 'bal thams cad mkhyen pa la rab tu byung / de'i gdan sa byed dgos pas/ thos pa gyisazer na'ang lha sa'i dgra lha klu phug tu lce sgom rdzong pa dang mjal/ thugs rje chen po'i chos skor zhus/ rtse gcig tu sgrub pas zla ba phyed bzhi la gtso 'khor gsum po'i zhal mthong / de nas bla ma tsa ri ras pa dang / spen phug pa chen po / rmog lcog pa/ rtogs ldan shad sgom/ lcog ston la sogs bsten/ rmi lam bzung nas chos zhus pas/ slob dpon pad+ma/ lha hi pa/ phyogs kyi go cha/pha dam pa/ bla ma lha pa/ ri bo sgang pa rnams dang yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi zhal dngos su gzigs pa/ thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa / phyag bzhi pa/bcu gcig zhal/ rtsa phyag bdun cu pa/ phyag stong spyan stong /bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ bde mchog kye rdor/ 'jigs byed/ dgra nagagashed dmar/ sgrol ma dkar mo/ mgon po dkar nag la sogs mang po dang rmi lam bzung nas/u rgyan/ po ta la/ 'bras spungs/ mchod rten dpal yon la sogs dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang por byon/ yi dam mkha' 'gro 415

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//mang po la chos gsan/ 'jigs byed/ dgra nag rta mgrin gsum gyi sgo nas/smyon pa brgyad bcu btul/ gza' mchog ra hu las srog snying phul/ chu bdag bha ru nas sbyin bdag byas/ tsho'i nor bu phul/ mchog tu sku drin che ba'i bla ma rmog lcog pas mkha' 'gro'o zab chos mig brgyud kyis thog drangs pa'i gdams pa thams cad ma lus par dbu sung bzhes nas nang chos skyong bran bzhin nyan pa'i bka' bsgo mdzad/ byin gyis brlabs pas sku drin dran pa'i 'bul mo che thengs gnyis/ kung lung du phul ba/ chos skyong gis kham sa par sprul nas bsu skyel byas/ dbyar ngo gcig bla ma 'khrid skyong ba'i chos bsgo ba mdzad/ rang sgom 'khrid kho na la spro na'ang khu bo 'bal bas tshad ma'i gdan sa byed dgos zer nas/ bsu mi rta pa sum brgya byung dus bla ma dam la sgar nas skyer sgang du gdan sa byas/ sku 'bum bzhengs 'bul mo che rting mar bla ma gdan drangs nas/ skyer sgang du phebs dus nyams bsdur mdzad pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas rgya gar gyi bla ma grub thob phal che ba las mkhas grub khyung po thugs dam bzang ba yin 'dug de las nga dge sbyong bzang ba 'dug gsung gi yod/ nga las khyed nyams rtogs bzang bar 'dug pas khang steng nas phyam tshe phyor ba las/ ba la mdzo skyes so zer ba'i skad thengs ma gsum thon gsungs/ mos gus dang 'bul bas bla ma mnyes par byung zhing / rig brgyud kyi bka' babs pa'o/ /grwa slob yon bdag ni/ gha dang rgya'i rgyal po bla ma sog pa/ ngam shod pa'i dge bshes phar phyin pa dang / dge bshes chos rgyal/skar chung btsad po/ zhang btsun rgyal ṭ+wāṃ/6gnam bar ba shad sgom ming sring la

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/sogs pa skya btsun mang po chos kyis smin cing nad gdon las grol nas thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong ba sha stag byung ngo / /de ltar bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad nas/ dgung lo bdun cu don gsum bzhes pa'i ston zla ra ba'i tshes bcu gsum la skyer sgang du zhi bar gshegs te 'di nas mngon dgar 'gro/ chos brgyud 'di g.yor po stod pa gcig gis 'dzin par yod cing / rdo rje 'am pa gi lung bstan bzhin/ mi rabs bdun brgyud thims nas/ chig brgyud kyi zab chos mkha' 'gro'i zhal gdams 'di phyogs su khyab nas/ gdul bya snod ldan yang mang du byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gsungs pa la sogs lung bstan mang po yang gnang ngo / /yol phu ri gong pa gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i 'khrungs yul ni/ yol gyi mda'/ rus ni gnyan yin/ de yang sku gzhon nu nyid nas chos kho na'i gtam dang / spyod lam la brtson par gyur zhing / dgung lo bcu gcig pa la gung po mkhar du slob dpon ston ye la chos sgor zhugs/bcu bdun pa la/mkhan po byang sems pa la dge tshul byas/ nyi shu la mkhan po bzod pa ba la bsnyen rdzogs zhus nas mkhan slob de pa dang / slob dpon e pa bla ma grags rgyal ba sogs la 'dul ba sogs bslabs so/ /slob gnyer cung zhig zhu dgos dgongs pa la las stod 'khyams po bya ba'i mched grogs kyis sgom sgrub la blo bskul nas skyer sgang du byon pas dbon ston pa'i shangs pa'i chos skor dang / mkha' 'gro'i zab chos chig brgyud kyi gdams pa thams cad bum pa gang byor gnang / chosaskyong 'khor bcas bran bzhin nyan pa'i bka' bsgo dang / ri go dgon pa 417

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ (ne'adebs pa skabs 'di tsam nas spyod pa ba'i tshul bzung / slob ma stod ldan bcu phrag gcig 'ong ba de skye bo 'bum phrag gcig las lhag go gsungs pa la sogs kyi lung bstan mang po mdzad nas slob ma'i thu bor bzung / de dus thugs rje chen po dang /sgrol ma dkar mo zhal mthong /yang 'bri khung dang / bla ma gtsang pa la'ang gdams pa zhus/ bla ma las stod mgon po ba la rgya gar nas bla ma dur khrod nag po'i lung bstan yin zer nas chos sgo skyel la byung /bsnyung las grol bar byas pas sku drin che gsungs/ bla ma skyer sgang pa dang nam mjal dus thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong rgyun par zhal mthong /rmi lam bzung nas yi dam dang zhing khams gnas chen mang du mthong / khyad par grub chen brgyad cu dang / rdo rje phag mo/ ḍā ki ma yi gu ma/ su ka ma sirnyi zhal gcig ma/ thod pa rgyan chen la sogs 'dzoms nas chos ci bzang mdun mdzad par byon/ de thams cad kyi gdams pa dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gsol ba'i skal ba gnang / nga'i slob ma lngas kyang de dus bdud rtsi myong yod pas ngo mtshar che/ ming bshad par mi bya gsungs/ mgon po lcam bral 'khor bcas la mi lab pa bzhin byas chog par byung zhing / chu bdag bha ru nas sbyin bdag byas/ gzhan yang rmi lam bzung nas dur ra'i btsan dang /lde'u yang dkar dang /chu bo ri'i sgo ba bzhi dang / gnyan mkhar nag la sogs gdug pa can mang po btul/ srog snying phul lo/ /bla ma 'dis/ dus gsum gyi skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad mkhyen na'ang / blo dman gyi blor mi shong bas/ log rtog gi rgyur song dog ni/ phal cher bka' rgyas bsdams pas

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/na sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen por grags so/ /grwa slob rnams la zhal gdams mdor bsdus gsungs pa ni/ nga yi lus dang rgyal ba'i sku/ /tha dad ma yin rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag gi ngag dang rgyal ba'i gsung / /dbye ba med do rnal 'byor pa/ kho bo'i sems dang rgyal ba'i thugs/ /gnyis med gcig tu rtogs par gyis/ /'bras bu rang shar lha sku dang / /sku gsum dbyer med bde chen yin/ /ces pa la sogs gsungs so/ /nga ni 'di nas shar phyogs me tog bkram pa'i zhing du/ sangs rgyas pa khro'i dpal bya bar 'gyur bas/gsol ba der thob cig gsungs so/ kha rag sil ma (brag dgon pa )ba chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa ba'i 'khrungs yul/ kha rag tsa'i sil ma/ rus ya ngal dkar po/ rigs bon po'i brgyud yin na'ang bon la thugs ma song / gzhon nu'i dus nas mi rtag pa kho na rgyud la skye bar byung zhing / dgung lo bcu pa la gangs bzang nas ma cig sprul sku byon nas dbang bskur/ chos gsungs/lung bstan/ bcu gsum pa la/ bla ma tsā ri ras pa la rab tu byung / mtshan brtson 'grus seng ger btags/ de dang slob dpon sregs dang / sum pa ras pa/ bla ma sbu ma ba/ bla ma spang po ba/ slob dpon tshogs ston shag bla ma khro phu ba/ bla ma sa skya pa/ slob dpon gtsang pa/ slob dpon jo gdan/ slob dpon grub thob/bla ma mkhar rgyab pa/slob dpon rdzo rgyal/slob dpon khams ston rnams la gdams pa mang du zhus/ bcu dgu pa la/ slob dpon chosargyal ba la bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ de rting slob dpon rngog ston bya ba sa khro rnam gnyis la'ang phyag mi 'tshal/ khong las nga mkhas zer ba de dang mjal/ chos 419

'tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ (//zhu dus khong pa'ang sgom sgrub la thugs song 'dug pa dang / rang yang bla ma grub thob cig bsten nas chu 'thung gin sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed 'dod pas de 'dra ba'i bla ma gar yod dris pas/ slob dpon na re/ po yul phu ri gong dgon pa na/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs/ 'od gsal mngon du gyur/ yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ chos skyong bran du 'khol ba'i gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig yod par 'dug gsungs nas lung bstan/ der byon pas/ bla ma mnyes te mjal grogs la sku gsum bya ba'i chos 'brel gnang /de rting / dbang bskur/ shangs pa'i chos skor dang / khyad par rig brgyud kyi zab don zhal gdams thams cad bum pa gang byo dbu snyung bzhes nas gnang / chos skyong lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ mi lab pa bzhin du ngo sprad/bran zhing nyan pa'i bka' bsgo mdzad/ de nas 'khrid bskyangs pas/ zhag nyi shu rtsa lnga la sprul bsgyur sbyong spel thub pa byung bas bla ma'i zhal nas/ sngon rgya gar gyi bla ma grub thob rnams las/ mkhas grub khyung po nyams rtogs bzang /de las mnyam med chen po bzang / de nas skyer sgang pa/ rim pa bzhin bzang du song zer/ nga las ni/ khyed dge sbyor bzang bar 'dug pa/ 'di 'dra'i dge sbyor skye lugs/da lta rgya bod gang na'ang med/khyod kyi 'khrid btab tshad thebs par 'dug zhing / 'gro don rgya chen po 'grub par 'dug gsungs shing / lung bstan zhal gdams mang du gnang ngo / /dge sbyor la brtson par mdzad pas/rje btsun ma dang bla ma ḍa ki mang pos bskor ba dang / sangs rgyas stong rtsa bde mchog lha lnga/ kye rdor lha dgu/ mahā /2 sdu lha lnga/ 'jam dpal thugs rje chen

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/po mkha' lding rgyal po/ /rta mgrin/ khro gnyer can/ mkha' spyod ma dkar mo la sogs zhal mthong / byin rlabs zhal gdams gnang / brag dgon du lo gcig dbu sngas la mi 'jog pa'i sgom rtse gcig byas pas zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin rnams rgya chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gang mos su rmi lam bzung nas phyin chog pa byung / rgyal po dang klu bdud btsan la sogs pa'i gnod byed mang po rmi lam bzung nas ba lha pa/ chos skyong 'khor bcas la/sdig ma gsog byas na'ang tshig 'jam rtsub cung zad la'ang gnod lan 'jal ba yod kyin 'dug pa rnams bkag kha gnon gang thub byas/ sman lung phu ru zla gcig snyung nas grongs la khad pa'i dus su/ tsha drags brag ring gi btsan gyis bal yul nas sman blangs nas phul ba dang thugs dam rtse gcig mdzad pas sung las grol te sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad do/ /bla ma 'di'i rjes nas chig brgyud kyi bka' rgya grol te/ khong gi slob ma/ chos rje shangs ston dang / mkhas btsun gzhen nu grub la sogs mang du byon zhing /slob ma'i mchog grub thob brgya rtsa brgyad du grags pas chos brgyud nyin mo ltar phyogs kun tu gsal bar byas te dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa lags so / / brgyud pa rin chen mdun ma 'di bris pa'i//dge tshogs rin chen phyogs bcu kun khyab ste/ /dal 'byor rin chen thob pa'i mi rnams kun/ /'gro kun rin chen brtson 'grus nyid gyur cig/ //421

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'gung gces bsdus/ (she// 'jig rten rnam gzhag mdo nas nye bar btus pa 'ga' bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/ko ṣi lo ka pradzñā ya ti/ bod skad du/ mdzod dang 'jig rten bzhag pa'i mdo/ bam po gcig go/dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo / / 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs dus/ bdud nag po dang lha bu'i bdud thams cad/srin po'i rgyal po mgrin bcu dang srin po'i rigs thams cad/ mi pham sgra'i lu ba can la sogs mu stegs thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das la rgol ba/go'u ta ma khyod kyis thams cad mkhyen na 'jig rten gyi gzhi 'di ji ltar gnas sems can ji ltar skye zhing 'khor/ lus dang / tshe'i tshad ji tsam yod/bskal pa'i grangs dang / nges tshig gang yin/ 'khor ba'i rgyu gang yin/ lasagang byas pas 'khor/ mya ngan las 'das pa bya ba ji ltar 'gyur/ thar pa'i lam ji lta bu zhig bsgom zhes smras pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag thams cad ni sems can gyi las las byung ste/ zhes pa nas/phyi stod kyi 'chags 'jig nang bcud sems can gyi skye 'chi/ khams gsum gyi dbye ba/ bskal pa'i grangs la sogs pa rnams rgyas par bstan cing 'khor ba'i rgyu ni/ bdag tu 'dzin pa ma rig pa'i dbang gis mtshan mar 'dzin/ rtag par 'dzin/ chad pa 2 2 pas khams gsum dang sa dgur

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/'khor te/ khams gsum ni/ 'dod khams la/ lha rigs drug gzugs khams la lha rigs bcu bdun/ gzugs med khams la lha rigs bzhi'o/ /sa dgu ni/ lhung ba yod pa dmyal ba'i sa/ /yi dwags byol song bying gi sa/ /bsod nams grub pa mi yi sa/ /kun tu g.yo ba rlung gi sa/ /mtho ris go 'phang lha yi sa/ /gzhal yas rin chen bkod pa'i sa/ /mtshan ni brtan pa sprin gyi sa/ /dri med ye shes ngar ldan sa/ /ming gi mtshon pa skye med sa'o/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa 'khor ba'i chos ni/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar rnams 'khor ba'i rgyu'o/ /de yang / las gang byas pas gcor zhe na/ mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga dang/ de dang nye ba lnga/ lci ba bzhi/ log pa brgyad/ kha na ma tho ba drug gi las rnams byas pas sdug bsngal gsum dang /brgyad dang / mi khom pa brgyad/ rgyu drug rkyen bzhi/ 'bras bu lnga/ sgrib pa lnga/snyigs ma lnga rnams kyis 'khor ro/ /de'ang mi dge ba bcu ni lus kyis srog gcod rku 'phrog mi tshangs spyod/ /ngag gi rdzun g.yo phra ma ngag 'khyal lo/ /yid kyis brnab sems gnod sems log lta'o/ /rgyas bshad re re la'ang gsum gsum yod/ /srog gcod gsum la 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /gti mug sgo nas gcod pa dag dang gsum/ /ma byin len gsum mthus sgyus 'jab bus dang / /'dod log gsum po chos khrims bdag pos bsrungs/ /rdzun gsum dbye ba mi chos bla ma'i rdzun/ /phan pa'i rdzun dang phan gnod med pa'i rdzun/ /phra ma btsan phra lkog phra gzhogs phra gsum/ /tshig rtsub gsum ni rgyud rtsub lan rtsub dang / /yon tan ༷/ tu ltas te rtsub pa'o/ /ngag 'byal

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 2 gung gces bsdus/ (sheshugs byung gnod par yengs pa dang //yang dag nyid du lta ba ngag 'khyal lo//brnab sems bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis ka gsum/ /gnod sems bdag gzhan gnyis kur gnod pa'o/ /log lta gsum po rtag lta chad lta dang / /bden par smra la bkur pa 'debs pa'o//spyir du mi dge bcu po rnam smin che//de'i nang nas che ba re re yod//srog gcod nang nas pha ma byang sems bsad//dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor la ma byin blangs/ /'dod log dgra bcom ma dag sun phyung dang / /mi chos bla ma phra ma dge 'dun dben/ /tshig rtsub rten gsum brnyas dang ngag 'khyal gyis/ /dge slong thugs dkrugs brnab sems dkon mchog nor/ /gnod sems bde gshegs sku la ngan sems kyis/khrag phyung log lta dam chos bden pa la//skur ba btab pa mchog tu rnam smin che/ /mtshams med lnga ni/ pha bsad ma bsad dgra bcom bsad pa dang / /dge 'dun dbyen byas bde gshegs sku bcom mo/ /de dang nye ba lnga ni/ dgra bcom sun phyung slob ma bsad pa dang / /byang sems bsad dang dge 'dun 'du ba yi / / sgo 'phrog bde gshegs mchod rten bshig pa'o/ /lci ba bzhi ni/ nyams pa'i lci ba log pa'i lci ba dang / /dmad pa'i lci ba bskur ba'i lci ba'o/ /rgyas bshad re re bzhi 'gyur dang po la/ /mi chos mna' lci nyan thos 'dul khrims lci / / byang sems sdom dang gsang sngags dam tshig lci/ /gnyis pa log pa'i lci ba rnam bzhi ni/ /sgom chen phyag lci sgrub pa'i bza' lhung lci/ /sngags pa'i nor lci mkhas btsun gong lci'o/ /gsum pa smad pa'i lci ba la yang bzhi/ /gti mug dbang gis 'phags pa'i s+t+ri ༵ smad/ /nga rgyal dbang gis bden

rgya bod mig tshang chen mo/pa'i chos la smad/ /phrag dog dbang gis grogs kyi yon tan smad/ /phyogasaris dbang gis 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /blang dor byas rnams smad pa'i lci ba'o/ /skur ba'i lci ba rnam bzhi 'di lta ste/ /mnyam nyid chos la khyad du gsad pa lci/ /rang bzhin med la gal du 'dzugs pa lci/ /mtshams med lnga las ngan sems khrag byin lci/ /mi dge bcu la log par lta ba lci/ /log pa brgyad la phyi nang bzhi bzhi ste/ /phyi yi bzhi dkar phyogs smad nag phyogs bstod/ /dad can tshogs bcag dge can thugs dkrugs so/ /nang bzhi spang bar mi rung dam chos spangs/ /slob dpon sku smad dam tshig gnyan po bral/ /skyung bar mi rung mched lcam gdung sems skyungs/ /de ltar log lta brgyad la spyad na ban song skye/ /theg log dmyal ba lta log yi dwags dang / /spyod log dud 'gro phyin pas log pa dang / /gshin rjer skye zhing chos log mu stegs dang / /dam rdzas log pa dug 'gyur sngags log rkyen/ /bden pa'i don la log na ru trar skye/ kha na ma tho drug la phyi nang gsum/ /phyi gsum rus snga kha nas shing shor dus/ /byib pa ba dang rus snga gsum kha yi/ kha na ma tho smras pas ngan 'gror lhung / /nang gi gsem po gsang sngags zab mo'i chos blo dman la gtad de yis rim par smad/ /dpon slob dam tshig khyad gsod dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /sdug bsngal gsum ni/ sdug bsngal nang gi sdug bsngal ngan song che/ /'pho zhing 'gyur pa'i sdug bsngal mi la che/ /'du byed sdug bsngal lha la che ba'o/ /sdug bsngal brgyad la phyi bzhi nang bzhi ste/ /phyi bzhi dgra phrad gnyen bral yod pa 'phrogs/ /med pa btsal gyis ma rnyed dogs pa'o/ /nang 425

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//bzhi rang la rang dbang med pa'o/ /skye dang rga ba na dang 'chi ba'o /mi khom brgyad la'ang phyi nang gnas bzhi ste/ /ngan song gsum dang 'du shes med pa yi / / lha ru skyes rnams phyi'i gnas bzhi'o/ /nang bzhi tha khob skyes dang dbang po chad/ /lta ba log dang sangs rgyas med par skyes/ /rgyu drug ni skal ba mnyam pa'i rgyu dang lhan cig tu 'byung ba'i dang /mtshungs par ldan pa'i/ kun tu 'gro ba'i rgyu/ rnam par smin pa'i rgyu dang byed pa'i rgyu/ rkyen bzhi ni/ rgyu'i rkyen dang bdag po'i rkyen/ dmigs pa'i rkyen dang de ma thag pa'i rkyen/ 'bras bu lnga ni/rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu rgyu mthun dang / /dbang gi 'bras bu skyes bu byed pa'i dang / /'bras bu'i 'bras bu dag dang rnam lnga'o/ /sgrib pa lnga ni/ 'dod la 'dun pa'i sgrib dang gnod sems dang / /gnyid dang rmugs rgod 'gyod pa the tshom sgrib/ /snyigs ma lnga ni/ sems can snyigs ma dus dang nyen mongs dang / /las dang tshe yi snyigs ma dag dang lnga/ /de rnams la brten nas 'khor bar 'khor ba yin no/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa bon de ji lta bur 'gyur zhe na/ des dang por/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/sgrib pa sbyangs/ dal ba brgyad/ 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che blangs/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyis phyug cing / mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang ldan par byas/ las dge ba bcu la spyod/ chos spyod bcu'i rim pa la rgyun du goms par gyur nas lam lnga sa bcu thob par gyur pa de nyid kyis/thar pa'i lam bsgom pa'o/ /de yang / bskal pa grangs med gsum ni/ theg chen pa'i lugs la/ sa gsum pa no/ sdus/ grangs med dang po'o/ /sa bdun

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/pa / grangs med gnyis pa/ sa bcu pa thob pa dang / grangs med gsum pa rdzogs par brtsi ba'o/ /dal ba brgyad ni mi khom brgyad spangs pa'o/ /'byor pa bcu ste gzhan 'byor lnga dang rang 'byor lnga/ gzhan 'byor sangs rgyas byon dang de yis dam chos gsungs/ /bstan pa yun gnas bsgrub pa'i grogs dang 'phrad/ /brtse ldan bla mas rjes su 'dzin dang lnga/ /rang 'byor bstan pa dang 'phrad mi lus thob/ /dbang po kun tshang yul dbus chos dang mjal/ /dkon mchog la sdang khyim thabs sdig las spangs/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun ni / dad dang tshul khrims thos dang gtong ba dang / khrel yod ngo tsha shes dang shes rab bo/ /mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun ni/ rigs ldan gzugs bzang dbang phyug che/ khres rab phun tshogs dbang phyug che/ /nad med shin tu tshe ring ba'o/ /dge ba bas ni/ mi dge bcu spangs pa'o/ /chos spyod bcu ni/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /klog dang kha 'don byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang bsgom pa'o/ /'phags pa'i lam lnga ni/ tshogs lam/ spyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ yang dag lam lnga'o/ /sa bcu ni/ rab dga' dri med 'od byed dang //'od 'phro shin tu sbyangs dka' dang / /mngon gyur ring song mi g.yo ba / / legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ /bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa/ /sabacu thob nas phyir mi ldog /sangs rgyas pa'i rim pa'o/ /sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin zhes pa man gyi bshad pa ni/ nyan thos pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin gyi/bcu gcig pa kun tu 'od dang / bcu gnyis pa ma chags can/ bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa zhes pa ni/ theg chen bla na med pa rnams kyi dgongs pa 427

brtse chen 'od snang la /skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/ (neste / chos kyi sku'i sa thob pa zhes bya'o/ /'di bris dge bas 'gro kun gyis/ /las 'bras bslu med don rtogs nas/ /sal ma rim pa myur bgrod de/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par shog khro dang rdeg dang gshe dang 'tshang 'bru la/ /lan 'don mi byed dge sbyong chos bzhi yin/ /tshe 'di'i che thabs rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /grags dang ma grags bde dang sdug bsngal dang / /bstod dang smad rnams 'jig rten chos brgyad 'di/ /mgo snyoms gyur na byang sems rtsa ba yin/ /pham pa rnam bzhi lhag ma bcu gsum dang / /spang ba sum cu lhung byed dgu phrag bcu/ /sor bshags bzhi dang cho ga phun tshogs pa/ /bslab bya brgyad dang bcu gnyis 'dul khrims kyi/ /rnam grangs nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum po//spyi dang bye brag nyams pa mthol lo bshags//log pa 'tsho ba rnam lnga'i rnam grangs ni/ /gzhe ges slong rnyed pa 'tshol ba dang / /rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba dang / /tshul 'chos rnyed pa 'tshol ba dang / kha bsags rnyed pa 'tshol ba dang / /thabs kyis 'jal bas rnyed pa 'tshol ba dang lnga'o/ /de ltar log 'tsho'i rnyed 'tshol lnga spangs nas/ /'khor gsum rnam dag brnyed pa'i rnyed rdzas kyis/ /dkon mchog mchod dang dbul phongs la spyin na/ /rnyed 'tshol mchog gyur rang gzhan phan bde 'byung / /428

rgya bod migazung chen mo/ / chos rgyal 'phags pa'i shes bya rab gsal nas sdod bcud kyi chags tshul mdor bsdus bzhugs/ /su sti/ bsam 'phel bla ma kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras/ /smra ba'i seng ge 'jam dbyangs zhabs btud nas/ /de yi rnam 'phrul chos rgyal 'phagasapa yis/ /mdo rgyud don bsdus shes bya'i gnas rnams kun/ /rab tu gsal byed bstan bcos brtsams pa las/ /mdor tsam bsdus pa 'di dag bdag gis 'bri/ /dang por rdul grangs 'gyur khyad brtsi ba ni/ /bcang bzung bzhig tu med pa phra rab rdul/ /bdun 'gyur rdul phran lcags chu ri bong rdul/ /lug glang nyi rdul sro ma shig nas rnams//de bzhin re re bzhin du bdun 'gyur te//nas bdun sor gcig bcu gnyis mtho gang la/ /mtho do khru gang khru bzhi 'dom pa gang / /de dag lnga brgyar rgyang grags de brgyad la/ /dpag tshad gcig tu brtsi ba rab gsal lugs//snod kyi chags tshul dang po stong pa la//phyogs bcu'i rlung g.yos dkyil 'khor rgya gram gyi/ /rngams su dpag tshad sa ya drug 'bum dang / /rgya khyon grangs med de yis brten pa'i steng / /chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po mthug rngams la/ /chig 'bum rwa can ('bum phrag bce gcig dang stong phrag nyi tso thad rkar sa ya gcig /nyis 'bum sum stong brgya phrag phyed dang lnga/ /de dag 'og gi rgya mtsho brgyad ldan chu/ /de rlabs spris ma gser gyi sa gzhi ni/ /rngams su dpag tshad sum 'bum nyis khri dang / /thad ma'i 429

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (//tshad ni 'og gam mtsho dang mnyam/ /gnyis rka'i mtha' bskor thad la gsum 'gyur ro/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor mi mjed 'jig rten khams/ /sa chu'i dkyil 'khor gling bzhi ri rab gdan/ /gser gyi sa steng char babs rgya mtshor gyur/ /rlung gis bsrubs pa'i khams rab bsdus pa la/ /ri rab 'bring bsdus gser gyi ri bdun dang / /tha mas lcags ri sna tshogs bsdus pa'i gling / /rim par chags shing lhun po'i shar phyogs dngul/ /lho phyogs be+e ḍūr nub phyogs shel dmar po/ /byang phyogs gser dang ri bdun gser 'ba' zhig /gling brgyad shas cher sa dang khor yug lcags/ /ri rab dpang la dpag tshad chig 'bum dang //drug khri yod pa mtsho mtshams yar mar phyed//ri bdun mtho shos gnya' shing 'dzin gyi dpang / /dpag tshad bzhi khri de nas bskol mda' 'dzin/ /seng ldeng can dang lta na sdug ri dang / /lta rna rnam 'dud mu khyud 'dzin rnams la/ /rim bzhin phyed mar phyi ma lcags ri'i dpang / /dpag tshad sum brgya phyed dang bcu bzhi yod/ /thad rka'i tshad rnams dpang dang mnyam pa'o/ /ri rab bar gyi mtsho bdun kha zhed la/ /nang la dpag tshad brgyad khri de nas phyir/ /rim bzhin phyed 'phri mu khyud 'dzin mtsho la/ /dpag tshad chig stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /klu rgyal rtse zhing rol pa'i gnas yin pas/ /rol pa'i mtsho bdun yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /ri rab ri bdun mtsho bdun gru bzhi las/ /ba tshwa'i mtsho dang lcags ri sgo mor gnas/ /mu khyud 'dzin pa lcags ri'i bar gyi tshad/ /dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri nyis stong yod/ /ba tshwa'i rgya mtsho'i mthas bsko/ )pag tshad grangs/ /sang phug gsum

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ drag 'bum bdun brgya dang / /lnga bcu yod cing phyogs kun 'dres pa yis/ /mtsho gcig rgya mtsho chen po bzhir grags pa/ /lhun po'i phyogs bzhi'i ngos kyi kha dog bzhin/ /mtsho de gling rnams de dang mthun pa'i phyir/ khor yug lcags ri'i mtha' bskor sa ya 'bum/ /drug 'bum nyis stong drug brgya nyer lnga yod//ri rab lho phyogs 'dzam gling shing rta'i dbyibs/ /sog kha'i yu ba chu ngos bstan pa la/ /dpag tshad phyed bzhi gzhan phyogs gsum po la/ /stong phrag gnyis gnyis shar na rnga yab dang / /nub na rnga yab gzhan yod 'dzam gling dbus/ /ma ga dha nas byang du ri nag po/ /dgu brgyud gangs ri spos ngad de yi phyir/ /spos ri ngad ldan de gnyis bar na mtsho/ /ma dros gru bzhi zab dang ngos ri'i tshad/ /dpag tshad lnga bcu re re de'i chu/ /gtsang dang dwangs dang rnyog pa med/ /mngar dang dri zhim 'jam pa dang / /mgrin pa lto bar mi gnod pa/ /yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa yin/ /de las chu bo bzhi 'bab si ta dang / /gaṅgā si rgyu pak+ṣu zhes pa'o/ /spos ri ngad ldan byang phyogs dpag tshad grangs/ /nyi shu sa na brag gi rang bzhin las/ /gser gyi bya skyibs lha min ngos zhes pa / / phyogs rer dpag tshad lnga bcu rngams kyi tshad/ /phyed bzhi gyen 'phags brag g.yog brgya stong yod/ /brag de'i byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na/ /sa la'i ljon shing rab brtan 'dom bzhi bcu/ /thur zug brgyad cu gyen du 'phags te yod/ /de yi shar phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na/ /rdzing bu dal 'bab dbyibs zlum mtha' bskor la/ /dpag tshad brgya dang lnga bcus bskor ba yod/ /brgya byin g.yul ngor spyod du spyan pa'i mchog /glang chen rab brtan

ba chen 'od snang lag 'i cho 'byung gce bsdus/ (naglang g.yog brgyad stong bcas/ /gser gyi bya skyibs ljon shing dal bab du/ /dgun dbyid ston dus zla ba bzhi bzhi gnas/ /gzhan yang 'dzam gling nub na u rgyan zhes/ /rdo rje chen po'i pho brang rig 'dzin gnas/ /lho phyogs rgya mtshor gru 'dzin ri rtse na/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rtsa bar sgrol ma dang / /shar phyogs ri bo rtse lngar 'jam dpal bzhugs/ /yul chen bcu drug yul phran stong gnas pa'i/ /mi rigs mi 'dra sum brgya drug cu dang / /skad rigasami gcig bdun brgya nyi shu yod//ma dros mtsho 'gram 'dzam bu kri khri'i shing //'bras bu cher smin mtsho nang lhung pa'i sgra/ /'dzam bu zhes byas mtshon pas 'dzam gling grags/ lta na ra gyi lus 'phags gling ni zla gam la/ /ri rab ngosabastan bcad kha'i dpag tshad grangs/ /sum brgya lnga bcu gzhan gsum drug stong ste/ /byang na lus dang lho na lus 'phags yod/ /de gsum gling gzhan rnams las lta na sdug/gyen du 'phags dang mi rnams gzugs bzang bas/ /lus 'phags po zhes grags pa de ltar yin/ /byang na sgra mi snyan ni gru bzhi la / / ngos rer dpag tshad nyis stong nub phyogs na/ /sgra mi snyan dang shar na de yi zla/ /shing dang sha za'i skad kyis zhag bdun nas/ /'chi ba'i sgra byung de phyir sgra mi snyan/ /nub kyi ba glang spyod ni zlum po la/ /mtha' bskor dag la dpag tshad bdun stong dang / /lnga brgya yod cing lho na g.yo ldan dang / /byang na lam mchog 'gro yod de yi mis/ /phal cher ba glang rin chen longs spyod pas/ /ba glang spyod zhes grags pa de'i phyir/ /gling phran brgyad pa'i rgya khyon byed ma la/ /dbyibs dang 'chags tshuX2 ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /ri bdun gling

rgya bod yig tshang chen slo/rnams ri bo thams cad kyang / /ri rab dang mtshungs thur du brgyad khri zug /'dzam gling khong na sing gha'i gling dang ni/ /gser gyi zangs gling zla ba'i gling la sogs/ /gling phran du ma yod cing gzhan gsum la'ang / /de bzhin gling phran yod rnams de khog tshang / /steng dang phyogs su dpag tshad bzhi yod pa/ /shing rta sna tshogs lho na g.yul 'jug gnas/ /rtsub gyur tshal dang nub na spyod lam gnas/ /'dres pa'i tshal dang byang na brtse dga' la/ /rol gnas dga' ba'i tshal zhes bzhi po de/ /gru bzhi dpag tshad stong res 'khor ba yod/ /tshal bzhi'i phyi rol dpag tshad nyi shu na/ /bde zhing 'jam pa'i sa gzhi bzang po ni/ mang rta can dang rtsub gyur 'dres pa can/ /dga' ba can rnams rgya khyon tshal dang mnyam/ /grong khyer lta na sdug gi byang shar na/ /dpag bsam ljon shing yongs 'du sa rtol zhes/ /thur du dpag tshad lnga zug steng du brgya 'phags shing / /lnga bcur lo 'dab 'dod rgu ster ba yod/ /de'i 'og na lwa ba ltar dkar ba'i/ /a mo li da'i rdo leb chu zheng la/ /dpag tshad lnga bcu mtha' ma nyis brgya yis/ /'khor ba'i gru bzhi mthong dga' yid 'ong yod/ /grong khyer lho nub chos bzang mdun sa zhes/ /dpag tshad dgu brgyas 'khor ba'i zlum po yod/ /de dbus brgya byin chos ston gser khri dang / /mtha' la nye dbang so gnyis gdan bshams yod/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas nas steng phyogs la/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri 'phags nas mtha' bral dang / /de bzhin rim par dga' ldan 'phrul dga' dang / /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed man chad 'dod khams te/ /de rnams bar khyad rgya khyon dpag tshad grangs/ /ri rab 433

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsas/ (re/steng nas yar mar gnyis 'gyur che/ /thams cad mkha' la rlung gi dkyil 'khor brten/ /rin chen bzhi la gnas bcas de steng nas/ /bsam gtan dang po'i gnas yod de man la/ /gling bzhi'i 'jig rten khams zer de stong ni / / stong khams chung ngu'i 'jig rten lcags ri gcig /de 'dra stong la stong gnyis bar ma'i khams/ /de yang lcags ri gcig bskor de dag stong / /stong chen 'jig rten lcags ri chen pos bskor/ /gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya bkram pa'o/ /gling bar thams cad mun pa'i rgyal khams yin/ /bsam gtan bzhi po 'jig rten khams bzhi dang //rgya mnyam bar khyad 'og las rim pa bzhin//gnyis 'gyur yar mtho gzugs khams pa zhes kyang / /gzugs med khams bzhi ting 'dzin ldan pa'i phyir/ /gzugs dang gnas dang longs spyod gzhan ma mchis/ /sdod kyi 'jig rten bshad pa de ltar yin/ /bcud kyi sems can dag la rigs drug ste/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro mi rnams dang //lha min lha'o de rnams ming don ni//rang lus dmyal gtub kha zas yid la btags/ /dud cing 'gro bas dud 'gro mi zhes pa/ /ma nu dzi'i don 'ad shas che bas/than lus longs spyod/ /phal cher lha 'dra tshang ba med pas lha min te/ /tshangs lus bde rol mchod 'os lha zhes brjod/ /'di 'og dpag tshad stong phrag nyer bzhir gnas/ /lcags las grub pa me 'bar tsha dmyal brgyad/ /yang gsos thig nag bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod dang / /ngu 'bod che dang tsha ba rab tsha dang / /mnar med ce bya sdug bsngal mi bzad gnas/ /dmyal ba zhes bya 'a/sdu gling 'di'i 'og tu/ mnar med zhes

rgya bod jig tshang chen mo/bya 'og med mthar thug yin/ /yang sos tshe tshad rgyal chen rigs bzhi yi/ /tshe gcig zhag rer brtsis pa'i lo lnga brgya/ /de bzhin rim pas gnyis 'gyur mnar med pas/ /bskal pa gcig gi tshe thub sdug bsngal yang / /'og mar gnyis 'gyur rim bzhin che bar bshad/ /tsha dmyal brgyad po re rer dmyal ba gzhan/ /lhag ma bzhi gnas bcu drug bcu drug ste/ /me ma mur dang ro myags 'dam mtshon cha/ /ral gri'i nags tshal lcags kyi shal ma ri/ khā ta 'dab 'jigs rtsa bar khyi nag zas/ /de rnams thar kyang thal tshan chu bor las/ /de ni nye 'bor zhes bya'i dmyal ba yin/ /tsha dmyal brgyad po'i byang thad rim pa bzhin/ /grang dmyal brgyad gnas chu bur can dang ni/ /chu bur rdol ba so tham a chu chu/ /kye hud zer dang ut+pal lta bur gas/ /pad+ma ltar gas pad chen ltar gas so/ /chu bur can gyi tshe tshad ma ga dha'i/ /bre chen khal grangs brgyad cu'i til 'bru'i grangs/ /de dang mnyam zhing 'og rnams rim pa bzhin/ /nyi shu nyi shu'i 'gyur gyis ring ba'o/ /nye tshe ba'i dmyal ba mi yul gyi/ /thang stong nyi zhag re la mtho ris dang / /dmyal ba'i bde sdug 'dres mar spyod pa yod/ /de ltar tsha grang bcu drug nyi tshe dang / /nye 'bor rnams la dmyal khams bco brgyad zer/ /yi dwags zhes bya rgyal po'i khab kyi 'og /dpag tshad lnga brgya grong khyer ser skya na/ /yi dwags gtso bo gshin rje chos rgyal 'khor/ /sum cu rtsa drug phyi nang sgrib pa can/ /zas sgom sgrib pa me lce'i 'khor lo can/ /de bzhin tshe tshad mi lo khri lnga stong / /rang lo lnga brgya thub cing kha 'thor ba'i/ /yi dwags mi yul dur khrod sha zar bgrang / /dud 435

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (she'agro phal cher phyi'i rgya mtshor gnas/ kha 'thor ba rnams lha mi'i yul na'ang yod/ /tshe tshad klu rgyal 'ga' res bar bskal thub/ /thung ba sbrang bu la sogs yud tsam 'chi/ /lus kyi tshad ni nges pa med par bstan/ /mi rnams gling bzhi gling g.yog brgyad po dang / /gling phran la gnas tshe tshad 'dzam gling pa / / ring thung nges med sgra mi snyan pa stong / /lus 'phags lnga brgya de phyed ba glang spyod/ /byang pa ma gtogs glo bur 'chi ba'ang yod/ /lus tshad 'dzam gling pa rnams rang gru bzhi/ tan ra nub byang bar rim bzhin gnyis 'gyur ldan/ /sgra mi snyan pa ma rmos su lu za/ /dpag bsam shing las gos rgyan ci 'dod 'byung / /gling gzhan gsum po btab 'bru sha za zhing / /rin chen ba glang nor la longs spyod byed/ /mi rnams gdong pa'ang rang rang gling dbyibs 'dra/ shar nub lho na tshar gnyer sa khang dang / /rje 'bangs nye 'brel bag ma gtong len dang / /'brig pa spyod cing nor rdzas mngon zhen yod/ /sgra mi snyan na de rnams kun med cing / /'khrig pa'i tshul tsam gsang gnas rlung rgyu'o/ /lus tshad gos la yang lci srang gcig yod/ /dus bzhi'i ming yod tsha grang bye brag med/ /gling g.yog rnams kyang de yis mtshon par byed/ /lha min gnas ni ri rab chu mtshams nas/ /dpag tshad chig khri chig stong thur gzhal ba'i/khong seng dag na 'od ldan rkang phreng can/ /brtan pa'i grong dang zab pa'i grong khyer na/ /lha min dbang po sgra gcan phreng ba can/ /rab snon thag zangs rigs zhes 'khor bcas rnams/ /brgya byin la 'gran grong khyer gser ldan dang / /pho brang gto can ljon shing ṭ+wāṃ 6ta pa/ /bdun pa nor bzang rdo leb

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/bzang po dang //skyed tshal kun dga' ra ba dga' ba dang //kun tu rab dga' zhes bya sa gzhi'i ming / /kun dga' ma dang rab dga' dga' ma dang / /kun tu dga' ba ma dang bzhi yod cing / /g.yul ngor spyod pa'i glang chen bzod dka' dang / /skyed tshal spyod pa'i ti se gangs brtsegs dang / /rta mchog rgyal po grags 'dzings zhes bya yod/ /mdor na chang med ma gtogs lha dang mnyam/ /grong khyer bzhi po bar khyad gong dang mtshungs/ /dbang stobasamanga' thang 'og nas che bar bshad//lha 'dra dngos ma yin pas lha min zer//lha drug 'og ma rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i 'khor/ /ri rab bang rim dang por gzhed thogs dang / /gnyis par phreng thogs gsum par rtag myos gnas/ /bzhi pa'i lha dang mnyam zhing 'dzin ri yi/ shar phyogs yul 'khor bsrung na yul 'khor bsrung / /byang phyogs lcang lo can na rnam thos sras/ /nub phyogs sna tshogs gzugs na mig mi bzang / /lho phyogs 'phags skyes po na 'phags skyes rgyal/ /nyi zla skar ma lcags ri 'dzam gling gi /ri dang ljon shing la gnas lha tshogs rnams/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i char gtogs sde tshan gcig /de steng ri rab rtse na brgya byin gnas/ /rnam rgyal khang par bde sogs ma la brtsegs/ /lha dang lha min bu mo brtse dgar rol/ /glang chen rab brtan g.yul ngor spyod pa dang / /skyed tshal spyod pa sa bsrung bu zhes pa/ /gnyis kyis dpag tshad bdun bdun 'khor ba yod/ /sprin gyi shugs can rta mchog de dang mtshungs/ /nor lha mched brgyad drag po bcu gcig dang / /nyi ma bcu gnyis tha skar bu gnyis steng / /dbang po nye dbang sum cu rtsa gsum 437

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (5dag /yod phyir lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum zer/ /de nas lha min 'thab rtsod bral ba'i phyir/ /'thab bral zhes bya'i lha gnas de steng na/ /byams mgon theg chen skyong bas dga' ldan zer/ /rang gis sprul nas spyod pas 'phrul dga'i gnas/ /gzhan gyis sprul pa'i longs spyod dpag med la/ /bde bar spyod pas gzhan sprul dbang byed zer/ /de man 'dod pa'i lha drug 'dod khams yin/ /lus tshad rgyal chen rigs bzhi rgyang grags kyi/ /bzhi cha yod cing yar yar bzhi cha 'phar/ /tshe tshad mi lo lnga bcu zhag gcig tu/ /rtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgya rigs bzhis thub/ /de nas gzhan sprul man la 'dab 'gyur 'phar/ /de steng gzugs khams lha rigs bcu bdun ni/ /bsam gtan bzhis bsdus dang po tshangs ris dang / /mdun na 'dod dang tshangs pa chen po'o/ /gnyis pa 'od chung tshad med 'od gsal lo/ /gsum pa dge chung tshad med dge rgyas so/ /bzhi pa dag la rnam pa brgyad yod de/ /sprin med bsod nams skyes dang 'bras bu che/ /de man so so skye bo'i gnas gzhan yin/ /mi che mi gdung gya nom snang ba dang / khren tu mthong ba 'og min gnas dang lnga/ /'phags pa'i gnas yin gtsang ris lha lnga zer/ /bcu bdun po de 'dod lha 'dod chags bral/ /gzugs la chags pas gzugs khams pa zhes zer/ /lus tshad tshangs ris dag la dpag tshad phyed/ /tshe tshad bskal chen gcig gi bzhi cha ste/ /de nas yar yar 'dab 'gyur 'phar bsan / / 'og min pa rnams lus la dpag tshad dang / /tshe la bskal chen gnyis kur khri drug stong / /re re thub cing 4 3 ༷ chen rigs bzhi dang / /sum cu rtsa

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/gsum pa la 'khrig spyod tshang / /dbang gnyis sbyor med gsang gnas rlung rgyu'o/ /rgyal rigs gzhan 'phrul bar rnams phrag gong du/ khye'u bu mo chung ngu rdzus te skyes/ /'thab bral 'khyud dang dga' ldan lag bcangs dang / /'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul ltas pa tsam zhig gis/ /'dod chags gdung ba zhi'o tshangs ris nas/ /'og min pa rnams 'dod chags gtan mi skye/ /yan lag nying lag rdzogs par rdzus te skye/ /nor rdzas nye du'i 'dod zhen gang yang med/ /gzugs khams steng na gzugs med lha gnas bzhi/ /lus med ting 'dzin bye brag bzhir gyur te/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched mtha' yas dang / /ci dbang med dang 'du shes med min rnams/ /tshe tshad bskal chen stong phrag nyi shu nas/ /rim pas bldab 'gyur gong mas brgyad cu ni/ /tshe tshad yin gyi gzugs med 'dod chags pas/ /gzugs med khams kyi lha gnas bzhi zer ro/ /e ma srid pa'i rtser phyin ma thob kyang / /sems kyi gnas lugs ma rtogs 'brul par spyod/ /zo chun khyud mo ji bzhin go ba rnams/ /dal 'byor thob dus btsan sa zin par rigs/ /bskal pa lo zla zhag dus kyi thung mtha' skad cig ma la thug ste/ de'ang phra ba'i skad cig ma'i tshad ni spyad kyi se gol ga rta ges pa gcig gi yun nam/ bud med 'bring pos bal 'dab 'then pa/ 'phang la dkris tshar ba'i yun de brgya nyi shur bgos pa'am cha gcig yin par 'dod do/ /phra ba'i skad cig ma de brgya nyi shu la rags pa'i skad cig ma gcig go/rags pa'i skad cig ma bcu drug la thang cig de sum cu la yud tsam/ de sum cu la nyin zhag dang / de sum cu la zla ba gcig zla ba 439

'tshen na 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (nabacu gnyis la lo gcig go/mdo sil bu las/gcig gnyis/ gsum/bzhi/lnga / drug bdun/ brgyad/ dgu/ bcu brgya/ stong / khri/ 'bum/ sa ya/ bye ba/dung phyur rnams zla bo med pa'i grangs so/ /zla bo dang bcas pa ni/ dung phyur bcu la ther 'bum gcig nas/ phrag khrig rab bkram/ gtam/ dkrigs/mi 'khrugs/ khyad 'byin/ spangs sten/ ded 'dren/ mtha' snang / rgyu rigs/'od mdzes/ dpang po/legs 'byin/rtogs 'gro/ 'byings rngul/ rgya rtags/stobs 'khor/ brda shes/ rnam 'byung / stobs mig rtogazhan du gcig bcu zhes bgrangs nas rjes la tshad med bzhi'i ming rnam 'dren pa'ang ngo /)/mas la grangs kyi gnas gzhan drug cu zer ro/ /rgya che rol par gong ltar bgrangs pa'i grangs kyi mtha' na mar rdul phra rab kyi 'jal ba rjes su song ba zhes pa'i grangs kyi ming dang / phal po che nas/ grangs kyi ming mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa'i mthar brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de ni gaṅgā'i rlung gi bye ma rtsis pa'i gzhi byas kyang chod par rung ngo / /bskal pa'i bar la brjod cing bgrangs kyang / mthar thug brjod du med pa'o/ /bskal pa drug ni/ bar gyi bskal pa dang / chags pa'i bskal pa dang / gnas pa'i dang / 'jig pa'i dang / stong pa'i dang /bskal pa chen po'i//bar bskal zhes pa ni/ mi lo ther 'bum bcu la ther 'bum chen po gcig yod pa de ni 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams tshe lo brgyad khri pa nas gzung ste/ tshe lo bcu par gyur pa de la bar bskal dang po'am/ ya thog ring mo zer/ bar bskal gcig go /de rting de 'dra ba thengs bco brgyad la bar gyi /sdu pa bco brgyad zer zhing / yang tshe lo

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ bcu pa nas/ brgyad khri bar gyur pa thengs ga ṇi ga la bar bskal tha ma'am/ma thog ring mo'ang zer te de rnams la bar bskal nyi shu yod do/ /de 'dra ba'i nyi shu'i yun la snod bcud 'jigs pa dang / nyi shu'i kun du stong pa/ nyi shu'i yun du chags pa/ nyi shu'i yun du gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar bar bskal brgyad cu la/ bskal pa chen po gcig zer/dang por chags pa la bar bskal gcig 'gro ba'i tshad ni/thog mar rlung gi dkyil 'khor brtsam pa nas/mthar mnar med kyi dmyal bar sems can gcig skyes pa'i bar yin no/ /bcud kyi sems can ni/ stong gsum 'di mes zhig pa'i rjes la 'od gsal gyi lha las 'bab ste/ 'od gsal gyi lha tshe zad pa rnams tshangs pa'i gzhal yas khang stong par skyes pas na/ 'jig rten gyi spyi mes tshangs pa zhes zer ro/ /de nas lha gnas rim pa bzhin mar babs nas/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang /byang sgra mi snyan/ nub ba longs spyod/ shar lus 'phags po/ mthar lho 'dzam bu gling du skye zhing / de tham sa cad kyang rdzus te skye zhing / tshe lo dpag tu med pa thub/ gzugs khams kyi lha dang 'dra bar yod do//de rting rim gyis dman te 'dzam gling gi rgyal po la snga ba mang pos bkur ba'i dus su ma byin par len pa sogs/ mi dge bcu la spyad pa'i skyon gyis tshe dang bsod nams mar 'gribs te/ tshe lo bcu ba'i dus su mtshon gyi bskal pa zhag bdun dang /nad kyi bskal pa zhag bdun zla ba bdun dang / mu ge thur ma ba dang / gab tshe ba dang / rus gong dkar po ba la sogs mu ge'i bskal pa zhag bdun/ zla ba bdun/ lo bdun byung nas mi phal cher zad/ lhag ma 'ga' re 'dus 441

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()pa phan tshun mthun par 'gyur zhing / nya stong tshes brgyad bsrung ba dang / srog gcod spong ba la sogs dge bcu spyod pa la goms pas tshe dang bsod nams rim gyis 'phel nas/ tshe lo brgyad khri bar gyur to/ /de ltar yar 'phel ba'i dus su/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rnams 'byung ste/ chos khrims kyis sems can skyong ngo / /mar 'grib dus su ni sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten du byon nas 'dren par mdzad/ rang rgyal rnams ni 'phel 'grib gnyis ma'i dus su byon nas sems can rnams bsod nams bsog pa'i zhing du mdzad/bar bskal nyi shu gnas pa'i rjes su/ 'jig pa'i mgo brtsom pa ni/ mnar med kyi dmyal bar gsar du skye ba'i rgyun chad nas stongs te/ tshul 'di nyid kyis dmyal ba gong ma dang / yi dwags dud 'gro/ mi yul/ lha mi/ lha gnas rnams mas yar rim pas stong par 'gyur te/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man stongs par 'gyur te/ de'i bar la bar gyi bskal pa bcu dgu thogs so/ /de nas/ gling bzhir nyi ma bdun shar nas/ rim pas skam ste/ bdun pa la/snod 'di me lte gcig tu 'bar nas mnar med nas tshangs pa'i gnas man mes 'jig go /de la bar bskal gcig thogs te/ 'jig rten 'jig pa la bar bskal nyi shu thogs so/ /de nas stongs pa ni/ bar gyi bskal ba nyi shu'i bar la stongs pa yin no/ /de ltar 'chags pa dang / gnas pa dang /'jig pa dang / stongs pa'i bskal pa rnams la bar gyi bskal pa brgyad cu yod do/ /de dag thams cad la ni bskal pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /snod 'jig pa de la mes 'jig pa dang / chus 'aX/ pa dang / rlung gis 'jig pa dang

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/gsum ste/ thog mar mes 'jig tshul gong du bshad pa ltar 'jig cing /yang char thengs rim pa bdun byung ba'i mthar bsam gtan gnyis pa man/lan tshwa chu nang du bzhu ba ltar chus 'jigs par byed de/ chu de yang rang nyid bskam par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar mes 'jig pa lan bdun re'i rjes la/ chus 'jig thengs re re byung ba'i chus lan bdun zhig pa de'i rjes la yang mes lan bsnyen btud mar 'jig cing de'i rjes la 'chags pa'i 'jig rten de ni/rlung gis 'jig ste de dus bsam gtan gsum pa man chad 'jig pa'i tshe/rlung chen pos ri rab kyang gtor la khad byed pas gzhan rnams smros mi dgos so/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa ni 'byung ba gang gis kyang mi 'jig ste rang skye 'chi'i dus gzhal yas khang dang mnyam du 'byung 'jig byed do/ /bsam gtan gsum pa man rlung des zhig tshar ba'i mthar/ phyogs bcu'i rlung 'dus pa la brten nas gong du bshad pa ltar/ yang bskal pa rim pa bzhin 'chags pa yin no/ /chos rgyal 'phags pas mdo rgyud mtha' dag gi khyad par 'phags pa'i don bsdus bstan bcos ming / khri shes bya rab gsal zhes grags nyi ma yis//bdag blo'i gti mug bsal phyir snod bcud kyi//'chags 'jig khams gsum dbye ba mdor bsdus 'di'i/ /dge bas 'gro rnamasakun mkhyen myur thob shog/ //443

nga tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ (/// yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed chen mo'i mdzad byang dang smon lam bzhugs so/ /su sti/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu yi/ /dgongs bzhed dang mthun 'dzam gling shas che ba'i/ /lo paṇa mkhas grub chos rgyal rim pa dang / /stobs ldan rnams kyis thub bstan rgyas pa'i thabs/ /sna tshogs spel mdzad rnam thar bsgrigs pa yi/ /legs bshad mkhas pa dga' byed yig tshang 'di/ /yig mkhan shākya'i dge bsnyen shrī bhu ti/ /bha dra'i lda pa la 'gror bzang po/༄skung can g.yas ru stag tshang pas/ lkeng pho stag la stag sna dong rtser bkod/ /'di yi dge ba rab dkar dri med des/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /'gro kun bla med byang chub myur thob shog /sngon chad bod 'dir mkhas mang gis bsdebs pa'i/ /yig tshang yig tshogs rgyas pa mang mod kyi/ /de dag kun kyang rin chen gser dang mtshungs/ /tshig gi nor bu rdog btus yi ge'i 'bru/ /dag gsal srad bur brgyus pa'i yig tshang mchog /mdor bsdus don gsal 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser/ /ji bzhin mkhas pa'i khyad nor 'di 'dra dkon/ /skal ldan dga' spro 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig /'di don mthong thos dran pa'i skye bo kun/ /chos rgyal yon mchod rnams la sems dad cing / /sangs rgyas bstan la mchog tu mos pa dang / /rang gzhan dge la bskul ba'i rgyur gyur /sdu /mkhas mang rgyu skar dbus na nyi ma

rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/bzhin/ /gzhan phan bde stong 'gyed pa'i yig tshang 'dis/ /blo ngan rab rib mun nag phyir bsal nas/ /blo gros pad tshal rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /blo gsal ri dwags gtso bo gdong lnga bzhin/ /smra ba'i phyogs la mi 'jigs yig tshang 'dis/ /lta ngan wa skyes tsho gos rnams zil mnan nas/ /phas rgol spobs pa 'joms pa'i rgyur gyur cig /zab yangs rgya mtsho'i klong na bsam 'phel bzhin/ /gang la ci 'dod ster ba'i yig tshang 'dis/ /blun rmongasadabul ba'i sdug bsngal kun bsal nas/ /'dod rgu'i gter kha 'byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig /nor 'tshol skye bo'i khrod na ded dpon bzhin/ /thabs mkhasagru chen ldan pa'i yig tshang 'dis/ /'gro mang phan bde'i rlung gis legs bskyod nas/ /thar pa'i lam mchog ston pa'i rgyur gyur cig /'dod rgu'i bang mdzod legs bshad rgyan gyis spras/ /ngo mtshar gtam brgyud phreng ba'i dra phyed 'phyang / /sangs rgyas byon tshul tog gi nyer mdzes pa'i/ khang bzangasakun 'joms 'di yi phyogs bzhi sa /da lta'i skabs na bstan pa'i srog 'dzin cing / /snyigs dus 'gro mgon chos rgyal rab brtan cing / /rnam thar nor bu'i rgyal mtshan cher btsugs nas/ /snyan grags ba dan g.yo ba'i rgyur gyur cig /dge ba'i bsam pas phyogs bcu mtha' dag nas/ /zab btus legs par sgrigs pa'i yig tshang 'dis/ /mkha' ltar khyab nas bstan pa'i bya ba kun/ /bsgrub pa'i dmigs rkyen byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig /phyogs gcig bsdus na 'dod rgu'i gter mdzod dang / /so sor 'thor na'ang rin chen ras ma bzhin/ /gang ltar gyur kyang phan bde'i yig tshang 'dis/ /'gro 445

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ (nemang dge la bskul ba'i rgyur gyur cig /mdor na bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir du/ /lhag bsam rnam par dag pas bkod pa dang / /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i mthus/ /ji ltar smon pa yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /smra ba'i seng ge 'jam dbyangs mgon po'i sku/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'khor tshogs sku tshe'i tshad/ /zhing khams phrin las bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'jug gyur cig /phyogs dus gnas skabs thamasacad du/ bkra shis dang bde legs chen po'i dpal gyis khyab par gyur cigabacom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smon lam yongs su 'grub pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ta cu thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra bhan+ta re swāhā/ zhes lan cig brjod pas/ rang dang gzhan gyi don du smon lam ci btab pa thams cad gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes mdo sde nas gsal bar gsungs so/ /dge ba'i lasagang byas pa'i rjes su/ oṃ sma ra sma ra bhi ma na ra ka ra mahā la za na hūṃ phaṭa/ces pa tsha bdun bzlas na/ dge ba de bye ba 'phel bar nges pa rgyud sde nas sla sdu smra//sa pa/// g.yas ru stag tshang dpal 'byor bzang po yis/ /thugs bcud las 'ong 'tham gling gsal ba'i rgyan/ /yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal rabs sna tshogs bsdus pa'i bstan bcos 'di/ /yi ge'i 'du byed kun bzang stobs rgyal gyis/ /skyid la sdug pa'i 'jig rten mi yul 'dir/ /mi zas yun ring zos pa'i rin 'bab tu/ /bzhengs pa'i ༷/ bas rgyal bstan rin po che/ /dar zhing

rgya bod yig rmas 'a mo/rgyas la yun du gnas pa dang / /dpal ldan 'brug pa'i chab srid brtan par shog /de'i mthu las bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /bde sgyid los sa spyod dpal gyis rab 'tsho nas/ /yang dag chos dang mjal ba'i smon lam zhu/ /ces pa'ang las rogs mched grogs u rgyan bstan 'dzin nas bskul ba bzhin yi ge 'bri pa pos smon mdun du zhus pa'o/ /de'ang ma dpe dbu med rnying pa yi ge ha cang ma dag pa zhig 'dug pa cung re bzo bcos byas snyam re'ang / shes yon gyis ma lcogs pa'i khar bzo bcos ma rung pa mkhas pa mang po'i zhal rgyun bzhin ma dpe ji bzhin du chad med dpe bshus pa las bzo bcos sogs gang yang byas med la/ des na mkhas pa yongs kyis gzigs lam du nor 'brul mang po yod par srid pas/ bzod gsol lha dang bla ma'i tshogs la bshags par bgyi'o// //447
